articles.title: Indigenous Hunters Drove Bison Off This Tall Cliff for 3,000 Years. It's Only the Second Buffalo Jump Ever Discovered in Texas

paras.en: For thousands of years, Indigenous communities in what is now Texas hunted bison by herding them toward the edge of a high cliff, sending the large animals plunging to their deaths below.
paras.zh: 数千年来，现在德克萨斯州的原住民社区通过将野牛赶到高高的悬崖边缘来猎杀野牛，然后将大型动物扔到下面死亡。

paras.en: That’s the conclusion archaeologists have reached after discovering bison bones, chipped stone tools and arrowheads beneath a 65-foot-tall cliff. Some of the bones bear cut marks suggesting prehistoric butchery, while many others have compression fractures indicating they fell from a great height. Together, the evidence pointed to the discovery of a “bison jump,” researchers report in a paper published earlier this month in the journal American Antiquity.
paras.zh: 这是考古学家在 65 英尺高的悬崖下发现野牛骨头、碎石工具和箭头后得出的结论。一些骨头上有切割痕迹，表明是史前屠杀，而其他许多骨头上有压缩性骨折，表明它们是从高处坠落的。研究人员在本月早些时候发表在《美国古代》杂志上的一篇论文中报告说，所有证据都表明发现了“野牛跳跃”。

paras.en: Archaeologists have found numerous bison jumps across the northern Great Plains, a vast region that stretches from Nebraska to Alberta. But, until now, only one such site had been found in the southern Great Plains, which includes Texas. The newly discovered bison jump, called Nighthawk, suggests the Indigenous practice of herding bison off cliffs may have been more widespread than previously thought.
paras.zh: 考古学家在北部大平原上发现了许多野牛跳跃，这是一个从内布拉斯加州延伸到阿尔伯塔省的广阔地区。但到目前为止，在包括德克萨斯州在内的大平原南部只发现了一处这样的遗址。新发现的野牛跳跃现象被称为“夜鹰”，表明原住民将野牛赶下悬崖的做法可能比之前想象的更为普遍。

paras.en: “The fact that we found this site is pretty incredible,” Tamra Walter, an archaeologist at Texas Tech University, told Texas Parks & Wildlife Magazine’s Eva Frederick in 2023. “It’s a once-in-a-lifetime kind of site. It’s so incredibly rare.”
paras.zh: 德克萨斯理工大学的考古学家塔姆拉·沃尔特 (Tamra Walter) 在 2023 年对德克萨斯公园与野生动物杂志的伊娃·弗雷德里克 (Eva Frederick) 表示：“我们发现这个遗址的事实非常令人难以置信。这是一个千载难逢的遗址。非常罕见。”

paras.en: Nighthawk is located in Caprock Canyons State Park, a roughly 17,500-acre protected area in Briscoe County, situated between Amarillo and Lubbock in the Texas Panhandle. Today, the park is home to the Texas State Bison Herd, which officials say is made up of the descendants of the tens of millions of Southern Plains bison that used to roam the land.
paras.zh: 夜鹰位于卡普罗克峡谷州立公园内，这是布里斯科县的一个保护区，占地约 17,500 英亩，位于德克萨斯州狭长地带的阿马里洛和拉伯克之间。如今，该公园是德克萨斯州野牛群的家园，官员们称该野牛群是由曾经在这片土地上漫步的数千万头南部平原野牛的后代组成的。

paras.en: In November 2021, Rick and Susan Day—science teachers at nearby Lockney Junior High School—were out hiking in the park when they spotted hundreds of bones jutting out from a cliff side, Texas Parks & Wildlife Magazine reported.
paras.zh: 据《德克萨斯公园与野生动物》杂志报道，2021 年 11 月，附近洛克尼初中的科学老师里克和苏珊·戴在公园里徒步旅行时，发现数百块骨头从悬崖边伸出。

paras.en: Archaeologists spent months excavating the site, ultimately determining that it was the first bison jump discovered in Texas in more than six decades. The only other known bison jump in the state is called Bonfire Shelter. It’s located in Val Verde County, close to the Mexico border, and was discovered in the 1960s.
paras.zh: 考古学家花了几个月的时间挖掘该地点，最终确定这是六十多年来在德克萨斯州发现的第一次野牛跳跃。该州唯一已知的野牛跳跃点被称为篝火避难所。它位于 Val Verde 县，靠近墨西哥边境，于 20 世纪 60 年代被发现。

paras.en: Radiocarbon dating revealed that at least seven mass bison kills took place at Nighthawk over a roughly 3,000-year period, as far back as 3,500 years ago. The kill events took place every 500 years, on average.
paras.zh: 放射性碳测年显示，在大约 3,000 年间，早在 3,500 年前，夜鹰至少发生过 7 次大规模猎杀野牛的事件。平均每 500 年就会发生一次杀戮事件。

paras.en: “The simplest explanation for long-lived jump facilities is that these techniques were passed down over long time spans rather than revived again and again,” the researchers write in the paper.
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“对长寿跳跃设施的最简单解释是，这些技术是在很长一段时间内传承下来的，而不是一次又一次地复兴。”

paras.en: At other bison jump sites, researchers think Indigenous hunters likely herded bison into a stampede toward a surprise fall off the edge of a cliff. Nighthawk, however, probably operated “more like ‘walking the plank,’” the researchers write in the paper, with Indigenous hunters taking advantage of the cliff’s natural spur shape to guide the massive animals to their deaths.
paras.zh: 在其他野牛跳跃地点，研究人员认为，土著猎人可能会驱赶野牛，导致野牛突然从悬崖边缘跌落。然而，研究人员在论文中写道，夜鹰的运作方式可能“更像是‘在木板上行走’”，土著猎人利用悬崖的天然山刺形状来引导这种大型动物走向死亡。

paras.en: Scientists aren’t sure what Indigenous hunters did with all the bison meat they obtained from these mass kill events. In the northern Plains, bison jumps are thought to have been used primarily in the fall, to help Indigenous communities stock up on pemmican, a long-lasting concoction made of dried meat and rendered fat, for the impending winter. But Texas was probably too warm for pemmican, as the high temperatures would have caused the fat to melt and, eventually, go rancid.
paras.zh: 科学家们不确定土著猎人如何处理从这些大规模屠杀事件中获得的所有野牛肉。在北部平原，野牛跳跃被认为主要在秋季使用，以帮助原住民社区储备干肉饼，这是一种由干肉和提炼脂肪制成的持久混合物，以应对即将到来的冬季。但德克萨斯州对于肉饼来说可能太温暖了，因为高温会导致脂肪融化并最终腐臭。

paras.en: Dense in protein and calories, pemmican was also eaten by fur traders in the North American wilderness, as well as Antarctic explorers, who combined it with sledging biscuits and water to make a concoction known as “hoosh.”
paras.zh: 干肉饼富含蛋白质和热量，北美荒野的毛皮商人和南极探险家也吃干肉干饼，他们将干肉干饼与雪橇饼干和水混合，制成一种名为“hoosh”的混合物。

paras.en: This leads the archaeologists to posit that, in the south, bison jumps may have been less about food and more about “social or political ambitions,” as they write in the paper. The mass kill events may have brought communities together for ceremonies, trade, celebrations and other events that helped strengthen relationships.
paras.zh: 这使得考古学家推测，在南方，野牛的跳跃可能与食物无关，而更多地与“社会或政治野心”有关，正如他们在论文中所写的那样。大规模杀戮事件可能使社区聚集在一起举行仪式、贸易、庆祝活动和其他有助于加强关系的活动。

paras.en: Whatever the explanation, bison jumping was a large-scale operation that required extensive planning and cooperation among multiple groups of people. “It’s a community activity,” lead author August “Gus” Costa, an anthropologist at Rice University, says in a statement. “They require a large group of people working together to be successful.”
paras.zh: 无论解释如何，野牛跳跃都是一项大规模行动，需要多组人员进行广泛的规划和合作。 “这是一项社区活动，”莱斯大学人类学家、主要作者奥古斯特·“格斯”·科斯塔在一份声明中说。 “他们需要一大群人共同努力才能取得成功。”

paras.en: Moving forward, researchers hope to compare ancient DNA from the bison remains found at Nighthawk to the herd that is roaming around the park today.
paras.zh: 展望未来，研究人员希望将夜鹰发现的野牛遗骸中的古代 DNA 与今天在公园周围漫步的牛群进行比较。

paras.en: “The unique lineage of the Southern Plains bison that live in the park, how far back can we chase that?” Costa tells KFDA’s Canion Cavazos.
paras.zh: “公园里生活着的南部平原野牛的独特血统，我们能追溯到多久以前？” Costa 告诉 KFDA 的 Canion Cavazos。

articles.title: Meet Earth's New 'Mini-Moon' 2026 QQ8, a Six-Foot-Wide Asteroid That's Temporarily Circling Our Planet

paras.en: Earth has a new “mini-moon”—at least for another few weeks.
paras.zh: 地球有一个新的“迷你月亮”——至少还会持续几周。

paras.en: The temporary companion, dubbed 2026 QQ8, entered orbit around our planet in April. Though it was first observed back in August by Hungarian astronomer Krisztián Sárneczky, scientists needed time to confirm whether the object was human-made or celestial. People previously mistook the European Space Agency’s Gaia observatory for a mini-moon, after all, according to Asa Stahl at the Planetary Society.
paras.zh: 这个临时伴星被称为 2026 QQ8，于 4 月进入绕地球轨道。尽管匈牙利天文学家 Krisztián Sárneczky 在八月份首次观测到该物体，但科学家们仍需要时间来确认该物体是人造物体还是天体。毕竟，根据行星协会的阿萨·斯塔尔的说法，人们此前曾将欧洲航天局的盖亚天文台误认为是迷你月球。

paras.en: Finally, on October 29, the International Astronomical Union’s Minor Planet Center announced that the object is, indeed, a space rock. It’ll keep circling Earth until sometime in December or January, after which it will continue its regular orbit around the sun.
paras.zh: 最终，10 月 29 日，国际天文学联合会小行星中心宣布，该物体确实是一颗太空岩石。它将继续绕地球运行，直到十二月或一月的某个时候，之后它将继续绕太阳运行其常规轨道。

paras.en: According to the Minor Planet Center, the object is only about six feet in diameter. Astronomers doubt it poses any danger to Earth, but even if it did get too close, it’s so small that it would probably burn up in our planet’s atmosphere. It’s also orbiting us from fairly far away—roughly 1.5 times the average distance of the moon, Joanna Thompson reports for Live Science.
paras.zh: 据小行星中心称，该物体的直径仅为约六英尺。天文学家怀疑它会对地球构成任何危险，但即使它确实离地球太近，它也太小了，很可能会在我们星球的大气层中燃烧。乔安娜·汤普森 (Joanna Thompson) 在《Live Science》杂志上报道称，它还从相当远的地方围绕我们运行——大约是月球平均距离的 1.5 倍。

paras.en: This tiny traveler isn’t our first mini-moon, which is an informal term. When little objects pass by Earth, they occasionally get captured by our planet’s gravity. They spend less than a year, on average, orbiting us before being flung back into space. Many scientists speculate that we always have at least one mini-moon. A study published last year even suggests Earth hosts at least six of them at any given time. Despite those postulations, only four other mini-moons have previously been observed, since they’re so small and hard to detect, per the Planetary Society.
paras.zh: 这个小旅行者并不是我们的第一个迷你月亮，这是一个非正式术语。当小物体经过地球时，它们偶尔会被地球的引力捕获。它们在被抛回太空之前平均花费不到一年的时间绕我们运行。许多科学家推测我们总是至少有一个迷你月亮。去年发表的一项研究甚至表明，地球在任何特定时间都至少拥有六个这样的行星。尽管有这些假设，但根据行星协会的说法，之前只观察到了另外四个迷你卫星，因为它们太小而且很难被发现。

paras.en: Sárneczky, a research coordinator at the Konkoly Observatory in Hungary, says he spotted 2026 QQ8 while “searching for near-Earth asteroids, as I have done on every clear night since 2020.”
paras.zh: 匈牙利 Konkoly 天文台的研究协调员 Sárneczky 表示，他在“寻找近地小行星时发现了 2026 QQ8，就像我自 2020 年以来在每个晴朗的夜晚所做的那样。”

paras.en: “At the time of its discovery, it appeared just like the nearly 400 other near-Earth asteroids I had found,” he tells Jacopo Prisco at CNN. “Its unique nature only became apparent later, following the precise orbital calculations.”
paras.zh: “在发现它时，它看起来就像我发现的近 400 颗其他近地小行星一样，”他告诉 CNN 的雅科波·普里斯科 (Jacopo Prisco)。 “经过精确的轨道计算后，它的独特性质才变得明显。”

paras.en: That triggered a weeks-long study by astronomers trying to determine the object’s nature, per the outlet. With the help of the Lowell Discovery Telescope in Arizona and the University of Hawaii’s telescope on Mauna Kea, they confirmed it was born in space.
paras.zh: 据报道，这引发了天文学家为期数周的研究，试图确定该物体的性质。 With the help of the Lowell Discovery Telescope in Arizona and the University of Hawaii’s telescope on Mauna Kea, they confirmed it was born in space.

paras.en: These objects are asteroids that, from a certain point of view, appear to behave like a moon of Earth, according to the Planetary Society. However, they’re actually orbiting the sun—their orbital paths are just very similar to our planet’s.
paras.zh: 根据行星协会的说法，这些物体是小行星，从某种角度来看，它们的行为似乎像地球的卫星。然而，它们实际上是绕太阳运行——它们的轨道与我们星球的轨道非常相似。

paras.en: According to Live Science, the current mini-moon is classified as an Aten asteroid, a type of space rock whose orbit around the sun occasionally brings it close to Earth. 2026 QQ8 cozies up with our planet around once every ten years. Although this object’s exact origins are unclear, scientists believe most near-Earth asteroids originate in the main asteroid belt, between Mars and Jupiter.
paras.zh: 据《生活科学》报道，​​目前的迷你卫星被归类为阿顿小行星，这是一种太空岩石，其绕太阳运行的轨道偶尔会使其靠近地球。 2026 QQ8大约每十年与我们的星球亲密接触一次。尽管该物体的确切起源尚不清楚，但科学家认为大多数近地小行星起源于火星和木星之间的主要小行星带。

paras.en: With new telescopes scanning the heavens, scientists expect many more mini-moons to be discovered. For instance, the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile started its decade-long Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST) over the summer, and the telescope has already detected thousands of new asteroids as it watches the Southern Hemisphere sky.
paras.zh: 随着新望远镜扫描天空，科学家们预计会发现更多的迷你卫星。例如，智利的维拉·C·鲁宾天文台在夏季开始了长达十年的时空遗产勘测（LSST），该望远镜在观察南半球的天空时已经发现了数千颗新的小行星。

paras.en: “When the LSST survey starts operating fully, it’s expected to discover lots and lots of things,” says Matthew Payne, director of the Minor Planet Center and an astrophysicist at the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, to CNN. “The expectation is that we’ll go from knowing 1.5 million objects to knowing 5 million.”
paras.zh: “当 LSST 调查开始全面运行时，预计会发现很多很多东西，”小行星中心主任、哈佛和史密森天体物理中心的天体物理学家马修·佩恩 (Matthew Payne) 向 CNN 表示。 “我们的期望是从了解 150 万个物体增加到了解 500 万个。”

articles.title: Scientists Discover Signs of Explosive Volcanic Eruptions 20,000 Feet Underwater—the Deepest Ever Found—in the Mariana Trench

paras.en: Challenger Deep, located in the Mariana Trench in the western Pacific Ocean, is the deepest known point on Earth, plunging 35,876 feet—or nearly seven miles—below the water’s surface.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊位于西太平洋的马里亚纳海沟，是地球上已知的最深点，深达水面以下 35,876 英尺（即近 7 英里）。

paras.en: Now, Challenger Deep can add another distinction to its list: the site of the deepest known explosive volcanic eruptions on Earth. Using a remotely operated underwater vehicle, scientists recovered pyroclastic rocks and “abundant” evidence of ultradeep explosive volcanism from the site. They described their findings in a study published November 22 in the journal Frontiers in Earth Science.
paras.zh: 现在，挑战者深渊可以在其名单中添加另一个特点：地球上已知最深的火山喷发地点。科学家们利用远程操作的水下航行器，从现场回收了火山碎屑岩和超深火山喷发的“大量”证据。他们在 11 月 22 日发表在《地球科学前沿》杂志上的一项研究中描述了他们的发现。

paras.en: The discovery is “surprising and unprecedented,” William Chadwick, a geologist at Oregon State University who was not involved with the work, tells Science News’ Carolyn Gramling. “Imagining this happening is … pretty mind-boggling.”
paras.zh: 未参与这项工作的俄勒冈州立大学地质学家威廉·查德威克 (William Chadwick) 告诉《科学新闻》的卡罗琳·格拉姆林 (Carolyn Gramling)，这一发现“令人惊讶且前所未有”。 “想象这种情况发生……真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: Challenger Deep is a dangerous place for humans to visit, with roughly 1,000 times the pressure we experience at sea level. So, scientists often turn to robots to explore this mysterious submarine depression. In 2024, researchers deployed a Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution submersible called Jason/Medea to explore part of the Mariana Trench.
paras.zh: 挑战者深渊对于人类来说是一个危险的地方，其压力大约是海平面压力的 1000 倍。因此，科学家经常求助于机器人来探索这个神秘的海底凹陷。 2024 年，研究人员部署了伍兹霍尔海洋研究所的一艘名为 Jason/Medea 的潜水器来探索马里亚纳海沟的部分区域。

paras.en: Some people have made the daring journey to Challenger Deep. The first were U.S. Navy officer Don Walsh and Swiss oceanographer Jacques Piccard, who ventured there in a submarine in January 1960.
paras.zh: 有些人已经勇敢地前往挑战者深渊。第一批是美国海军军官唐·沃尔什 (Don Walsh) 和瑞士海洋学家雅克·皮卡德 (Jacques Piccard)，他们于 1960 年 1 月乘坐潜艇冒险前往那里。

paras.en: The underwater device couldn’t reach the very bottom of Challenger Deep without risking implosion, but it did descend to a maximum depth of about 21,300 feet. On three dives, the submersible’s camera spotted flat, lobe-shaped rocks at different spots, some located more than about 19,685 feet below the surface, along a 60-mile stretch. Scientists say this material, some of which was brought back to the surface, represents the remnants of a pyroclastic flow, a fast-moving mixture of hot gas, ash and volcanic rock produced by explosive eruptions.
paras.zh: 该水下装置无法到达挑战者深渊的最底部而不冒内爆的风险，但它确实下降到了约 21,300 英尺的最大深度。在三次潜水中，潜水器的相机在不同地点发现了平坦的叶状岩石，其中一些位于水面以下约 19,685 英尺以上，绵延 60 英里。科学家表示，这种物质（其中一些被带回地表）代表了火山碎屑流的残余物，火山碎屑流是爆炸性喷发产生的热气体、火山灰和火山岩的快速移动混合物。

paras.en: The team couldn’t find the exact location of the eruption, but they suspect it occurred somewhere nearby, along the trench wall. They also don’t know exactly when the eruption occurred, but they think it happened somewhat recently in geologic terms.
paras.zh: 研究小组无法找到喷发的确切位置，但他们怀疑喷发发生在附近的某个地方，沿着沟渠壁。他们也不知道火山喷发发生的确切时间，但他们认为从地质角度来看，火山喷发是最近发生的。

paras.en: “They’re not yesterday, but I don’t think they’re a million years old,” lead author Robert Stern, a geoscientist who retired from the University of Texas at Dallas, tells Live Science’s Stephanie Pappas.
paras.zh: 从德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校退休的地球科学家、主要作者罗伯特·斯特恩 (Robert Stern) 告诉《生活科学》杂志的斯蒂芬妮·帕帕斯 (Stephanie Pappas)：“它们不是昨天的事，但我认为它们还没有一百万年的历史。”

paras.en: Most of Earth’s volcanic activity occurs underwater, forming island chains and extensive networks of hydrothermal vents along mid-ocean ridges. But scientists never expected to find explosive eruptions at such extreme depths, thinking they were only possible in shallower waters.
paras.zh: 地球上的大部分火山活动发生在水下，沿着洋中脊形成岛链和广泛的热液喷口网络。但科学家们从未想到会在如此极端的深度发现爆炸性喷发，认为它们只可能在较浅的水域中发生。

paras.en: “It’s not something that, as a geoscientist, I would have said would be predicted,” Sune Nielsen, a geochemist at the University of Lorraine in France who was not involved in the study, tells Live Science. “Very far from it.”
paras.zh: “作为一名地球科学家，我认为这不是可以预测的，”未参与这项研究的法国洛林大学地球化学家苏尼·尼尔森 (Sune Nielsen) 告诉《生活科学》。 “离它很远。”

paras.en: In Challenger Deep, explosive eruptions were thought to be impossible, since the immense water pressure should prevent volcanic gases from expanding and triggering an explosion. Yet the evidence suggests some kind of volcanic explosion did occur there, raising new questions about what’s possible.
paras.zh: 在挑战者深渊，爆炸性喷发被认为是不可能的，因为巨大的水压应该可以防止火山气体膨胀并引发爆炸。然而，有证据表明那里确实发生了某种火山爆发，这引发了关于可能发生的新问题。

paras.en: “Submarine volcanism is something we’ve got quite big knowledge gaps in,” Peter Rowley, a volcanologist at the University of Bristol in England who was not involved with the study, tells New Scientist’s Matthew Sparkes. “It’s that famous thing that we know less about the seafloor than we do about the moon.”
paras.zh: 英国布里斯托大学火山学家彼得·罗利（Peter Rowley）没有参与这项研究，他告诉《新科学家》杂志的马修·斯帕克斯：“我们在海底火山活动方面存在很大的知识空白。” “众所周知，我们对海底的了解还不如对月球的了解。”

paras.en: Scientists still don’t fully understand how explosive volcanism works at such extreme depths. They suspect, however, that these eruptions function very differently than those that occur on land. As Robin George Andrews writes for National Geographic, perhaps an underwater eruption at this depth would look like “a convulsing, crumbling, splintering stream of toothpaste angrily escaping out of the seafloor.”
paras.zh: 科学家们仍然不完全了解爆炸性火山活动如何在如此极端的深度发挥作用。然而，他们怀疑这些喷发的作用与陆地上发生的喷发有很大不同。正如罗宾·乔治·安德鲁斯为《国家地理》杂志所写的那样，也许在这个深度的水下喷发看起来就像“一股痉挛、破碎、分裂的牙膏流愤怒地从海底逸出”。

paras.en: Another puzzle is the location of the volcanic deposits. Scientists say they sit unusually close to the trench, a subduction zone that began to form about 52 million years ago when the older, denser Pacific tectonic plate started sliding beneath the smaller Mariana microplate.
paras.zh: 另一个谜团是火山沉积物的位置。科学家表示，它们的位置异常靠近海沟，这是大约 5200 万年前开始形成的俯冲带，当时更古老、密度更大的太平洋构造板块开始在较小的马里亚纳微板块下方滑动。

paras.en: In subduction zones, the sinking plate heats up and starts to melt into magma as it dives beneath the overriding plate. Typically, that magma rises to the surface and erupts hundreds of miles from the place where the two plates meet.
paras.zh: 在俯冲带，下沉板块在潜入上覆板块下方时升温并开始融化成岩浆。通常情况下，岩浆会上升到地表并从两个板块相遇的地方喷发数百英里。

paras.en: But scientists found the Mariana Trench volcanic deposits much closer to the meeting point of the Pacific and Mariana plates than they would have expected. One possible explanation for this proximity is that the Pacific plate makes a sharp, steep bend as it sinks beneath the Mariana Plate. This hypothesis might also help explain how Challenger Deep got so far below the surface in the first place, reports Science News.
paras.zh: 但科学家发现马里亚纳海沟火山沉积物比他们预期的更接近太平洋板块和马里亚纳板块的交汇点。对于这种接近的一种可能的解释是，太平洋板块在沉入马里亚纳板块下方时发生了急剧的、陡峭的弯曲。据《科学新闻》报道，这一假设也可能有助于解释“挑战者深渊”最初是如何深入地表以下的。

paras.en: Many questions remain unanswered. But the scientists behind the new work hope their discovery inspires other researchers to explore these largely uncharted underwater environments.
paras.zh: 许多问题仍未得到解答。但这项新工作背后的科学家希望他们的发现能够激励其他研究人员探索这些基本上未知的水下环境。

paras.en: “The trenches are the last frontier,” Stern tells National Geographic. “We’ve opened a door.”
paras.zh: “战壕是最后的边疆，”斯特恩告诉国家地理杂志。 “我们已经打开了一扇门。”

paras.en: New customers can also get free 1-3-day delivery (with real-time tracking) on first-time orders over $35, which seriously helps cut down the convenience cost of getting your 40-lb litter box to your third-floor apartment without having to lug it on the L train yourself (speaking from experience, don’t endure what I’ve had to). Get the convenience without paying for it with Chewy coupons for free delivery on all items.
paras.zh: 新客户还可以在首次订单超过 35 美元时享受 1-3 天的免费送货服务（实时跟踪），这极大地帮助降低了将 40 磅垃圾箱运送到三楼公寓的便利成本，而无需自己将其拖上 L 火车（根据经验，不要忍受我不得不忍受的事情）。使用 Chewy 优惠券免费送货，无需付费即可享受便利。

paras.en: Save 50% With Chewy Coupons and Pet Food Deals
paras.zh: 使用耐嚼优惠券和宠物食品优惠节省 50%

paras.en: Already a devoted pet parent/Chewy member? While the best Chewy promo codes are often reserved for first-time customers, existing customers can score daily deals like buy 3, get 1 free offers on toys. Make sure to stay tuned here. While our top Chewy promo codes unlock over 20% off, there’s more to look forward to. Expect discount codes still to come, like 50% off premium dog and cat food, up to 40% off flea and tick medications for fall, and free shipping on $35, an easy price to hit when you’re grabbing pet essentials (not to mention I’ll spend any amount to avoid lugging around boxes of concrete clay litter in the pits of hell, a.k.a. the subway).
paras.zh: 已经是忠实的宠物家长/Chewy 会员？虽然最好的 Chewy 促销代码通常是为首次购买的客户保留的，但现有客户可以获得每日优惠，例如玩具买 3 送 1 免费优惠。请务必关注这里。虽然我们的顶级 Chewy 促销代码可享受超过 20% 的折扣，但还有更多值得期待的内容。预计还会有折扣码，比如高级狗粮和猫粮 50% 折扣，秋季跳蚤和蜱虫药物最高 40% 折扣，35 美元免运费，当你购买宠物必需品时，这是一个很容易买到的价格（更不用说我会花很多钱来避免在地狱坑（又名地铁）里拖着一箱箱混凝土粘土垃圾）。

paras.en: Get 50% Off Your First Chewy Autoship Order
paras.zh: 首次订购 Chewy Autoship 即可享受 50% 折扣

paras.en: Are there any equestrians here tonight? If so, you’re in luck. You can enjoy 40% off horse joint health supplements with the Chewy promo code EQSUP. Interestingly, some deals are automatic and don’t require a code or effort. When you set up an autoship subscription for certain products, you’ll receive 35% off your first order and discounts of up to 50% on select pet food brands, plus an extra 5% off all future shipments. Chewy allows combining autoship with other deals or category discounts listed on the “Today’s Deals” page. It’s flexible: you can pause, skip, or cancel any autoship at any time without being locked into a subscription. You can also adjust the delivery frequency—from weekly to monthly or more. Additionally, autoship orders on pharmacy items, including prescription medications, come with extra discounts.
paras.zh: 今晚这里有马术爱好者吗？如果是这样，那么你很幸运。使用 Chewy 促销代码 EQSUP，您可以享受马关节健康补充剂 40% 的折扣。有趣的是，有些交易是自动进行的，不需要代码或努力。当您为某些产品设置自动发货订阅时，您的首笔订单将享受 35% 的折扣，特定宠物食品品牌的折扣高达 50%，未来所有发货还可享受 5% 的额外折扣。 Chewy 允许将自动发货与“今日优惠”页面上列出的其他优惠或类别折扣结合起来。它很灵活：您可以随时暂停、跳过或取消任何自动发货，而无需锁定订阅。您还可以调整交付频率——从每周到每月或更长时间。此外，药品（包括处方药）的自动发货订单还可享受额外折扣。

paras.en: Save on our Favorite Chewy Tech Products
paras.zh: 节省我们最喜欢的耐嚼科技产品

paras.en: I’m sort of the cat tech guru around here, and I’ve tested a myriad of the best pet tech, including automatic feeders and automatic litter boxes. I have some very strong opinions about which are worth the money (or not). I’m currently using—erm, my cats are using—the Litter-Robot 4 automatic litter box, and although it’s pricey, this box has changed my life. Gone are the days of foul smells, scooping, and pouring litter. This little machine does all the dirty work for you so you can spend more time on cuddles. I also own the LEVOIT Core Pet Care Air Purifier, which has been a game changer for me living in a cramped apartment with two giant cats—it really helps dissipate any smells, pet hair, or pesky dander. Overall, my house feels cleaner because of this small powerhouse machine. When I transition from WFH, I’m going to invest in this inexpensive camera, the INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 Degree Wi-Fi Security Pet Camera, to keep an eye on the goings-on and shenanigans while I’m at work.
paras.zh: 我是这里的猫技术专家，我测试了无数最好的宠物技术，包括自动喂食器和自动猫砂盆。对于哪些值得（或不值得），我有一些非常强烈的意见。我目前正在使用——呃，我的猫正在使用——Litter-Robot 4 自动猫砂盆，虽然价格昂贵，但这个盒子改变了我的生活。恶臭、铲起和倾倒垃圾的日子已经一去不复返了。这台小机器会为您完成所有脏活，这样您就可以花更多时间拥抱。我还拥有 LEVOIT Core 宠物护理空气净化器，对于我住在一间有两只大猫的狭窄公寓里来说，它改变了游戏规则——它确实有助于消除任何气味、宠物毛发或讨厌的皮屑。总的来说，因为有了这台小型动力机器，我的房子感觉更干净了。当我从 WFH 转型时，我将投资购买这款便宜的摄像机，即 INSTACHEW Purrsight 360 度 Wi-Fi 安全宠物摄像机，以便在我工作时密切关注发生的事情和恶作剧。

paras.en: If you haven’t ordered from Chewy before, now’s a great time to give it a try and see if it’s a good fit for you or your furry friend. Right now, when you place an order over $49, you’ll get a $25 eGift card. This means that when you buy anything over $49, from dog toys to cat litter to bird food, you’ll be rewarded with an eGift card to use on future purchases and cut down costs. (Some restrictions apply.)
paras.zh: 如果您以前没有从 Chewy 订购过，现在是尝试一下的好时机，看看它是否适合您或您毛茸茸的朋友。现在，当您下订单超过 49 美元时，您将获得一张 25 美元的电子礼品卡。这意味着，当您购买超过 49 美元的任何商品（从狗玩具到猫砂再到鸟食）时，您将获得一张电子礼品卡，可用于将来的购买并降低成本。 （有一些限制。）

paras.en: If you’re not a new Chewy customer, don’t worry. You can still snag great deals! Returning Chewy customers can still get rewards for their purchases. Right now, when you spend $100 at Chewy, you’ll get a $30 e-gift card. While browsing, be sure to check out Chewy’s autoship deals for even more stackable savings, including half off Purina Pro Plan Veterinary Diet supplements and chews. Be sure to check out the whole page of autoship savings and deals, with heavy discounts of up to half off Churu treats, oral care chews, brushes, and even more pet essentials.
paras.zh: 如果您不是 Chewy 的新客户，请不要担心。您仍然可以抢到超值优惠！ Chewy 的回头客仍然可以获得购买奖励。现在，当您在 Chewy 消费 100 美元时，您将获得一张 30 美元的电子礼品卡。浏览时，请务必查看 Chewy 的自动送货优惠，以获得更多可叠加的优惠，包括 Purina Pro Plan 兽医饮食补充剂和咀嚼物半价优惠。请务必查看整页的自动送货优惠和优惠，其中 Churu 零食、口腔护理咀嚼物、刷子以及更多宠物必需品可享受高达半价的大幅折扣。

paras.en: If you are like me and find yourself needing to restock on (heavy) essentials like kibble, canned food, and litter every few weeks, it’s a good idea to become a Chewy+ member, where you’ll get discounts on tons of items, autoship savings, rewards, and free delivery. With Chewy+, you not only get free, fast shipping with no minimums, but you’ll also get 5% back in rewards on purchases, exclusive offers, double rewards, discounts, free items, and more. Chewy also gives you a 30-day trial period so you can decide if Chewy+ is right for you. After that, it’ll be $79 per year. When you earn rewards, they will be added to your Chewy+ rewards balance, which shows in your member details and at checkout for redemption. Join Chewy+ today so you can make the most of your Chewy membership with newly added and changing offers like free access to Chewy services for your pet, extra rewards, or special pricing.
paras.zh: 如果你像我一样，发现自己每隔几周就需要补充一些（重的）必需品，比如粗磨食品、罐头食品和垃圾，那么成为 Chewy+ 会员是个好主意，在这里你将获得大量物品的折扣、自动送货节省、奖励和免费送货。使用 Chewy+，您不仅可以获得无最低限额的免费、快速送货服务，而且还可以获得 5% 的购买奖励、独家优惠、双倍奖励、折扣、免费物品等。 Chewy 还为您提供 30 天的试用期，以便您可以决定 Chewy+ 是否适合您。之后，每年费用为 79 美元。当您获得奖励时，它们将被添加到您的 Chewy+ 奖励余额中，该余额会显示在您的会员详细信息中以及结帐兑换时。立即加入 Chewy+，这样您就可以通过新增和更改的优惠充分利用您的 Chewy 会员资格，例如为您的宠物免费使用 Chewy 服务、额外奖励或特价。

paras.en: Chewy dog deals are one of the best ways for dog owners to save big at Chewy. Under the “daily deals” tab, you can find deep discounts on pet essentials, from toys to treats, organized by category. (Think of it like a clearance bin, but for pets!) Right now, when you buy three toys or treats, you’ll get the fourth free. Be sure to review the details of the Chewy dog deals, as only certain top-rated toys and treats qualify.
paras.zh: Chewy 狗优惠是狗主人在 Chewy 省大钱的最佳方式之一。在“每日优惠”选项卡下，您可以找到按类别整理的宠物必需品的大幅折扣，从玩具到零食。 （可以把它想象成一个清仓箱，但用于宠物！）现在，当您购买三个玩具或零食时，您将免费获得第四个。请务必查看耐嚼狗优惠的详细信息，因为只有某些顶级玩具和零食才有资格。

paras.en: Does your doggo deserve treats? Of course they do! Right now, you can save $1 on soft, chewy Milk-Bone Peanut Buttery Cups with Jif Peanut Butter & Real Bacon using the Chewy promo code MILKBONE, until December 31 at 5:59 a.m. ET. These soft, chewy treats make the perfect accompaniment when giving meds or serve as a high-value treat during training. Note that there’s a limit of 1 item per order and 1 order per customer.
paras.zh: 你的狗狗值得被对待吗？他们当然知道！现在，您可以使用 Chewy 促销代码 MILKBONE 购买柔软耐嚼的奶骨花生酱杯（含 Jif 花生酱和真正的培根），以节省 1 美元，直至 12 月 31 日上午 5:59（美国东部时间）。这些柔软、耐嚼的零食是服药时的完美搭配，或在训练期间作为高价值零食。请注意，每个订单最多只能购买 1 件商品，每个客户最多只能购买 1 个订单。

paras.en: Get 50% Off Flea, Tick, and Heartworm Medication for Pets
paras.zh: 宠物跳蚤、蜱虫和心丝虫药物可享受 50% 折扣

paras.en: Although I love warmer weather, it’s when the bugs come out. Particularly harmful bugs like fleas and ticks can make your pet’s life (and yours!) unbearable. Although it’s off-season, Chewy has a deal for 50% off your first prescription autoship order—including flea, tick, and heartworm medications for cats and dogs. So whether you’re refilling a prescription or shopping for dog or cat flea and tick prevention and treatment, topical treatments, collars, or more, you’ll get a 50% discount on your first prescription autoship order.
paras.zh: 虽然我喜欢温暖的天气，但那是虫子出来的时候。特别有害的虫子，如跳蚤和蜱虫，可能会让您的宠物（和您的！）的生活变得难以忍受。虽然现在是淡季，但 Chewy 为您的首笔处方自动发货订单提供 50% 的折扣，包括用于猫和狗的跳蚤、蜱虫和心丝虫药物。因此，无论您是续配处方药还是购买狗或猫跳蚤和蜱虫预防和治疗、局部治疗、项圈等，您的第一个处方自动发货订单都将获得 50% 的折扣。

articles.title: Lenovo Coupon Codes: 15% Off in November 2026
articles.author: Luke Larsen

paras.en: Lenovo is currently the biggest PC and laptop company in the world, and they just so happen to make some of our favorite laptops and PC peripherals. In fact, our list of the Best Laptops you can buy includes a number of Lenovo devices that we’ve tested and fully recommend, ranging from high-end premium laptops to options for budget-minded shoppers. If you are looking to save a few bucks while shopping for a new Lenovo product, here are the Lenovo coupon codes and special offers you need to know about.
paras.zh: 联想是目前世界上最大的个人电脑和笔记本电脑公司，他们恰好生产了一些我们最喜欢的笔记本电脑和个人电脑外围设备。事实上，您可以购买的最佳笔记本电脑列表包括我们已经测试并充分推荐的许多联想设备，从高端笔记本电脑到精打细算的购物者的选择。如果您想在购买新的联想产品时节省一些钱，这里是您需要了解的联想优惠券代码和特别优惠。

paras.en: It’s hard to believe, but Black Friday (and the holidays) are right around the corner. During Lenovo Black Friday Deal Days, you’ll get free shipping and returns with no minimum, a price-match guarantee, and special financing. You can also save up to an additional $100 with the Lenovo promo code LENOVODEAL at checkout. Be sure to check out Lenovo Black Friday Deals for discounts on laptops, ThinkPads, workstations, desktop computers, monitors, accessories, tablets, phones, and gaming products.
paras.zh: 很难相信，但黑色星期五（和假期）即将来临。在联想黑色星期五促销日期间，您将获得无最低限额的免费送货和退货、价格匹配保证和特别融资。您还可以在结帐时使用 Lenovo 促销代码 LENOVODEAL 额外节省最多 100 美元。请务必查看 Lenovo 黑色星期五优惠，了解笔记本电脑、ThinkPad、工作站、台式电脑、显示器、配件、平板电脑、手机和游戏产品的折扣。

paras.en: Score Weekly Tech Deals, Price Match Guarantee, and Free Shipping
paras.zh: 获得每周技术优惠、价格匹配保证和免费送货

paras.en: In addition to the deals listed above, Lenovo has several other current offers available when shopping on Lenovo.com. There are weekly deals on PCs and tech, including free shipping with no minimums. For certain products, you can even choose to buy online and pick up in-store at Best Buy. If you’re looking for more Lenovo recommendations, we’re big fans of the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro, an Android tablet that’s currently on our Best Tablets list. It’s discounted by 26%, bringing the price down to $280.
paras.zh: 除了上面列出的优惠之外，在 Lenovo.com 上购物时，联想还提供其他一些当前优惠。每周都有电脑和科技产品优惠，包括无最低限额的免费送货。对于某些产品，您甚至可以选择在线购买并在百思买店内提货。如果您正在寻找更多联想推荐，我们是 Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 的忠实粉丝，这款 Android 平板电脑目前位于我们的最佳平板电脑列表中。折扣 26%，价格降至 280 美元。

paras.en: Lenovo also offers price matching on any comparable PC, including those from many online retailers. That’s really helpful, as it’s not uncommon to see price discrepancies between retailers.
paras.zh: 联想还提供任何同类电脑的价格匹配，包括来自许多在线零售商的电脑。这确实很有帮助，因为零售商之间的价格差异并不罕见。

paras.en: Get Exclusive Savings With Lenovo Discount Programs
paras.zh: 通过联想折扣计划获得独家优惠

paras.en: Lenovo also offers a fairly generous discount program for certain demographics. These include a 5% discount for Education, health care, First Responder, and Senior (over 55) customers. You can use this discount on anything you find at Lenovo.com, which includes much more than just Lenovo-branded laptops. For example, Lenovo sells one of our favorite laptop docking stations, the Kensington Triple Video Mobile Dock. Despite its compact size, this device can power up to three 1080p (or two 4K) displays simultaneously. It’s a great example of the wide range of products you can use these discounts and coupon codes on.
paras.zh: 联想还针对某些人群提供相当慷慨的折扣计划。其中包括针对教育、医疗保健、急救人员和老年（55 岁以上）客户的 5% 折扣。您可以在 Lenovo.com 上找到的任何商品上使用此折扣，其中不仅包括 Lenovo 品牌的笔记本电脑。例如，联想销售我们最喜欢的笔记本电脑扩展坞之一：Kensington 三重视频移动扩展坞。尽管尺寸紧凑，该设备最多可以同时为三个 1080p（或两个 4K）显示器供电。这是您可以使用这些折扣和优惠券代码的各种产品的一个很好的例子。

paras.en: If you’re looking to buy multiple devices or plan to make a big tech purchase soon, I’d recommend buying now to save more. Use the Lenovo promo code BUYMORELENOVO at checkout to save $15 on purchases of $500-$750, $25 off purchases of $750-$1,000, $40 off purchases of $1,000-$2,000, and $100 off when you purchase $2,000 or more. (Excludes clearance and workstation items.)
paras.zh: 如果您想购买多台设备或计划很快购买大型科技产品，我建议您立即购买以节省更多。结帐时使用 Lenovo 促销代码 BUYMORELENOVO，购买满 500-750 美元可节省 15 美元，购买 750-1,000 美元可节省 25 美元，购买 1,000-2,000 美元可节省 40 美元，购买 2,000 美元或以上可节省 100 美元。 （不包括间隙和工作站项目。）

paras.en: The Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is a perfect tablet for students, featuring a vibrant, nearly 13-inch 3K touchscreen display ideal for everyday tasks like reading, studying, and streaming. It also has a MediaTek processor, 8GB of memory, and 128GB of storage for seamless multitasking and ample space for apps and files. Plus, it has dual cameras for Zoom calls. Although the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is specifically designed with students in mind, it’s versatile enough to be a great fit for a multitude of people wanting a reliable tablet with tons of extra features. Plus, it’s 35% off right now. There’s no better time to buy.
paras.zh: Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 是一款非常适合学生的平板电脑，配备色彩鲜艳的近 13 英寸 3K 触摸屏显示屏，非常适合阅读、学习和流媒体等日常任务。它还配备联发科处理器、8GB 内存和 128GB 存储空间，可实现无缝多任务处理，并为应用程序和文件提供充足的空间。此外，它还具有用于 Zoom 通话的双摄像头。尽管 Lenovo Idea Tab Pro 是专门为学生设计的，但它的多功能性足以满足许多想要拥有大量额外功能的可靠平板电脑的人的需求。另外，现在还有 35% 的折扣。没有比这更好的购买时机了。

paras.en: We all know that being a student is expensive, and it gets even harder when you need pricey tech to thrive in academia. One of the easiest ways to save big on tech at Lenovo is with a student discount. All you need to get this student discount at Lenovo is to verify your student or employee status with a valid .edu email address or through ID.me verification. Then, create a Lenovo Education account to unlock benefits for one year, where discounts are automatically applied to eligible products. Once you log in with the verified account, you’ll save 5% sitewide, and discounts will be automatically applied to eligible products. That means you’ll get 5% off in your cart year-round—plus, you’ll be able to unlock even deeper discounts during special promo periods.
paras.zh: 我们都知道，作为一名学生的成本很高，当你需要昂贵的技术才能在学术界蓬勃发展时，这就变得更加困难。在联想节省大量技术费用的最简单方法之一就是学生折扣。要在 Lenovo 获得此学生折扣，您只需使用有效的 .edu 电子邮件地址或通过 ID.me 验证来验证您的学生或员工身份。然后，创建一个联想教育帐户以解锁一年的福利，其中折扣将自动应用于符合条件的产品。使用经过验证的帐户登录后，您将在全站范围内节省 5%，并且折扣将自动应用于符合条件的产品。这意味着您的购物车全年可享受 5% 的折扣，此外，您还可以在特殊促销期间享受更大的折扣。

articles.title: U2 Wind Back the Years With Classics, Dolly Parton Tribute for Thanksgiving Eve NFL Halftime Show
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The legendary Irish rock band, as they’ve done so often in the past, stepped into the cauldron, rocked out, and gave everyone what they were looking for.
paras.zh: 正如他们过去经常做的那样，传奇的爱尔兰摇滚乐队走进大锅，摇滚出来，给了每个人他们想要的东西。

paras.en: On this occasion, Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr. stepped into the colosseum that is the NFL‘s first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game at SoFi Stadium, pitting the Los Angeles Rams against the visiting Green Bay Packers.
paras.zh: 值此之际，Bono、The Edge、Adam Clayton 和 Larry Mullen Jr. 走进斗兽场，这是 NFL 在 SoFi 体育场举行的第一场感恩节前夕比赛，洛杉矶公羊队对阵来访的绿湾包装工队。

paras.en: The Rock Hall-inducted group headlined the halftime show, which streamed live late Wednesday, Nov. 25 on Netflix.
paras.zh: 这支摇滚音乐厅的乐队在中场表演中占据主导地位，该表演于 11 月 25 日星期三晚在 Netflix 上进行了现场直播。

paras.en: At the very top, the four bandmates took the long walk to the centerfield as a choir recited the lyrics of “I Still Haven’t Found What I’m Looking For.”
paras.zh: 在最高处，四位乐队成员长途跋涉到达中场，合唱团吟诵着“我仍然没有找到我正在寻找的东西”的歌词。

paras.en: “Thank you for having us,” Bono remarked over Mullen’s iconic, military-style drum pattern that launched the mini-set proper with “Sunday Bloody Sunday,” one of the band’s early political anthems. The production stepped up several gears as a marching band assembled and the song shapeshifted, interpolating The Supremes’ “Stop! In The Name of Love.”
paras.zh: “谢谢你邀请我们，”波诺对马伦标志性的军用风格的鼓声说道，该鼓声以乐队早期的政治歌曲之一“周日血腥星期日”启动了迷你套装。随着行进乐队的集结和歌曲的变形，制作加快了几个步伐，插入了至尊乐队的“停止！以爱之名”。

paras.en: Then, a change in mood as U2 paid tribute to Dolly Parton, the late queen of country’s smiling image splashed on three sails towering over the circular, center stage. Bono dueted with Dolly’s vocals for “Torn,” her very last recording which appears on the band’s 16th and latest studio album, Carnaval de Luz.
paras.zh: 然后，当 U2 向多莉·帕顿致敬时，气氛发生了变化，已故乡村女王的微笑形象溅落在圆形中央舞台上高耸的三张帆上。波诺与多莉的声音合唱了《Torn》，这是她最后一张录音，出现在乐队第 16 张也是最新的录音室专辑《Carnaval de Luz》中。

paras.en: And, in a moment that earned a roar from the audience, the band slotted seamlessly into another Joshua Tree number, “Where The Streets Have No Name.” The sails came down, and U2 got down to rockstar business — with some support from scores of backing singers.
paras.zh: 而且，在赢得观众欢呼的那一刻，乐队无缝地插入了约书亚树乐队的另一首歌曲“Where The Streets Have No Name”。风帆落下，U2 开始从事摇滚明星业务——并得到了数十位伴唱的支持。

paras.en: Without missing a beat, Bono and Co. reached into their glorybox with a rendition of “Pride (In The Name of Love)” a tribute to the assassinated civil rights leader Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., which appeared on their 1984 LP The Unforgettable Fire. And with that, U2 was done and it was game on.
paras.zh: 波诺和他的伙伴们毫不犹豫地走进他们的荣耀箱，演唱了一首向被暗杀的民权领袖马丁·路德·金博士致敬的《骄傲（以爱之名）》，这首歌曲出现在他们 1984 年的唱片《难忘的火焰》中。就这样，U2 就完成了，比赛开始了。

paras.en: Carnaval de Luz this month debuted at No. 1 on three Billboard charts, including No. 1 on Top Rock Albums, Vinyl Albums and Indie Store Album Sales, and became the band’s 14th top 10 on the Billboard 200 (opening at No. 4). It’s their 12th No. 1 on the Official U.K. Albums Chart and Australia’s ARIA Chart.
paras.zh: Carnaval de Luz 本月首次亮相就在三张 Billboard 排行榜上排名第一，其中包括顶级摇滚专辑、黑胶专辑和独立商店专辑销量第一，并成为乐队第 14 位进入 Billboard 200 排行榜前 10 名（开局排名第四）。这是他们在英国官方专辑排行榜和澳大利亚 ARIA 排行榜上第 12 个第一名。

paras.en: U2 this year chalks up its 50th anniversary, the celebrations for which will accelerate next year when the band returns to stadiums around the globe with Carnaval De Luz presents: The Greatest Show on Earth, its first stadium tour since 2019. Watch highlights from the Thanksgiving Eve halftime show and check out the setlist below. Stream the full performance here on Netflix.
paras.zh: U2 今年迎来了成立 50 周年，明年，乐队的庆祝活动将会加速，届时乐队将带着 Carnaval De Luz 的节目重返全球各地的体育场：地球上最伟大的表演，这是自 2019 年以来的首次体育场巡演。观看感恩节前夕中场表演的精彩片段，并查看下面的演出列表。在 Netflix 上观看完整演出。

paras.zh: U2 感恩节前夕中场表演曲目表：

articles.title: Andy Taylor Was Full of Surprises: Six Deep-Dive Career Moments
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Andy Taylor, the founding guitarist with Duran Duran, who passed away Monday (Nov. 23) following a years-long battle with prostate cancer, aged 65, just might be the most underrated musician to emerge from the early 1980s.
paras.zh: 杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 的创始吉他手安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 在与前列腺癌抗争多年后于周一（11 月 23 日）去世，享年 65 岁，他可能是 20 世纪 80 年代初出现的最被低估的音乐家。

paras.en: Taylor, who would also form The Power Station, enjoyed a solo career and was something of a serial collaborator, stood tall in a golden era for electric guitarists. Even the slickest commercial pop songs had destructive guitar solos, the type of which seem to be lost to this generation and last.
paras.zh: 泰勒（Taylor）也是 The Power Station 的组建者，他享受着独奏生涯，并且是一位连续合作者，在电吉他手的黄金时代中屹立不倒。即使是最圆滑的商业流行歌曲也有破坏性的吉他独奏，这种类型似乎在这一代人和最后一代人中都消失了。

paras.en: Forget the Cold War, there was another arms race where the weapons of choice were plugged-in six-strings, with rows of effects pedals. Eddie Van Halen, Steve Vai, Joe Satriani, The Edge, Steve Stevens, Yngwie Malmsteen, Steve Lukather. It was an expansive group, and Andy Taylor was a member.
paras.zh: 忘记冷战吧，还有另一场军备竞赛，选择的武器是插入六弦，带有一排效果踏板。埃迪·范·海伦、史蒂夫·瓦伊、乔·萨特里亚尼、The Edge、史蒂夫·史蒂文斯、英格维·马尔姆斯汀、史蒂夫·卢卡瑟。这是一个庞大的团体，安迪·泰勒是其中的成员。

paras.en: Born in Tynemouth and raised in Cullercoats, Northumberland, in north east England, Taylor was the wild boy in Duran Duran – his autobiography from 2008 even carried that title.
paras.zh: 泰勒出生于泰恩茅斯，在英格兰东北部诺森伯兰郡的卡勒科茨长大，他是《杜兰·杜兰》中的狂野男孩——他 2008 年的自传甚至带有这个标题。

paras.en: Here was a roguish rockstar with fast hands, itchy feet, who didn’t follow trends, but had many, many followers. But because of his breakthrough with Duran Duran, a band that drew a mystifying flood of hate from critics of the time, Taylor’s talents were largely overlooked.
paras.zh: 这是一位流氓摇滚明星，手快，脚痒，不追随潮流，但却拥有很多很多的追随者。但由于他与杜兰杜兰乐队的突破，这支乐队引起了当时评论家的大量仇恨，泰勒的才华在很大程度上被忽视了。

paras.en: Duran Duran split into two camps following the release of the 1985 James Bond hit “A View To A Kill.” Andy and John Taylor formed The Power Station, the funk-rock supergroup with Robert Palmer at the front, and Tony Thompson at the back, while Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes and Roger Taylor launched Arcadia, a collaborative-stacked project that, in an alternative universe, would’ve been Duran Duran’s fourth studio album.
paras.zh: 1985 年詹姆斯·邦德的热门影片《杀人之眼》上映后，杜兰·杜兰分成了两个阵营。安迪和约翰·泰勒组建了放克摇滚超级组合“The Power Station”，罗伯特·帕尔默（Robert Palmer）在前，托尼·汤普森（Tony Thompson）在后，而西蒙·勒邦（Simon Le Bon）、尼克·罗兹（Nick Rhodes）和罗杰·泰勒（Roger Taylor）则推出了“Arcadia”，这是一个合作堆叠的项目，在另一个宇宙中，这将是杜兰·杜兰（Duran Duran）的第四张录音室专辑。

paras.en: With The Power Station, Andy Taylor was unleashed. We got shredding, finger tapping, the works. Taylor contributed to the Duran Duran album from 1986, Notorious, then he was out. Fifteen years later, he returned to the band with original drummer Roger Taylor, to reunite the Fab Five. He contributed to the 2004 album Astronaut, and again on the 2023 collection Danse Macabre.
paras.zh: 凭借《发电站》，安迪·泰勒得到了释放。我们进行了粉碎、手指敲击等工作。泰勒从 1986 年开始为杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 的专辑《Notorious》做出贡献，然后他就出局了。十五年后，他与原来的鼓手罗杰·泰勒一起重返乐队，重新组合了五人组。他为 2004 年的专辑《Astronaut》做出了贡献，并再次为 2023 年的专辑《Danse Macabre》做出了贡献。

paras.en: The music world learned of his illness when, in 2022, Duran Duran was inducted into the Rock And Roll Hall of Fame. Taylor, his bandmates explained, as they read out a letter from the guitarist, was unable to attend due to illness.
paras.zh: 2022 年，当杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 入选摇滚名人堂时，音乐界得知了他的病情。泰勒的乐队成员在宣读吉他手的一封信时解释说，泰勒因病无法出席。

paras.en: Billboard has compiled six deep-dive moments from Andy Taylor’s Hall of Fame career.
paras.zh: 《公告牌》整理了安迪·泰勒名人堂生涯中的六个深刻时刻。

paras.en: - The Joker In The Pack In 1984, Duran Duran was on top of the world. The previous year, the band dropped Seven And The Ragged Tiger, their first U.K. No. 1 album. Its opening track, “The Reflex,” gave them a first No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. The following year, in 1985, another U.S. No. 1 with “A View To A Kill.” A 1984 tour documentary, Sing Blue Silver, a line from the fan favorite Rio album closer “The Chauffeur,” captured the band on the road, but also gave Duranies an unexpected smack to the funnybone. Andy Taylor has one of the standout moments when he ignited an impromptu, running double-entendre joke at a press conference, a response to a question on when he learned to play his instrument. The punchline is a knockout. Watch here.
paras.zh: - The Joker In The Pack 1984 年，杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 登上了世界之巅。去年，乐队推出了他们的首张英国排名第一的专辑《Seven And The Ragged Tiger》。其开场歌曲《The Reflex》让他们首次登上 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜第一名。次年，即 1985 年，他们凭借《A View To A Kill》再次排名美国第一。 1984 年的巡演纪录片《Sing Blue Silver》（《Sing Blue Silver》）中的一句台词取自歌迷最喜爱的里约热内卢专辑《The Chauffeur》中的台词，捕捉到了乐队在路上的情景，但也给了 Duranies 意想不到的一击。安迪·泰勒（Andy Taylor）最引人注目的时刻之一是，他在新闻发布会上即兴开了一个双关语笑话，回答了有关他何时学会演奏乐器的问题。妙语是淘汰赛。观看此处。

paras.en: - The Axe Man With The Power Station, Andy Taylor was off the leash. The first single, “Some Like It Hot,” showcased his mad skills. With their cover of T-Rex’s “Get It On (Bang a Gong),” he was on fire. Perhaps his finest work is on “Murderess,” which the band performed at the Philadelphia leg of Live Aid in 1985, with Michael Des Barres slotting in on vocal duties when Robert Palmer dropped out. With Des Barres on board, the fourpiece made an appearance on Miami Vice. Check out the studio cut and the live version of “Murderess” below.
paras.zh: - 斧头人与电站，安迪·泰勒摆脱了束缚。第一首单曲“Some Like It Hot”展示了他疯狂的技巧。随着他们翻唱 T-Rex 的“Get It On (Bang a Gong)”，他火了。也许他最好的作品是“Murderess”，乐队于 1985 年在 Live Aid 费城站演出，罗伯特·帕尔默退出后，迈克尔·德巴雷斯 (Michael Des Barres) 接替了主唱。在德巴雷斯的加入下，四人组出现在《迈阿密风云》中。请查看下面的“Murderess”的录音室剪辑和现场版本。

paras.en: - His Own Way During the 1985 recording sessions for The Power Station’s self-titled debut album at the Power Station studio in New York City, Taylor recorded his tasty licks and explosive solos in the control room rather than out in the main live room. The reason behind it was to create an almost-live atmosphere, with producer Bernard Edwards part of his audience. Watch from 3.40 in this behind the scenes footage. “A lead guitarist, their personalities are usually fire,” the late Chic great Edwards explains. “It’s usually pretty hot. And he is a lead guitarist.”
paras.zh: - His Own Way During the 1985 recording sessions for The Power Station’s self-titled debut album at the Power Station studio in New York City, Taylor recorded his tasty licks and explosive solos in the control room rather than out in the main live room. The reason behind it was to create an almost-live atmosphere, with producer Bernard Edwards part of his audience.观看 3.40 的幕后花絮。 “A lead guitarist, their personalities are usually fire,” the late Chic great Edwards explains. “通常都很热。而且他是主音吉他手。”

paras.en: - Solo Man After splitting with Duran Duran, and moving on from The Power Station (he would contribute to a second album, Living In Fear, released in 1996), Taylor took the natural next step and started a solo career. For the entre, he presented “Take It Easy,” which appeared on the soundtrack for the 1986 feature film American Anthem. It was as different to a Duran Duran song as one could imagine. And Andy, for the first time, was on vocal duties. A full solo album, Thunder, followed in 1987.
paras.zh: - Solo Man 在与 Duran Duran 分手并离开 The Power Station 后（他为 1996 年发行的第二张专辑《Living In Fear》做出了贡献），Taylor 自然而然地迈出了下一步，开始了独唱生涯。在主奏中，他演奏了《Take It Easy》，这首歌曲出现在 1986 年故事片《美国国歌》的配乐中。正如人们所能想象的那样，这与杜兰·杜兰的歌曲截然不同。安迪第一次担任配音职务。随后于 1987 年推出了完整的个人专辑《Thunder》。

paras.en: - The Collaborator Andy Taylor was constantly on the move, recording with Robert Palmer (he played the guitar parts on his 1986 hit “Addicted to Love”), and with the likes of Rod Stewart, the Almighty, Love and Money, Tina Arena, Then Jerico and Belinda Carlisle. “I was blessed to work with Andy Taylor – such a genius… he played the guitar solo in MAD ABOUT YOU, appears in the video and he made special appearances onstage for some of my first solo shows. What a talent,” writes Carlisle on social media. “Thank you Andy Taylor for the music and all of the joy you brought to the world which will live on forever. I hope you are feeling the love…Godspeed.” Taylor appears in the official music video at the 2.07 mark.
paras.zh: - 合作者安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 一直在不断地活动，与罗伯特·帕尔默 (Robert Palmer)（他在 1986 年的热门单曲《Addicted to Love》中担任吉他部分）以及罗德·斯图尔特 (Rod Stewart)、the Almighty、Love and Money、Tina Arena、Then Jerico 和 Belinda Carlisle 等人一起录音。卡莱尔在社交媒体上写道：“我很幸运能与安迪·泰勒合作——他真是一个天才……他在《MAD ABOUT YOU》中演奏了吉他独奏，出现在视频中，并且在我的一些首次个人表演中特别出现在舞台上。真是一个天才。” “谢谢安迪·泰勒的音乐和你给世界带来的所有欢乐，这些欢乐将永远存在。我希望你感受到爱……祝你好运。”泰勒在官方音乐视频中出现在 2.07 分。

paras.en: - The Restauranteur In the 1980s, Andy operated Rio’s (also known as Rio Bar), a wine bar and restaurant in Whitley Bay, England. It was, of course, named after the band’s hit sophomore album and its title track. In 1985, a vandal reportedly smashed the venue’s piranha tank, spilling hundreds of gallons of water and letting loose its carnivorous occupants. It’s not known what happened with the fish, but the spot ultimately changed hands.
paras.zh: - 餐厅老板 20 世纪 80 年代，安迪 (Andy) 在英国惠特利湾 (Whitley Bay) 经营 Rio’s（也称为 Rio Bar），这是一家酒吧兼餐厅。当然，它是以乐队的热门第二张专辑及其主打歌命名的。据报道，1985 年，一名破坏者打碎了该场馆的食人鱼水箱，导致数百加仑的水溢出，并释放了食肉动物。目前尚不清楚这条鱼发生了什么，但该地点最终易手。

articles.title: ‘What A Talent’: Belinda Carlisle, UB40, Spandau Ballet & More Remember Andy Taylor
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Tributes are flooding in for Andy Taylor, the brawny founding guitarist for Duran Duran and The Power Station, who has passed away after a years-long battle with prostate cancer. He was 65.
paras.zh: 人们纷纷向安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 致敬，他是杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 和 The Power Station 乐队的健壮创始吉他手，在与前列腺癌抗争多年后去世。他 65 岁了。

paras.en: “I was blessed to work with Andy Taylor – such a genius… he played the guitar solo in MAD ABOUT YOU, appears in the video and he made special appearances onstage for some of my first solo shows. What a talent,” writes Belinda Carlisle on her social channels.
paras.zh: “我很幸运能与安迪·泰勒一起工作——他真是个天才……他在《MAD ABOUT YOU》中演奏了吉他独奏，出现在视频中，并且在我的一些首次个人表演中特别出现在舞台上。真是一个天才，”贝琳达·卡莱尔在她的社交频道上写道。

paras.en: “Thank you Andy Taylor for the music and all of the joy you brought to the world which will live on forever. I hope you are feeling the love…Godspeed.”
paras.zh: “谢谢安迪·泰勒的音乐和你给世界带来的所有欢乐，这些欢乐将永远存在。我希望你感受到爱……祝你好运。”

paras.en: Fellow axeman Steve Stevens, the longtime talisman of Billy Idol, was heartbroken on the news. “F#ck cancer,” he writes. “Have so many memories with Andy. He was the first guitarist to sing my praises in the English press, I was forever grateful. He, Tony, & Robert are definitely jamming now,” says Stevens, a nod to the late Power Station members Tony Thompson and Robert Palmer.
paras.zh: 比利·爱多的长期护身符、斧头手史蒂夫·史蒂文斯得知这一消息后心碎不已。 “去他妈的癌症，”他写道。 “与安迪有很多回忆。他是第一个在英语媒体上赞扬我的吉他手，我永远感激不已。他、托尼和罗伯特现在肯定正在即兴演奏，”史蒂文斯说道，这是对已故发电站成员托尼·汤普森和罗伯特·帕尔默的致敬。

paras.en: Duran Duran and Spandau Ballet were, for a time, the British second invasion’s pin-up boys. “So sad to hear the news of Andy’s passing,” writes Spandau Ballet’s co-founder and songwriter Gary Kemp. “A great player who set the tone for the eighties and influenced many of us along the way with his sparse staccato style. He brought shameless rock to the mix. All my love to the Duran family. RIP Andy.”
paras.zh: 杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 和斯潘道芭蕾舞团 (Spandau Ballet) 一度是英国第二次入侵时的海报女郎。 “听到安迪去世的消息我感到非常悲伤，”斯潘道芭蕾舞团的联合创始人兼词曲作者加里·坎普写道。 “一位伟大的演奏家为八十年代定下了基调，并以其稀疏的断奏风格影响了我们许多人。他将无耻的摇滚带入了混音中。我对杜兰家族的全部爱。安息安迪。”

paras.en: Veteran British singer Michael Des Barres stepped up when Robert Palmer stepped out of The Power Station, the funk-rock band Andy and John Taylor formed in 1985 when Duran Duran was on hiatus. “He was a tough and rocking guitar player,” writes Des Barres. “He knew what he wanted, and he gave it to us. I was able to learn 22 songs in five days of rehearsal with the Power Station because of Andy‘s tremendous enthusiasm and professionalism. Simply put, he loved rock ‘n’ roll. RIP- My friend.”
paras.zh: 当罗伯特·帕尔默 (Robert Palmer) 退出 The Power Station 时，英国资深歌手迈克尔·德巴雷斯 (Michael Des Barres) 站了出来。放克摇滚乐队安迪 (Andy) 和约翰·泰勒 (John Taylor) 于 1985 年组建，当时杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 处于停职状态。 “他是一位坚强而摇滚的吉他手，”德巴雷斯写道。 “他知道他想要什么，并且把它给了我们。由于 Andy 的巨大热情和专业精神，我在 Power Station 排练的五天内学会了 22 首歌曲。简单地说，他热爱摇滚乐。安息吧——我的朋友。”

paras.en: Terri Nunn’s Berlin paid tribute with a lyric to the band’s 1993 comeback classic “Ordinary World,” which featured Warren Cuccurullo on guitar. “Where is the life that I recognise? (Gone away) RIP #AndyTaylor.”
paras.zh: Terri Nunn 的 Berlin 用一首歌词向乐队 1993 年复出的经典歌曲《Ordinary World》致敬，其中由 Warren Cuccurullo 担任吉他手。 “我所认识的生活在哪里？（走了）安息吧#AndyTaylor。”

paras.en: Andy Taylor (no relation with John and Roger) had multiple stints in Duran Duran, scoring 13 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including two No. 1s: “The Reflex” in 1984 and “A View to a Kill” in 1985. The group’s beloved second album Rio album (which housed “Hungry Like the Wolf,” “Save a Prayer,” and the title track) hit the Billboard 200 in 1982 and remained on the chart for a whopping 128 weeks.
paras.zh: 安迪·泰勒（与约翰和罗杰没有关系）在杜兰·杜兰乐队中多次演出，在 Billboard Hot 100 中获得 13 首单曲，包括两次排名第一：1984 年的《The Reflex》和 1985 年的《A View to a Kill》。该乐队深受喜爱的第二张专辑《Rio》（收录了《Hungry Like the Wolf》、《Save a Prayer》和主打歌）于 2007 年进入 Billboard 200 强。 1982 and remained on the chart for a whopping 128 weeks.

paras.en: As a member of The Power Station, he earned three top 40 hits on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1985, and as a soloist, he scored two entries on the chart: “Take It Easy” (No. 24 in 1986) and “When the Rain Comes Down” (No. 73 in 1986).
paras.zh: 作为The Power Station的成员，他在1985年的Billboard Hot 100单曲排行榜上获得了三首前40名的成绩，作为独唱者，他在排行榜上获得了两首歌曲：“Take It Easy”（1986年第24位）和“When the Rain Comes Down”（1986年第73位）。

paras.en: Taylor was inducted into the 2022 Rock And Roll Hall of Fame in absentia due to his illness, which his bandmates announced from the platform of their induction speech for the very first time.
paras.zh: 泰勒因病缺席入选 2022 年摇滚名人堂，这是他的乐队成员首次在入职演讲中宣布这一消息。

paras.en: It was the rocker’s former bandmates who shared the tragic news “Andy was there at the very beginning of our story,” the group wrote on their website and on Instagram. “From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music.”
paras.zh: 这位摇滚歌手的前乐队成员分享了这个悲惨的消息：“安迪在我们故事的一开始就在场，”该团体在他们的网站和 Instagram 上写道。 “从他带着一把吉他从东北来到伯明翰的那一刻起，他对我们能够成为什么样的人有着不可动摇的信念，他给我们的音乐带来了不可磨灭的热情和昂扬。”

paras.en: The message continued, “His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded and gave the band its edge through the extraordinary years that followed.”
paras.zh: 消息中还写道：“他的演奏带动了我们环游世界的歌曲，他的冷幽默与他极其冷静、严肃的人生观相匹配，让我们脚踏实地，并在接下来的非凡岁月中为乐队带来了优势。”

paras.en: Also, Taylor’s wife, Tracey, shared a statement: “To the world, Andy was a brilliant guitarist, but to us, he was the most wonderful husband, a loving dad and the proudest grandfather,” she wrote. “He was the rock of our family. For all the incredible experiences music brought him, family always came first.”
paras.zh: 此外，泰勒的妻子特雷西也发表了一份声明：“对世界来说，安迪是一位出色的吉他手，但对我们来说，他是最好的丈夫、慈爱的父亲和最自豪的祖父，”她写道。 “他是我们家庭的支柱。尽管音乐给他带来了所有令人难以置信的经历，但家庭始终是第一位的。”

paras.en: Andy is also survived by his children — Georgina, Isabella, Bethany and Andrew — and grandson Albie.
paras.zh: 安迪身后还有他的孩子——乔治娜、伊莎贝拉、贝瑟尼和安德鲁——以及孙子阿尔比。

articles.title: ‘South Park’ Season Finale Drops Kenny Into ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ as South America Comes Clean
articles.author: Kevin Dolak

paras.en: All is not well in South America (née South Park) in the season 29 finale. The long-anticipated November release of Grand Theft Auto VI — the show’s metaphorical stand-in for the midterm elections — has finally arrived, but rolling power outages caused by local billionaires’ AI-powered data centers are keeping the townspeople — from the little-seen Goth Kids to Mr. Garrison to Big Gay Al, and of course, our core boy heroes — from enjoying the biggest media release of all time.
paras.zh: 第 29 季结局中的南美洲（原名南方公园）一切都不太顺利。期待已久的《侠盗猎车手 6》——该剧象征中期选举的替身——终于在 11 月上映，但当地亿万富翁的人工智能数据中心造成的轮流停电，让镇上的人们——从鲜为人知的哥特小子到加里森先生，再到大同性恋阿尔，当然还有我们的核心男孩英雄——无法享受有史以来最大的媒体发布。

paras.en: Mass protest ensues, and we’re reminded of the deep corruption that has taken hold of the Colorado town, starting with Mayor McDaniels’ administration taking kickbacks from the tiny-penis billionaires — who, we’ll recall, broke Butters’ fight against them earlier in the season with a backroom deal to keep building their data centers in town and siphoning its power. Butters and family deliver a fun nod to “It’s a Good Life,” a classic Twilight Zone plot here, with Butters’ parents believing he has supernatural powers and are absolutely terrified of him.
paras.zh: 大规模抗议随之而来，我们想起了科罗拉多小镇的严重腐败，首先是麦克丹尼尔斯市长的政府从小阴茎亿万富翁那里收受回扣——我们记得，他们在本赛季早些时候通过一项幕后交易打破了巴特斯与他们的斗争，继续在镇上建设数据中心并窃取其电力。巴特斯和家人对《暮光之城》的经典情节“美好生活”表示了有趣的认可，巴特斯的父母相信他拥有超自然力量，并且绝对害怕他。

paras.en: For an episode that packs plenty in, calling back to much of the season’s action and picking up most of the plot threads it introduced (minus, unfortunately, the great Tweek and Craig), it’s Lu Kim, the Asian American owner of City Wok and now City Ending massage, who walks away with the heaviest storyline. He’s quickly scapegoated and placed under suspicious watch by armed South America residents, who are made aware of a Chinese spy that feels a little like a recent international tech world scandal. A Shitty Ending feels inevitable.
paras.zh: 这一集内容丰富，回顾了本季的大部分情节，并选取了它引入的大部分情节线索（不幸的是，除了伟大的特维克和克雷格），而故事情节最沉重的是 Lu Kim，City Wok 的亚裔美国人老板，现在是 City Ending 按摩店。他很快就成为替罪羊，并受到武装的南美居民的可疑监视，他们意识到一名中国间谍的存在，感觉有点像最近的国际科技界丑闻。糟糕的结局感觉是不可避免的。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kenny, who was believed to have died in an e-bike accident in the season premiere, resurfaces terrifyingly. The boys first spot him in the distance outside; after following him, they discover he’s a zombie. He points at them horrifically, à la Donald Sutherland in Invasion of the Body Snatchers, then disintegrates before their eyes. He later reemerges to haunt them in the worst place imaginable: inside Grand Theft Auto VI as the boys play. Their supposedly deceased friend exits the game as some sort of four-legged beast, ready to devour little Butters.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据信在本季首播中死于电动自行车事故的肯尼却可怕地重新出现。孩子们首先在外面远处发现了他。跟踪他后，他们发现他是僵尸。他像《掠尸者的入侵》中的唐纳德·萨瑟兰那样可怕地指着他们，然后在他们眼前崩溃。后来，他再次出现，在你能想象到的最糟糕的地方困扰着他们：在侠盗猎车手 6 里，男孩们正在玩耍。他们所谓已故的朋友以某种四足野兽的形式退出游戏，准备吞噬小巴特斯。

paras.en: Whatever is going on here, our longtime elementary school heroes are going to figure it out — and in doing so, tie up all (well, most) of the season’s threads. Shaken to his core by Kenny’s appearance, Butters fesses up about the billionaires’ earlier bribe, then tells the boys how he offloaded the data centers to Peter Mullins’ house. The boys head there next and discover a high-tech data center in their classmate’s never-looked-at backyard.
paras.zh: 无论这里发生了什么，我们长期以来的小学英雄都会弄清楚——并通过这样做，将本季的所有（好吧，大部分）线索联系起来。巴特斯被肯尼的出现彻底震撼了，他承认了亿万富翁之前的贿赂行为，然后告诉男孩们他如何将数据中心转移到彼得·马林斯的家里。接下来，男孩们前往那里，在他们同学从未见过的后院发现了一个高科技数据中心。

paras.en: When the boys bring what they know about Kenny — whose spirit, they’ve discerned, is somehow trapped in South America — to the local police, they also lay out the billionaires’ secret bribes and the town’s corruption. The detectives and officers are none too surprised. As Lil’ Randy points out after dramatically barging into the station, the whole town has become corrupt, and it all started with the name change to South America.
paras.zh: 当男孩们将他们对肯尼的了解——他们发现肯尼的灵魂不知何故被困在南美洲——交给当地警方时，他们也揭露了亿万富翁的秘密贿赂和该镇的腐败。侦探和警官们对此并不感到太惊讶。正如小兰迪戏剧性地闯入车站后所指出的那样，整个城镇都变得腐败，而这一切都是从更名为“南美洲”开始的。

paras.en: It’s time for everyone to come clean: The mayor confesses to her administration’s corruption at the hands of the tiny-penis billionaires, but there’s no accountability for her or her office, just as there’s none for Randy and the others actually involved in Kenny’s death. This is South Park, after all, and it’s easier to keep Lu Kim as the scapegoat. Like Nvidia’s Jensen Huang, Kim is ousted here at the behest of the small-penis billionaires — he’s sent off in a rocket, a South Park tradition that has spelled the demise of Ms. Ellen, Jambu the orca and, of course, Tom Cruise. Still, one gets the feeling Lu Kim will be back in South Park next season, given Huang’s ultimate fate with his board of directors.
paras.zh: 现在是每个人都坦白的时候了：市长承认了她的政府在小阴茎亿万富翁手中的腐败行为，但她或她的办公室没有责任，就像兰迪和其他真正参与肯尼之死的人没有责任一样。毕竟这是南方公园，让路金当替罪羊更容易。和英伟达公司的黄仁勋一样，金在小阴茎亿万富翁的要求下被驱逐到这里——他被乘火箭送走，这是南方公园的传统，它导致了艾伦女士、逆戟鲸詹布，当然还有汤姆·克鲁斯的灭亡。尽管如此，考虑到黄与董事会的最终命运，人们还是有一种感觉，金路下赛季将重返南方公园。

paras.en: By the end of the episode and the season, the core four boys of South Park Elementary are restored, Randy is still Lil’ Randy, it seems, and the town, according to the iconic sign at its edge, is once again called South Park.
paras.zh: 在这一集和这一季的结尾，南方公园小学的四个核心男孩都被恢复了，兰迪似乎仍然是小兰迪，而根据其边缘的标志性标志，这个小镇再次被称为南方公园。

articles.title: Hollywood’s Most Notable Deaths of 2026
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: The entertainment industry is already mourning the loss of several Hollywood legends this year, including actors, singers, performers, creatives and executives.
paras.zh: 娱乐业已经在哀悼今年几位好莱坞传奇人物的去世，其中包括演员、歌手、表演者、创意人员和高管。

paras.en: The Hollywood Reporter is highlighting some of the most well-known figures who have died in 2026, from Dolly Parton, Patrick Stewart, Catherine O’Hara and Tim Curry to James Van Der Beek, Robert Duvall, Eric Dane and James Tolkan.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》重点介绍了 2026 年去世的一些最著名的人物，从多莉·帕顿、帕特里克·斯图尔特、凯瑟琳·奥哈拉和蒂姆·库里到詹姆斯·范德比克、罗伯特·杜瓦尔、埃里克·戴恩和詹姆斯·托尔坎。

paras.en: Below are more of this year’s most notable deaths within Hollywood, and check out THR‘s obituaries page for other 2026 industry deaths, as well as last year’s entertainment deaths here.
paras.zh: 以下是今年好莱坞最著名的死亡事件，并查看 THR 的讣告页面，了解 2026 年其他行业死亡事件以及去年的娱乐业死亡事件。

paras.en: Valentino, the legendary Italian fashion designer who seamlessly blended opulence and high style to create clothes that delighted generations of high-profile women, died Jan. 19 at his Rome residence, his foundation announced. He was 93. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 瓦伦蒂诺 (Valentino) 基金会宣布，意大利传奇时装设计师瓦伦蒂诺 (Valentino) 于 1 月 19 日在其位于罗马的住所去世，他将奢华与高雅风格完美融合，创造出令一代又一代知名女性满意的服装。他 93 岁了。阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Catherine O’Hara, a gifted comedic actress and two-time Emmy winner known for her roles in Home Alone, Schitt’s Creek and The Studio, died Jan. 30 at her home in Los Angeles after a brief illness, her reps at CAA confirmed. She was 71. Read her full obituary here.
paras.zh: 凯瑟琳·奥哈拉 (Catherine O’Hara) 是一位才华横溢的喜剧女演员，曾两次获得艾美奖，因在《小鬼当家》、《Schitt’s Creek》和《工作室》中的角色而闻名，她在 CAA 的代表证实，她因短暂患病于 1 月 30 日在洛杉矶的家中去世。她享年 71 岁。请在此处阅读她的完整讣告。

paras.en: James Van Der Beek, the charismatic actor who starred as the sensitive and insecure Dawson Leery on The WB teen melodrama Dawson’s Creek, lost his battle with colorectal cancer on Feb. 11. He was 48. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·范德比克 (James Van Der Beek) 是一位魅力十足的演员，他在 WB 青少年情节剧《道森溪》(Dawson’s Creek) 中饰演敏感而缺乏安全感的道森·利瑞 (Dawson Leery)，他于 2 月 11 日在与结直肠癌的斗争中失败。他享年 48 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

paras.en: Robert Duvall, the steely-eyed actor whose performances in the first two Godfather films, Apocalypse Now, The Great Santini, Lonesome Dove and The Apostle made him one of the finest actors of any generation, died on Feb. 15. He was 95. Read his full obituary.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·杜瓦尔 (Robert Duvall) 是一位目光坚定的演员，他在《教父》前两部电影《现代启示录》、《伟大的桑蒂尼》、《孤独的鸽子》和《使徒》中的表演使他成为这一代人中最优秀的演员之一。他于 2 月 15 日去世，享年 95 岁。请阅读他的完整讣告。

paras.en: Eric Dane, the hunky actor who found fame and the nickname “McSteamy” for his eight-year run as the plastic surgeon Mark Sloan on the ABC drama Grey’s Anatomy, lost his battle with ALS. He was 53. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 埃里克·戴恩 (Eric Dane) 是一位身材魁梧的演员，因连续八年在 ABC 电视剧《实习医生格蕾》中饰演整形外科医生马克·斯隆 (Mark Sloan) 而名声大噪，并获得了“麦克蒸汽”(McSteamy) 的绰号，但他在与 ALS 的斗争中失败了。他享年 53 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

paras.en: Chuck Norris, the martial arts champion and karate school teacher who jumped fist- and feetfirst into stardom with 1980s action movies like Missing in Action and the long-running CBS drama Walker, Texas Ranger, died on March 19. He was 86. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 武术冠军兼空手道学校老师查克·诺里斯 (Chuck Norris) 凭借 20 世纪 80 年代的动作片《失踪在行动》和 CBS 长篇电视剧《沃克，德克萨斯游骑兵》一跃成为明星，于 3 月 19 日去世。享年 86 岁。请阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Nicholas Brendon, the actor best known for playing lovable underdog Xander Harris on all seven seasons of the TV series Buffy the Vampire Slayer, died on March 20. He was 54. Full obituary.
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯·布伦登 (Nicholas Brendon) 因在电视剧《吸血鬼猎人巴菲》的全部七季中扮演可爱的失败者 Xander Harris 而闻名，于 3 月 20 日去世。享年 54 岁。完整讣告。

paras.en: James Tolkan, the character actor who expressed a disdain for “slackers” in the Back to the Future trilogy and portrayed Tom Cruise’s no-nonsense commanding officer in Top Gun, died on March 26. He was 94. Read his full obituary here.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·托尔坎 (James Tolkan) 于 3 月 26 日去世，享年 94 岁。在《回到未来》三部曲中表达了对“懒鬼”的蔑视，并在《壮志凌云》中饰演汤姆·克鲁斯严肃的指挥官。詹姆斯·托尔坎于 3 月 26 日去世，享年 94 岁。请在此处阅读他的完整讣告。

paras.en: Ted Turner, the media visionary who forever altered the news business by founding CNN and helped introduce Americans to pay TV by creating cable channels like TNT, Turner Classic Movies and Cartoon Network, died on May 6. He was 87. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 特德·特纳 (Ted Turner) 是一位媒体梦想家，他通过创立 CNN 永远改变了新闻业，并通过创建 TNT、特纳经典电影和卡通网络等有线电视频道帮助美国人引入付费电视。他于 5 月 6 日去世。享年 87 岁。请阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Kelly Curtis, an actress, documentarian and daughter of Tony Curtis and Janet Leigh, died on May 30, her younger sister, Jamie Lee Curtis, announced. She was 69. Read her full obituary.
paras.zh: 演员、纪录片导演凯莉·柯蒂斯 (Kelly Curtis) 是托尼·柯蒂斯 (Tony Curtis) 和珍妮特·利 (Janet Leigh) 的女儿，她的妹妹杰米·李·柯蒂斯 (Jamie Lee Curtis) 宣布，她于 5 月 30 日去世。她 69 岁。阅读她的完整讣告。

paras.en: Peabo Bryson, the two-time Grammy-winning R&B artist memorable for his work on the hit Disney songs “Beauty and the Beast” and “A Whole New World,” died on June 2. He was 75. Full obituary.
paras.zh: 两次获得格莱美奖的 R&B 艺术家皮博·布莱森 (Peabo Bryson) 因创作迪士尼热门歌曲《美女与野兽》和《全新世界》而令人难忘，他于 6 月 2 日去世，享年 75 岁。完整讣告。

paras.en: Oliver Tree, the singer, director and record producer known for his hit songs “Life Goes On” and “Miss You,” with Robin Schulz, died on June 14 in a helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. He was 32. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 歌手、导演兼唱片制作人奥利弗·特里 (Oliver Tree) 因与罗宾·舒尔茨 (Robin Schulz) 合作的热门歌曲《Life Goes On》和《Miss You》而闻名，于 6 月 14 日在巴西里约热内卢的一次直升机失事中丧生。他 32 岁。完整的讣告在这里。

paras.en: Clive Davis, the hands-on hitmaker with a “golden ear” who brought Janis Joplin, Whitney Houston and Bruce Springsteen to the world and revitalized the careers of Carlos Santana, Rod Stewart and Aretha Franklin, died on June 22. He was 94. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 克莱夫·戴维斯 (Clive Davis) 是一位拥有“金耳朵”的实干热门制作人，他为世界带来了詹尼斯·乔普林 (Janis Joplin)、惠特尼·休斯顿 (Whitney Houston) 和布鲁斯·斯普林斯汀 (Bruce Springsteen)，并重振了卡洛斯·桑塔纳 (Carlos Santana)、罗德·斯图尔特 (Rod Stewart) 和艾瑞莎·富兰克林 (Aretha Franklin) 的事业，他于 6 月 22 日去世。享年 94 岁。请阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Sam Neill, the amiable and adventurous leading man who emerged from New Zealand to make his mark in such films as Jurassic Park, The Piano, Dead Calm, In the Mouth of Madness and so much more, died on July 13. He was 78. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 萨姆·尼尔 (Sam Neill) 是一位来自新西兰的和蔼可亲、富有冒险精神的男主角，他在《侏罗纪公园》、《钢琴》、《死寂》、《疯狂之口》等影片中崭露头角，于 7 月 13 日去世。享年 78 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

paras.en: Arlene Smith, an original member of The Chantels who wrote and sang the lead on the R&B girl group’s classic 1957 hit, “Maybe,” died on July 29. She was 84. Read her obituary.
paras.zh: 阿琳·史密斯 (Arlene Smith) 是 The Chantels 的原成员，她为这支 R&B 女子组合 1957 年的经典热门歌曲《Maybe》作词并主唱，于 7 月 29 日去世。享年 84 岁。请阅读她的讣告。

paras.en: Jon Cypher, who portrayed Prince Charming opposite Julie Andrews in the first live TV production of Cinderella and Chief of Police Fletcher Daniels on all seven seasons of Hill Street Blues, died on Aug. 3. He was 94. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 乔恩·赛弗 (Jon Cypher) 于 8 月 3 日去世，享年 94 岁。乔恩·赛弗 (Jon Cypher) 于 8 月 3 日去世，享年 94 岁。

paras.en: Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles on shows such as Heroes and Nashville, died on Aug. 16, her father said in a statement. She was 36. It was later announced that she died from the toxic effects of fentanyl as well as prescription drugs. Read her full obituary here.
paras.zh: 海顿·潘妮蒂尔 (Hayden Panettiere) 因出演《英雄》和《纳什维尔》等电视剧而闻名，她的父亲在一份声明中表示，她于 8 月 16 日去世。她今年 36 岁。后来宣布她死于芬太尼和处方药的毒性作用。在这里阅读她的完整讣告。

paras.en: Bill Rasmussen, a onetime sportscaster for a Massachusetts TV station who borrowed $9,000 on his credit card on the way to launching the sports behemoth ESPN, died on Aug. 18. He was 93. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 比尔·拉斯穆森 (Bill Rasmussen) 曾是马萨诸塞州一家电视台的体育播音员，他在创办体育巨头 ESPN 的过程中用信用卡借了 9,000 美元，于 8 月 18 日去世。享年 93 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

paras.en: Bunny Levine, an actress who appeared in Gilmore Girls, You Don’t Mess With the Zohan, Thelma and numerous other TV shows and films, died on Aug. 20. She was 97. Read her obituary.
paras.zh: 邦尼·莱文 (Bunny Levine) 是一位女演员，曾出演《吉尔摩女孩》、《别惹佐汉》、《塞尔玛》和许多其他电视节目和电影，于 8 月 20 日去世。享年 97 岁。请阅读她的讣告。

paras.en: Shelley Fabares, the wholesome daughter on The Donna Reed Show who went on to star opposite Elvis Presley in three movies and as Craig T. Nelson’s independent wife on Coach, died on Aug. 22. She was 82. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 雪莱·法巴雷斯 (Shelley Fabares) 于 8 月 22 日去世，享年 82 岁。雪莉·法巴雷斯 (Shelley Fabares) 于 8 月 22 日去世，享年 82 岁。

paras.en: Dolly Parton, the irrepressible singer-songwriter, actress and entrepreneur who penned chart-toppers such as “9 to 5” and turned her namesake Tennessee theme park Dollywood into one of the world’s top amusement destinations, died Aug. 25 after a “brief battle with cancer.” She was 80. Read her full obituary here.
paras.zh: 多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton) 是一位难以抑制的创作型歌手、演员和企业家，她创作了《朝九晚五》等排行榜冠军歌曲，并将她的同名田纳西州主题公园多莱山 (Dollywood) 打造成世界顶级娱乐目的地之一，她在“与癌症的短暂斗争”后于 8 月 25 日去世。她享年 80 岁。请在此处阅读她的完整讣告。

paras.en: Tim Curry, the offbeat British actor who specialized in playing eccentrics like the seductive, cross-dressing scientist Dr. Frank-N-Furter in The Rocky Horror Picture Show and such fiendish villains as Pennywise the Clown from Stephen King’s It, died on Aug. 25. He was 80. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 另类英国演员蒂姆·库里 (Tim Curry) 于 8 月 25 日去世，享年 80 岁。他专门扮演《洛基恐怖秀》中迷人的异装科学家弗兰克·N·福特博士等怪人，以及史蒂芬·金的《它》中的小丑潘尼怀斯等邪恶恶棍。

paras.en: Peter Cullen, the Canadian voice actor who starred as the heroic Optimus Prime in a convoy of Transformers films, TV shows and video games and as the gloomy Eeyore in dozens of Winnie the Pooh projects, died on Aug. 26. He was 85. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 加拿大配音演员彼得·卡伦 (Peter Cullen) 于 8 月 26 日去世，享年 85 岁，他在变形金刚电影、电视节目和视频游戏中饰演英雄擎天柱，并在数十个小熊维尼项目中饰演忧郁的屹耳。

paras.en: Bob Mackie, the nine-time Emmy-winning costume designer known as the “Sultan of Sequins” for the spectacular, over-the-top outfits he created for the likes of Cher, Diana Ross, Mitzi Gaynor and Carol Burnett, died on Sept. 13. He was 87. Read his obituary here.
paras.zh: 九次获得艾美奖的服装设计师鲍勃·麦基 (Bob Mackie) 因为雪儿 (Cher)、戴安娜·罗斯 (Diana Ross)、米兹·盖纳 (Mitzi Gaynor) 和卡罗尔·伯内特 (Carol Burnett) 等人设计的华丽夸张服装而被称为“亮片苏丹”，于 9 月 13 日去世。享年 87 岁。请在此处阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Eva Marie Saint, the ethereal beauty who won the best supporting actress Oscar for her work in her first motion picture, On the Waterfront, then dazzled audiences as a double agent in North by Northwest, died on Oct. 6. She was 102. Read her obituary here.
paras.zh: 空灵美丽的爱娃·玛丽·森特 (Eva Marie Saint) 于 10 月 6 日去世，享年 102 岁。她凭借第一部电影《码头风云》获得奥斯卡最佳女配角，随后在《西北偏北》中饰演双重间谍，令观众眼花缭乱。她于 10 月 6 日去世，享年 102 岁。请在此处阅读她的讣告。

paras.en: R.J. Mitte, the actor and disability rights advocate who portrayed Walter White Jr., the son of Bryan Cranston’s character, on Breaking Bad, died on Oct. 12. He was 34. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: R.J.米特是一位演员兼残疾人权利倡导者，他在《绝命毒师》中扮演了布莱恩·科兰斯顿角色的儿子小沃尔特·怀特，于 10 月 12 日去世。享年 34 岁。阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Patrick Stewart, the sophisticated actor who brought a Shakespearean touch to Star Trek and X-Men as he made an otherworldly transformation from British stage veteran to sci-fi icon, died on Oct. 28. He was 86. Read his obituary here.
paras.zh: 帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 于 10 月 28 日去世，享年 86 岁。帕特里克·斯图尔特 (Patrick Stewart) 于 10 月 28 日去世，享年 86 岁。

paras.en: Toukie Smith, a top model in the 1970s and an actress who appeared as Eva Rawley on the Marla Gibbs-starring NBC sitcom 227, died on Nov. 4. She was 74. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 图基·史密斯 (Toukie Smith) 是 20 世纪 70 年代的顶级模特，也是一位女演员，曾在玛拉·吉布斯 (Marla Gibbs) 主演的 NBC 情景喜剧 227 中饰演伊娃·罗利 (Eva Rawley)，于 11 月 4 日去世。享年 74 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

paras.en: Stacy Keach, the two-fisted actor who starred as the hard-boiled private eye Mike Hammer on television and won acclaim — but never superstardom — for his work in Fat City, The New Centurions and many other films, died on Nov. 10. He was 85. Read his obituary.
paras.zh: 史黛西·基奇 (Stacy Keach) 是一位双拳演员，他在电视上饰演冷酷的私家侦探迈克·哈默 (Mike Hammer)，并因其在《胖城》、《新百夫长》和许多其他电影中的出色表现而赢得赞誉，但从未成为超级巨星。他于 11 月 10 日去世，享年 85 岁。请阅读他的讣告。

paras.en: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran‘s guitarist during the band’s commercial peak in the 1980s as well as a founding member of supergroup The Power Station, died on Nov. 23. He was 65. Full obituary here.
paras.zh: 安迪·泰勒 (Andy Taylor) 是杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 乐队在 1980 年代商业巅峰期间的吉他手，也是超级组合 The Power Station 的创始成员，于 11 月 23 日去世。享年 65 岁。完整讣告请点击此处。

articles.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals

paras.en: The Trump administration has unveiled a fresh tariff salvo on more than a dozen trading partners, with China, Vietnam, and India facing some of the steepest potential rates and mounting pressure to conclude trade deals with Washington.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府对十多个贸易伙伴发起了新的关税攻势，其中中国、越南和印度面临着一些最高的潜在关税，并且与华盛顿达成贸易协议的压力越来越大。

paras.en: The proposed tariffs, framed as curbing excess industrial capacity, start at 15% for the European Union, South Korea, Switzerland and Taiwan and rise to as much as 35% for Vietnam.
paras.zh: 拟议的关税旨在抑制过剩工业产能，对欧盟、韩国、瑞士和台湾的关税起始为 15%，对越南则提高至 35%。

paras.en: The U.S. Trade Representative's Office said it intends to cap the new duties at lower levels for countries that have completed trade deals or are still negotiating with Washington.
paras.zh: 美国贸易代表办公室表示，打算将已完成贸易协议或仍在与华盛顿谈判的国家的新关税限制在较低水平。

paras.en: The overall impact on the region is likely to be limited, said Mark Williams, chief Asia economist at Capital Economics. The proposal "puts most of the targeted countries back where they were earlier in the year," he said, after the Supreme Court struck down Trump's emergency tariffs in February.
paras.zh: 凯投宏观首席亚洲经济学家马克·威廉姆斯表示，对该地区的总体影响可能有限。在最高法院二月份推翻特朗普的紧急关税后，他表示，该提案“使大多数目标国家回到了今年早些时候的水平”。

paras.en: Still, the proposal could give some countries an incentive to speed up trade talks in order to lock in lower tariff rates, analysts said.
paras.zh: 不过，分析师表示，该提案可能会激励一些国家加快贸易谈判，以锁定较低的关税税率。

paras.en: On Wednesday, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said that the new policy likely will not take effect for months, with a senior U.S. official saying the duties could take effect as early as January.
paras.zh: 周三，美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔 (Jamieson Greer) 表示，新政策可能要几个月后才会生效，一位美国高级官员表示，关税最早可能在一月份生效。

paras.en: China faces a capped rate of 20%, on top of an existing 25% tariff imposed during President Donald Trump's first term. The rate could rise to 40% if the trade truce reached in South Korea last October is not extended beyond January, the USTR said.
paras.zh: 除了唐纳德·特朗普总统第一任期内征收的 25% 关税之外，中国还面临 20% 的关税上限。美国贸易代表办公室表示，如果去年 10 月与韩国达成的贸易休战协议不延长至 1 月之后，税率可能升至 40%。

paras.en: Beijing has rejected Washington's claim of excess capacity while vowing to take measures necessary to protect its rights.
paras.zh: 北京拒绝了华盛顿关于产能过剩的说法，同时誓言采取必要措施保护其权利。

paras.en: On Thursday, Chinese Commerce Ministry spokesperson He Yadong called on Washington to "rectify its wrongdoing and return to the right track of resolving issues through dialogue."
paras.zh: 周四，中国商务部发言人何亚东呼吁华盛顿“纠正错误做法，回到通过对话解决问题的正确轨道”。

paras.en: He was responding to Washington's plan to raise tariffs following its Section 301 investigations, while the ministry also urged the U.S. to implement $30 billion of reciprocal tariff cuts agreed by the two sides in late September.
paras.zh: 他是在回应华盛顿在301调查后提高关税的计划，而商务部还敦促美国实施双方9月底商定的300亿美元的互惠关税削减。

paras.en: The renewed tensions come despite several conciliatory meetings between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping this year, as well as what Williams described as Trump's "apparent lack of concern" about allegations that Chinese technology firms have circumvented U.S. chip export controls.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普与中国国家主席习近平今年举行了几次和解会议，而且威廉姆斯称特朗普对中国科技公司规避美国芯片出口管制的指控“明显缺乏担忧”，但紧张局势再次出现。

paras.en: The two leaders are expected to meet for a fourth time this year at the Group of 20 leaders summit in Miami in December.
paras.zh: 两位领导人预计将于 12 月在迈阿密举行的 20 国集团领导人峰会上第四次会面。

paras.en: "While not happy, Beijing seems prepared to live with the new rates provided that they don't exceed 20%," said Wendy Cutler, senior vice president at the Asia Society Policy Institute.
paras.zh: 亚洲协会政策研究所高级副总裁温迪·卡特勒表示，“虽然不高兴，但北京似乎准备接受新的税率，前提是不超过 20%。”

paras.en: By retaining the option to raise levies if bilateral talks deteriorate, Washington is using the tariffs as leverage to "secure expected shipments of critical minerals and rare earths, and further purchases of U.S. agricultural goods," Cutler said.
paras.zh: 卡特勒表示，通过保留在双边谈判恶化时提高关税的选择，华盛顿正在利用关税作为杠杆，以“确保关键矿产和稀土的预期运输，并进一步购买美国农产品”。

paras.en: Washington has warned that tariffs on Chinese goods could double to 40% if the USTR finds that Beijing is not engaging. "If the trade war did start up again, today's measures provide the U.S. with some ammunition," Williams said.
paras.zh: 华盛顿警告称，如果美国贸易代表办公室发现北京方面不参与，中国商品的关税可能会增加一倍，达到 40%。威廉姆斯表示：“如果贸易战确实再次爆发，今天的措施将为美国提供一些弹药。”

paras.en: Even the sweeping actions against the other 13 trading partners appear aimed squarely at China, said Williams, who tallied that the word "China" appears 253 times in the USTR's report on Vietnam, and 315 times in the document on the European Union.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说，即使是针对其他13个贸易伙伴的全面行动似乎也直接针对中国。他统计，“中国”一词在美国贸易代表办公室关于越南的报告中出现了253次，在关于欧盟的文件中出现了315次。

paras.en: "Foremost among the 'unreasonable acts, policies, and practices' that these countries are criticised for is being slow to restrict imports and FDI from China," Williams said.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说：“这些国家受到批评的‘不合理行为、政策和做法’中最重要的是限制来自中国的进口和外国直接投资的行动缓慢。”

paras.en: While the proposed tariffs generally lift average rates only modestly, India and Vietnam stand out because of the wider gaps between the rates they would face with and without a deal, analysts said.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，虽然拟议的关税通常只会小幅提高平均税率，但印度和越南脱颖而出，因为达成协议和未达成协议时两国面临的税率差距更大。

paras.en: India and Vietnam face proposed tariffs of 25% and 35%, respectively, but those rates could fall sharply to 17% and 20% if ongoing talks with the U.S. produce reciprocal trade agreements.
paras.zh: 印度和越南分别面临拟议的 25% 和 35% 关税，但如果与美国正在进行的谈判达成互惠贸易协定，这些税率可能会大幅降至 17% 和 20%。

paras.en: The two countries have "a strong incentive" to conclude deals with Washington to secure the lower rates, Cutler said.
paras.zh: 卡特勒表示，两国“有强烈的动机”与华盛顿达成协议以确保较低的利率。

paras.en: Vietnam's trade ministry said Thursday that it was working with the U.S. to complete a trade deal as soon as possible, according to Reuters. India could also gain an edge over some Asian rivals through comparatively lower levies if New Delhi concludes its long-pending trade deal with Washington.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，越南贸易部周四表示，正在与美国合作，尽快完成贸易协议。如果新德里与华盛顿达成悬而未决的贸易协议，印度还可能通过相对较低的关税获得相对于一些亚洲竞争对手的优势。

paras.en: Singapore faces a similar challenge. The proposal sets a maximum potential rate of 20% on its exports, net of existing Section 301 tariffs, which could fall to 10% if it reaches an agreement on reciprocal trade with the U.S. or concludes other negotiations addressing the USTR's findings, according to Singapore's Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry.
paras.zh: 新加坡也面临着类似的挑战。新加坡能源、贸易和工业部表示，该提案将其出口的最高潜在税率设定为 20%（扣除现有的 301 条款关税），如果与美国达成互惠贸易协议或完成针对 USTR 调查结果的其他谈判，则该税率可能降至 10%。

paras.en: The ministry said it disagreed with the findings and was "very disappointed" with the proposed action, arguing that it failed to account for the structure of Singapore's economy.
paras.zh: 该部表示不同意调查结果，并对拟议的行动“非常失望”，认为它未能考虑到新加坡经济的结构。

paras.en: Under the U.S.-Singapore Free Trade Agreement, Singapore imposes zero tariffs on U.S. goods, while the U.S. has run a trade surplus with the city-state for more than 20 years, the ministry said. That surplus grew to $33 billion in 2025 from $27 billion in 2024.
paras.zh: 该部表示，根据美国-新加坡自由贸易协定，新加坡对美国商品实行零关税，而美国与新加坡的贸易顺差已有20多年。这一盈余从 2024 年的 270 亿美元增至 2025 年的 330 亿美元。

paras.en: Singapore said it would submit further comments during the public consultation period and urge the USTR to reconsider.
paras.zh: 新加坡表示将在公众咨询期间提交进一步评论，并敦促美国贸易代表办公室重新考虑。

paras.en: Exemptions for semiconductors and other electronics should cushion the impact on South Korea and Taiwan, whose economies are heavily concentrated in those sectors, analysts said.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，对半导体和其他电子产品的豁免应该可以缓解对韩国和台湾的影响，这两个国家的经济主要集中在这些行业。

paras.en: The USTR singled out South Korea for its concentration in memory-chip production and what it described as outsized government support. Yet it excluded the country's chips from the proposed excess-capacity tariffs.
