articles.title: Commercial Space Federation Welcomes CesiumAstro as a New Associate Member
articles.author: Commercial Space Federation

paras.en: November 13, 2026— Washington, D.C.—The Commercial Space Federation (CSF) is pleased to welcome CesiumAstro as its newest Associate Member. A global leader in advanced connectivity solutions for the space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. CesiumAstro’s addition further strengthens CSF’s diverse membership and the Federation’s work to advance a competitive, innovative, and sustainable U.S. commercial space economy.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日——华盛顿特区——商业航天联合会 (CSF) 很高兴欢迎 CesiumAstro 成为其最新准会员。 CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。 CesiumAstro 的加入进一步加强了 CSF 的多元化成员资格以及联合会推动竞争性、创新性和可持续的美国商业太空经济的工作。

paras.en: CesiumAstro is a lobal leader in advanced connectivity solutions for space and defense sectors, CesiumAstro delivers advanced space systems that connect, detect, and defend across commercial, government, and national security missions. Its full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads and advanced computing systems. CesiumAstro maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards. Headquartered near Austin, Texas, the company operates additional facilities in Colorado, California, Washington, D.C., Florida, the United Kingdom, Germany, Singapore, Taiwan, and Japan.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 是太空和国防部门先进连接解决方​​案的全球领导者，CesiumAstro 提供先进的太空系统，可跨商业、政府和国家安全任务进行连接、检测和防御。其全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。 CesiumAstro 保持与内部设计、制造和测试能力的完全垂直整合，并通过了 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证。该公司总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀附近，在科罗拉多州、加利福尼亚州、华盛顿特区、佛罗里达州、英国、德国、新加坡、台湾和日本设有其他工厂。

paras.en: CesiumAstro recently announced the closing of $730 million in Series D financing, valuing the company at more than $4.5 billion, and unveiled Synchronicity, a planned 737-satellite, AI-enabled constellation. The new capital will support advanced technologies, expansion of U.S. manufacturing capacity, development and production of next-generation spacecraft, Synchronicity deployment, and international growth.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 最近宣布完成 7.3 亿美元的 D 轮融资，公司估值超过 45 亿美元，并推出了 Synchronicity，这是一个计划中的 737 颗卫星、支持人工智能的星座。新资金将支持先进技术、美国制造能力的扩张、下一代航天器的开发和生产、同步部署和国际增长。

paras.en: In the past 12 months, CesiumAstro has expanded its capabilities through three strategic acquisitions: Jariet Technologies, 1Aardvark, and Vidrovr, strengthening the company’s capabilities across semiconductor technology, mission software, and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 在过去的 12 个月中，CesiumAstro 通过三项战略收购扩大了其能力：Jariet Technologies、1Aardvark 和 Vidrovr，增强了公司在半导体技术、任务软件和人工智能方面的能力。

paras.en: CesiumAstro’s full-stack, multi-mission, end-to-end hardware and software solutions encompass satellites, high-performance communications payloads, and advanced compute systems. The company maintains complete vertical integration with in-house design, manufacturing, and testing capabilities certified to AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 standards.
paras.zh: CesiumAstro 的全栈、多任务、端到端硬件和软件解决方案涵盖卫星、高性能通信有效载荷和先进计算系统。该公司与通过 AS9100D/ISO 9001:2015 标准认证的内部设计、制造和测试能力保持完整的垂直整合。

paras.en: “A thriving commercial economy in low Earth orbit needs reliable communications and a clear path from development to operations. CesiumAstro is joining CSF’s Commercial LEO Council to bring our communications expertise to that effort. We look forward to advancing policies that encourage investment, expand government use of commercial services, and support companies building the next generation of space infrastructure.”
paras.zh: “近地轨道蓬勃发展的商业经济需要可靠的通信以及从开发到运营的清晰路径。CesiumAstro 正在加入 CSF 的商业 LEO 委员会，将我们的通信专业知识用于这一努力。我们期待推进鼓励投资、扩大政府对商业服务的使用以及支持企业建设下一代空间基础设施的政策。”

paras.en: – Josh Ingersoll, Director of Spectrum and Regulatory Affairs at CesiumAstro
paras.zh: – Josh Ingersoll，CesiumAstro 频谱和监管事务总监

paras.en: Founded in 2006, the Commercial Space Federation (CSF) and its members are laying the foundation for democratizing access to outer space for scientists, students, civilians, and businesses. All while working towards the goal of expanding the U.S. Commercial Space Economy. Through the promotion of technological innovation, CSF and its diverse membership are guiding the bolstering of U.S. leadership in aerospace and inspiring America’s next generation of engineers and explorers. CSF also serves as the commercial space industry’s primary advocate with the U.S. Congress and the Administration, helping inform the development and implementation of policy priorities. By engaging with congressional players, CSF is able to provide recommendations on commercial space issues that will impact the commercial space industry in the short and long term.
paras.zh: 商业太空联盟 (CSF) 及其成员成立于 2006 年，正在为科学家、学生、平民和企业进入外太空的民主化奠定基础。同时努力实现扩大美国商业太空经济的目标。通过促进技术创新，CSF 及其多元化成员正在指导巩固美国在航空航天领域的领导地位，并激励美国下一代工程师和探险家。 CSF 还担任美国国会和政府商业航天业的主要倡导者，帮助为政策优先事项的制定和实施提供信息。通过与国会参与者合作，CSF 能够就商业航天问题提供建议，这些问题将在短期和长期影响商业航天行业。

articles.title: Gaza’s widows raise their families alone: ‘We do our duties twice over, but where are our rights?’

paras.en: Gaza’s widows raise their families alone: ‘We do our duties twice over, but where are our rights?’
paras.zh: 加沙的寡妇独自养家糊口：“我们双重履行了我们的职责，但我们的权利在哪里？”

paras.en: For women in Gaza who lost their husbands in the war, providing for a family no longer means just putting food on the table. Now it also means finding shelter, hauling water and keeping children in school – all from a tent.
paras.zh: 对于在战争中失去丈夫的加沙妇女来说，养家糊口不再仅仅意味着温饱。现在，这还意味着寻找庇护所、运水以及让孩子们上学——所有这些都需要在帐篷里完成。

paras.en: At the Flowers of Palestine camp, set up for widows in western Gaza City, the day begins with a walk to the water tankers. Women and their children fill buckets and plastic containers and carry them back to their canvas dwellings.
paras.zh: 在加沙城西部为寡妇设立的巴勒斯坦之花营地，新的一天从步行到水罐车开始。妇女和她们的孩子把水桶和塑料容器装满，然后把它们带回她们的帆布住所。

paras.en: “We carry out our duties twice over – our own and the man’s as well – but where are our rights?” said Kholoud Farajallah, a mother of three, speaking to our UN News correspondent in Gaza.
paras.zh: “我们双重履行我们的义务——我们自己的和人的——但我们的权利在哪里？”三个孩子的母亲霍卢德·法拉贾拉 (Kholoud Farajallah) 在加沙接受我们的联合国新闻记者采访时说道。

paras.en: According to UN Women, more than 86,000 households in Gaza are now headed by women.
paras.zh: 据联合国妇女署称，加沙目前有超过 86,000 个家庭由女性担任户主。

paras.en: That is nearly one in four, compared with one in nine before the war. On the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, marked on 25 November, their struggle shows how the war’s harm to women goes far beyond death and injury.
paras.zh: 这一比例接近四分之一，而战前为九分之一。 11 月 25 日是消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日，她们的斗争表明战争对妇女的伤害远远超出了死亡和伤害。

paras.en: Ms. Farajallah lost her husband early in the war. With no money coming in, she had to give up her master’s degree in mathematics and teaching methods.
paras.zh: 法拉贾拉女士在战争初期失去了丈夫。由于没有钱进来，她不得不放弃数学和教学方法的硕士学位。

paras.en: She started out by baking pastries and sending her son to sell them around the displacement camps. Later she built a small shop out of timber and plastic sheeting near the camp, which now covers her children’s basic needs.
paras.zh: 她一开始烘烤糕点，然后派儿子到流离失所者营地周围出售。后来，她在营地附近用木材和塑料布建了一家小商店，现在可以满足孩子们的基本需求。

paras.en: Her day doesn’t end at the counter. She also runs the household, looks after the children and keeps on top of their schooling.
paras.zh: 她的一天并没有在柜台结束。她还负责管理家庭、照顾孩子并负责他们的学业。

paras.en: In another tent in the camp, Umm Mohammed Abu Rayala is raising seven children. She alone has to feed them, look after them and see that they keep learning.
paras.zh: 在营地的另一个帐篷里，乌姆·穆罕默德·阿布·拉亚拉 (Umm Mohammed Abu Rayala) 正在抚养七个孩子。她必须独自喂养他们，照顾他们并确保他们不断学习。

paras.en: Losing their husbands has left women with burdens they never carried before the war, she told UN News. They now fill the roles of both father and mother, in a daily life with nothing stable in it.
paras.zh: 她告诉联合国新闻，失去丈夫给妇女带来了战前从未承受过的负担。他们现在扮演着父亲和母亲的角色，在日常生活中没有任何稳定的东西。

paras.en: UN Women says 68 per cent of households headed by women do not have adequate shelter, and 67 per cent urgently need cash assistance just to get through each day. On average, these families have been forced to move eight times since October 2023.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署表示，68％的以女性为户主的家庭没有足够的住所，67％的家庭迫切需要现金援助才能度过每一天。自 2023 年 10 月以来，这些家庭平均被迫搬家八次。

paras.en: The Flowers of Palestine initiative is trying to meet some of those needs. Nidaa Matar, one of its organizers, said it began as a personal effort in response to the growing number of widows and orphans the war was leaving behind.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦之花倡议正试图满足其中一些需求。活动组织者之一尼达·马塔尔 (Nidaa Matar) 表示，这一活动最初是个人的努力，旨在应对战争留下的越来越多的寡妇和孤儿。

paras.en: “We reached out to different organizations and associations to make this idea a reality. Thank God, we managed to build this camp, which shelters 82 widowed families,” she said. “We were able to give a home to families who didn’t know where to live, because they had no breadwinner and no income.”
paras.zh: “我们联系了不同的组织和协会，让这个想法成为现实。感谢上帝，我们成功建造了这个营地，为 82 个丧偶家庭提供了庇护，”她说。 “我们能够为那些不知道住在哪里的家庭提供一个家，因为他们没有养家糊口，也没有收入。”

paras.en: UN Women has warned that conditions will get worse as winter rains and floods sweep through displacement camps. Households headed by women are at greater risk because their shelters are flimsy and they are displaced again and again.
paras.zh: 联合国妇女署警告说，随着冬季降雨和洪水席卷流离失所者营地，情况将变得更糟。以妇女为户主的家庭面临更大的风险，因为她们的住所很脆弱，并且一次又一次地流离失所。

paras.en: Nearly 50,000 women and girls in Gaza have been killed or seriously injured since the war began, according to UN Women. More than 38,000 of them were killed, and around 11,700 have been left with permanent disabilities.
paras.zh: 据联合国妇女署称，自战争开始以来，加沙已有近 5 万名妇女和女童被杀或重伤。其中超过 38,000 人死亡，约 11,700 人永久残疾。

paras.en: Between the tents, the water queues and the daily hunt for a living, women like Ms. Farajallah and Ms. Abu Rayala keep their families going. How much longer they can do it is another question.
paras.zh: 法拉贾拉 (Farajallah) 和阿布·拉亚拉 (Abu Rayala) 等妇女在帐篷、排队取水和日常谋生之间维持着家庭的生计。他们还能坚持多久是另一个问题。

paras.en: “As a woman, I have received none of my rights at all,” Ms. Farajallah said. “I gave up my education, I gave up my life, and I devote everything – all my time – to raising my children. But until when?”
paras.zh: “作为一名女性，我根本没有获得任何权利，”法拉贾拉女士说。 “我放弃了我的教育，我放弃了我的生活，我投入了一切——所有的时间——来抚养我的孩子。但要等到什么时候呢？”

articles.title: Governments and experts gather in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis

paras.en: Governments and experts gather in Nairobi to tackle the global housing crisis
paras.zh: 各国政府和专家齐聚内罗毕应对全球住房危机

paras.en: A home is a place where people can feel safe. Yet billions worldwide do not have a proper place to live. As the global housing crisis deepens, government representatives and housing experts are gathering at the United Nations in Nairobi from 26-27 November to discuss how to address it.
paras.zh: 家是一个让人感到安全的地方。然而，全世界有数十亿人没有合适的居住地。随着全球住房危机的加深，政府代表和住房专家将于 11 月 26 日至 27 日齐聚内罗毕联合国，讨论如何解决这一问题。

paras.en: For many people living in informal settlements, the housing crisis goes hand in hand with the climate crisis.
paras.zh: 对于许多生活在非正规住区的人来说，住房危机与气候危机齐头并进。

paras.en: “People don’t sleep at night because they don't know if their houses will be standing the next day,” said Anacláudia Rossbach, Executive Director of UN-Habitat, the agency working to make cities more sustainable, which is hosting the meeting.
paras.zh: 联合国人居署执行主任阿纳克拉乌迪亚·罗斯巴赫（Anacláudia Rossbach）表示：“人们晚上不睡觉，因为他们不知道自己的房子第二天是否还能屹立不倒。”联合国人居署致力于让城市变得更加可持续，也是这次会议的主办方。

paras.en: The objective is to better understand the scale and nature of homelessness, improve national housing policies, and ensure that housing can withstand growing environmental and climate pressures.
paras.zh: 目标是更好地了解无家可归的规模和性质，改善国家住房政策，并确保住房能够承受日益增长的环境和气候压力。

paras.en: This is the third session of the Open-ended Intergovernmental Expert Working Group on Adequate Housing for All (OEWG-H) which was established in 2023. It aims to advance a comprehensive set of recommendations for the UN-Habitat Assembly in 2029.
paras.zh: 这是2023年成立的人人享有适足住房问题不限成员名额政府间专家工作组（OEWG-H）的第三次会议，旨在为2029年联合国人居大会提出一套全面的建议。

paras.en: Speaking to UN News ahead of the meeting, Ms. Rossbach emphasized the importance of bringing the housing crisis to the attention of Member States and building consensus on how to address it.
paras.zh: 罗斯巴赫女士在会议前接受《联合国新闻》采访时强调了提请会员国关注住房危机并就如何解决这一问题达成共识的重要性。

paras.en: Adequate housing means having the right to live somewhere in security, peace and dignity. For example, people should not fear being evicted, or that their home is unsafe because it was built with the wrong materials. She also highlighted the need to put homelessness on the global housing agenda.
paras.zh: 充足的住房意味着有权在安全、和平和有尊严的地方居住。例如，人们不应该担心被驱逐，或者他们的家因为使用了错误的材料而不安全。她还强调有必要将无家可归问题纳入全球住房议程。

paras.en: “We estimate that we have about 300 million people living without a roof over their heads, but we don't have a global definition of homelessness,” she said.
paras.zh: “我们估计大约有 3 亿人无家可归，但我们对无家可归没有一个全球性的定义，”她说。

paras.en: Having this definition means that people who are experiencing homelessness can be more easily included in housing policies in line with internationally agreed targets.
paras.zh: 有了这个定义意味着无家可归的人可以更容易地纳入符合国际商定目标的住房政策。

paras.en: However, having a home does not necessarily mean that it is safe. The latest UN-Habitat World Cities Report estimates that up to 3.4 billion people lack adequate housing, with more than 1.1 billion living in informal settlements and slums. This usually entails a lack of secure tenure, sanitation or safe water.
paras.zh: 然而，拥有一个家并不一定意味着它是安全的。联合国人居署最新的《世界城市报告》估计，多达 34 亿人缺乏足够的住房，其中超过 11 亿人生活在非正规住区和贫民窟。这通常意味着缺乏有保障的保有权、卫生设施或安全用水。

paras.en: As governments face the challenge of improving existing housing and building new homes, they must also consider the environmental consequences of construction and where these homes are built. “Housing is the cornerstone for adaptation,” she stressed.
paras.zh: 当政府面临改善现有住房和建造新住宅的挑战时，他们还必须考虑建筑工程以及这些住宅的建造地点对环境的影响。 “住房是适应的基石，”她强调。

paras.en: To address the housing crisis, an essential component remains listening to those most affected. Ms. Rossbach underscored the importance of involving local authorities and communities in the development of housing policies, especially those in more vulnerable positions. Local governments, she explained, are closer to the communities they serve and are therefore better positioned to understand their needs.
paras.zh: 为了解决住房危机，一个重要的组成部分仍然是倾听受影响最严重的人的意见。罗斯巴赫女士强调了地方当局和社区参与制定住房政策的重要性，特别是那些处于弱势地位的社区。她解释说，地方政府更接近他们所服务的社区，因此更有能力了解他们的需求。

paras.en: From communities and local governments to researchers and the private sector, efforts to address housing challenges are already underway. “They are finding solutions. They are innovating, and they are moving the frontier,” she said.
paras.zh: 从社区和地方政府到研究人员和私营部门，解决住房挑战的努力已经在进行中。 “他们正在寻找解决方案。他们正在创新，他们正在突破前沿，”她说。

paras.en: At the meeting, UN-Habitat will launch the first version of its Housing Knowledge Platform, bringing together housing data, policy resources and examples of practices from around the world.
paras.zh: 会上，人居署将推出第一版住房知识平台，汇集世界各地的住房数据、政策资源和实践范例。

paras.en: Despite the magnitude of the global housing crisis, Ms. Rossbach finds hope in the solutions already emerging on the ground.
paras.zh: 尽管全球住房危机十分严重，罗斯巴赫女士还是从已经出现的解决方案中看到了希望。

paras.en: “The decisions here, they will have a direct impact on the lives of people,” she said. “So, let's keep people at the centre of our minds this week.”
paras.zh: “这里的决定将对人们的生活产生直接影响，”她说。 “所以，本周让我们以人为本。”

articles.title: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians

paras.en: Türk warns of widening risk of atrocity crimes against Palestinians
paras.zh: 蒂尔克警告巴勒斯坦人遭受暴行罪的风险不断扩大

paras.en: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Wednesday warned of a widening risk of further atrocity crimes by Israel against Palestinians, saying violence in the occupied West Bank in recent months has heightened existential fears.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周三警告称，以色列对巴勒斯坦人实施进一步暴行的风险不断加大，称近几个月来被占领的约旦河西岸发生的暴力事件加剧了人们的生存恐惧。

paras.en: “In Gaza, my office has repeatedly warned against the risk of Israeli actions posing a real threat to the continued existence of Palestinians as a group,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在加沙，我的办公室一再警告以色列的行动可能对巴勒斯坦人作为一个群体的继续存在构成真正的威胁。”

paras.en: “Events over the past months in the occupied West Bank exacerbate our fear of such risk across the entirety of the occupied Palestinian territory.”
paras.zh: “过去几个月在被占领的约旦河西岸发生的事件加剧了我们对整个被占领巴勒斯坦领土出现这种风险的担忧。”

paras.en: “Our warnings have not been heeded, and atrocity crimes continue to recur,” the High Commissioner said. “Civilians continue to be killed, and hundreds of thousands of Palestinians have been forcibly displaced, with senior Israeli officials indicating intent for such displacement to be permanent.”
paras.zh: 高级专员表示：“我们的警告没有得到重视，暴行犯罪仍在继续发生。” “平民继续被杀害，数十万巴勒斯坦人被迫流离失所，以色列高级官员表示有意让这种流离失所成为永久性的。”

paras.en: Since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks, 42,666 Palestinians have been forcibly displaced by Israeli forces and settlers in the West Bank, including East Jerusalem, according to the UN human rights office. In Gaza, nearly two million have been forcibly displaced, often multiple times.
paras.zh: 据联合国人权办公室称，自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击以来，包括东耶路撒冷在内的西岸地区有 42,666 名巴勒斯坦人被以色列军队和定居者强迫流离失所。在加沙，近两百万人被迫流离失所，而且往往是多次流离失所。

paras.en: “I am extremely worried about the increasingly widespread and systematic nature of the violations being perpetrated across both the West Bank and Gaza,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “我对约旦河西岸和加沙地带日益普遍和系统性的侵犯行为感到极其担忧，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “Civilian infrastructure is destroyed in Gaza, as illegal settlements advance in the West Bank,” he added. “Palestinians are persistently arbitrarily detained, subjected to torture and mistreatment, and exposed to a two-tier justice system. The list goes on and on.”
paras.zh: “随着非法定居点在西岸的推进，加沙的民用基础设施遭到破坏，”他补充道。 “巴勒斯坦人持续遭到任意拘留，遭受酷刑和虐待，并面临两级司法系统的制裁。这样的例子不胜枚举。”

paras.en: He expressed particular concern over continued unlawful killings in Gaza even after a ceasefire was announced last year.
paras.zh: 他对去年宣布停火后加沙持续发生的非法杀戮表示特别关注。

paras.en: Gaza’s population is confined to an ever-shrinking sliver of the territory, he said, while Israel’s continued blockade and closure deprive Palestinians of basic survival necessities, including food, medicine and shelter.
paras.zh: 他说，加沙的人口被限制在不断缩小的领土上，而以色列的持续封锁和封锁剥夺了巴勒斯坦人的基本生存必需品，包括食品、药品和住所。

paras.en: Mr. Türk also reminded Hamas and other Palestinian armed groups of their obligation to protect civilians and to respect the safety and independence of humanitarian personnel and operations, as well as the prohibitions of summary executions, arbitrary detention, torture and other ill-treatment.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生还提醒哈马斯和其他巴勒斯坦武装团体有义务保护平民、尊重人道主义人员和行动的安全和独立性，并禁止即决处决、任意拘留、酷刑和其他虐待行为。

paras.en: In the West Bank, he pointed to systematic, violent efforts to replace Palestinian communities with Israeli settlers and to fragment the territory in a way that undermines any prospect of a contiguous future Palestinian State.
paras.zh: 他指出，在西岸，以色列定居者以系统性的暴力行为取代巴勒斯坦社区，并分裂领土，从而破坏了未来巴勒斯坦国的任何前景。

paras.en: He also cited a system of racial segregation, oppression and domination, seen most clearly in a separate legal system for Palestinians and a discriminatory movement regime that prioritises settlers’ freedom of movement over Palestinians’ ability to exercise their basic rights in daily life.
paras.zh: 他还列举了种族隔离、压迫和统治的制度，最明显地体现在针对巴勒斯坦人的单独法律制度和歧视性运动制度中，该制度优先考虑定居者的行动自由，而不是巴勒斯坦人在日常生活中行使其基本权利的能力。

paras.en: “Israeli Government representatives at highest levels have time and again spelled out policies of annexation, ethnic cleansing, and collective punishment in the West Bank,” he said. “Across society, the incitement to hatred and to perpetration of violations amounting to atrocity crimes – war crimes, crimes against humanity and even genocide – has been appalling.”
paras.zh: “以色列政府最高层代表一再阐明在西岸的吞并、种族清洗和集体惩罚政策，”他说。 “在整个社会，煽动仇恨和实施相当于暴行罪——战争罪、反人类罪甚至种族灭绝罪——的行为令人震惊。”

paras.en: “All States have the obligation to act, now, to prevent further atrocity crimes against the Palestinians,” Mr. Türk said.
paras.zh: “所有国家现在都有义务采取行动，防止针对巴勒斯坦人的进一步暴行，”蒂尔克先生说。

paras.en: “There must be independent investigations, and those responsible must be held to account. The work of the international courts in this regard must be supported by all States.”
paras.zh: “必须进行独立调查，必须追究责任人的责任。国际法院在这方面的工作必须得到所有国家的支持。”

articles.title: 'Cyborg' LeBron breaks own NBA record as Durant reaches historic milestone

paras.en: LeBron James breaks NBA record with Philadelphia 76ers as Kevin Durant joins exclusive club by passing 33,000 points
paras.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯随费城 76 人队打破 NBA 纪录，凯文·杜兰特以 33,000 分以上的成绩加入独家俱乐部

paras.en: LeBron James recorded his first triple-double with the Philadelphia 76ers in their victory over Miami Heat, breaking his own NBA record as the oldest to do so; Kevin Durant also became just the fifth to pass 33,000 career points during Wednesday NBA Cup action
paras.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯在费城 76 人队战胜迈阿密热火队的比赛中取得了他的首个三双，打破了他自己保持的 NBA 最年长三双纪录；凯文·杜兰特也成为第五位在周三 NBA 杯比赛中职业生涯得分超过 33,000 分的人

paras.en: LeBron James broke his own record as the oldest player to record a triple-double in NBA history as the Philadelphia 76ers beat the Miami Heat 111-104 in an NBA Cup game on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，费城 76 人队在 NBA 杯比赛中以 111-104 击败迈阿密热火队，勒布朗·詹姆斯打破了自己的纪录，成为 NBA 历史上获得三双的最年长球员。

paras.en: The 41-year-old finished with 25 points, 12 assists and 10 rebounds, scoring 14 consecutive points in the first half, including three three-pointers.
paras.zh: 这位41岁的球员全场得到25分、12次助攻和10个篮板，上半场连续得到14分，其中包括3个三分球。

paras.en: Tyrese Maxey added 30 points for Philadelphia, while Giannis Antetokounmpo had 32 points and 14 rebounds for Miami.
paras.zh: 泰瑞斯·马克西为费城队贡献了30分，扬尼斯·阿德托昆博为迈阿密队贡献了32分和14个篮板。

paras.en: Philadelphia were without Joel Embiid for a second consecutive game due to illness and lost Jaylen Brown to left hamstring tightness at the end of the second quarter, but snapped Heat's seven-game winning streak and moved to 15-4 on the season.
paras.zh: 费城队因乔尔·恩比德连续第二场因病缺席，并在第二节末因左腿筋拉伤而失去了杰伦·布朗，但热火队的七连胜被终结，赛季战绩达到15胜4负。

paras.en: "I don't think my job is to dominate the game every night for this ball club," James said. "If they need me to dust off the cape from time to time - I can still accomplish that. That's not my job. But if they need it, I can do it at any given moment."
paras.zh: “我不认为我的工作是每晚为这个球俱乐部主宰比赛，”詹姆斯说。 “如果他们需要我时不时地掸掉斗篷上的灰尘，我仍然可以做到。那不是我的工作。但如果他们需要，我可以在任何特定时刻做到。”

paras.en: On whether he was surprised at James continuing to deliver impressive performances, Barlow teammate Dominick said: "I mean, from a regular 40-year-old, probably, but I mean, he's a cyborg!
paras.zh: 当被问及是否对詹姆斯继续打出令人印象深刻的表现感到惊讶时，巴洛的队友多米尼克说道：“我的意思是，他可能是一个普通的 40 岁年轻人，但我的意思是，他是一个机器人！

paras.en: "He has been doing this for a long time now, so it don't surprise me at all. I mean, this is just who he is. I mean, it's going to be this till whenever he decides not to play. So, I mean we're going to keep flowing with him."
paras.zh: “他这样做已经很长时间了，所以我一点也不感到惊讶。我的意思是，这就是他。我的意思是，直到他决定不参加比赛之前都会如此。所以，我的意思是我们将继续与他一起流动。”

paras.en: Durant reaches historic 33,000 points milestone
paras.zh: 杜兰特达到历史性的 33,000 分里程碑

paras.en: Kevin Durant became just the fifth NBA player in history to pass 33,000 points, joining James, Kareem Abdul-Jabbar, Karl Malone and Kobe Bryant in an exclusive club.
paras.zh: 凯文·杜兰特成为历史上第五位得分超过 33,000 分的 NBA 球员，加入了詹姆斯、卡里姆·阿卜杜尔·贾巴尔、卡尔·马龙和科比·布莱恩特的专属俱乐部。

paras.en: The 38-year-old reached the milestone during the Houston Rockets' 116-104 victory against the Phoenix Suns, firing a three-pointer with 46.3 seconds left in the second quarter.
paras.zh: 这位38岁的球员在休斯顿火箭队以116-104战胜菲尼克斯太阳队的比赛中达到了这一里程碑，他在第二节还剩46.3秒时投进了一个三分球。

paras.en: Durant scored 20 points, shot seven of 15 from the field and grabbed 10 rebounds, with Houston's victory ending a four-game winning streak for the Suns (9-8) and eliminating them from NBA Cup contention.
paras.zh: 杜兰特15投7中得到20分并抢下10个篮板，休斯顿队的胜利结束了太阳队的四连胜（9胜8负），并将他们从NBA杯的争夺中淘汰。

paras.en: He became the second-quickest player to reach the milestone, taking four more games than James, while he is now just over 600 points behind Bryant in the career points standings.
paras.zh: 他成为第二快达到这一里程碑的球员，比詹姆斯多打了四场比赛，而他现在在职业生涯得分榜上仅落后科比 600 多分。

paras.en: There were nine NBA Cup matches on Wednesday, including Minnesota Timberwolves continuing their unbeaten start with a 113-106 win over the Oklahoma City Thunder and Portland Trail Blazers beating San Antonio Spurs 116-111.
paras.zh: 周三，NBA 杯共有 9 场比赛，其中明尼苏达森林狼队以 113-106 战胜俄克拉荷马城雷霆队，延续不败开局；波特兰开拓者队以 116-111 击败圣安东尼奥马刺队。

paras.en: Jaden McDaniels posted his fourth career 30+ point game and locked down Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (32 pts) down the stretch for the Timberwolves, who outlasted a Thunder side without Anthony Edwards.
paras.zh: 贾登·麦克丹尼尔斯打出了职业生涯第四场30分以上的比赛，并在最后时刻锁定了谢伊·吉尔吉斯·亚历山大（32分），森林狼队在没有安东尼·爱德华兹的情况下击败了雷霆队。

paras.en: Victor Wembanyama (44 points, 16 rebounds) failed to maintain San Antonio's impressive away record, as Deni Avdija banked in a clutch three-pointer in the final minute to give Portland victory in a thriller that saw 25 lead changes and 13 ties.
paras.zh: 维克多·文班亚马（44分、16个篮板）没能保持圣安东尼奥令人印象深刻的客场战绩，德尼·阿夫迪亚在最后一分钟投进关键三分球，帮助开拓者队在这场惊心动魄的比赛中取得胜利，这场比赛双方领先25次，战成13平。

articles.title: 2 men charged with burglary after break-in at Prince William and Princess Kate’s country home
articles.author: Henry Austin

paras.en: LONDON — Two men have been charged in connection with a burglary at the royal family’s Sandringham estate, British police said Wednesday, after a reported break-in at the country home of Prince William and Princess Kate.
paras.zh: 伦敦——英国警方周三表示，在威廉王子和凯特王妃的乡村住宅发生入室盗窃事件后，英国警方周三表示，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃而被指控。

paras.en: The pair were charged with entering a dwelling with intent to steal and trespassing on a protected site, the local police force said in a statement.
paras.zh: 当地警方在一份声明中称，两人被指控进入住宅意图盗窃和侵入受保护的地点。

paras.en: Officers were called just before 6 p.m. local time (1 p.m. ET) on Monday “to reports of suspicious activity at a property,” Norfolk Constabulary said. “Police and specialist resources attended and two men were arrested nearby on suspicion of burglary and trespass and taken into custody for questioning,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 下午 6 点左右，警方接到报警。诺福克警察局表示，当地时间周一（美国东部时间下午 1 点）“接到有关某处房产可疑活动的报告”。声明补充说：“警察和专家人员赶到现场，两名男子因涉嫌入室盗窃和非法侵入而在附近被捕，并被拘留接受审讯。”

paras.en: The two men, named by police as Mirgen Doku, 34, and Arilen Ndoci, 32, have now been charged.
paras.zh: 警方称这两名男子为 34 岁的米尔根·多库 (Mirgen Doku) 和 32 岁的阿里伦·恩多西 (Arilen Ndoci)，现已受到指控。

paras.en: The pair were remanded in custody after a brief court appearance in the eastern city of Norwich on Wednesday morning, according to Britain’s Press Association news agency. Describing the accused as Albanian nationals, the agency reported that they were accused of stealing six pairs of cuff links and a clock, value unknown.
paras.zh: 据英国新闻协会通讯社报道，周三上午，两人在东部城市诺维奇短暂出庭后被还押。该机构将被告描述为阿尔巴尼亚国民，称他们被指控盗窃六对袖扣和一个时钟，价值未知。

paras.en: David Harrison, the games and conservation manager at the Sandringham Estate, told the court he was conducting a patrol when he saw two males jump through a hedgerow and run into a wooded area using a thermal spotter, according to the PA. He said he followed in a utility motor vehicle but could not locate the men.
paras.zh: 据 PA 报道，桑德灵厄姆庄园的游戏和保护经理戴维·哈里森 (David Harrison) 告诉法庭，他当时正在巡逻，看到两只雄性使用热观测仪跳过树篱，跑进树林里。他说，他开着一辆多功能汽车跟踪，但找不到这些人。

paras.en: The property, gifted to the heir to the British throne and his wife by the late Queen Elizabeth II as a wedding present, is nestled in the heart of the royals’ sprawling estate.
paras.zh: 该房产是已故女王伊丽莎白二世作为结婚礼物赠送给英国王位继承人及其妻子的礼物，坐落在王室庞大庄园的中心。

paras.en: In an earlier statement, police said the property which has its own private swimming pool, a full-size, artificial grass tennis court and vast grounds, was unoccupied at the time of the incident.
paras.zh: 警方在早些时候的一份声明中表示，该房产拥有自己的私人游泳池、一个全尺寸的人造草地网球场和广阔的场地，但在事件发生时无人居住。

paras.en: Separately, a royal source told NBC News that the couple and their three children, George, Charlotte and Louis, were not there at the time.
paras.zh: 另外，一位王室消息人士告诉 NBC 新闻，这对夫妇和他们的三个孩子乔治、夏洛特和路易斯当时并不在场。

paras.en: The couple and their children have often enjoyed weekend breaks and holidays at the royal estate in eastern England.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇和他们的孩子经常在英格兰东部的皇家庄园享受周末和假期。

paras.en: While they weren’t present at the time of the burglary, the incident is a significant security breach for the royals.
paras.zh: 虽然入室盗窃发生时他们并不在场，但这起事件对王室来说是一个重大的安全漏洞。

paras.en: The break in “of course, raises huge concerns,” NBC News royal contributor Emily Nash said Wednesday. “This is the home of our future king and queen.”
paras.zh: NBC 新闻皇家撰稿人艾米丽·纳什周三表示，这次闯入“当然引起了巨大的担忧”。 “这是我们未来国王和王后的家。”

paras.en: “Nobody wants to feel as though their home, their private space is being violated,” she said. “They do have a great deal of security in place and so they’ll be looking at why that has lapsed.”
paras.zh: “没有人愿意感觉自己的家、私人空间受到侵犯，”她说。 “他们确实有很多安全措施，所以他们会研究为什么会失效。”

paras.en: Security arrangements “are naturally cloaked in secrecy because they don’t want to let people know too much about what’s happening,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说，安全安排“自然是保密的，因为他们不想让人们过多了解正在发生的事情”。

paras.en: “Essentially, it’s a bit like an onion. They have multiple layers of security,” she said, adding that when they were on the estate “they also have their armed police protection officers who ensure that nobody can get close to them.”
paras.zh: “本质上，这有点像洋葱。他们有多层安全措施，”她说，并补充说，当他们进入庄园时，“他们还有武装警察保护人员，确保没有人可以接近他们。”

paras.en: Anmer Hall, a 10-bedroom country house built in the early 1800s, entered the royals’ extensive property portfolio when it was bought in 1898 by Queen Victoria’s son, who would later become King Edward VII.
paras.zh: 安默厅 (Anmer Hall) 是一座建于 1800 年代初、拥有 10 间卧室的乡间别墅，于 1898 年被维多利亚女王的儿子（后来成为国王爱德华七世）买下，进入了王室的广泛财产组合。

paras.en: The prince and princess of Wales’ main home is Forest Lodge in Windsor, a small town around 30 miles west of London. The couple said they moved there for a “fresh start” in 2025 after the death of the late queen and Kate’s cancer diagnosis.
paras.zh: 威尔士王子和王妃的主要住所是位于伦敦以西约 30 英里的小镇温莎的森林小屋。这对夫妇表示，在已故女王去世和凯特被诊断出癌症后，他们于 2025 年搬到了那里，希望有一个“新的开始”。

paras.en: There have been several previous high profile security breaches involving the royal family.
paras.zh: 此前曾发生过数起涉及王室的引人注目的安全漏洞事件。

paras.en: In October 2024, burglars broke into the Windsor Castle estate and stole a pickup truck and a quad bike from a farm building. King Charles and Queen Camilla weren’t at the property at the time.
paras.zh: 2024 年 10 月，窃贼闯入温莎城堡庄园，从一座农场建筑中偷走了一辆皮卡车和一辆四轮摩托车。查尔斯国王和卡米拉王后当时并不在庄园。

paras.en: But perhaps the most famous break in came in 1982, when a man called Michael Fagan managed to sneak into the queen’s private chambers while she was in bed. The queen spent 10 minutes talking with the intruder before raising the alarm when he asked for a cigarette.
paras.zh: 但最著名的闯入事件可能发生在 1982 年，当时一名名叫迈克尔·费根 (Michael Fagan) 的男子趁女王睡觉时潜入了她的私人卧室。女王花了10分钟与入侵者交谈，然后当他要香烟时才发出警报。

paras.en: The latest incursion came days before the release of a new documentary about Kate’s cancer diagnosis and remission, called “Heal.”
paras.zh: 最近一次入侵发生在一部关于凯特癌症诊断和缓解的新纪录片《治愈》发布前几天。

paras.en: Set to air on NBC on Nov. 30 at 8 p.m. ET/PT before streaming on Peacock from Dec. 1., the highly personal film will see her share her private thoughts on her illness and recovery.
paras.zh: 定于 11 月 30 日晚上 8 点在 NBC 播出这部高度个人化的电影将在美国东部时间/太平洋时间 12 月 1 日起在 Peacock 上播出之前，分享她对疾病和康复的私人想法。

paras.en: “It changes your body, it changes you physically, but there is a much, much deeper part to what a cancer diagnosis shifts in you,” Kate says in a clip released ahead of Sunday’s air date
paras.zh: 凯特在周日播出前发布的一段视频中说道：“它改变了你的身体，它改变了你的身体，但癌症诊断对你的改变还有更深层次的影响。”

paras.en: “It is often through pain that we realize there is a greater beauty that lies beyond that,” she adds.
paras.zh: “往往是通过痛苦，我们才意识到除此之外还有更伟大的美丽，”她补充道。

articles.title: Train services to be disrupted after Fair Work Commission delays decision
articles.author: Bridget Murphy and Ben Clifford

paras.en: NSW regional and interstate trains disrupted after Fair Work Commission delays decision
paras.zh: 公平工作委员会推迟决定后新南威尔士州地区和州际列车中断

paras.en: The unions representing NSW rail workers had planned a week-long strike as part of an ongoing enterprise bargaining dispute.
paras.zh: 代表新南威尔士州铁路工人的工会计划举行为期一周的罢工，作为正在进行的企业谈判纠纷的一部分。

paras.en: The Fair Work Commission has delayed its decision on whether the industrial action can legally go ahead.
paras.zh: 公平工作委员会推迟了关于罢工是否可以合法进行的决定。

paras.en: Many regional and interstate services scheduled for Friday will be replaced by coaches or cancelled.
paras.zh: 原定于周五举行的许多地区和州际航班将被长途汽车取代或取消。

articles.title: Sydney apartment buyers in limbo after $24m in deposits goes missing
articles.author: Emily Baker

paras.en: Developer Landmark is pursuing a Sydney law firm and solicitor over $24 million in missing unit deposits.
paras.zh: 开发商 Landmark 正在追捕一家悉尼律师事务所和律师，该律师事务所和律师失踪的单位押金超过 2400 万澳元。

paras.en: Hundreds of home buyers were hoping to move into newly-built complexes in Dee Why and Blacktown before their funds vanished.
paras.zh: 数百名购房者希望在资金耗尽之前搬进迪威和布莱克敦的新建综合楼。

paras.en: The matter is due to return to the Supreme Court on November 30.
paras.zh: 该案将于 11 月 30 日返回最高法院。

paras.en: More than $24 million in deposits from prospective apartment buyers has gone missing as a Sydney developer acknowledges "something has gone seriously wrong".
paras.zh: 悉尼开发商承认“出了严重问题”，潜在公寓买家的超过 2400 万澳元的定金消失了。

paras.en: Almost 300 home buyers were due to get the keys to their newly-built apartments in Dee Why and Blacktown between this week and early next year but have been left in limbo.
paras.zh: 本周到明年初，近 300 名购房者本应拿到位于 Dee Why 和 Blacktown 的新建公寓的钥匙，但目前仍处于悬而未决的状态。

paras.en: Developer Landmark has launched legal action against Branston Neville Lawyers and solicitor Ken Neville to recoup the missing funds, after alleging only part of the deposits held in trust were transferred to Hendrix Legal as directed after the company changed firms.
paras.zh: 开发商Landmark已对Branston Neville律师事务所和律师Ken Neville提起法律诉讼，要求追回丢失的资金，此前该公司声称，在该公司更换公司后，只有部分信托存款按照指示转移给了Hendrix Legal。

paras.en: The ABC has contacted Branston Neville Lawyers and Mr Neville.
paras.zh: ABC 已联系布兰斯顿·内维尔律师事务所和内维尔先生。

paras.en: Purchasers in the Dee Why Casa Delmar complex were expecting to settle as early as Wednesday afternoon before receiving an email from Hendrix Legal that same morning that said their deposit had not come through.
paras.zh: Dee Why Casa Delmar 综合楼的买家预计最早于周三下午完成结算，但当天早上收到了来自 Hendrix Legal 的电子邮件，称他们的押金尚未到账。

paras.en: In a statement, Landmark founder Arash Tavakoli said the situation was unprecedented.
paras.zh: Landmark 创始人 Arash Tavakoli 在一份声明中表示，这种情况是前所未有的。

paras.en: "In over 25 years and thousands of homes delivered, this has never happened to us or our buyers,"
paras.zh: “在超过 25 年的时间里，交付了数千套房屋，这种情况从未发生在我们或我们的买家身上，”

paras.en: The situation affects about 140 purchasers at the Casa Delmar development at Dee Why and about 145 purchasers at the Second Avenue development at Blacktown.
paras.zh: 这种情况影响了 Dee Why 的 Casa Delmar 开发项目的约 140 名买家，以及 Blacktown 的第二大道开发项目的约 145 名买家。

paras.en: Apartment buyers told the ABC they were devastated.
paras.zh: 公寓买家告诉澳大利亚广播公司，他们感到震惊。

paras.en: Wainwright Legal principal lawyer Clare Wainwright represents 42 affected Dee Why purchasers and said she was receiving "really limited information" about the "completely unprecedented" situation.
paras.zh: Wainwright Legal 的首席律师 Clare Wainwright 代表 42 名受影响的 Dee Why 购买者，并表示她收到的有关“完全前所未有”的情况的“信息非常有限”。

paras.en: "Our position is our purchasers have done all the right things and ultimately settlement should be called for," Ms Wright said.
paras.zh: “我们的立场是，我们的买家已经做了所有正确的事情，最终应该要求和解，”赖特女士说。

paras.en: "We are needing to know what is happening and what the vendor's intention is because we have clients who don't have anywhere to go."
paras.zh: “我们需要知道发生了什么以及供应商的意图是什么，因为我们的客户无处可去。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, the Law Society of NSW confirmed it had suspended the practising certificate of Mr Neville and appointed a manager to Branston Neville Lawyers to "take control of the practice with immediate effect".
paras.zh: 与此同时，新南威尔士州律师协会证实已吊销内维尔先生的执业证书，并为布兰斯顿内维尔律师事务所任命了一名经理，以“立即控制其执业”。

paras.en: Mr Tavakoli wrote directly to affected apartment buyers to acknowledge "something has gone seriously wrong" and affirm the company's commitment to completing their contracts.
paras.zh: 塔瓦科利先生直接写信给受影响的公寓买家，承认“出现了严重问题”，并确认公司履行合同的承诺。

paras.en: In the correspondence, he urged affected purchasers to write to NSW Premier Chris Minns and other MPs to encourage the Law Society of NSW to lift the cap on the compensation available through its Fidelity Fund.
paras.zh: 在信中，他敦促受影响的购买者写信给新南威尔士州州长克里斯明斯和其他议员，鼓励新南威尔士州律师协会取消通过其富达基金提供的赔偿上限。

paras.en: The fund is administered by the Law Society to compensate people who lose money due to law firms acting improperly in relation to trust funds or property.
paras.zh: 该基金由律师协会管理，用于补偿因律师事务所在信托基金或财产方面采取不当行为而遭受损失的人。

paras.en: It is capped at $1 million to a single law practice unless the Law Society authorises a greater payment.
paras.zh: 除非律师协会授权支付更高的金额，否则单个律师事务所的最高限额为 100 万美元。

paras.en: "We would welcome the Law Society Council using its discretion to lift that limit, and the government looking at whether that limit still protects buyers in today's market," Mr Tavakoli said in his media statement.
paras.zh: 塔瓦科利在媒体声明中表示：“我们欢迎律师协会理事会利用其自由裁量权取消这一限制，并欢迎政府研究该限制是否仍然可以保护当今市场上的买家。”

paras.en: The matter is due to return to the Supreme Court on November 30.
paras.zh: 该案将于 11 月 30 日返回最高法院。

articles.title: Councillor ordered to apologise over 'school short-skirt brigade' remarks
articles.author: Ellen-Maree Elliot

paras.en: Ipswich City Council voted to direct a councillor to make a public apology and undertake training and counselling.
paras.zh: 伊普斯威奇市议会投票决定指示一名议员公开道歉并进行培训和咨询。

paras.en: Cr Andrew Antoniolli was found to have made comments, including that a female contractor was part of the "school short-skirt brigade".
paras.zh: 安德鲁·安东尼奥利议员被发现发表了评论，其中包括一名女承包商是“学校短裙大队”的成员。

paras.en: The complaint was made by the council's CEO in February and then referred to the council for investigation.
paras.zh: 该投诉由该委员会的首席执行官于二月份提出，然后转交给该委员会进行调查。

paras.en: Ipswich City Council voted to direct a councillor to make a public apology and undertake training and counselling after he made comments including that a female contractor was part of the "school short skirt brigade".
paras.zh: 伊普斯威奇市议会投票指示一名议员公开道歉并接受培训和咨询，此前他发表了包括一名女承包商是“学校短裙大队”的成员在内的言论。

paras.en: That was one of three allegations against Cr Andrew Antoniolli outlined in an investigation summary tabled at the council meeting today.
paras.zh: 这是今天议会会议上提交的调查摘要中概述的针对安德鲁·安东尼奥利议员的三项指控之一。

paras.en: Cr Antoniolli excused himself from the debate, which was held in closed session, and the vote due to his conflict of interest.
paras.zh: 安东尼奥利议员因利益冲突而缺席了闭门辩论和投票。

paras.en: The ABC has contacted Cr Antoniolli for comment.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚广播公司已联系安东尼奥利议员征求意见。

paras.en: Investigation summary outlines three allegations
paras.zh: 调查摘要概述了三项指控

paras.en: The complaint was made by Ipswich City Council CEO Sonia Cooper to the Office of the Independent Assessor in February and then referred to the council for investigation.
paras.zh: 伊普斯威奇市议会首席执行官索尼娅·库珀 (Sonia Cooper) 在二月份向独立评估员办公室提出了投诉，然后转交给市议会进行调查。

paras.en: The investigation summary stated the first allegation was that, on or around January 28, 2026, at a meeting with a council employee and representatives of a contractor, Cr Antoniolli referred to a female contractor as "being part of the school short-skirt brigade".
paras.zh: 调查摘要称，第一项指控是，在 2026 年 1 月 28 日左右，在与一名市议会雇员和一名承包商代表的会议上，安东尼奥利市长将一名女承包商称为“学校短裙大队的一部分”。

paras.en: The second allegation was that, at the same meeting, when introduced to a female contractor, Cr Antoniolli "looked her up and down and said words to the effect that 'women do not normally work in facilities management'".
paras.zh: 第二项指控是，在同一次会议上，当安东尼奥利市长被介绍给一名女性承包商时，他“上下打量了她一番，并说了一些大意是‘女性通常不会从事设施管理工作’”。

paras.en: The third allegation was that, on or around January 29, at a councillor workshop at the Nicholas Street Precinct, in the presence of the council CEO and fellow councillors, Cr Antoniolli queried "whether they could find someone with Queensland Rail experience that had 'slept with the boss' when working at Queensland Rail to assist in dealing with property tenure issues".
paras.zh: 第三项指控是，1月29日左右，在尼古拉斯街辖区举行的议员研讨会上，在议会首席执行官和其他议员在场的情况下，安东尼奥利议员询问“他们是否可以找到一个有昆士兰铁路经验、在昆士兰铁路工作时‘和老板睡过’的人来协助处理财产保有权问题”。

paras.en: The council spent multiple hours debating the item in a closed session before coming back to vote unanimously that "on the balance of probabilities" the first two allegations had been proven, and that Cr Antoniolli had admitted to the third.
paras.zh: 该委员会在闭门会议上花了多个小时讨论该项目，然后一致投票认为“根据可能性”，前两项指控已得到证实，安东尼奥利市长也承认了第三项指控。

paras.en: It also required him to make a public apology and undertake training and counselling.
paras.zh: 它还要求他公开道歉并接受培训和咨询。

paras.en: Mayor Teresa Harding did not speak in the public meeting on the matter.
paras.zh: 市长特雷莎·哈丁没有在公开会议上就此事发表讲话。

paras.en: Deciding on fellow councillor 'difficult'
paras.zh: 决定议员同事“很困难”

paras.en: Division 2 councillor Paul Tully said the council had "a very thorough discussion of the matters".
paras.zh: 第 2 区议员保罗·塔利 (Paul Tully) 表示，议会“对此事进行了非常彻底的讨论”。

paras.en: "It's probably been one of the most difficult decisions or recommendations for this matter to be raised," he said.
paras.zh: “这可能是就此事提出的最困难的决定或建议之一，”他说。

paras.en: "I will say that the legislation has changed from the 1st of July. If these matters had arisen after the 1st of July, they would not have been referred back to council.
paras.zh: “我要说的是，立法从7月1日起就发生了变化。如果这些问题是在7月1日之后出现的，它们就不会被提交回议会。”

paras.en: "[This is] probably the last matter in Queensland that will go to any of the 77 councils in Queensland for a decision.
paras.zh: “[这]可能是昆士兰州最后一个需要由昆士兰州 77 个议会做出决定的事项。

paras.en: "We've evaluated the evidence, evaluated matters which are in detail over a period of hours. It's not just a rushed decision.
paras.zh: “我们评估了证据，评估了几个小时内详细的问题。这不仅仅是一个仓促的决定。

paras.en: "And in relation to the recommendation about the training and an apology, I think that is appropriate in all of the circumstances."
paras.zh: “关于培训和道歉的建议，我认为这在所有情况下都是适当的。”

paras.en: Division 1 councillor Jacob Madsen said the state legislation should not "ever include forcing councillors to make determinations about their fellow councillors".
paras.zh: 第一部门议员雅各布·马德森表示，州立法不应“强迫议员对其同事做出决定”。

paras.en: "I gravely hope that people don't sort of misuse this to treat the subject councillor poorly," he said
paras.zh: 他说：“我真诚地希望人们不要滥用这一点来对待议员。”

paras.en: "I do genuinely worry with how this may be potentially misused online and in media to do him harm."
paras.zh: “我确实担心这可能会在网上和媒体上被滥用来伤害他。”

paras.en: Deputy Mayor Nicole Jonic, Division 4 councillor David Martin and Division 1 councillor Pye Augustine all echoed the comments that it had been unpleasant to make the determination, but praised the council's robust debate and unanimous decision.
paras.zh: 副市长 Nicole Jonic、第 4 区议员 David Martin 和第 1 区议员 Pye Augustine 都表示做出这一决定令人不快，但赞扬了市议会的激烈辩论和一致决定。

paras.en: The full investigation report, redacted to protect the identities of those involved in the investigation, will be published soon.
paras.zh: 完整的调查报告将很快发布，该报告经过编辑以保护参与调查的人员的身份。

articles.title: Pig kidney transplant patient marks 1 year without dialysis in medical breakthrough
articles.author: Sheena Goodyear

paras.en: Pig kidney transplant patient marks 1 year without dialysis in medical breakthrough
paras.zh: 猪肾移植患者无需透析一周年，医学突破

paras.en: Doctors say Molly Falco's one-year marker is a major milestone for the growing field of xenotransplantation
paras.zh: 医生表示，莫莉·法尔科的一周岁标记是不断发展的异种移植领域的一个重要里程碑

paras.en: It's been more than a year since Molly Falco underwent experimental surgery to receive a kidney harvested from a genetically modified pig, and she says she has no regrets.
paras.zh: 莫莉·法尔科接受实验性手术，接受从转基因猪身上摘取的肾脏已经一年多了，她说她并不后悔。

paras.en: Before the surgery, she says she could barely move the three feet between her at-home dialysis machine to her bed without becoming exhausted. But now?
paras.zh: 她说，在手术前，她几乎无法将家用透析机与床上之间的三英尺移动而不感到精疲力竭。但现在呢？

paras.en: "I feel good. I feel like I have a lot of energy," the 58-year-old New Hampshire woman told As It Happens host Nil Köksal. "I still go kind of slow, but I'm not nauseous. I'm not dizzy. I'm not feeling like throwing up all the time."
paras.zh: “我感觉很好。我感觉自己精力充沛，”这位 58 岁的新罕布什尔州女性告诉《As It Happens》主持人尼尔·科克萨尔 (Nil Köksal)。 “我的速度仍然有点慢，但我不恶心。我不头晕。我不想一直呕吐。”

paras.en: Falco is one of only a handful of patients in the world who have received a pig kidney transplant, and on Sunday, she became the first to go a full year without rejecting the organ.
paras.zh: 法尔科是世界上少数接受猪肾移植的患者之一，周日，她成为第一个整整一年没有排斥器官的患者。

paras.en: Doctors say this is major milestone in the growing field of animal-to-human organ transplantation, known as xenotransplantation. But they caution it could be years before this kind of procedure is available to patients outside of clinical trials.
paras.zh: 医生表示，这是不断发展的动物到人类器官移植（即异种移植）领域的一个重要里程碑。但他们警告说，这种手术可能需要数年时间才能向临床试验之外的患者提供。

paras.en: "It's not the finish line," Dr. Leonardo Riella, who oversaw Falco's treatment at Mass General Brigham Hospital in Boston, said. "It's sort of a stepping stone."
paras.zh: “这不是终点线，”在波士顿麻省总医院布里格姆医院负责法尔科治疗的莱昂纳多·里埃拉医生说。 “这可以说是一块踏脚石。”

paras.en: Falco, who suffers from kidney failure, says she signed up to be considered for clinical trial when she put her name on the waitlist for a human kidney transplant.
paras.zh: 患有肾衰竭的法尔科表示，当她将自己的名字列入人类肾移植的候补名单时，她就报名参加了临床试验。

paras.en: "I thought it was really cool and, you know, I'd be thrilled to be a part of something that's helping the advancement of medicine and science," she said. "I never expected to get called."
paras.zh: “我觉得这真的很酷，而且，你知道，我很高兴能成为帮助医学和科学进步的一部分，”她说。 “我没想到会接到电话。”

paras.en: When Riella, Mass General Brigham's director of kidney transplantation, reached out to her, she'd already made up her mind.
paras.zh: 当麻省总医院布里格姆肾移植中心主任里埃拉联系她时，她已经下定决心了。

paras.en: "I just said yes before he finished asking," she said. "I said, 'You know what? I'll do anything to get off dialysis.'"
paras.zh: “在他问完之前我就答应了，”她说。 “我说，‘你知道吗？我会做任何事情来摆脱透析。’”

paras.en: It was an odd experience, she says, being on the frontier of something cutting-edge.
paras.zh: 她说，处于尖端事物的前沿，这是一次奇怪的经历。

paras.en: "Because it was new, the first thing they said was: We have no idea what will happen. And every day you have it, we learn something," she said.
paras.zh: “因为它是新的，他们说的第一句话是：我们不知道会发生什么。每天你拥有它，我们都会学到一些东西，”她说。

paras.en: Six pig kidney transplants have been performed at Mass General Brigham Hospital since 2024. One patient died shortly after surgery from unrelated heart disease. Two of the transplanted kidneys lasted between eight and nine months before the patients' bodies rejected them, forcing them to return to dialysis. The two most recent patients received their transplants this year and still have them.
paras.zh: 自 2024 年以来，麻省总医院已实施 6 例猪肾移植手术。一名患者在手术后不久就因无关的心脏病死亡。其中两个移植的肾脏持续了八到九个月，之后患者的身体出现排斥反应，迫使他们重新进行透析。最近的两名患者今年接受了移植手术，并且仍然保留着移植手术。

paras.en: The total number of pig kidney transplants performed worldwide is unclear, but Riella says a couple have been performed at other U.S. hospitals and that China is also experimenting with xenotransplantation.
paras.zh: 全球范围内进行的猪肾移植总数尚不清楚，但里埃拉表示，美国其他医院已经进行了几例，中国也在试验异种移植。

paras.en: He says Falco and the others taking part in these trials are "true heroes."
paras.zh: 他说法尔科和其他参与这些试验的人是“真正的英雄”。

paras.en: Riella says the gold standard of treatment for late-stage kidney disease is a human kidney transplant.
paras.zh: 里埃拉说，治疗晚期肾病的黄金标准是人体肾移植。

paras.en: The problem, he says, is there just aren't enough of them.
paras.zh: 他说，问题在于它们的数量还不够。

paras.en: While patients wait for a kidney to become available, they undergo dialysis, a way of artificially simulating the function of the kidneys by removing extra fluid and waste products from the blood.
paras.zh: 当患者等待肾脏可用时，他们会进行透析，这是一种通过去除血液中多余的液体和废物来人为模拟肾脏功能的方法。

paras.en: The side effects of dialysis can be debilitating, he says, and the wait for a transplant can last years.
paras.zh: 他说，透析的副作用可能会让人衰弱，而等待移植的时间可能会持续数年。

paras.en: "Every week we are removing patients from our waiting list because they either get too sick, and we cannot move through transplant anymore, or they die while they're waiting for the promised kidney," he said.
paras.zh: “每周我们都会将患者从等候名单中删除，因为他们要么病得太重，我们无法再进行移植，要么他们在等待承诺的肾脏时死亡，”他说。

paras.en: Dr. Leonardo Rielli is the director of kidney transplantation at Mass General Brigham Hospital in Boston, and the head of a new clinical trial into xenotransplantation. (Mass General Brigham Hospital)
paras.zh: 莱昂纳多·里埃利 (Leonardo Rielli) 博士是波士顿麻省总医院肾移植科主任，也是一项新的异种移植临床试验的负责人。 （麻省布里格姆总医院）

paras.en: Dr. Deepali Kumar, program medical director of the Ajmera Transplant Centre at Toronto General Hospital, says Falco's story provides hope for the roughly 30,000 Canadians currently on dialysis for end-stage kidney disease.
paras.zh: 多伦多综合医院 Ajmera 移植中心的项目医疗主任迪帕里·库马尔 (Deepali Kumar) 博士表示，法尔科的故事为目前因终末期肾病接受透析的约 30,000 名加拿大人带来了希望。

paras.en: "It's actually a very exciting milestone in the transplant field," Kumar said. "The fact that it's lasted for a year is incredible."
paras.zh: “这实际上是移植领域的一个非常令人兴奋的里程碑，”库马尔说。 “它持续了一年这一事实令人难以置信。”

paras.en: According to the Canadian Institute of Health Information (CIHI), 3,174 Canadians received life-saving organ transplants in 2025, while another 212 people died on the waiting list. Of those, 77 were waiting for kidneys.
paras.zh: 据加拿大健康信息研究所（CIHI）称，2025年有3,174名加拿大人接受了挽救生命的器官移植，另有212人在等待名单上死亡。其中，77 人正在等待肾脏。

paras.en: Kumar cautions that xenotransplantation is not currently being performed anywhere in Canada, as there are a lot of unanswered questions about the long-term impact, eligibility criteria and post-surgery care.
paras.zh: 库马尔警告说，异种移植目前在加拿大任何地方都没有进行，因为关于长期影响、资格标准和术后护理还有很多悬而未决的问题。

paras.en: "We have taken a more cautious approach and we'd like to see the longer-term outcomes from the clinical trial that's going on in the United States," she said.
paras.zh: “我们采取了更加谨慎的态度，我们希望看到美国正在进行的临床试验的长期结果，”她说。

paras.en: Early next year, Riella is expected to lead a clinical trial involving 33 patients who will receive pig kidneys from eGenesis at 10 U.S. medical centres. The biotechnology company also provided Falco's kidney.
paras.zh: 明年初，Riella 预计将领导一项临床试验，涉及 33 名患者，这些患者将在美国 10 个医疗中心接受 eGenesis 的猪肾。该生物技术公司还提供了法尔科的肾脏。

paras.en: He says there's a long road ahead, but he's hopeful that, one day, pig transplants will keep thousands of patients off dialysis as they wait for human kidneys — or, better yet, become the go-to long-term treatment.
paras.zh: 他说，前面的路还很长，但他希望有一天，猪移植能让成千上万的患者在等待人类肾脏时免于透析，或者更好的是，成为首选的长期治疗方法。

paras.en: "What's remarkable about the technology of how these pig kidneys are generated is that there are endless numbers of things that we could potentially modify in their genes … to make it even more compatible to humans," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这些猪肾生成技术的非凡之处在于，我们可以对它们的基因进行无数的修改……使其与人类更加相容​​。”

paras.en: Falco, left, pictured with her family. She says her life has improved dramatically since she's been off dialysis. (Submitted by Paul Falco)
paras.zh: 法尔科（左）与家人合影。她说，自从停止透析以来，她的生活有了显着改善。 （保罗·法尔科提交）

paras.en: Falco, meanwhile, has named her pig kidney Lily, after the flower her daughter crocheted for her while she was in the hospital. If her body eventually rejects it, she'll go back on dialysis and await a human kidney.
paras.zh: 与此同时，法尔科将她的猪肾命名为“莉莉”，这是她女儿在医院期间为她编织的花。如果她的身体最终拒绝它，她将重新接受透析并等待人类肾脏。

paras.en: But she hopes she won't have to part with Lily any time soon.
paras.zh: 但她希望自己不会很快与莉莉分开。

paras.en: "I've committed to keep the kidney as long as I can," she said.
paras.zh: “我承诺尽可能长时间地保留肾脏，”她说。

paras.en: Interview with Molly Falco produced by Livia Dyring
paras.zh: 莫莉·法尔科访谈由 Livia Dyring 制作

articles.title: Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie settle dispute over French estate Château Miraval
articles.author: Jessica Wong

paras.en: Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie settle dispute over French estate Château Miraval
paras.zh: 布拉德·皮特和安吉丽娜·朱莉就法国米拉瓦尔城堡庄园纠纷达成和解

paras.en: Allegations of abuse emerged in court filings during contentious legal battle
paras.zh: 在激烈的法律诉讼中，法院文件中出现了虐待指控

paras.en: Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie have reached a settlement in their contentious dispute over the French winery and estate Château Miraval, where they were wed.
paras.zh: 布拉德·皮特和安吉丽娜·朱莉就他们结婚所在地法国米拉瓦尔酒庄和庄园的争议达成和解。

paras.en: "We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further," Pitt and Jolie's representatives told CBC News in a joint statement on Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 皮特和朱莉的代表在周三下午的联合声明中告诉加拿大广播公司新闻：“为了我们家庭的最大利益，我们已经在庭外和解，不会进一步发表评论。”

paras.en: "Any comments in media stories attributed to 'sources' are in fact not coming from either of us, or anyone close to us," they added.
paras.zh: 他们补充说：“媒体报道中任何归因于‘消息来源’的评论实际上都不是来自我们任何人或任何与我们关系密切的人。”

paras.en: Terms of the settlement were not disclosed.
paras.zh: 和解条款并未披露。

paras.en: The Hollywood couple, formerly dubbed Brangelina, had leased the 1,200-acre vineyard and estate — located in Correns, in the southern French region of Provence — back in 2008, eventually purchasing it.
paras.zh: 这对好莱坞夫妇（原名 Brangelina）早在 2008 年就租赁了位于法国南部普罗旺斯地区科伦斯的 1,200 英亩葡萄园和庄园，并最终将其买下。

paras.en: The Château Miraval property in Correns, located in the southern French region of Provence, is seen in 2008. (Lionel Cironneau/Associated Press)
paras.zh: 位于法国南部普罗旺斯地区科伦斯的米拉瓦尔城堡 (Château Miraval) 摄于 2008 年。（Lionel Cironneau/美联社）

paras.en: It was the site of the pair's wedding in 2014. At the time of their nuptials, the duo had been romantic partners for about a decade.
paras.zh: 这是两人 2014 年举行婚礼的场地。婚礼时，两人已经恋爱了大约十年。

paras.en: However, just two years later, Jolie filed for divorce, citing irreconcilable differences.
paras.zh: 然而仅仅两年后，朱莉就以不可调和的分歧为由提出离婚。

paras.en: Their split — which involved a bitter custody dispute and allegations of abuse levelled at Pitt — dragged out for eight years, with the A-list Hollywood actors ultimately reaching a divorce settlement in late December 2024.
paras.zh: 他们的分手——涉及激烈的监护权纠纷和对皮特的虐待指控——拖延了八年，这对好莱坞一线演员最终于 2024 年 12 月下旬达成离婚协议。

paras.en: In fall 2021, Jolie sold her half of Château Miraval to a wine subsidiary of Russian businessman Yuri Shefler's SPI Group, the international consortium that sells Stoli vodka and other alcohol brands worldwide.
paras.zh: 2021 年秋季，朱莉将自己持有的 Miraval 酒庄的一半股份出售给了俄罗斯商人尤里·谢夫勒 (Yuri Shefler) 旗下 SPI 集团的葡萄酒子公司，SPI 集团是一家国际财团，在全球范围内销售 Stoli 伏特加和其他酒类品牌。

paras.en: Pitt sued her and Shefler over the sale in 2022, contending that he and Jolie had previously agreed to seek each other's consent before selling their stakes.
paras.zh: 皮特于 2022 年就出售股份起诉了她和谢夫勒，称他和朱莉此前同意在出售股份之前征求对方的同意。

paras.en: Angelina Jolie, second from left, attends the premiere of her movie Maria with her children Pax, left, Zahara, second right, and Maddox in New York in 2024. (Evan Agostini/Invision/Associated Press)
paras.zh: 安吉丽娜·朱莉（左二）与她的孩子帕克斯（左）、扎哈拉（右二）和马多克斯于 2024 年在纽约出席她的电影《玛丽亚》首映式。（Evan Agostini/Invision/美联社）

paras.en: Jolie countersued and — in a subsequent court filing tied to the winery dispute — made public for the first time a raft of details about the in-flight confrontation involving the pair and their children in 2016 that prompted her, days later, to file for divorce.
paras.zh: 朱莉提出反诉，并在随后一份与酒庄纠纷有关的法庭文件中，首次公开了 2016 年两人及其孩子在飞机上发生冲突的大量细节，几天后，这促使她提出离婚。

paras.en: Jolie alleged in the filing that she and her children had experienced physical and verbal abuse from Pitt while on that private flight, en route from Château Miraval to their home in Los Angeles. The incident was investigated at the time, and no charges were filed against Pitt.
paras.zh: 朱莉在文件中声称，她和她的孩子在从米拉瓦尔城堡飞往洛杉矶家的私人航班上遭受了皮特的身体和言语虐待。当时对该事件进行了调查，没有对皮特提出任何指控。

paras.en: Wednesday's settlement ends the Miraval legal battle between Pitt and Jolie, but Pitt's case against Shefler remains.
paras.zh: 周三的和解结束了皮特和朱莉之间的米拉瓦尔法律纠纷，但皮特对谢夫勒的诉讼仍然存在。

articles.title: U.S. judge blocks FCC from revoking licences of Disney-owned ABC stations

paras.en: U.S. judge blocks FCC from revoking licences of Disney-owned ABC stations
paras.zh: 美国法官阻止 FCC 撤销迪士尼旗下 ABC 电视台的许可证

paras.en: Ruling is a blow to Trump's efforts to rein in American media firms
paras.zh: 这一裁决对特朗普控制美国媒体公司的努力是一个打击

paras.en: A U.S. ‌judge on Wednesday barred the Federal Communications Commission from revoking Walt Disney's licences for its eight company-owned ABC TV stations, in a dramatic blow to President Donald Trump's efforts to rein in American media companies.
paras.zh: 周三，一名美国法官禁止联邦通信委员会撤销华特迪士尼对其旗下八家 ABC 电视台的许可，这对唐纳德·特朗普总统控制美国媒体公司的努力造成了巨大打击。

paras.en: "This is not a close case," US District Judge Loren Alikhan wrote. ABC has a "weighty interest in 'vindicating their right to be free of retaliation for [their] protected speech,'" the judge wrote in a case that was a key test of the free-speech rights of media outlets.
paras.zh: “这不是一个结案，”美国地区法官洛伦·阿里汗写道。法官在一个对媒体言论自由权进行关键考验的案件中写道，美国广播公司“在‘维护其言论不受报复的权利’方面有着重大利益”。

paras.en: The judge said the FCC appears to be carrying out a retaliatory campaign driven by Trump.
paras.zh: 法官表示，联邦通信委员会似乎正在开展一场由特朗普推动的报复行动。

paras.en: FCC chair Brendan Carr, who was tapped to lead the agency in January 2025, "has taken President Trump's rhetoric as his marching orders," the judge added.
paras.zh: 法官补充说，2025 年 1 月被任命领导该机构的 FCC 主席布伦丹·卡尔“已将特朗普总统的言论作为他的前进命令”。

paras.en: Trump has repeatedly urged broadcasters to drop ‌comedy or news programs that he dislikes or that have been critical of him or his administration. He has also pressed the FCC on a number of occasions to revoke ABC's licences.
paras.zh: 特朗普一再敦促广播公司放弃他不喜欢或批评他或他的政府的喜剧或新闻节目。他还多次向联邦通信委员会施压，要求吊销美国广播公司的执照。

paras.en: Carr, the White House, Disney and ABC did not immediately respond to requests for comment late on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三晚些时候，卡尔、白宫、迪士尼和美国广播公司没有立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Disney and ABC sued the FCC in August to block an unprecedented early review of licences for eight ABC stations, arguing that the Trump administration was trying to punish the network over its broadcast content.
paras.zh: 迪士尼和美国广播公司 (ABC) 在 8 月份起诉美国联邦通信委员会 (FCC)，要求阻止对 ABC 八家电视台进行史无前例的早期许可审查，理由是特朗普政府试图惩罚该网络的广播内容。

paras.en: Carr ordered the reviews in April, even though the stations' licence renewals ‌were not scheduled to be considered before October 2028. The FCC had not ordered an early review in more than 50 years before April.
paras.zh: 卡尔在 4 月份下令进行审查，尽管这些电台的许可证更新预计不会在 2028 年 10 月之前考虑。FCC 已经有 50 多年没有在 4 月之前下令进行提前审查了。

paras.en: - ABC sues U.S. broadcast regulator over early licence reviews, calling it an 'existential threat'
paras.zh: - 美国广播公司就早期许可证审查起诉美国广播监管机构，称其为“生存威胁”

paras.en: - Trump says ABC should fire Jimmy Kimmel over his 'expectant widow' joke
paras.zh: - 特朗普表示 ABC 应该因为吉米·金梅尔的“准寡妇”笑话而解雇他

paras.en: The reviews were ordered in April, a day after Trump urged ABC to fire late-night host Jimmy Kimmel.
paras.zh: 这些审查是在四月下令进行的，一天前，特朗普敦促美国广播公司解雇深夜主持人吉米·金梅尔。

paras.en: Broadcast stations need FCC licences to use public airwaves. While licence revocations are extremely rare, critics say the threat of losing a licence can pressure broadcasters and raise concerns about government interference in editorial and programming decisions. Networks have broad free-speech protections over programming choices.
paras.zh: 广播电台需要获得 FCC 许可才能使用公共广播。虽然撤销许可证的情况极为罕见，但批评者表示，失去许可证的威胁可能会给广播公司带来压力，并引起人们对政府干预编辑和节目决策的担忧。网络对节目选择有广泛的言论自由保护。

paras.en: Trump has waged an aggressive series of attacks on the news media and the latest move follows a two-year-long battle between Trump and Disney. In July, Trump again called for ABC stations to lose their licences because the network refused to air a prime-time speech on elections.
paras.zh: 特朗普对新闻媒体发起了一系列咄咄逼人的攻击，而这一最新举动是在特朗普与迪士尼之间长达两年的争斗之后发生的。 7月，特朗普再次呼吁美国广播公司（ABC）电视台吊销执照，因为该电视台拒绝在黄金时段播出有关选举的演讲。

paras.en: The FCC is also investigating ABC daytime talk show The View, which discusses U.S. politics, after saying it may be subject to federal rules requiring broadcasters to provide equal-time opportunities to political candidates.
paras.zh: 美国联邦通信委员会还在调查美国广播公司 (ABC) 讨论美国政治的日间脱口秀节目《The View》，此前该节目表示，该节目可能需要遵守要求广播公司向政治候选人提供平等机会的联邦规定。

paras.en: Disney noted earlier that as a result, the program did not invite any political candidates to appear ahead of the November midterm elections, citing the FCC's "pressure campaign."
paras.zh: 迪士尼早些时候指出，因此，该计划没有邀请任何政治候选人在 11 月中期选举前露面，理由是 FCC 的“施压活动”。

paras.en: Trump has also been more broadly criticized by free-speech advocates for attempting to target critics, deport foreign student protesters and freeze federal funds for educational institutions. His efforts have faced legal challenges and some judicial setbacks.
paras.zh: 特朗普还受到言论自由倡导者更广泛的批评，因为他试图针对批评者、驱逐外国学生抗议者并冻结教育机构的联邦资金。他的努力面临着法律挑战和一些司法挫折。

articles.title: In Afghanistan, no female doctor often means no treatment for women

paras.en: In many parts of Taliban-ruled Afghanistan, male doctors are no longer allowed to treat women. The consequences have been highlighted in a recent United Nations report, which offers disturbing insight into the harsh reality many women face.
paras.zh: 在塔利班统治的阿富汗许多地区，男医生不再被允许为女性提供治疗。联合国最近的一份报告强调了其后果，该报告对许多妇女面临的严酷现实提供了令人不安的见解。

paras.en: In one case, a woman from Kunar province described how she suffered several miscarriages without being able to access medical care.
paras.zh: 在一个案例中，库纳尔省的一名妇女描述了她如何在无法获得医疗护理的情况下多次流产。

paras.en: Her case highlights the increasing number of pregnant women who urgently need medical assistance and are unable to receive it because of restrictions imposed by the Taliban.
paras.zh: 她的案例凸显出越来越多的孕妇迫切需要医疗援助，但由于塔利班的限制而无法获得援助。

paras.en: And overall, women in Afghanistan are increasingly losing access to essential healthcare. This is due both to the Taliban's restrictions and to cuts in international aid funding.
paras.zh: 总体而言，阿富汗妇女越来越无法获得基本医疗保健。这是由于塔利班的限制和国际援助资金的削减。

paras.en: Taliban remove women from public life in Afghanistan
paras.zh: 塔利班将妇女排除在阿富汗公共生活之外

paras.en: "If a pregnant woman dies because male doctors are not allowed to treat her, her husband can marry another, younger woman. That is how the Taliban think," said 28-year-old Tamana Zaryab Paryani.
paras.zh: 28 岁的塔马纳·扎里亚布·帕里亚尼 (Tamana Zaryab Paryani) 说：“如果一名孕妇因不允许男医生治疗而死亡，她的丈夫可以娶另一个更年轻的女性。塔利班就是这么想的。”

paras.en: Paryani is an Afghan women's rights activist and one of the best-known voices of resistance against the Taliban.
paras.zh: 帕里亚尼是一名阿富汗妇女权利活动家，也是最著名的抵抗塔利班的声音之一。

paras.en: A trained lawyer, she worked as a newspaper journalist before the Taliban returned to power. Following their takeover in August 2021, she took part in protests against restrictions on the rights of women and girls. In January 2022, she was detained by the Taliban in Kabul alongside her sisters. After her release, she managed to reach Europe.
paras.zh: 她是一名训练有素的律师，在塔利班重新掌权之前曾担任报纸记者。 2021 年 8 月他们接管后，她参加了反对限制妇女和女童权利的抗议活动。 2022 年 1 月，她与姐妹们一起在喀布尔被塔利班拘留。获释后，她成功抵达欧洲。

paras.en: Since then, she has continued to advocate internationally for the rights of Afghan women. At the end of October, she addressed the UN Security Council, describing the repression of women in Afghanistan and urging the international community not to normalise their systematic disenfranchisement.
paras.zh: 此后，她继续在国际上倡导阿富汗妇女的权利。 10月底，她在联合国安理会发表讲话，描述了阿富汗妇女遭受的镇压，并敦促国际社会不要将系统性剥夺妇女选举权的行为正常化。

paras.en: "This is gender apartheid. We expect the international community to recognise it and stand with the women of Afghanistan," Paryani told DW.
paras.zh: 帕里亚尼告诉德国之声：“这是性别种族隔离。我们希望国际社会能够认识到这一点，并与阿富汗妇女站在一起。”

paras.en: Since returning to power in 2021, the Taliban have issued more than 100 decrees severely restricting the lives of women and girls. Girls are barred from secondary education, while women are denied access to universities. Women's opportunities to work outside the home are also severely restricted.
paras.zh: 自2021年重新掌权以来，塔利班已颁布了100多项法令，严格限制妇女和女童的生活。女孩被禁止接受中等教育，而妇女则被剥夺进入大学的机会。妇女外出工作的机会也受到严格限制。

paras.en: The UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA), which monitors and regularly documents the human rights situation in the country, reported in September 2025 that inspectors from the Taliban's Ministry for the Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice were further restricting women's access to healthcare through the enforcement of regulations and decrees.
paras.zh: 负责监测并定期记录该国人权状况的联合国阿富汗援助团 (联阿援助团) 于 2025 年 9 月报告称，塔利班弘扬美德和预防恶习部的检查人员通过执行法规和法令进一步限制妇女获得医疗保健。

paras.en: According to the UN, around 2.6 million girls are excluded from secondary education. This is likely to lead to more girls being married off at an early age and to an increase in maternal mortality, UN Women warns.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，约有 260 万女孩被排除在中等教育之外。联合国妇女署警告说，这可能会导致更多女孩过早结婚，并导致孕产妇死亡率上升。

paras.en: Afghanistan has a population of around 45 million. With a median age of approximately 17, it has one of the youngest populations in the world. Around 42% of its population is under the age of 15.
paras.zh: 阿富汗人口约为 4500 万。该国的平均年龄约为 17 岁，是世界上人口最年轻的国家之一。大约 42% 的人口年龄在 15 岁以下。

paras.en: The world's 'worst women's rights crisis'
paras.zh: 世界“最严重的妇女权利危机”

paras.en: "What is happening in Afghanistan goes beyond gender-based persecution, as already defined under the Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court," Haroon Mutasem, professor of International Criminal Law at the American University of Afghanistan and research fellow at Berlin's Humboldt University, told DW.
paras.zh: 阿富汗美国大学国际刑法教授、柏林洪堡大学研究员哈龙·穆塔塞姆 (Haroon Mutasem) 告诉德国之声：“阿富汗发生的事情超出了《国际刑事法院罗马规约》所定义的基于性别的迫害。”

paras.en: The Afghan legal scholar examines how the systematic oppression of women in Afghanistan can be classified and prosecuted under international law.
paras.zh: 这位阿富汗法律学者研究了如何根据国际法对阿富汗境内对妇女的系统性压迫进行分类和起诉。

paras.en: "This is not just about individual acts of persecution, but about an institutionalised system of oppression and domination of one gender group by another. They have established a system that considers women as secondary and defines a life for them as raising kids, working at home, and also actually satisfying the sexual desires of their men."
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是个人的迫害行为，而是一种性别群体对另一种性别群体的压迫和统治的制度化体系。他们建立了一种将女性视为次要的体系，并将女性的生活定义为抚养孩子、在家工作，并实际上满足男性的性欲。”

paras.en: Mutasem argues that failure to respond to the systematic oppression of Afghan women could undermine the universal validity of human and women's rights. He warns that other authoritarian regimes and extremist movements could adopt similar practices.
paras.zh: 穆塔塞姆认为，如果不回应对阿富汗妇女的系统性压迫，可能会损害人权和妇女权利的普遍有效性。他警告说，其他独裁政权和极端主义运动可能会采取类似的做法。

paras.en: According to UN estimates, in 2027 more than 4 million children under the age of five, as well as around 1.27 million pregnant and breastfeeding women, will require treatment for acute malnutrition.
paras.zh: 据联合国估计，到 2027 年，将有超过 400 万五岁以下儿童以及约 127 万孕妇和哺乳期妇女需要接受急性营养不良治疗。

paras.en: Susan Ferguson, the UN's Special Representative in Afghanistan, described the situation in her latest report as "the world's worst women's rights crisis." Afghan women, she said, are now "fighting for their very survival."
paras.zh: 联合国驻阿富汗特别代表苏珊·弗格森在她最新的报告中将局势描述为“世界上最严重的妇女权利危机”。她说，阿富汗妇女现在“正在为自己的生存而战”。

paras.en: Cuts in aid funding have forced humanitarian organisations to make "impossible decisions about which women and girls can receive support and which have to be turned away," Ferguson said.
paras.zh: 弗格森说，援助资金的削减迫使人道主义组织做出“不可能的决定，决定哪些妇女和女孩可以获得支持，哪些必须拒绝”。

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Can Rassvet, 'Russia's Starlink' change the course of the war in Ukraine?

paras.en: Both Russian and international media refer to the satellite communications network Rassvet (Dawn) as the "Russian Starlink," a satellite internet service operated by the US company SpaceX.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和国际媒体将卫星通信网络 Rassvet (Dawn) 称为“俄罗斯星链”，这是由美国 SpaceX 公司运营的卫星互联网服务。

paras.en: Rassvet, which was developed by the Russian aerospace company Bureau 1440, operates in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: Rassvet由俄罗斯航天公司Bureau 1440开发，在近地轨道运行。

paras.en: Interest in the system surged after the Russian military lost access to Starlink terminals, which until then had ensured communications and internet access in the battle zone in Ukraine.On the front, for example, Starlink helps drone pilots and commanders receive images from drones equipped with cameras. Military personnel also communicate together thanks to Starlink.
paras.zh: 在俄罗斯军方失去对星链终端的访问权限后，对该系统的兴趣激增，此前星链终端一直确保乌克兰战区的通信和互联网访问。例如，在前线，星链帮助无人机飞行员和指挥官从配备摄像头的无人机接收图像。借助星链，军事人员也可以进行交流。

paras.en: Though Russia does not fall within Starlink's area of coverage, the Russian military managed to acquire "illegal" terminals through third countries and was thus using the same system as the Ukrainian army.
paras.zh: 尽管俄罗斯不在星链覆盖范围内，但俄罗斯军方设法通过第三国获取“非法”终端，因此使用与乌克兰军队相同的系统。

paras.en: In early 2026, SpaceX, in coordination with the Ukrainian Defense Ministry, introduced a "whitelist," which registered all devices on Ukrainian territory authorized to operate on the Starlink network. Any terminals being used by Russian forces were subsequently deactivated, and reports of serious communication problems on the front then began to appear in Russian social media channels.
paras.zh: 2026 年初，SpaceX 与乌克兰国防部协调推出了一份“白名单”，登记了乌克兰境内所有有权在星链网络上运行的设备。俄罗斯军队使用的所有终端随后都被停用，俄罗斯社交媒体渠道上开始出现有关前线严重通信问题的报道。

paras.en: In May, the US news channel Bloomberg reported that the Ukrainian army had recaptured about 400 square kilometers (ca. 155 square miles) of Ukrainian territory since Russian forces lost access to Starlink.
paras.zh: 5月，美国新闻频道彭博社报道称，自俄罗斯军队失去星链连接以来，乌克兰军队已夺回约400平方公里（约155平方英里）的乌克兰领土。

paras.en: Two first launches of serial Rassvet satellites took place in March and July 2026.
paras.zh: Rassvet 系列卫星的首次发射分别于 2026 年 3 月和 7 月进行了两次。

paras.en: According to information from Ukraine's military intelligence (HUR) published by the Reuters news agency in early November, Russia has started using Rassvet for military communications over Ukraine and to carry out attacks.
paras.zh: 据路透社11月初公布的乌克兰军事情报局（HUR）信息，俄罗斯已开始利用Rassvet在乌克兰上空进行军事通信并实施攻击。

paras.en: The system is reportedly being used to improve strike accuracy, expand capabilities of reconnaissance drones and to strengthen resilience against electronic warfare.
paras.zh: 据报道，该系统被用来提高打击精度、扩大侦察无人机的能力并增强针对电子战的抵御能力。

paras.en: HUR spokesperson Andriy Yusov also told Reuters that "the constellation is currently insufficient to provide uninterrupted coverage of Ukrainian territory."
paras.zh: HUR发言人安德烈·尤索夫也对路透社表示，“该星座目前不足以对乌克兰领土提供不间断的覆盖。”

paras.en: Georgiy Trishkin, a rocket analyst and operator of Telegram channel Tekhassky Vestnik (The Texas Herald), told DW that Russia aims to have a functioning "sovereign" alternative to Starlink — consisting of 292 satellites in orbit — running by the end of 2027.
paras.zh: 火箭分析师兼 Telegram 频道 Tekhassky Vestnik（《德克萨斯先驱报》）操作员乔治·特里什金 (Georgiy Trishkin) 告诉德国之声，俄罗斯的目标是在 2027 年底前拥有一个可运行的“主权”替代星链——由 292 颗在轨卫星组成。

paras.en: According to Serhii Beskrestnov, aka Flash, an advisor to the Ukrainian president, the main danger posed by the Rassvet system is that it could allow the Russian army to control drones over Ukrainian territory.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统顾问谢尔希·别斯克列斯特诺夫（Serhii Beskrestnov）（又名“Flash”）表示，“拉斯韦特”系统带来的主要危险在于，它可能会让俄罗斯军队控制乌克兰领土上空的无人机。

paras.en: He also pointed out on the platform Facebook that the Ukrainian military cannot use Starlink to control drones over Russian territory, since the US service does not work there.
paras.zh: 他还在脸书平台上指出，乌克兰军方无法使用星链控制俄罗斯领土上空的无人机，因为美国的服务在那里无法使用。

paras.en: SpaceX remains far superior to Rassvet in tech terms
paras.zh: SpaceX 在技术方面仍然远远优于 Rassvet

paras.en: Inspired by the Starlink model, the Russian military also wants to be able to equip drones with terminals, which will enable connectivity in more remote parts of Ukrainian territory. Bureau 1440 unveiled some initial models last month, but according to Trishkin, the similarities between Rassvet and Starlink stop at the "basic features and concept."
paras.zh: 受星链模式的启发，俄罗斯军方还希望能够为无人机配备终端，这将使乌克兰领土上更偏远的地区实现连接。 Bureau 1440 上个月公布了一些初始模型，但根据 Trishkin 的说法，Rassvet 和 Starlink 之间的相似之处仅限于“基本功能和概念”。

paras.en: "When it comes to details, these are completely different projects. No one can currently match SpaceX's technological edge — and especially its lead in production technology," he said, pointing out that while the Starlink constellation comprised over 10,000 satellites, Rassvet would not have more than 300 in its first phase.
paras.zh: “说到细节，这是完全不同的项目。目前没有人能够与 SpaceX 的技术优势相媲美，尤其是其在生产技术方面的领先地位，”他说。他指出，虽然 Starlink 星座由 10,000 多颗卫星组成，但 Rassvet 第一阶段的卫星数量不会超过 300 颗。

paras.en: He added that Bureau 1440 would struggle to make enough of the kits used on the ground. While SpaceX can manufacture about 15,000 per day, this would be a "remarkable achievement even over the course of a year" for the Russian company.
paras.zh: 他补充说，1440 局将很难生产足够的地面使用的套件。虽然 SpaceX 每天可以生产约 15,000 个，但这对于这家俄罗斯公司来说“即使在一年内也将是一个了不起的成就”。

paras.en: He also said that the terminals produced by Bureau 1440 were much more expensive than those by Starlink as they relied "on foreign components."
paras.zh: 他还表示，Bureau 1440 生产的终端比 Starlink 生产的终端贵得多，因为它们依赖“外国部件”。

paras.en: "Right now, no one can beat SpaceX in terms of price, volume and quality of service," Trishkin said. "The next step for the company is mobile satellite services, where it's making very rapid progress. Will Bureau 1440 be able to respond? Unlikely for the time being."
paras.zh: 特里什金表示：“目前，在价格、数量和服务质量方面，没有人能够击败 SpaceX。” “该公司的下一步是移动卫星服务，在这方面进展非常迅速。Bureau 1440 能够做出回应吗？暂时不太可能。”

paras.en: SpaceX's Starlink was primarily designed as a civilian service, while Starshield is more for government and military sectors.
paras.zh: SpaceX 的 Starlink 主要是为民用服务而设计的，而 Starshield 则更多地为政府和军事部门设计。

paras.en: According to DW sources, Rassvet was likely designed to support battlefield communications and thus does not currently require as many satellites as Starlink.
paras.zh: 据德国之声消息人士透露，Rassvet 很可能是为了支持战场通信而设计的，因此目前不需要像 Starlink 那样多的卫星。

paras.en: Ukrainian military expert Oleh Starikov said that if Rassvet continues to develop as it has then it could fulfil the mission put to it by the Russian military. He added that SpaceX CEO Elon Musk was developing a system that would work around the world, whereas Bureau 1440's satellites sufficed for Russian military purposes.
paras.zh: 乌克兰军事专家奥列赫·斯塔里科夫表示，如果“拉斯维特”继续发展下去，那么它就能完成俄罗斯军方赋予它的使命。他补充说，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克正在开发一种可以在全球范围内使用的系统，而 Bureau 1440 的卫星足以满足俄罗斯的军事目的。

paras.en: But he also underlined the massive expansion of Russia's satellite network generally, which — on January 1, 2022, before the full-scale invasion of Ukraine — comprised 102 satellites according to Dmitry Rogozin, who at the time was general director of the Russian space agency Roscosmos.
paras.zh: 但他也强调了俄罗斯卫星网络的大规模扩张，据时任俄罗斯航天局 Roscosmos 总经理的德米特里·罗戈津 (Dmitry Rogozin) 称，2022 年 1 月 1 日，在全面入侵乌克兰之前，该网络由 102 颗卫星组成。

paras.en: In September of this year, Rogozin's successor Dmitry Bakanov said that the number almost quadrupled.
paras.zh: 今年9月，罗戈津的继任者德米特里·巴卡诺夫表示，这一数字几乎翻了两番。

paras.en: Did SpaceX throttle Starlink in Ukraine?
paras.zh: SpaceX 是否扼杀了乌克兰的 Starlink？

paras.en: Recent restrictions to Starlink services in Ukraine have brought the issue to the fore again. In mid-November, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Starshield had been throttled in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 最近乌克兰对星链服务的限制再次使这个问题成为人们关注的焦点。 11月中旬，乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，“星盾”计划在乌克兰境内受到了限制。

paras.en: "Unfortunately, our units have been recording significant disruptions to Starshield's operations over the territory of Ukraine for several days now — along the entire front line and in the temporarily occupied territories of Ukraine," he said, adding that the restrictions occurred at speeds of 161 km/h and higher.
paras.zh: 他说：“不幸的是，我们的部队连续几天记录到星盾在乌克兰境内的行动受到严重干扰，包括整个前线和乌克兰临时占领的领土。”他补充说，这些限制发生的速度为 161 公里/小时或更高。

paras.en: Restrictions on the use of Starlink were first put in place on October 14 and then lifted, according to US President Donald Trump, on October 23.
paras.zh: 据美国总统唐纳德·特朗普称，对星链的使用限制于 10 月 14 日首次实施，随后于 10 月 23 日取消。

paras.en: When asked by DW whether the Ukrainian military could gain access to Rassvet, Trishkin said it was "only a matter of time" before terminals fell "into foreign hands and are subsequently examined."
paras.zh: 当被德国之声问及乌克兰军方是否可以进入拉斯韦特时，特里什金表示，终端“落入外国人手中并随后接受检查”只是“时间问题”。

paras.en: This article was originally published in Russian.
paras.zh: 本文最初以俄语发表。

articles.title: How Chinese companies circumvent chips sanctions in Southeast Asia

paras.en: Some €510 billion ($559 billion) have been invested into AI infrastructure across Malaysia since February 2025. The consulting group Fitch Solutions has opened 125 data centers in Malaysia to serve the global digital economy. The sector is booming in the western Malaysian state of Johor where, according to Malaysia's Digital Ministry, 16 of 27 new data centers are located.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 2 月以来，马来西亚各地的人工智能基础设施投资约 5100 亿欧元（5590 亿美元）。咨询集团 Fitch Solutions 已在马来西亚开设 125 个数据中心，为全球数字经济服务。该行业在马来西亚西部柔佛州蓬勃发展，根据马来西亚数字部的数据，27 个新数据中心中有 16 个位于该州。

paras.en: The government in Kuala Lumpur hopes the investment will create numerous new jobs, up to 90% of which are expected to be filled by locals. The advantages of the data center sites include low electricity prices for energy-intensive computing and good links to international submarine cables.
paras.zh: 吉隆坡政府希望这项投资能够创造大量新的就业机会，其中高达90%预计将由当地人填补。数据中心站点的优势包括能源密集型计算的低电价以及与国际海底电缆的良好连接。

paras.en: Amazon, Google and Microsoft along Strait of Malacca
paras.zh: 马六甲海峡沿岸的亚马逊、谷歌和微软

paras.en: Major US technology companies have also set up along the Strait of Malacca. Amazon and Oracle have each invested $6 billion, while Microsoft and Google have invested $2 billion apiece. In early November, Google's parent company, Alphabet, announced additional investments of $15 billion.
paras.zh: 美国主要科技公司也纷纷在马六甲海峡沿岸设立基地。亚马逊和甲骨文各投资了 60 亿美元，微软和谷歌各投资了 20 亿美元。 11月初，谷歌母公司Alphabet宣布追加投资150亿美元。

paras.en: "Malaysia's vision is not only to build an economy that uses artificial intelligence, but also one that uses AI creatively,” explained Digital Minister Gobind Singh Deo in a statement that was tellingly published in Chinese, which is not an official language of Malaysia.
paras.zh: “马来西亚的愿景不仅是建立一个使用人工智能的经济体，而且是一个创造性地使用人工智能的经济体，”数字部长哥宾德·辛格·迪奥(Gobind Singh Deo)在一份声明中解释道，该声明以中文发布，而中文不是马来西亚的官方语言。

paras.en: Data center growth in Southeast Asia is part of the race for technological supremacy in artificial intelligence. The US has restricted the export of high-performance chips, such as those produced by US tech giant Nvidia, to China. It has also tried to block the sale of the advanced lithography machines used to manufacture microchips that are made by Dutch manufacturer ASML.
paras.zh: 东南亚数据中心的增长是人工智能技术霸主竞赛的一部分。美国限制向中国出口高性能芯片，例如美国科技巨头英伟达生产的芯片。它还试图阻止荷兰制造商 ASML 制造的用于制造微芯片的先进光刻机的销售。

paras.en: Chinese companies rent access to US chips
paras.zh: 中国公司租用美国芯片

paras.en: Since Chinese chips have yet to reach the same technological standards as others, some Chinese companies are testing an alternative model in that they legally purchase or lease capacity in other countries. They can thus rent access to US chips that have been installed in systems in Malaysia, for example, and develop their AI models from abroad.
paras.zh: 由于中国芯片尚未达到与其他国家相同的技术标准，一些中国公司正在测试另一种模式，即在其他国家合法购买或租赁产能。例如，他们可以租用已安装在马来西亚系统中的美国芯片，并从国外开发人工智能模型。

paras.en: In October, the Institute for Progress (IFP), an independent think tank in Washington, warned that Southeast Asia was becoming an offshore hub for Chinese AI enclaves.
