It estimated that by the end of the year about 24% of China's total computing power came from remote access to overseas data centers, three-quarters of which were in Southeast Asia. This was predicted to rise to 31% by the end of 2027.
paras.zh: 10 月，华盛顿独立智库进步研究所 (IFP) 警告称，东南亚正在成为中国人工智能飞地的离岸中心。据估计，到今年年底，中国总计算能力的约24%来自远程访问海外数据中心，其中四分之三位于东南亚。预计到 2027 年底这一比例将上升至 31%。

paras.en: The IFP said that though "US AI chips hosted in overseas data centers are a significant source of compute for China," they were "difficult to size."
paras.zh: IFP 表示，尽管“托管在海外数据中心的美国人工智能芯片是中国的重要计算来源”，但它们“很难确定规模”。

paras.en: It explained that "Chinese entities can rent GPUs [graphics processing units] as a service from cloud providers or lease data center capacity overseas, directly from developers or through intermediaries. Cloud providers and data center developers rarely name their customers or disclose how much capacity each uses, and Chinese companies disclose little themselves."
paras.zh: 它解释说，“中国实体可以直接从开发商或通过中介机构向云提供商租用GPU（图形处理单元）作为服务，或在海外租赁数据中心容量。云提供商和数据中心开发商很少透露其客户的名称或透露各自使用了多少容量，中国公司自己也很少透露。”

paras.en: The Chinese giant Alibaba Cloud currently operates six data centers in Malaysia — three in Johor and three in the greater Kuala Lumpur region, with the most recent one opening on November 19.
paras.zh: 中国巨头阿里云目前在马来西亚运营着六个数据中心，其中三个在柔佛州，三个在大吉隆坡地区，最近一个于 11 月 19 日开业。

paras.en: The company has invested $53 billion in data centers in total, including in South Korea, Thailand, the Philippines and Mexico, as well as Malaysia. TikTok's parent company also operates data center capacity in Johor.
paras.zh: 该公司总共在数据中心投资了530亿美元，其中包括韩国、泰国、菲律宾和墨西哥以及马来西亚。 TikTok 的母公司还在柔佛州运营数据中心容量。

paras.en: In early October, Tencent, another multinational technology conglomerate, which is based in Shenzhen, signed a five-year $7 billion contract with Oracle, allowing it to use computing capacity equivalent to 100,000 modern AI chips for training artificial intelligence. The company was supposed to pay 30% upfront.
paras.zh: 10月初，另一家总部位于深圳的跨国科技集团腾讯与甲骨文签署了一份为期五年、价值70亿美元的合同，允许其使用相当于10万个现代人工智能芯片的计算能力来训练人工智能。该公司应该预付30%。

paras.en: The deal fell through a few weeks later, however, and both companies have remained silent about the reasons. According to media reports, there was pressure from the governments in both Beijing and Washington. China wants to develop its own chip industry, whereas high-ranking US officials reportedly raised security concerns with Oracle.
paras.zh: 然而几周后，这笔交易宣告失败，两家公司均对原因保持沉默。据媒体报道，此举受到了来自北京和华盛顿政府的压力。中国希望发展自己的芯片产业，而据报道美国高级官员向甲骨文提出了安全担忧。

paras.en: In mid-2025, the US threatened to impose an additional 25% tariff on Malaysia imports "to prevent circumvention of export controls on chips," according to the Chinese consulting firm Equal Ocean. "The Malaysian government quickly responded by opposing illegal resale practices and introducing licensing requirements for the transshipment of certain high-end chips."
paras.zh: 据中国咨询公司Equal Ocean称，美国威胁要在2025年中期对马来西亚进口产品征收额外25%的关税，“以防止规避芯片出口管制”。 “马来西亚政府迅速做出反应，反对非法转售行为，并对某些高端芯片的转运提出许可要求。”

paras.en: Washington is now stepping up its efforts. On the same day that US President Donald Trump met with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the APEC meeting in Shenzhen, China last week, the Bureau of Industry and Security, an agency of the US Department of Commerce, issued new rules with regard to remote access to advanced AI chips and servers.
paras.zh: 华盛顿现在正在加紧努力。就在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普上周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织会议上会见中国国家主席习近平的同一天，美国商务部下属工业与安全局发布了有关远程访问先进人工智能芯片和服务器的新规则。

paras.en: It said that the goal was "to prevent certain foreign actors from leveraging advanced computing power based on US technology to threaten US national security and foreign policy interests." The restrictions pertain to data centers that provide significant computing capacity to companies with ties to countries in "Country Group D:5 or Macau."
paras.zh: 声明称，其目标是“防止某些外国行为者利用基于美国技术的先进计算能力威胁美国国家安全和外交政策利益”。这些限制适用于为与“D:5 国家或澳门”国家有联系的公司提供大量计算能力的数据中心。

paras.en: According to US export regulations, the D:5 group includes China, Russia, Iran and North Korea and others. In future, companies will have to conduct more thorough checks to identify the ownership and control structures behind their clients.
paras.zh: 根据美国出口法规，D:5组包括中国、俄罗斯、伊朗和朝鲜等。未来，公司将必须进行更彻底的检查，以确定客户背后的所有权和控制结构。

paras.en: Washington has also introduced new licensing requirements for advanced semiconductors destined for Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil. Subsidiaries of US companies are exempt.
paras.zh: 华盛顿还对运往印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和巴西的先进半导体提出了新的许可要求。美国公司的子公司不受此限制。

paras.en: "The US is not only reviewing which countries will receive AI chips in future but also wants to have a say in where the chips are used, who operates them and which customers they serve," explained Chinese industry expert Xu Sanlang. "This means that data centers, which have been providing remote computing capacity to Chinese clients will have to comply with these restrictions in future."
paras.zh: 中国行业专家徐三郎解释说：“美国不仅在审查未来哪些国家将获得人工智能芯片，而且还想在芯片的使用地点、运营者以及服务的客户方面拥有发言权。” “这意味着一直为中国客户提供远程计算能力的数据中心将来必须遵守这些限制。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: At least 13 dead in Indonesia gold mine flood as rescue efforts intensify

paras.en: At least 13 workers have died and 13 others remain missing after flooding hit an unauthorised gold mine in Indonesia’s West Java province.
paras.zh: 印度尼西亚西爪哇省一座未经许可的金矿遭洪水袭击，造成至少 13 名工人死亡，另有 13 人失踪。

paras.en: Local search and rescue chief Desiana Kartika Bahari confirmed the death toll in a statement on Thursday, as rescuers battled high water, darkness and slippery, narrow terrain in search of the missing workers.
paras.zh: 当地搜救负责人德西安娜·卡蒂卡·巴哈里 (Desiana Kartika Bahari) 在周四的一份声明中证实了死亡人数，救援人员在高水位、黑暗和湿滑、狭窄的地形中奋力寻找失踪的工人。

paras.en: Police first received reports of trapped miners on Tuesday, about 16 hours after the flooding occurred, police said, while nearby state-owned mining company PT Antam forwarded a formal report to the Jakarta Search and Rescue Agency shortly after midnight on Wednesday, triggering a full-scale rescue operation.
paras.zh: 警方称，周二，也就是洪水发生约 16 小时后，警方首次收到了被困矿工的报告，而周三午夜过后不久，附近的国有矿业公司 PT Antam 向雅加达搜救机构提交了一份正式报告，引发了全面的救援行动。

paras.en: Authorities said they were not immediately notified because the miners were operating illegally, and local miners and residents initially tried to pump water from the site themselves before the situation became unmanageable.
paras.zh: 当局表示，他们没有立即收到通知，因为矿工非法作业，当地矿工和居民最初试图自己从现场抽水，直到情况变得无法控制。

paras.en: The 325 rescue personnel have been facing challenging conditions, with narrow excavation pits about 100 metres (330 feet) deep, minimal lighting and slippery terrain conditions, Desiana said.
paras.zh: Desiana 说，325 名救援人员面临着充满挑战的条件，挖掘坑深约 100 米（330 英尺），照明极少，地形湿滑。

paras.en: “The depth of the shaft, narrow access and limited lighting are key considerations in determining the search strategy so that personnel can operate safely,” Desiana explained. “All efforts are made by taking into account field conditions and prioritising the safety of personnel involved in SAR (search and rescue) operations,” she added.
paras.zh: “竖井的深度、狭窄的通道和有限的照明是确定搜索策略的关键考虑因素，以便人员能够安全操作，”德西亚娜解释道。她补充说：“所有努力都是考虑到现场情况，并优先考虑参与搜救行动的人员的安全。”

paras.en: Eleven miners were able to leave safely before water flooded the shafts on Monday, West Java police spokesperson Hendra Rochmawan said.
paras.zh: 西爪哇警方发言人亨德拉·罗赫马万 (Hendra Rochmawan) 表示，周一，在水淹没矿井之前，11 名矿工得以安全离开。

paras.en: The mine is located in the Pongkor area of Bogor, a mountainous area 60km south of the capital, Jakarta, where state miner Antam runs gold-mining operations.
paras.zh: 该矿位于茂物的 Pongkor 地区，这是首都雅加达以南 60 公里的山区，国有矿业公司 Antam 在那里经营金矿开采业务。

paras.en: Small-scale and unauthorised mining often leads to accidents in resource-rich Indonesia, where mineral resources are located in remote areas in conditions difficult for authorities to regulate.
paras.zh: 在资源丰富的印度尼西亚，小规模和未经授权的采矿经常导致事故，该国矿产资源位于偏远地区，当局难以监管。

articles.title: DR Congo Ebola cases surpass 12,000 as fighting disrupts response in east

paras.en: The number of confirmed ‌Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 12,000, government data shows, as escalating fighting in the east disrupts efforts to contain the country’s deadliest outbreak on record.
paras.zh: 政府数据显示，刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 确诊的埃博拉病例数量已超过 12,000 例，东部不断升级的战斗扰乱了该国遏制该国有记录以来最致命疫情的努力。

paras.en: Ebola response workers have been forced to leave affected areas amid worsening violence in the eastern DRC, health officials and humanitarian workers said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 卫生官员和人道主义工作者周三表示，由于刚果民主共和国东部暴力局势不断恶化，埃博拉应对人员被迫离开受影响地区。

paras.en: Clashes in Ituri province have intensified in recent days between the Congolese army and fighters from the Convention for the Popular Revolution (CRP), displacing civilians, the United Nations mission said in a statement.
paras.zh: 联合国代表团在一份声明中表示，最近几天，伊图里省刚果军队与人民革命公约组织战士之间的冲突加剧，导致平民流离失所。

paras.en: Catherine Smallwood, the World Health Organization’s Ebola incident manager, said about a dozen people, including two WHO personnel and Congolese health officials, were evacuated to Bunia after three days trapped in a hospital in Akwe, northeast of the provincial capital, amid intense crossfire.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织埃博拉事件经理凯瑟琳·斯莫尔伍德表示，在激烈的交火中，包括两名世界卫生组织人员和刚果卫生官员在内的大约十几人被困在省会东北部阿克维的一家医院三天后被疏散到布尼亚。

paras.en: “They were caught really in the crossfire, very intense fighting, and we managed to evacuate them,” Smallwood said.
paras.zh: 斯莫尔伍德说：“他们确实陷入了交火，战斗非常激烈，我们设法疏散了他们。”

paras.en: The CRP is led by Thomas Lubanga, who was convicted by the International Criminal Court in 2012 of conscripting child soldiers. The group declared a unilateral ceasefire in May, but fighting has continued.
paras.zh: CRP 由托马斯·卢班加 (Thomas Lubanga) 领导，他于 2012 年因招募儿童兵而被国际刑事法院定罪。该组织于五月宣布单方面停火，但战斗仍在继续。

paras.en: It is one of more than 100 armed groups in the eastern DRC, where conflict has disrupted efforts to contain the country’s worst Ebola outbreak on record.
paras.zh: 它是刚果民主共和国东部 100 多个武装团体之一，那里的冲突扰乱了该国遏制该国有记录以来最严重的埃博拉疫情的努力。

paras.en: At least 12,021 infections have been confirmed, including 5,904 deaths, government data showed on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四政府数据显示，至少已确诊 12,021 例感染，其中 5,904 例死亡。

paras.en: The outbreak, caused by the rare Bundibugyo species of the Ebola virus, was declared in mid-May in Ituri province in the northeastern DRC. There are no approved treatments or vaccines for this species.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国东北部伊图里省于五月中旬宣布爆发埃博拉病毒，由罕见的本迪布焦物种引起。目前还没有针对该物种的批准治疗方法或疫苗。

paras.en: Delayed detection, conflict, and strained health services have accelerated the spread of infections, with cases reported in eight of the DRC’s 26 provinces.
paras.zh: 延迟检测、冲突和紧张的卫生服务加速了感染的传播，刚果民主共和国 26 个省中的 8 个省报告了病例。

paras.en: Sandrine Buju, a humanitarian worker involved in the Ebola response, said her team came under gunfire on Monday while returning to Bunia after training community volunteers.
paras.zh: 参与埃博拉应对工作的人道主义工作者桑德琳·布朱 (Sandrine Buju) 表示，她的团队周一在培训社区志愿者后返回布尼亚时遭到枪击。

paras.en: “We were surprised by gunfire about 15 metres (50ft) from where we were,” she told The Associated Press news agency. “I was very frightened.”
paras.zh: “我们对距离我们所在位置约 15 米（50 英尺）处的枪声感到惊讶，”她告诉美联社。 “我非常害怕。”

paras.en: The driver immediately turned around, and the team sought protection at a UN peacekeeping base, Buju said. Peacekeepers later escorted them through two areas of fighting towards Bunia.
paras.zh: 布朱说，司机立即掉头，车队前往联合国维和基地寻求保护。维和人员随后护送他们穿过两个战斗地区，前往布尼亚。

articles.title: Photos: Rallies around the world denounce violence against women

paras.en: Women have rallied around the world to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence Against Women.
paras.zh: 世界各地的妇女聚集在一起纪念消除对妇女的暴力行为国际日。

paras.en: About 47,000 women and girls were intentionally killed by an intimate partner or family member last year, according to data from the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and UN Women.
paras.zh: 根据联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室 (UNODC) 和联合国妇女署的数据，去年约有 47,000 名妇女和女孩被亲密伴侣或家庭成员故意杀害。

paras.en: The figures, published on Tuesday in the 2026 Femicide Brief to coincide with the international day, show the scale of gender-based killings worldwide.
paras.zh: 周二在国际日之际，《2026 年女性杀戮简报》中发布的这些数据显示了全球基于性别的杀戮规模。

paras.en: While the 47,000 figure is lower than the 2024 estimate of 50,000 victims, the UN said this change largely reflects improved country-level data rather than an actual decrease in femicides.
paras.zh: 虽然 47,000 人的数字低于 2024 年估计的 50,000 名受害者，但联合国表示，这一变化很大程度上反映了国家一级数据的改善，而不是杀害女性事件的实际减少。

paras.en: No region was spared, with such killings recorded across the globe. The UN found that while overall homicide rates have declined worldwide, femicide rates have fallen at a slower pace.
paras.zh: 没有一个地区能够幸免，全球各地都有这样的杀戮记录。联合国发现，虽然全球凶杀率总体下降，但杀戮女性率下降的速度较慢。

articles.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
articles.author: John Otis

paras.en: MONGUÍ, Colombia — Moisés Moreno greets visitors at his greenhouse 10,000 feet high in the Andes Mountains. Underneath the plastic roof, he nurtures tiny seedlings that can grow to be 30-feet tall.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚蒙古伊——莫伊塞斯·莫雷诺在他位于安第斯山脉一万英尺高的温室里迎接游客。在塑料屋顶下，他培育可长到 30 英尺高的小树苗。

paras.en: "Do you know anything about frailejons?" Moreno asks his visitors, who are mostly clueless.
paras.zh: “你知道关于frailejons的事情吗？”莫雷诺问他的访客，他们大多一无所知。

paras.en: Related to the sunflower, frailejons are the iconic flora of Colombia's high mountain wetlands, which are known as páramos, and are vital for the country's water supply.
paras.zh: frailejons 与向日葵有关，是哥伦比亚高山湿地的标志性植物，被称为“帕拉莫斯”，对该国的供水至关重要。

paras.en: The wooly fuzz on their leaves protect frailejons from the cold and absorb water from the cloud cover. This helps maintain moisture in the páramos, which are the source of major rivers, and much of Colombia's water.
paras.zh: 叶子上的毛茸茸的绒毛可以保护脆弱的植物免受寒冷，并吸收云层中的水分。这有助于保持帕拉莫斯河的水分，帕拉莫斯河是主要河流和哥伦比亚大部分水源的源头。

paras.en: But frailejons and the páramos where they grow face a growing array of threats, including farmers, cattle ranchers and coal miners who are gradually pushing higher into the Andes. In addition, climate change is warming the mountains, allowing invasive species to survive at higher altitudes and disrupt their fragile ecosystems.
paras.zh: 但脆弱的乔木和它们生长的帕拉莫斯面临着越来越多的威胁，其中包括逐渐向安第斯山脉推进的农民、牧场主和煤矿工人。此外，气候变化正在使山脉变暖，使入侵物种能够在更高的海拔地区生存并破坏其脆弱的生态系统。

paras.en: Of the nearly 150 species of frailejons, two-thirds are at risk and 17 are endangered, says Mauricio Diazgranados, a Colombian expert on the plant who is chief science officer at the New York Botanical Garden.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚植物专家、纽约植物园首席科学官毛里西奥·迪亚兹格拉纳多斯 (Mauricio Diazgranados) 表示，在近 150 种脆弱植物中，三分之二面临危险，其中 17 种濒临灭绝。

paras.en: "They are a keystone species for maintaining the páramos and play a key role in water production," he says. "But most frailejons are in trouble,"
paras.zh: “它们是维持帕拉莫斯的关键物种，并在水生产中发挥着关键作用，”他说。 “但大多数脆弱的人都遇到了麻烦，”

paras.en: When explorers first spotted the shrubs mysteriously protruding from the mountain fog centuries ago, they reminded them of hooded monks. Hence the name frailejon, which is Spanish for "big friar."
paras.zh: 几个世纪前，当探险家第一次发现这些神秘地从山雾中伸出的灌木时，他们让他们想起了戴着兜帽的僧侣。因此得名 frailejon，在西班牙语中是“大修道士”的意思。

paras.en: The long, thin leaves of some species bend toward the sky and resemble palm fronds. Many are stout in the middle because, rather than falling to the ground, their dying leaves slump down to form a brownish outer shell to their trunks.
paras.zh: 有些物种的叶子又长又薄，向天空弯曲，类似于棕榈叶。许多植物的中部粗壮，因为它们垂死的叶子不会掉落在地上，而是会掉落下来，在树干上形成棕色的外壳。

paras.en: The Muisca Indians, who once populated the area, considered frailejons to be sacred guardians of the water. When he first came across the plants as a teenager in Colombia, Diazgranados says: "I became completely captivated."
paras.zh: 曾经居住在该地区的穆伊斯卡印第安人认为脆弱的水神是水的神圣守护者。当迪亚兹格拉纳多斯十几岁的时候在哥伦比亚第一次看到这些植物时，他说：“我完全被迷住了。”

paras.en: By contrast, Moreno, 53, who runs the frailejon greenhouse, used to be one of the plant's predators. Growing up on a mountainside farm near the central Colombian town of Monguí, Moreno and neighboring farmers knew little about them and chopped them down to make way for potato fields and cow pastures.
paras.zh: 相比之下，53 岁的莫雷诺经营着 frailejon 温室，他曾经是这种植物的捕食者之一。莫雷诺在哥伦比亚中部小镇蒙吉附近的一个山腰农场长大，他和附近的农民对它们知之甚少，他们把它们砍倒，为马铃薯田和奶牛牧场让路。

paras.en: "We viewed them as a nuisance," Moreno says.
paras.zh: “我们认为它们很麻烦，”莫雷诺说。

paras.en: Later, while employed by a coal mine, he was injured during a cave-in and vowed to work above ground in the fresh mountain air.
paras.zh: 后来，在一家煤矿工作时，他在塌方中受伤，并发誓要在山上空气清新的地面上工作。

paras.en: On his own he began studying páramo ecosystem that he'd grown up in, started his greenhouse and began leading tourists and volunteers on expeditions to replace the frailejons that had been wiped out.
paras.zh: 他开始独自研究他长大的帕拉莫生态系统，建立了自己的温室，并开始带领游客和志愿者进行探险，以取代已被消灭的脆弱地区。

paras.en: "I felt inspired to do something to protect the páramos," he says.
paras.zh: “我受到启发，想做一些事情来保护帕拉莫斯，”他说。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Colombia's National Parks agency and even its armed forces have gotten involved in reforestation campaigns after wildfires scorched thousands of acres of frailejons.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，野火烧毁了数千英亩的脆弱森林后，哥伦比亚国家公园机构甚至其武装部队也参与了重新造林活动。

paras.en: Yet many average Colombians have learned about the plant's importance through an enormously popular cartoon character called Ernesto Pérez. Shaped like a frailejon, he exhorts people to conserve the flora and fauna of the Andes, similar to the way Smokey Bear promotes forest fire prevention in the U.S.
paras.zh: 然而，许多普通哥伦比亚人通过一个非常受欢迎的卡通人物埃内斯托·佩雷斯（Ernesto Pérez）了解了这种植物的重要性。他的形状像一个frailejon，劝告人们保护安第斯山脉的动植物群，类似于烟熊在美国促进森林防火的方式。

paras.en: In fact, several of the volunteers Moreno is guiding up the mountain say the cartoon and its earworm theme song introduced them to the frailejon.
paras.zh: 事实上，莫雷诺带领上山的几位志愿者表示，这部动画片及其耳虫主题曲让他们认识了 frailejon。

paras.en: "The song is very contagious," says Nicolás Coronado, 25, who works for a Bogotá-based plastics company, and is carrying a 6-inch frailejon that he will plant in the páramo.
paras.zh: “这首歌很有感染力，”25 岁的尼古拉斯·科罗纳多 (Nicolás Coronado) 说，他在波哥大一家塑料公司工作，他手里拿着一棵 6 英寸的 frailejon，他将把它种植在帕拉莫。

paras.en: The hike takes the group up to an altitude of 11,000 feet, past streams, waterfalls and lagoons. Underfoot, the ground is damp and spongy. The area is a state park and frailejons dot the landscape. But there are also barbed-wire fences erected by farmers and a half dozen cows grazing on the mountainside.
paras.zh: 徒步旅行团将到达海拔 11,000 英尺，途经溪流、瀑布和泻湖。脚下的地面又湿又软。该地区是一个州立公园，景观中点缀着脆弱的树木。但也有农民竖起的铁丝网和在山坡上吃草的六头牛。

paras.en: Moreno and his assistants show the volunteers how to dig shallow holes, then add a bit of shredded tobacco as fertilizer, before nestling the tiny frailejons into the soil.
paras.zh: 莫雷诺和他的助手向志愿者展示了如何挖浅洞，然后添加一些切碎的烟草作为肥料，然后将微小的脆弱植物埋入土壤中。

paras.en: Their survival is no sure thing. Many die in the cold, harsh climate and those that take hold grow just a few inches per year.
paras.zh: 他们的生存并不确定。许多人死于寒冷、恶劣的气候，而那些扎根的每年只长几英寸。

paras.en: To help them along, the volunteers hold an impromptu ceremony, with one member reciting a prayer to connect with the mountain spirits and another blowing on a conch shell.
paras.zh: 为了帮助他们前进，志愿者们举行了一个即兴仪式，其中一名成员背诵祈祷文以与山神联系，另一名成员吹响海螺壳。

paras.en: By now, some volunteers have grown attached to the frailejons that they've carried up the mountain and have bestowed names on them. Among them is biologist Julieta Barba has baptized hers "Gerry," in honor of her mother.
paras.zh: 现在，一些志愿者已经对他们抬上山的脆弱的东西产生了依恋，并给它们起了名字。其中生物学家朱丽叶塔·巴尔巴（Julieta Barba）为她的儿子命名为“格里”，以纪念她的母亲。

paras.en: After patting some dirt around the plant's roots, she says: "I'm very excited for her future here in the páramo."
paras.zh: 在拍掉植物根部周围的一些泥土后，她说：“我对她在帕拉莫的未来感到非常兴奋。”

articles.title: China investigates Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: China investigates Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining
paras.zh: 中共中央政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁立案调查

paras.en: BANGKOK — Chinese Communist Party authorities are investigating Shanghai party secretary Chen Jining for suspected violations of party discipline, China's anti-corruption watchdog said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 曼谷——中国反腐败监管机构周二表示，中国共产党当局正在对上海市委书记陈吉宁涉嫌违反党纪的行为进行调查。

paras.en: The Politburo member is the latest senior official targeted in President Xi Jinping's long-running anti-corruption campaign, which has shown no signs of letting up in scope or depth.
paras.zh: 这位政治局委员是习近平主席长期反腐败运动中最新一位针对的高级官员，反腐败运动的范围和深度都没有显示出放松的迹象。

paras.en: Chen is under investigation by the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection. The brief announcement by China's Central Commission for Discipline Inspection provided no further details.
paras.zh: 陈某目前正接受中央纪律检查委员会组织调查。中国中央纪律检查委员会的简短公告没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: A statement released by the Shanghai city government said the Standing Committee of the Shanghai Committee of the CCP "expressed firm support" for the decision to investigate Chen.
paras.zh: 上海市政府发表声明称，中共上海市委常委会“坚决支持”调查陈的决定。

paras.en: The decision sent "a clear and powerful signal that the fight against corruption would continue without pause or retreat," but with "a firm determination to win," the statement said.
paras.zh: 声明称，这一决定发出了“明确而有力的信号，即反腐败斗争将继续下去，毫不停顿，毫不退缩”，同时“坚定必胜的决心”。

paras.en: The investigation follows sweeping purges under Xi, who has emphasized greater party discipline. The Chinese leader has pursued an anti-corruption campaign for more than a decade, carrying out purges on a scale not seen since Mao Zedong's rule.
paras.zh: 此次调查是在习近平领导下的大规模清洗之后进行的，习近平强调加强党的纪律。这位中国领导人十多年来一直致力于反腐败运动，进行了自毛泽东统治以来从未见过的大规模清洗。

paras.en: "The takedown again shows that Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign has no limits," Mingda Qiu, a senior analyst at Eurasia Group, said in an emailed statement. "This is the fourth Politburo member to fall, and the fourth sitting member brought down in the current cycle. The pattern is unprecedented."
paras.zh: 欧亚集团高级分析师邱明达在一份电子邮件声明中表示，“此次抓捕行动再次表明，习近平的反腐行动是无止境的”。 “这是第四位落马的政治局委员，也是本周期第四位落马的现任政治局委员。这种模式是前所未有的。”

paras.en: The recent Politburo purges highlight how much Chinese politics depend on shifting circumstances, with even officials with qualities that Xi apparently valued being vulnerable to removal, said Joseph Torigian, a professor at American University based in Washington.
paras.zh: 华盛顿美利坚大学教授约瑟夫·托里吉安 (Joseph Torigian) 表示，最近的政治局清洗凸显了中国政治对环境变化的依赖程度，即使是习近平显然看重的官员也很容易被免职。

paras.en: "On paper," they appear to be "individuals Xi would appreciate," Torigian said, but afterward, "we could easily come up with hypotheses for why he got rid of them."
paras.zh: 托里吉安说，“从表面上看，”他们似乎是“习近平会欣赏的人”，但事后，“我们可以很容易地提出假设，解释他为什么要摆脱他们。”

paras.en: Other Politburo members purged include Gen. Zhang Youxia and He Weidong, both senior members of the Central Military Commission, which oversees the armed forces, and Ma Xingrui, a provincial party secretary.
paras.zh: 其他被清洗的政治局成员包括中央军委高级委员张又侠和何卫东，以及省委书记马兴瑞。

paras.en: The post of Shanghai party secretary has traditionally been viewed as a stepping stone to China's top leadership. The country's former President Jiang Zemin, its current premier, Li Qiang, and Xi himself previously held the position.
paras.zh: 上海市委书记一职历来被视为晋升中国最高领导层的垫脚石。中国前国家主席江泽民、现任总理李强和习近平本人都曾担任过这一职务。

paras.en: Chen has served as Shanghai party secretary since 2022. He previously held senior positions in Beijing's municipal government and headed the Ministry of Environmental Protection.
paras.zh: 陈自 2022 年起担任上海市委书记。他此前曾在北京市政府担任高级职务，并担任环境保护部部长。

articles.title: Greetings from Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest point in all its splendor
articles.author: Emily Feng

paras.en: Greetings from Mount Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest point in all its splendor
paras.zh: 来自非洲最壮丽的最高点乞力马扎罗山的问候

paras.en: As dawn broke one recent morning over camp, we got one of our first full views of the peak of Mount Kilimanjaro, normally hidden behind clouds.
paras.zh: 最近的一个早晨，当黎明破晓时，我们第一次看到了通常隐藏在云层后面的乞力马扎罗山峰的全景。

paras.en: Climbing tall mountains like Kilimanjaro is a study in contrasts. The beating sun bakes you during the day, walking so close to the equator, but the nights quickly dip below freezing. Snow remains constantly in sight from humid rainforest and alpine landscapes, freshly charred from a wildfire three weeks before. And always beckoning is the peak, within sight, but seemingly never nearer; the high altitude means hikers need to walk slowly or else risk exhaustion and altitude sickness.
paras.zh: 攀登乞力马扎罗山这样的高山是一项对比研究。白天，烈日炙烤着你，走在离赤道如此之近的地方，但夜晚很快就会降至冰点以下。潮湿的雨林和高山地区始终可见积雪，三周前的一场野火刚刚烧焦。山峰总是在向我们招手，就在眼前，但似乎从未如此接近；高海拔意味着徒步旅行者需要缓慢行走，否则可能会出现疲惫和高原反应。

paras.en: A group of friends and fellow hikers and I spent days camping at altitude to acclimatize before a final summit push during our second-to-last evening on the mountain. We trudged through heavy snow under the stars, cresting a massive volcanic crater rim, and leaned against drifts of what had become a full blizzard to reach the top in the early morning hours. I stood on the peak I'd seen only from a distance for the last week but saw only whiteness: all snow and ice, the absence of life and color heightened by my low oxygen levels.
paras.zh: 我和一群朋友兼徒步旅行者花了几天时间在高海拔地区露营，以适应环境，然后在我们在山上的倒数第二个晚上进行最后一次冲顶。我们在星空下艰难地穿过大雪，登上了一个巨大的火山口边缘，并靠着已经变成暴风雪的雪堆，在清晨到达了山顶。我站在上周只能从远处看到的山峰上，但只看到一片白色：全是雪和冰，缺乏生命和颜色，因为我的低氧气含量更加突出。

paras.en: Days later, having descended and decompressed and readying myself to fly back home, I looked back at the mountain one last time. For a few minutes, in the dusk light, the clouds parted and she revealed herself before disappearing again into the darkening evening, still as elusive as ever.
paras.zh: 几天后，我下山减压，准备飞回家，最后一次回头看了一眼这座山。有几分钟，在暮色中，云层散开，她显露出来，然后又消失在夜色中，仍然像以前一样难以捉摸。

paras.en: For more Far-Flung Postcards, click here.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多遥远的明信片，请点击此处。

articles.title: Pritzker accused of turning education tax credit into partisan fight by opting out of program: 'Sad to see'

paras.en: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, a Democrat, is being accused of putting partisan politics over kids' educational needs after he decided to opt out of the Federal Scholarship Tax Credit program, prompting criticism from parents and education advocacy groups.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊州州长、民主党人 JB 普利茨克 (JB Pritzker) 被指控在决定退出联邦奖学金税收抵免计划后将党派政治置于孩子的教育需求之上，引发了家长和教育倡导团体的批评。

paras.en: Pritzker announced on Tuesday that his state will not opt into the program, which was signed into law by President Donald Trump last year as part of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The governor described the program as a school voucher, while advocacy groups argued that he mischaracterized the plan.
paras.zh: 普利茨克周二宣布，他的州不会选择加入该计划，该计划于去年由唐纳德·特朗普总统签署成为法律，作为“美丽法案法案”的一部分。州长将该计划描述为学校优惠券，而倡导团体则认为他错误地描述了该计划。

paras.en: "At a time when public school education needs investments more than ever, we should not siphon money from public schools for private education – especially as the Trump Administration's policies decimate education," Pritzker said in a statement. "We have a responsibility to do right by all of our students. Taxpayer funding should not subsidize donations to private schools that could discriminate based on religion, sexual orientation, or other characteristics."
paras.zh: 普利茨克在一份声明中表示：“在公立学校教育比以往任何时候都更需要投资的时候，我们不应该从公立学校抽走资金用于私立教育——特别是在特朗普政府的政策摧毁教育的情况下。” “我们有责任为所有学生做正确的事。纳税人的资金不应补贴对可能因宗教、性取向或其他特征而歧视的私立学校的捐款。”

paras.en: The program allows people to receive federal tax credits for donations up to $1,700 to authorized scholarship-granting organizations (SGOs), which distribute the donated scholarship funds to eligible families to be used on private or public educational expenses, including private school tuition, tutoring services, textbooks and more.
paras.zh: 该计划允许人们向授权的奖学金授予组织 (SGO) 捐款最多 1,700 美元，从而获得联邦税收抵免，这些组织将捐赠的奖学金资金分发给符合条件的家庭，用于私人或公共教育费用，包括私立学校学费、辅导服务、教科书等。

paras.en: In an interview with Fox News Digital, Teach Coalition CEO Sydney Altfield said her advocacy group is "extremely disappointed" in the governor for opting out of the program.
paras.zh: 在接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时，教育联盟首席执行官悉尼·阿尔特菲尔德表示，她的倡导组织对州长选择退出该计划“非常失望”。

paras.en: "Not only did he opt kids out of his state and families out of his state from receiving scholarships, but the program allows for Illinois residents to still claim the tax credit. And what that means is that money that should have and could have gone to students and families in Illinois will now just move over the border and flow out of state — over about $2 billion in estimated scholarship money that could have stayed in the state," she explained.
paras.zh: “他不仅选择让孩子离开他的州和离开他的州的家庭获得奖学金，而且该计划允许伊利诺伊州居民仍然申请税收抵免。这意味着本来应该并且本来可以流向伊利诺伊州学生和家庭的资金现在将越过边境并流出该州 - 超过约 20 亿美元的奖学金资金估计本来可以留在该州，”她解释道。

paras.en: Pritzker said in his announcement that his opt-out reaffirms his commitment to strengthening the state’s public schools by ensuring federal taxpayer resources remain available to the students and communities they are intended to serve.
paras.zh: 普利茨克在声明中表示，他的退出重申了他对加强该州公立学校的承诺，确保联邦纳税人的资源仍然可供学生和他们打算服务的社区使用。

paras.en: But Altfield took issue with Pritzker describing the program as a voucher, contending that it does not take money from public schools.
paras.zh: 但阿尔特菲尔德对普利兹克将该计划描述为代金券提出了异议，认为该计划不接受公立学校的资金。

paras.en: "In the same vein of him opting out, he completely misrepresented this program, saying that it is a voucher scheme. It is by definition not a voucher. It does not take a dollar from [the] public school systems. All it does is incentivize taxpayers to use their tax dollars, their federal tax dollars, not their state tax dollars, but federal tax dollars for scholarship money. And instead of it helping families in Illinois, it will now help families outside," Altfield said.
paras.zh: “与他选择退出的方式一样，他完全歪曲了这个计划，说这是一个代金券计划。从定义上来说，它不是一个代金券。它不从公立学校系统拿走一美元。它所做的只是激励纳税人使用他们的税款，他们的联邦税款，而不是他们的州税款，而是联邦税款作为奖学金。它现在不是帮助伊利诺伊州的家庭，而是帮助外面的家庭，”阿尔特菲尔德说。

paras.en: "Public school students are able to take this money," she added. "And we know that the vast majority of Illinois students go to public schools. That means the vast majority of taxpayers in the state send their kids to public schools. So we will see the vast majority of taxpayers designating their tax dollars to help support SGOs that will, in turn, support public school kids and students."
paras.zh: “公立学校的学生可以拿这笔钱，”她补充道。 “我们知道绝大多数伊利诺伊州学生都去公立学校。这意味着该州绝大多数纳税人将他们的孩子送到公立学校。因此，我们将看到绝大多数纳税人指定他们的税款来帮助支持 SGO，而 SGO 反过来又会支持公立学校的孩子和学生。”

paras.en: Altfield also accused Pritzker of putting children in the crossfire of partisan politics over an issue that she believes has an opportunity for a rare showing of bipartisanship.
paras.zh: 阿尔特菲尔德还指责普利茨克在一个问题上让孩子们陷入党派政治的交火中，她认为这个问题有机会罕见地表现出两党合作。

paras.en: Three other Democrats — Colorado Gov. Jared Polis, New York Gov. Kathy Hochul and New Mexico Gov. Michelle Lujan Grisham — joined dozens of Republicans in opting their states into the program. However, some states that have already opted in will have a new Democratic governor in January, such as Colorado, where Gov.-elect Phil Weiser has already signaled plans to withdraw.
paras.zh: 另外三名民主党人——科罗拉多州州长贾里德·波利斯、纽约州州长凯西·霍赫尔和新墨西哥州州长米歇尔·卢扬·格里沙姆——与数十名共和党人一起选择他们所在的州加入该计划。然而，一些已经选择加入的州将在一月份迎来一位新的民主党州长，例如科罗拉多州，当选州长菲尔·韦瑟(Phil Weiser)已经表示计划退出。

paras.en: Kansas, Kentucky and North Carolina all have Democratic governors who did not want to join the program, but GOP legislatures in those states overrode the governors' vetoes.
paras.zh: 堪萨斯州、肯塔基州和北卡罗来纳州都有不想加入该计划的民主党州长，但这些州的共和党立法机构推翻了州长的否决。

paras.en: "I think it's really sad to see — to put kids in the middle of partisan politics," Altfield said of Pritzker's opt-out. "Many blue state governors — Gov. Hochul, Gov. Polis in Colorado and the New Mexico governor — have put politics aside and have put kids first. And I think that if governors can peel back whatever misconceptions they are reading and they can read the program for what it is, it is bipartisan. It will have bipartisan support because education, kids, families are the ones that are going to be successful in this."
paras.zh: “我认为看到让孩子们陷入党派政治之中真的令人难过，”阿尔特菲尔德在谈到普利兹克的选择退出时说道。 “许多蓝州州长——霍赫尔州长、科罗拉多州州长波利斯和新墨西哥州州长——已经把政治放在一边，把孩子放在第一位。我认为，如果州长们能够消除他们正在阅读的任何误解，并且能够了解该计划的本质，那么它就是两党的。它将得到两党的支持，因为教育、孩子和家庭才是这方面取得成功的人。”

paras.en: "I think we're going to see, and I hope we're going to see, more Democratic governors opting into this program before Jan. 1," she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“我认为我们将会看到，而且我希望我们会看到，更多的民主党州长在 1 月 1 日之前选择加入该计划。”

paras.en: Altfield also noted that the program could benefit families who may be struggling financially amid concerns in Illinois and across the nation about affordability.
paras.zh: 阿尔特菲尔德还指出，该计划可以使那些因伊利诺伊州和全国范围内的负担能力问题而陷入经济困境的家庭受益。

paras.en: "We all know that affordability is the number one issue that Democrats and everyone is running on and everyone is feeling a pinch of the penny across the country. And this is a real opportunity that has money flowing into the state of Illinois that could have helped families that are pinching every dollar. For the working mom of two or three or four, she may have one or two jobs, three jobs. Where is she sending her kid after school? Is she paying for after-school care? The tax credit program could have offered her a scholarship to help cover those costs," Altfield said.
paras.zh: “我们都知道，负担能力是民主党和每个人都在竞选的首要问题，全国各地的每个人都感到手头拮据。这是一个真正的机会，资金流入伊利诺伊州，可以帮助那些精打细算的家庭。对于两个、三个或四个孩子的职业妈妈来说，她可能有一份或两份工作，三份工作。她送孩子放学后去哪里？她支付课后托管费用吗？税收抵免计划可以为她提供奖学金来帮助支付这些费用。成本，”阿尔特菲尔德说。

paras.en: "We talk about teachers paying out of pocket. It's been estimated that teachers pay well over $800 out of their pocket for school supplies. Imagine if every low-income kid came to school with all of the school supplies needed. That teacher would not have to pay out of pocket. It's small things like this that really add up in a pocketbook that are now not available to the families and the students in Illinois," she continued.
paras.zh: “我们谈论的是教师自掏腰包。据估计，教师自掏腰包购买学习用品的费用远远超过 800 美元。想象一下，如果每个低收入家庭的孩子都带着所需的所有学习用品来上学，那么老师就不必自掏腰包了。像这样的小事，真正在钱包里加起来，现在是伊利诺伊州的家庭和学生无法负担的，”她继续说道。

articles.title: Judge temporarily blocks FCC from reviewing ABC station licenses amid First Amendment fight

paras.en: A federal judge on Wednesday blocked the Federal Communications Commission from conducting an early review of ABC's broadcast station licenses, siding with The Walt Disney Company-owned media network's position that the Trump administration's move would have a chilling effect on First Amendment rights.
paras.zh: 周三，一名联邦法官阻止了联邦通信委员会（FCC）对美国广播公司（ABC）的广播电台执照进行提前审查，支持这家由华特迪士尼公司（Walt Disney Company）拥有的媒体网络的立场，即特朗普政府的举动将对第一修正案的权利产生寒蝉效应。

paras.en: U.S. District Judge Loren AliKhan granted ABC's request for a temporary restraining order and a preliminary injunction, citing freedom of speech protections after the network accused the FCC of violating its right to free speech in retaliation against programming that the federal government did not support.
paras.zh: 美国地方法官洛伦·阿里汗（Loren AliKhan）批准了ABC的临时禁令和初步禁令申请，理由是保护言论自由。此前，ABC指控FCC侵犯其言论自由权，以报复该电视台播放联邦政府不支持的节目。

paras.en: "This is not a close case," AliKhan wrote in her ruling, saying the network was likely to succeed on First Amendment grounds.
paras.zh: “这不是一个容易判决的案件。”阿里·汗在判决书中写道，并表示该网络很可能以第一修正案为由胜诉。

paras.en: ABC proved "a campaign of retaliation against them in response to their exercise of their First Amendment rights," the judge said, noting that this showed an "irreparable injury."
paras.zh: 法官表示，美国广播公司被证明是“针对他们行使其第一修正案权利而进行的报复活动”，并指出这表明了“无法弥补的伤害”。

paras.en: ABC praised the judge's decision, calling it "an important victory for the First Amendment."
paras.zh: 美国广播公司赞扬了法官的决定，称其为“第一修正案的重要胜利”。

paras.en: The network had also asked the judge to temporarily bar the FCC from taking "any actions, formal or informal," meant to pressure or threaten penalties aimed at influencing its "exercise of editorial discretion." But the judge rejected that request, noting that the network had not specified what those future threats could entail outside the early license renewal proceedings.
paras.zh: 该网络还要求法官暂时禁止联邦通信委员会采取“任何正式或非正式的行动”，旨在施加压力或威胁进行处罚，以影响其“行使编辑自由裁量权”。但法官拒绝了这一请求，并指出该网络没有具体说明这些未来的威胁在早期许可证更新程序之外可能会带来什么。

paras.en: The FCC, meanwhile, claimed the portion of the ruling that granted ABC's motion "is wrong on the facts and wrong on the law."
paras.zh: 与此同时，美国联邦通信委员会声称，批准美国广播公司动议的裁决部分“在事实和法律上都是错误的”。

paras.en: "While we appreciate the district court denying in part Disney's request for preliminary injunctive relief, the portion of the decision granting Disney's motion is wrong on the facts and wrong on the law — as controlling Supreme Court precedent makes clear," the agency said in a statement. "The FCC looks forward to prevailing in full on this matter. We will continue to use our lawful authority to hold broadcasters accountable to their public interest obligations."
paras.zh: 该机构在一份声明中表示：“虽然我们赞赏地区法院部分拒绝迪士尼提出的初步禁令救济请求，但批准迪士尼动议的决定中的部分内容在事实和法律上都是错误的——正如最高法院的先例所表明的那样。” “联邦通信委员会期待在此事上取得全面胜利。我们将继续利用我们的合法权力，让广播公司对其公共利益义务负责。”

paras.en: Wednesday's decision comes after ABC and Disney sued the FCC and its commissioner, Brendan Carr, in August following the commission's unusual move to order eight ABC-owned stations to submit renewal applications for their broadcast licenses years before they were set to expire.
paras.zh: 周三的决定是在 ABC 和迪士尼于 8 月起诉 FCC 及其专员布伦丹·卡尔 (Brendan Carr) 后做出的。此前，FCC 采取了不同寻常的举措，要求 ABC 旗下的八家电视台在广播许可证到期前几年提交续签申请。

paras.en: Carr, a staunch ally of President Donald Trump, ordered the early review of the stations’ licenses in April in response to a joke made by ABC's late-night host Jimmy Kimmel.
paras.zh: 卡尔是唐纳德·特朗普总统的坚定盟友，他在四月份下令对电视台的许可证进行早期审查，以回应美国广播公司深夜主持人吉米·金梅尔的一个笑话。

paras.en: During a skit featuring a mock White House Correspondents' Association dinner monologue on "Jimmy Kimmel Live!" that used spliced video clips to pretend the president and first lady Melania Trump were in the audience, Kimmel said, "Mrs. Trump, you have a glow like an expectant widow." Just days later, a gunman attempted to rush into the actual White House Correspondents' Association Dinner in Washington, D. C.
paras.zh: 在“吉米·金梅尔现场秀”中模仿白宫记者协会晚宴独白的小品中。该节目使用拼接视频片段假装总统和第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普就在观众席上，基梅尔说：“特朗普夫人，你容光焕发，就像一个即将到来的寡妇。”几天后，一名枪手试图冲进华盛顿特区的白宫记者协会晚宴。

paras.en: The joke angered Trump and the first lady, prompting the president to demand Kimmel be fired.
paras.zh: 这个笑话激怒了特朗普和第一夫人，促使总统要求解雇金梅尔。

paras.en: "When is ABC Fake News Network firing seriously unfunny Jimmy Kimmel, who incompetently presides over one of the Lowest Rated shows on Television? People are angry. It better be soon!!!" Trump said on social media at the time.
paras.zh: “美国广播公司假新闻网什么时候解雇了非常无趣的吉米·金梅尔，他无能地主持着电视收视率最低的节目之一？人们很生气。最好快点！！！”特朗普当时在社交媒体上说道。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: Shooting during New Jersey high school football game leaves 1 dead

paras.en: An investigation is underway after a man was shot and killed at a high school football game in New Jersey on Wednesday, according to authorities.
paras.zh: 据当局称，周三一名男子在新泽西州的一场高中橄榄球比赛中被枪杀，目前正在进行调查。

paras.en: Teaneck High School was hosting Hackensack High School on the eve of Thanksgiving when police heard gunshots at around 7:15 p.m. near Cranford Place, located adjacent to the football field. Teaneck Police and Hackensack Police were at the game when the shooting was reported.
paras.zh: 感恩节前夕，提内克高中 (Teaneck High School) 正在接待哈肯萨克高中 (Hackensack High School)，警方于晚上 7 点 15 分左右听到枪声。靠近克兰福德广场 (Cranford Place)，毗邻足球场。枪击事件发生时，蒂内克警方和哈肯萨克警方正在现场观看比赛。

paras.en: Officers located a man with a gunshot wound and rendered aid before he was rushed to a hospital, where he was pronounced dead.
paras.zh: 警方找到了一名受枪伤的男子并对其进行了救助，随后他被送往医院，但在医院被宣布死亡。

paras.en: The victim has not been identified by authorities. The Bergen County Prosecutor's Office said the victim was an adult male and not a current student at either school.
paras.zh: 当局尚未确认受害者的身份。卑尔根县检察官办公室表示，受害者是一名成年男性，不是两所学校的在校学生。

paras.en: Witnesses told WABC that the victim was a 19-year-old man who had attended both high schools but recently graduated from Hackensack. Witnesses also told the outlet that the shooting happened while halftime activities were going on after a gun was pulled during an argument.
paras.zh: 目击者告诉 WABC，受害者是一名 19 岁男子，曾就读于两所高中，但最近从哈肯萨克毕业。目击者还告诉媒体，枪击事件发生在中场休息时，一场争吵中有人拔枪。

paras.en: A source told the outlet that the victim was struck in the face.
paras.zh: 一位消息人士告诉媒体，受害者的脸部被击中。

paras.en: The incident remains under investigation.
paras.zh: 该事件仍在调查中。

paras.en: Teaneck Mayor Mark Schwartz and Hackensack Mayor Caseen Gaines released a joint statement saying "violence has no place in Teaneck or Hackensack, and the safety of our students, families, staff, and residents remains our highest priority."
paras.zh: 蒂内克市长马克·施瓦茨和哈肯萨克市长凯斯恩·盖恩斯发表联合声明，称“蒂内克或哈肯萨克不允许暴力，我们学生、家庭、工作人员和居民的安全仍然是我们的首要任务。”

paras.en: "We stand together as neighbors and remain committed to supporting our communities during this difficult time," the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“我们作为邻居站在一起，并继续致力于在这个困难时期支持我们的社区。”

paras.en: New Jersey Gov. Mikie Sherrill said she was briefed on the shooting and her team was in touch with local officials.
paras.zh: 新泽西州州长米基·谢里尔表示，她已了解枪击事件的情况，她的团队正在与当地官员保持联系。

paras.en: "This act of gun violence is especially heartbreaking as people gathered to cheer on their kids on the eve of Thanksgiving. My thoughts are with the victim and the community," she wrote on X.
paras.zh: “这起枪支暴力事件尤其令人痛心，因为人们在感恩节前夕聚集在一起为他们的孩子加油。我的心与受害者和社区同在。”她在X上写道。

paras.en: U.S. Rep. Josh Gottheimer, whose district covers the area where the shooting took place, described the death as "devastating."
paras.zh: 美国众议员乔什·戈特海默（Josh Gottheimer）所在的选区涵盖枪击事件发生的地区，他形容这起死亡事件是“毁灭性的”。

paras.en: "It’s devastating that a day meant to bring the Teaneck and Hackensack communities together ended in tragedy, with one person killed at the annual Thanksgiving football game," he wrote on X. "I’ve spoken with both mayors and the Bergen County Prosecutor and am staying in close contact as we learn more."
paras.zh: 他在 X 上写道：“本应让蒂内克和哈肯萨克社区团结起来的一天却以悲剧告终，一人在一年一度的感恩节橄榄球比赛中丧生，这是毁灭性的。我已经与两位市长和卑尔根县检察官进行了交谈，并在了解更多信息时保持密切联系。”

articles.title: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause, BBC understands

paras.en: The government and the EU are set to publish the texts of two treaties that were agreed last week as part of a post-Brexit reset.
paras.zh: 作为英国脱欧后重置的一部分，英国政府和欧盟将公布上周达成的两项条约的文本。

paras.en: The treaties will be published on Thursday afternoon, alongside legislation which is designed to enact the bulk of the deal.
paras.zh: 这些条约将于周四下午公布，同时还将公布旨在实施大部分协议的立法。

paras.en: The BBC understands the deal covering food exports has a 10-year termination clause that would mean if one party ended the agreement, they would have to pay to rebuild border checks infrastructure, which will be significantly scaled back as part of the new deal.
paras.zh: 据英国广播公司了解，涉及食品出口的协议有一个为期 10 年的终止条款，这意味着如果一方终止协议，他们将不得不支付重建边境检查基础设施的费用，而作为新协议的一部分，这一基础设施将大幅缩减。

paras.en: Opposition leader Kemi Badenoch has said she would scrap the deal and Reform UK's Nigel Farage has suggested he would refuse to pay.
paras.zh: 反对党领袖凯米·巴德诺克 (Kemi Badenoch) 表示，她将废除该协议，而改革英国的奈杰尔·法拉奇 (Nigel Farage) 则表示，他将拒绝付款。

paras.en: The Brexit reset deal has already sparked debate about its benefits, its costs, and a wider discussion on the long-term UK-EU relationship.
paras.zh: 英国脱欧重置协议已经引发了关于其好处、成本的争论，以及对英国与欧盟长期关系的更广泛讨论。

paras.en: The deal covers British food exports, emissions trading and a youth experience scheme.
paras.zh: 该协议涵盖英国食品出口、排放交易和青年体验计划。

paras.en: Two of the three legal texts will be released on Thursday, covering the food trade and emissions trading scheme deals, alongside the government's cost-cutting bill to enact the deal.
paras.zh: 三份法律文本中的两份将于周四发布，涵盖食品贸易和排放交易计划协议，以及政府实施该协议的成本削减法案。

paras.en: New assessments of the impact of the deal on different sectors and regions of the country are also expected.
paras.zh: 预计还将对该交易对该国不同部门和地区的影响进行新的评估。

paras.en: Under the deal, food exporters will be significant beneficiaries from the scrapping of considerable red tape and checks, and dismantling of border facilities. An internal analysis forecasts a 16% boost to agricultural exports.
paras.zh: 根据该协议，食品出口商将成为取消大量繁文缛节和检查以及拆除边境设施的重要受益者。一项内部分析预测农产品出口将增长 16%。

paras.en: The industry and government hope the reduction in costs for food producers and sellers will be passed on to customers, but there may be no clear visible impact at the checkout.
paras.zh: 行业和政府希望食品生产商和销售商成本的降低能够转嫁给消费者，但结账时可能不会产生明显的影响。

paras.en: Privately, industry insiders told the BBC earlier this week that there are too many moving parts in the world economy, in particular the energy price shock resulting from war in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，业内人士私下告诉英国广播公司，世界经济中有太多变动因素，特别是中东战争造成的能源价格冲击。

paras.en: Regarding the fine detail in the text of one of the treaties relating to the 10-year termination clause, European affairs minister Hamish Falconer said: "The Cutting Costs Bill allows us to implement two major trade agreements."
paras.zh: 关于其中一项与十年终止条款有关的条约文本中的细节，欧洲事务部长哈米什·福尔科纳表示：“削减成本法案使我们能够实施两项主要贸易协定。”

paras.en: "It allows us to eliminate paperwork for our food and drink traders, protect billions of pounds worth of British exports from carbon taxes, and make doing business with our largest trading partner cheaper and easier."
paras.zh: “它使我们能够消除食品和饮料贸易商的文书工作，保护价值数十亿英镑的英国出口产品免受碳税，并使与我们最大的贸易伙伴开展业务变得更便宜、更容易。”

paras.en: The BBC understands that a plan to link British and European emissions trading schemes will see more coverage across the UK's aviation and maritime industries.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司了解到，将英国和欧洲排放交易计划联系起来的计划将扩大英国航空和海运业的覆盖范围。

paras.en: The treaty text will also contain finer detail of how the UK will observe, shape but not vote on relevant EU rules.
paras.zh: 条约文本还将更详细地说明英国将如何观察、制定但不对相关欧盟规则进行投票。

paras.en: Plans to use secondary legislation, including granting direct so-called "Henry VIII powers" to ministers to align UK and EU laws, will also be detailed in the legislation.
paras.zh: 该立法还将详细说明利用二级立法的计划，包括直接授予部长们所谓的“亨利八世权力”，以协调英国和欧盟的法律。

paras.en: Such powers could enable ministers to make changes to bills with less Parliamentary scrutiny.
paras.zh: 这些权力可以使部长们在较少议会审查的情况下对法案进行修改。

paras.en: Outlining the agreement with the EU to MPs earlier this week, the prime minister said new agreements with the EU are "pragmatic" and "not a prelude to anything".
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，首相向国会议员概述了与欧盟的协议，并表示与欧盟的新协议是“务实的”，“不是任何事情的前奏”。

paras.en: Andy Burnham also said it would be "unthinkable" for the UK to rejoin the bloc without a referendum.
paras.zh: 安迪·伯纳姆还表示，英国在不进行公投的情况下重新加入欧盟是“不可想象的”。

paras.en: Several former prime ministers have urged him not to reopen the Brexit debate. Burnham said they are "stuck in the past" and later claimed there would be "no banging on about Europe" from Labour.
paras.zh: 几位前首相敦促他不要重启英国脱欧辩论。伯纳姆表示，他们“陷入了过去”，后来声称工党“不会对欧洲进行攻击”。

paras.en: Badenoch said Burnham has "oversold" the deal and was "trying to take Britain back to 2015".
paras.zh: 巴德诺克表示，伯纳姆“超卖”了这笔交易，并“试图让英国回到2015年”。

articles.title: Guinea orders residents to clean up the capital months after deadly rubbish dump collapse

paras.en: Guinea has ordered residents to do a mass clean-up of the capital, Conakry, months after a rubbish landfill collapsed, killing dozens of people.
paras.zh: 几内亚下令居民对首都科纳克里进行大规模清理，几个月前，垃圾填埋场倒塌，造成数十人死亡。

paras.en: Prime Minister Amadou Oury Bah on Wednesday announced a deadline of 31 December to clear rubbish in the city and its suburbs, which has seen an increase in illegal dumping in recent months.
paras.zh: 周三，总理阿马杜·乌里·巴 (Amadou Oury Bah) 宣布，该市及其郊区的垃圾清理工作截止日期为 12 月 31 日，近几个月来，非法倾倒垃圾现象有所增加。

paras.en: In August heavy rains caused a landslide at the capital's main waste dump, with the rubbish collapsing onto homes killing 31 people and injuring others.
paras.zh: 8 月，大雨导致首都主要垃圾场发生山体滑坡，垃圾倒塌到房屋上，造成 31 人死亡、多人受伤。

paras.en: The site in the city's Dar es Salaam area was subsequently closed permanently, which has led to piles of rubbish accumulating outside homes and on the streets.
paras.zh: 该市达累斯萨拉姆地区的该地点随后被永久关闭，导致房屋外和街道上堆积成堆的垃圾。

paras.en: At a public forum on sanitation, Sanitation Minister Aboubacar Camara said Conakry was generating about 3,000 tonnes of waste every day.
paras.zh: 在卫生公共论坛上，卫生部长阿布巴卡尔·卡马拉表示，科纳克里每天产生约 3,000 吨垃圾。

paras.en: He said much of the garbage was ending up in the streets because of weaknesses in the collection system.
paras.zh: 他说，由于收集系统的缺陷，许多垃圾最终被扔到了街上。

paras.en: The prime minister called on local authorities to become more involved in organising waste collection, saying this could become a way to create jobs.
paras.zh: 总理呼吁地方当局更多地参与组织垃圾收集，并表示这可能成为创造就业机会的一种方式。

paras.en: "The state will do its part, but the municipalities must also organise themselves to ensure waste collection and provide jobs for young people," the prime minister said.
paras.zh: 总理说：“国家将尽自己的一份力量，但各市政府也必须组织起来，确保废物收集并为年轻人提供就业机会。”

paras.en: "Conakry must be completely clean by the end of December," he added, relaying a directive from the country's president, Mamady Doumbouya.
paras.zh: “科纳克里必须在 12 月底之前完全清洁，”他补充道，转达了该国总统马马迪·敦布亚 (Mamady Doumbouya) 的指示。

paras.en: He cited measures the government was taking to improve waste collection and recycling, including a national sanitation fund that would guarantee financing for the sector.
paras.zh: 他列举了政府为改善废物收集和回收而采取的措施，包括设立国家卫生基金，以保证该行业的融资。

paras.en: Camara said talks had been finalised with a waste collection operator, with a plan for equipment to move waste from transit and sorting centres to a new disposal site in BaretodÃ©, outside the capital.
paras.zh: 卡马拉表示，已经与废物收集运营商完成了谈判，计划购买设备将废物从转运和分类中心转移到首都郊外巴雷托德的新处置场。

paras.en: The August tragedy at the Dar es Salaam landfill was not the first - 10 people were killed at the same site in 2017.
paras.zh: 达累斯萨拉姆垃圾填埋场 8 月发生的悲剧并不是第一起——2017 年，同一地点就有 10 人死亡。

paras.en: The government had ordered people living close to the site to move, but many residents chose to stay.
paras.zh: 政府已下令居住在该地点附近的人们搬走，但许多居民选择留下来。

paras.en: According to the prime minister, the government now plans to transform the closed waste site into an urban park.
paras.zh: 据总理称，政府现在计划将关闭的垃圾场改造成城市公园。

articles.title: Two screenings of Pakistani TV show cancelled in India after backlash

paras.en: Until Wednesday, the weekend plans of some television enthusiasts in the Indian city of Bengaluru involved dressing up, having an elaborate dinner and finding out what happens next in the lives of a wildly popular fictional Pakistani couple.
paras.zh: 直到周三，印度城市班加罗尔的一些电视爱好者的周末计划包括盛装打扮、享用丰盛的晚餐，并了解一对广受欢迎的虚构巴基斯坦夫妇的生活接下来会发生什么。

paras.en: Two private screenings of Dar-e-Nijaat (Door to Salvation), a Pakistani television drama that has become something of a sensation on Indian social media, were called off after an online backlash and police scrutiny.
paras.zh: 在印度社交媒体上引起轰动的巴基斯坦电视剧 Dar-e-Nijaat（《拯救之门》）的两场私人放映在网上强烈反对和警方审查后被取消。

paras.en: The serial, which airs on Pakistan's ARY Digital, is available to Indian viewers through some YouTube channels, though the broadcaster's official channel is blocked in India.
paras.zh: 这部连续剧在巴基斯坦的 ARY Digital 播出，印度观众可以通过一些 YouTube 频道观看该剧，尽管该广播公司的官方频道在印度被屏蔽。

paras.en: The controversy comes amid a renewed appetite for Pakistani entertainment in India, even though cultural engagement remains a sensitive issue following a brief but intense military confrontation between the two nuclear-armed neighbours in May last year.
paras.zh: 此次争议发生之际，印度对巴基斯坦娱乐的兴趣重新燃起，尽管在去年 5 月这两个拥有核武器的邻国之间发生了短暂而激烈的军事对抗之后，文化接触仍然是一个敏感问题。

paras.en: A similar gathering in Delhi, featuring quizzes and even a virtual interaction with the show's director, had already divided opinion online last week.
paras.zh: 上周在德里举行的一次类似聚会，以测验甚至与节目导演的虚拟互动为特色，已经在网上产生了分歧。

paras.en: In Bengaluru, one screening, scheduled for Saturday at a restaurant, offered a Persian and Arabic dinner alongside two episodes of the serial for a small ticket charge. The other - scheduled at a private theatre and meant only for family members - asked guests to dress in their "best Pakistani ensemble".
paras.zh: 在班加罗尔，定于周六在一家餐厅放映的一场放映会提供波斯和阿拉伯晚餐以及该连续剧的两集，只需支付少量门票。另一场演出安排在一家私人剧院，仅供家庭成员观看，要求客人穿着“最好的巴基斯坦服装”。

paras.en: As promotional posters circulated online, several social media users questioned the appropriateness of such gatherings and called for police intervention. Both events have since been called off.
paras.zh: 随着宣传海报在网上流传，一些社交媒体用户质疑此类集会的适当性，并呼吁警方干预。此后，这两项活动均被取消。

paras.en: The backlash has coincided with calls to block the release of another Pakistani drama in India.
paras.zh: 与此同时，人们还呼吁阻止另一部巴基斯坦电视剧在印度上映。

paras.en: The All Indian Cine Workers Association (AICWA) has written to Prime Minister Narendra Modi demanding that Netflix's upcoming Pakistani series, Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo (Gather whatever is left), be barred from release in India.
paras.zh: 全印度电影工人协会 (AICWA) 已致函印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪，要求禁止 Netflix 即将推出的巴基斯坦剧集《Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo》（《收集剩下的一切》）在印度上映。

paras.en: Featuring Fawad Khan, Mahira Khan, Sanam Saeed and other stars with many Indian fans, the series is Pakistan's first Netflix original. Its global premiere is scheduled for 4 December.
paras.zh: 该剧由法瓦德·汗、马希拉·汗、萨南·赛义德等明星主演，拥有众多印度粉丝，是巴基斯坦首部 Netflix 原创剧集。其全球首映定于 12 月 4 日举行。

paras.en: In its letter to Modi on Tuesday, the AICWA argued that releasing the series in India would disregard the sentiments of families affected by terrorism. India has long accused Pakistan of supporting cross-border terrorism, an allegation Islamabad denies.
paras.zh: AICWA 在周二写给莫迪的信中辩称，在印度上映该系列剧将无视受恐怖主义影响的家庭的情感。印度长期以来一直指责巴基斯坦支持跨境恐怖主义，伊斯兰堡否认了这一指控。

paras.en: The developments have revived an old debate in India over whether cultural ties with Pakistan should be kept separate from political differences.
paras.zh: 这些事态发展在印度重新引发了一场古老的争论，即与巴基斯坦的文化联系是否应该与政治分歧分开。

paras.en: India and Pakistan share a rich cultural heritage, but relations between them have often been fraught since they were carved out of British India as independent nations in 1947.
paras.zh: 印度和巴基斯坦拥有丰富的文化遗产，但自 1947 年从英属印度分离出来作为独立国家以来，两国之间的关系常常令人担忧。

paras.en: And cultural exchanges have often been among the first casualties of political tensions. Pakistani ghazal singers with devoted audiences in India have periodically found themselves unable to perform there. Indian films, immensely popular in Pakistan, have disappeared from its cinemas. Artistic collaborations have flourished during periods of relative calm, only to unravel when tensions flare again.
paras.zh: 文化交流往往是政治紧张局势的首要受害者之一。在印度拥有忠实观众的巴基斯坦加扎勒歌手有时会发现自己无法在那里演出。在巴基斯坦非常受欢迎的印度电影已经从巴基斯坦的电影院消失了。艺术合作在相对平静的时期蓬勃发展，但当紧张局势再次爆发时，艺术合作就会瓦解。

paras.en: The early 2010s were a particularly fertile period. Pakistani singers Atif Aslam and Rahat Fateh Ali Khan were among the most recognisable voices in Hindi cinema. The launch of the television channel Zindagi in 2014 brought Pakistani serials into Indian living rooms, introducing viewers to stories whose language and emotional worlds were familiar, but whose treatment of everyday life often felt refreshingly different.
paras.zh: 2010 年代初是一个特别多产的时期。巴基斯坦歌手阿提夫·阿斯拉姆 (Atif Aslam) 和拉哈特·法塔赫·阿里·汗 (Rahat Fateh Ali Khan) 是印地语电影中最知名的声音之一。 2014 年电视频道 Zindagi 的推出将巴基斯坦连续剧带入了印度的客厅，向观众介绍了一些故事，这些故事的语言和情感世界是熟悉的，但其对日常生活的处理往往令人耳目一新。

paras.en: By 2016, Fawad Khan was appearing in some of Bollywood's most prominent productions. But attacks on Indian security forces in Uri that year and in Pulwama in 2019, both of which India blamed on Pakistan-based militant groups, narrowed the space for cultural collaboration. Pakistan - which has constantly denied any involvement - also imposed restrictions on Indian entertainment.
paras.zh: 到 2016 年，法瓦德·汗 (Fawad Khan) 出现在一些宝莱坞最著名的作品中。但当年在乌里州和 2019 年在普尔瓦马对印度安全部队的袭击（印度均将这两次袭击归咎于巴基斯坦武装组织）缩小了文化合作的空间。一直否认有任何参与的巴基斯坦也对印度娱乐活动实施了限制。

paras.en: Even as formal exchanges dwindled, Pakistani dramas found new audiences in India on YouTube, while music continued to travel across the border through streaming platforms.
paras.zh: 尽管正式交流减少，巴基斯坦电视剧在 YouTube 上在印度找到了新的观众，而音乐则继续通过流媒体平台跨境传播。

paras.en: But the events of last year disrupted even this relatively informal relationship.
paras.zh: 但去年发生的事件甚至破坏了这种相对非正式的关系。

paras.en: On 22 April 2025, militants killed 26 people, most of them tourists, in Pahalgam in Indian-administered Kashmir. India blamed Pakistan-linked militants; Islamabad denied involvement. In May, India launched military strikes on what it described as terrorist infrastructure in Pakistan and Pakistan-administered Kashmir. Four days of fighting followed before a ceasefire was announced.
paras.zh: 2025 年 4 月 22 日，武装分子在印控克什米尔的帕哈加姆杀害了 26 人，其中大多数是游客。印度指责与巴基斯坦有联系的武装分子；伊斯兰堡否认参与其中。 5月，印度对其所谓的巴基斯坦和巴控克什米尔的恐怖主义基础设施发动了军事打击。经过四天的战斗后宣布停火。

paras.en: Amid widespread anger in India, the government asked streaming platforms to discontinue Pakistani-origin content, while social media accounts of several Pakistani celebrities were blocked.
paras.zh: 在印度普遍愤怒之际，政府要求流媒体平台停止源自巴基斯坦的内容，同时几名巴基斯坦名人的社交媒体账户被封锁。

paras.en: Fawad Khan's much-anticipated return to Hindi cinema with Abir Gulaal was thwarted when the film was denied permission for release in India. Criticism of India's military action by Pakistani artistes fuelled further anger.
paras.zh: 法瓦德·汗 (Fawad Khan) 与阿比尔·古拉尔 (Abir Gulaal) 重返印地语电影备受期待，但因影片在印度上映的许可被拒绝而受挫。巴基斯坦艺人对印度军事行动的批评进一步加剧了愤怒。

paras.en: For much of the past year, Indian audiences have encountered Pakistan on screen largely through the prism of national security. In December, millions flocked to watch Dhurandhar, Aditya Dhar's espionage thriller, whose success inspired a fascination with the gangsters, spies and political intrigues of Karachi.
paras.zh: 在过去一年的大部分时间里，印度观众主要是通过国家安全的角度在银幕上遇到巴基斯坦。 12 月，数百万人蜂拥观看阿迪亚·达尔 (Aditya Dhar) 的间谍惊悚片《杜兰达尔》(Dhurandhar)，该片的成功激发了人们对卡拉奇的黑帮、间谍和政治阴谋的迷恋。

paras.en: But in recent months, a more familiar kind of fascination with Pakistan has begun to resurface.
paras.zh: 但近几个月来，人们对巴基斯坦的一种更为熟悉的迷恋开始重新出现。

paras.en: Pakistani songs like Alfaaz have become hugely popular on Indian social media, while Dar-e-Nijaat, a story about marriage, heartbreak and domestic life, has found an enthusiastic audience.
paras.zh: Alfaaz 等巴基斯坦歌曲在印度社交媒体上非常受欢迎，而讲述婚姻、心碎和家庭生活的故事 Dar-e-Nijaat 也赢得了热情的听众。

paras.en: Written by the celebrated Urdu novelist Umera Ahmed, the serial revolves around the marriage of Zaryab (Durefishan Saleem), a young woman recovering from a romantic betrayal, and Abu Bakar (Sheheryar Munawar), a deeply religious man.
paras.zh: 该剧由著名乌尔都语小说家乌梅拉·艾哈迈德 (Umera Ahmed) 撰写，围绕年轻女子扎里亚布 (Durefishan Saleem 饰) 和阿布·巴卡尔 (Abu Bakar) 的婚姻展开。

paras.en: Though the drama explores questions of faith and redemption, it is Abu Bakar's tenderness towards his wife that has earned him perhaps the highest accolade in the contemporary vocabulary of courtship: a "green flag".
paras.zh: 尽管这部剧探讨了信仰和救赎的问题，但阿布·巴卡尔对妻子的温柔为他赢得了当代求爱词汇中的最高荣誉：“绿旗”。

paras.en: It was this enthusiasm for the drama that prompted the organiser of one of the screenings in Bengaluru to plan an event at a private theatre in her apartment complex.
paras.zh: 正是对这部戏剧的热情促使班加罗尔一场放映的组织者计划在她公寓大楼的私人剧院举办一场活动。

paras.en: What she had envisaged as a small family gathering, she said, had been interpreted quite differently once the invitation found its way onto X.
paras.zh: 她说，当邀请函传到 X 时，她原本设想的小型家庭聚会的解读却大不相同。

paras.en: "My family was saying why should we cancel?" she said. But ultimately, she decided to call it off.
paras.zh: “我的家人说我们为什么要取消？”她说。但最终，她决定取消。

articles.title: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

paras.en: New Facility Brings Off-Highway Wet Friction Production to India

Carlisle Brake & Friction has broken ground to expand its Chennai, India manufacturing operations in one of the world’s fastest-growing industrial regions. Having produced mechatronic products in the region for more than 15 years, Carlisle CBF will relocate to add production at a larger site for off-highway paper wet friction discs and steel separator plates. The new facility is scheduled to open in 2027.

The move to expanded space is designed to accommodate manufacturing capabilities needed to serve the growing demand across the agriculture, construction and especially mining industries in India and Southeast Asia. Local production will improve supply chain responsiveness while supporting original equipment and aftermarket requirements in cost-sensitive markets.

Carlisle Brake & Friction is establishing a state-of-the-art wet friction manufacturing facility on par with proven global manufacturing processes in the new Chennai plant, to build a more resilient regional platform. This expansion strengthens our ability to deliver durable wet friction products that help keep critical off-highway equipment productive.

articles.title: LKQ restructures UK sales and workshop support leadership
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: LKQ restructures UK sales and workshop support leadership
The aftermarket giant has announced a raft of internal promotions, splitting its UK sales leadership into North and South regions while unifying its garage services under Louise Davies

LKQ UK and Ireland has unveiled a series of internal appointments aimed at aligning its sales, operations, and workshop support teams for independent garages and key accounts. Under a new two-region UK structure, Pete Brookes becomes sales director for the North, working alongside operations director Michael Gordon, while Paul Ollerenshaw takes charge of sales in the South alongside operations director Nick Greenmount.

Andy Southby, chief commercial officer at LKQ UK & Ireland, said: “These appointments recognise the experience within our business and our commitment to helping customers grow. Alongside our regional leadership teams, Louise, Mike and Shane will strengthen the support we offer beyond parts, through our garage concepts, tools and equipment, and training.”
Davies promoted in garage services unification

Simultaneously, Louise Davies steps into the newly created role of business development & services director, bringing Workshop Solutions Services (WSS), GMS, Concepts, and LKQ Academy under a single leader. Davies will continue to oversee LKQ’s 1TEC Auto Hub, which supports more than 500 garages, and AUTOFY, which has signed up 120 workshops since launching in August. Supporting her, Mike Bell moves from WSS to become head of concepts, while former sales director Shane Macleod takes over as head of WSS.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Louise Davies, business development & services director at LKQ Euro Car Parts, said: “Helping independent garages grow has long been a focus of my work. Through helping establish 1TEC Auto Hub and launching AUTOFY, I’ve built strong relationships with garage owners and seen first-hand the difference practical support can make to their businesses.

“I’m looking forward to continuing that work while bringing more of LKQ’s expertise together in my new role. Working closely with our sales colleagues will help us make that support more accessible, whether a customer wants to develop their team’s technical skills or find ways to run their workshop more efficiently.”

articles.title: IAAF unveils supplier line-up for second Garage Den
articles.author: Andrew

paras.en: IAAF unveils supplier line-up for second Garage Den
Klipboard, Mahle, Thinkcar, Ring & OSRAM, and Carwood will pitch to independent garages at the IAAF Annual Conference on 3 December 2026

The Independent Automotive Aftermarket Federation (IAAF) has announced the participating suppliers for the second instalment of its Garage Den initiative, set to take place during its Annual Conference on Thursday 3 December 2026.

Klipboard, Mahle, Thinkcar, Ring & OSRAM, and Carwood will present to a new panel of independent garages, collaborating over the coming year to develop solutions for everyday workshop challenges. Progress will be tracked at Automechanika Birmingham 2027 before a winner is crowned at the IAAF Awards Dinner in December 2027.

Mark Field, chief executive of IAAF, said: “The first year of Garage Den showed how much suppliers can learn by spending time in a workshop and seeing how technicians work day-to-day. The garages brought practical questions and honest feedback, and that helped the suppliers see where their products and services could make a difference.
“On 3 December, we’ll introduce a whole new group of garages and Dragons. I’m looking forward to seeing what challenges they bring to the table and what they can develop together.”

Sponsored by Alliance Automotive Group and NAPA Auto Parts UK & Ireland, the conference – entitled Rebel Aftermarket: The Right to Repair Challenge – will also feature a keynote from Matthew Syed, followed by the evening’s Aftermarket Federation Trade Awards (AFTAs). Entertainment will be provided by comedian Rob Beckett and an after-dinner DJ set from Martin Kemp. Booking information is available on the IAAF website.

articles.title: Car-O-Liner Frame Machines Help Collision Repairers Restore Structure, Rebuild Confidence
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Car-O-Liner premium auto body frame machine portfolio is designed and manufactured to help collision repair professionals measure, pull and align vehicles with consistent accuracy.
Whether a vehicle has a minor impact or significant structural damage, every repair starts with a solid foundation, and the Car-O-Liner frame machines are engineered to provide that foundation.

“Shops today face a wider mix of vehicles within the same workspace, and they need equipment that keeps up,” said Doug Bortz, manager, collision sales, North America, Car-O-Liner. “Our frame machines are engineered to give repairers the accuracy and control they need, whatever comes through the door. That is why collision repair professionals around the world trust Car-O-Liner.”
The machines use state-of-the-art technology and robust materials. Technicians get controlled pulling power, flexible repair capabilities and manufacturer-aligned results.
- Speed 3T: A lightweight bench supporting vehicles up to three tons. It handles light and medium cosmetic repairs with quick draw aligner setup and five-ton multi-angle pulling capacity.

- BenchRack: Combines drive-on convenience with a hydraulic lift and removable ramps. Available in four lengths, it suits unibody and full-frame vehicles, from small cars to light trucks, vans and SUVs, and covers light cosmetic work to full-frame repairs.

- BenchRack Versa: An in-ground straightening system designed to improve access, ergonomics and workflow efficiency. Selectable bench lengths and integrated measuring support help maintain repair accuracy across a broad mix of vehicle types.

- Quick42: A multi-functional alignment bench system offering a complete repair solution. It provides a streamlined process to diagnose and repair vehicles, helping body shops expand repair capabilities, increase efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.
For more information about Car-O-Liner frame machines and other Car-O-Liner equipment, visit Car-O-Liner.com.

articles.title: Shops raise concerns over Allstate ADAS calibration pricing practices
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Collision repair shops have raised concerns that Allstate and National General are limiting ADAS calibration payments based on information from Kinetic, a software and robotics company.

A shop owner and Repairer Driven News reader who preferred not to use their name told RDN that after posting their thoughts on the subject on an online forum, several other shops shared similar experiences. The reader said they personally questioned Allstate, in part, on behalf of a body shop they sublet for.
RDN attempted to reach Allstate several times with questions, but the company didn’t respond.

“Allstate basically said, ‘We’re not paying the calibration prices,’ and then they updated the RO with the pricing,” the anonymous reader said. “I’m like, ‘Wow, that looks kind of low, not terrible, but it’s lower than what I typically see.'”
They added that after providing Allstate with documentation to support the operations, the insurer continued pushing the reimbursement prices they wanted to pay, then mentioned Kinetic.
They provided an Oct. 12 email from an Allstate Claims Division representative:

The reader likened Allstate’s pricing with Kinetic to following direct repair program terms without actually being in a DRP. They said: “They’re not just dictating what calibrations need to be done. They shouldn’t do that. Now, they’re dictating pricing.”
Emails provided by other RDN readers also show similar instances occurring:
Documents shared with RDN from repair facilities show that reports Allstate provided to them list Allstate Insurance Company as the customer.

RDN spoke to Kinetic CEO and co-founder Nikhil Naikal. While he wouldn’t share specific information related to Kinetic’s relationship with Allstate, Naikal wanted to emphasize Kinetic doesn’t set insurer calibration pricing, and said Kinetic ID, his company’s ADAS calibration identification software, “is intended to support and not replace the repair professional’s evaluation of that vehicle and any applicable OEM procedures.”

“We follow OEM procedures, so what we help the user that is using the software do is to interpret the OEM calibration requirements, not override them, but to interpret them based on the repair estimate that they’ve already written,” he said. “Our data comes from technical resources like OEM documentation and I-CAR and places like that. Our software is a tool to help repair professionals identify the necessary procedures. It is not a substitute for OEM repair documentation or any professional judgment of the repairer or the repair facility.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Naikal added that insurance carriers set their own pricing.

“When we receive that specific insurance pricing, we program that into our system, so it’s not our pricing,” he said. “We are not setting insurance pricing. We are a tiny company that has no say in pricing decisions. We are just following the pricing that the carriers are determining themselves if they choose to disclose it to us.”
Naikal explained that Kinetic ID provides a technical assessment based on vehicle information and repair operations that are available at the time of the analysis.

“If a repair facility identifies additional requirements supported by OEM documentation, those findings should be considered as part of the repair assessment,” he said. “Kinetic’s technical conclusion can be reviewed when additional repair information becomes available. The decisions regarding any sort of reimbursement, be it from an insurer or charging a customer who’s paying out of pocket, they’re made by the payer, not by Kinetic. The applicable payer determines the process for reviewing and disputing any payment decisions. That has nothing to do with Kinetic.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: He added that the software produces the same output, regardless of who the user is, whether that’s a repairer, an insurer, or a consumer.

“We are not implementing different hierarchies or decision profiles on what the software produces and then output based on who the user is; it’s one uniform user,” Naikal said. “We are not in cahoots with anyone. We are an independent company that’s trying to do our best to make repairs safer.”
If the software deviates from what shops are seeing, Naikal said context can be added to explain why repairers think the software is wrong, and the software will consider it and reevaluate.
When asked, Naikal did confirm that Allstate Strategic Ventures has invested in Kinetic.

In June 2024, Kinetic said in a press release that it was “pleased to have received strategic investments from the venture arms of Liberty Mutual Insurance and Allstate Insurance.” The release says Kinetic received $21 million in Series B funding, but doesn’t share how much came from Allstate and Liberty Mutual.
There is also a website with an Allstate-specific Kinetic login. Naikal wouldn’t confirm to RDN that Allstate has a unique Kinetic profile.
“I cannot talk about individual commercial relationships between Kinetic and any customer at this time,” he said.
RDN readers have also told us about a separate industry issue involving Allstate, and the company hasn’t returned our request for information.
In September, an Allstate Good Hands Repair Network (GHRN) senior damage consultant emailed a group of repair facilities directing them to bill 0.5 mechanical hours for pre- and post-scans:

A document attached to the email establishes the payment methodology but also states GHRN facilities should determine the need for scanning on a case-by-case basis, considering vehicle age, damage, ADAS equipment, restraint deployment, and vehicle-specific OEM procedures.

The document also states, “Allstate expects our Good Hands Repair Network facilities to maintain up-to-date vehicle scanning equipment capable of scanning most vehicles, including those requiring OE licensed data across multiple vehicle brands.”
Allstate’s basis for specifying a set limit on mechanical hours is unclear. RDN’s several attempts to reach Allstate were unreturned.
