articles.title: Astronomers Accidentally Find a Rare Triple-Star System That They Say Shouldn't Exist. It's Located Just 28 Light-Years From Earth

paras.en: Astronomers searching for exoplanets—worlds beyond our solar system—accidentally uncovered something much stranger. The team stumbled upon an odd triple-star system located merely 28 light-years from Earth. The findings, described November 19 in the journal Astronomy & Astrophysics, challenge scientists’ understanding of how stellar systems work, since this weird one shouldn’t be possible based on our current knowledge.
paras.zh: 天文学家在寻找系外行星（太阳系之外的世界）时意外地发现了一些更奇怪的东西。研究小组偶然发现了一个奇怪的三星系统，距离地球仅 28 光年。 11 月 19 日发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的研究结果挑战了科学家对恒星系统如何工作的理解，因为根据我们目前的知识，这种奇怪的系统是不可能发生的。

paras.en: “It’s a freak thing. It was an annoying object,” lead author Étienne Artigau, an astrophysicist at the University of Montreal in Canada, tells CBC News’ Nicole Mortillaro. “It’s not what we were looking for.”
paras.zh: “这是一件奇怪的事情。这是一个令人讨厌的物体，”主要作者、加拿大蒙特利尔大学的天体物理学家艾蒂安·阿蒂高 (Étienne Artigau) 告诉 CBC 新闻的妮可·莫蒂拉罗 (Nicole Mortillaro)。 “这不是我们要找的。”

paras.en: Artigau and colleagues had been hunting for faraway planets with a special instrument on the Canada-France-Hawaii Telescope on Mauna Kea, a volcano on Hawaii’s Big Island. It helps researchers identify distant worlds by measuring minuscule changes in a star’s velocity, which can be caused by orbiting planets. But when the instrument turned toward a neighboring red dwarf, a small, cool, orange-ish type of star, the scientists found that its velocity variations were much greater than expected—more than 1,000-fold.
paras.zh: 阿蒂高和同事一直在使用位于夏威夷大岛莫纳克亚火山的加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜上的特殊仪器寻找遥远的行星。它可以帮助研究人员通过测量恒星速度的微小变化来识别遥远的世界，这种变化可能是由绕轨道运行的行星引起的。但当仪器转向邻近的红矮星（一种小型、凉爽、橙色的恒星）时，科学家们发现它的速度变化比预期大得多——超过 1000 倍。

paras.en: “Typically, we measure fluctuations in a star’s velocity of just a few meters per second. In this case, however, we detected a shift of nearly 16 kilometers per second,” study co-author Atanas Stefanov, an astrophysicist at the University of Geneva in Switzerland, says in a statement. “That was when we realized that what we had encountered was not an ordinary planet, but a much more massive companion.”
paras.zh: “通常情况下，我们测量到的恒星速度波动仅为每秒几米。然而，在这种情况下，我们检测到每秒近 16 公里的移动，”该研究的合著者、瑞士日内瓦大学的天体物理学家阿塔纳斯·斯特凡诺夫 (Atanas Stefanov) 在一份声明中表示。 “那时我们意识到我们遇到的不是一颗普通的行星，而是一颗质量大得多的伴星。”

paras.en: Analyses suggested the mysterious satellite must contain more than half the mass of our sun. This high mass and low brightness pointed toward a dead star. So, the researchers conducted follow-up observations in 2023 and 2024 using an instrument on the Gemini North telescope on Mauna Kea. That allowed them to directly detect the culprit behind the dramatic velocity variations: a white dwarf. It’s a dense stellar core left behind by a deceased low- to medium-mass star, like the sun.
paras.zh: 分析表明，这颗神秘卫星的质量一定超过太阳质量的一半。这种高质量和低亮度指向一颗死星。因此，研究人员在2023年和2024年利用莫纳克亚山双子座北望远镜上的仪器进行了后续观测。这使他们能够直接探测到速度剧烈变化背后的罪魁祸首：白矮星。它是一颗已死亡的中低质量恒星（如太阳）留下的致密恒星核心。

paras.en: This newly discovered white dwarf is quite close to the red dwarf, orbiting at a maximum distance of about 4.6 times the space between the sun and Earth. However, researchers already knew the central star hosted a much more distant white dwarf, and the team estimates it circles the inner pair at about 124 times the distance between our star and our planet. The previously known white dwarf appears to loop around the star duo, while the newly discovered one and the red dwarf orbit close to each other in a binary system.
paras.zh: 这颗新发现的白矮星与红矮星相当接近，其轨道最大距离约为太阳与地球之间空间的4.6倍。然而，研究人员已经知道这颗中心恒星拥有一颗距离更远的白矮星，研究小组估计它围绕内对恒星运行的距离约为我们恒星与行星之间距离的 124 倍。先前已知的白矮星似乎围绕着这对恒星旋转，而新发现的白矮星和红矮星在双星系统中彼此靠近。

paras.en: While astronomers have spotted white dwarf pairs before, Keith Cooper reports for Space.com, a triple system with two white dwarfs and a regular star is exceptionally rare. In fact, this system, dubbed Welopōʻai, is the only one of its kind known in the sun’s neighborhood, according to a separate statement. Astronomers haven’t discovered anything similar within 100 light-years of our planet.
paras.zh: 基思·库珀在 Space.com 上报道说，虽然天文学家以前发现过白矮星对，但由两颗白矮星和一颗普通恒星组成的三重系统极为罕见。事实上，根据另一份声明，这个被称为“Welopō'ai”的系统是太阳附近唯一已知的此类系统。天文学家在距地球 100 光年范围内尚未发现任何类似的东西。

paras.en: Welopōʻai combines the Hawaiian words welo, meaning an inherited or family trait, and pō‘ai, an orbit or circular path. Together, the name translates to a “path of family traits.”
paras.zh: Welopō´ai 结合了夏威夷语 welo（意思是遗传或家族特征）和 pō‘ai（轨道或圆形路径）。总的来说，这个名字的意思是“家庭特质之路”。

paras.en: Welopōʻai is even more mysterious because, according to astrophysicists’ current understanding, it is an impossible stellar system. The star that became the newly discovered white dwarf was originally about 1.4 times as massive as our sun. As it neared the end of its life, it should have ballooned to several hundred times its initial size. Researchers would have expected the enlarging star to engulf the nearby red dwarf and possibly even merge with it.
paras.zh: 韦洛波艾更加神秘，因为根据天体物理学家目前的理解，它是一个不可能的恒星系统。这颗新发现的白矮星恒星最初的质量约为太阳的 1.4 倍。当它接近生命终点时，它的体积应该会膨胀到原来的数百倍。研究人员原本预计这颗不断增大的恒星会吞没附近的红矮星，甚至可能与其合并。

paras.en: But surprisingly, that didn’t happen in Welopōʻai. The red dwarf seems to be alive and well, following a wide, stable orbit.
paras.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，这种情况并没有发生在韦洛波艾。这颗红矮星似乎还活着，而且运行良好，沿着宽阔、稳定的轨道运行。

paras.en: “This system should not exist,” study co-author Patrick Dufour, an astrophysicist at the University of Montreal, says in the second statement. “We have no clean explanation for how it got here. That is the question driving our next observations.”
paras.zh: “这个系统不应该存在，”研究合著者、蒙特利尔大学天体物理学家帕特里克·杜福尔在第二份声明中说道。 “对于它是如何到达这里的，我们没有明确的解释。这是推动我们下一步观察的问题。”

paras.en: Even the faraway white dwarf may have once been less of a third wheel, Paul Delaney, an astrophysicist who retired from York University in Canada and wasn’t involved in the study, tells CBC News.
paras.zh: 从加拿大约克大学退休并没有参与这项研究的天体物理学家保罗·德莱尼 (Paul Delaney) 告诉 CBC 新闻，即使是遥远的白矮星也可能曾经不那么像第三轮。

paras.en: “I would bet that they were relatively proximate to each other and then they did engage in a bit of gravitational embracing, and the farther white dwarf today was much, much closer in its heyday.”
paras.zh: “我敢打赌，它们彼此相对较近，然后它们确实进行了一些引力拥抱，而今天更远的白矮星在其全盛时期距离要近得多。”

articles.title: America's Thanksgiving Parade in Detroit Is Celebrating 100 Years of Elaborate Floats, Papier-Mâché 'Big Heads' and a Distinguished Clown Corps

paras.en: For festive Detroiters, this year’s Thanksgiving Day is cause for a larger celebration than usual. On Thursday morning, the city will host its 100th annual America’s Thanksgiving Parade, marking a major milestone for what is already one of the oldest holiday traditions in the nation.
paras.zh: 对于喜庆的底特律人来说，今年的感恩节比往常更盛大的庆祝活动。周四上午，该市将举办第 100 届年度美国感恩节游行，这标志着美国最古老的节日传统之一的一个重要里程碑。

paras.en: Founded in 1924, the yearly procession (minus two cancellations due to World War II, in 1943 and 1944) has sent floats, larger-than-life balloons and popular recurring characters down Woodward Avenue in downtown Detroit. This year’s procession will include 33 floats, five giant balloons and seven marching bands, as well as the city’s beloved Big Heads and Distinguished Clown Corps.
paras.zh: 这个一年一度的游行始建于 1924 年（减去 1943 年和 1944 年两次因第二次世界大战而取消的情况），沿底特律市中心的伍德沃德大道运送花车、巨型气球和常见的流行人物。今年的游行队伍将包括 33 个花车、五个巨型气球和七个游行乐队，以及这座城市深受喜爱的大头乐队和杰出小丑乐队。

paras.en: Just across town, a second spectacle is also getting in on the fun. Now on display at the Detroit Historical Society, which itself is celebrating its centennial, a new exhibition, “This is 100: America's Thanksgiving Parade,” is honoring the cherished parade with a display of historic footage, props and well-known artifacts. Visitors to the installation will have the opportunity to walk through an interactive timeline of the parade’s benchmark moments, try on famous costumes and even sit on the gilded throne of the only person who has featured in the event since the beginning: Santa Claus.
paras.zh: 就在城镇对面，第二场奇观也正在热闹起来。正在庆祝成立一百周年的底特律历史学会正在举办一个新展览，名为“这是 100 周年：美国感恩节游行”，通过展示历史镜头、道具和著名文物来纪念这一珍贵的游行。参观该装置的游客将有机会浏览游行基准时刻的互动时间线，试穿著名的服装，甚至坐在镀金宝座上，这是自活动开始以来唯一出现在活动中的人：圣诞老人。

paras.en: “Santa has been a part of our parade every single year since 1924,” Rebecca Salminen-Witt, the museum’s chief strategy and marketing officer, tells WDIV’s Jay Scott Smith. “Back in the day, the parade ended right in front of Hudson’s [department store]. Santa would exit his sleigh, he would go upstairs to the 12th floor of Hudson’s and he would open Toy Land for all the children.”
paras.zh: “自 1924 年以来，圣诞老人每年都会成为我们游行的一部分，”博物馆首席战略和营销官 Rebecca Salminen-Witt 告诉 WDIV 的 Jay Scott Smith。 “当时，游行在 Hudson's [百货商店] 前结束。圣诞老人会从他的雪橇上下来，上楼到 Hudson's 的 12 楼，然后为所有孩子们开放玩具乐园。”

paras.en: The exhibit features standout pieces from the world’s largest collection of papier-mâché heads, better known as “the Big Heads” in Detroit, which have been worn by performers since the parade’s beginning. Standing between two and four feet tall and weighing between five pounds and 50 pounds, the first masks arrived from the Carnival of Viareggio in Italy and immediately gained notoriety for their eerie look, the Detroit News’ Francis X. Donnelly reports.
paras.zh: 该展览展出了世界上最大的纸型头像收藏中的杰出作品，这些头像在底特律被称为“大头像”，自游行开始以来表演者就一直佩戴着这些头像。据《底特律新闻》的弗朗西斯·X·唐纳利报道，第一批面具高 2 到 4 英尺，重 5 到 50 磅，从意大利维亚雷焦狂欢节运来，并立即因其怪异的外观而臭名昭著。

paras.en: Over the decades, some 300 new masks were made in caricature of celebrities with connections to Detroit, including Aretha Franklin, Bob Seger, Stevie Wonder, Gordie Howe, Barry Sanders and Sparky Anderson. About half of these feature in the parade each year, while the others are kept in a warehouse with other retired parade paraphernalia.
paras.zh: 几十年来，大约有 300 个新面具以与底特律有联系的名人漫画为主题，包括艾瑞莎·富兰克林、鲍勃·西格、史蒂维·旺德、戈迪·豪、巴里·桑德斯和斯帕克·安德森。其中大约一半会出现在每年的游行中，而其他的则与其他退役的游行用具一起保存在仓库中。

paras.en: “Members of the Big Head Corps pay $300 apiece and pick out what Big Head costume they want to be,” Tony Michaels, president of the Parade Company, which organizes the event, tells MLive’s Edward Pevos and Santino Mattioli. “We have a breakfast for them and they march as a team down Woodward Avenue. This year the new Big Head is Jeff Daniels.”
paras.zh: “大头军团的成员每人支付 300 美元，然后挑选他们想要成为的大头服装，”组织该活动的 Parade Company 总裁托尼·迈克尔斯 (Tony Michaels) 告诉 MLive 的爱德华·佩沃斯 (Edward Pevos) 和桑蒂诺·马蒂奥利 (Santino Mattioli)。 “我们为他们准备了早餐，然后他们作为一个团队沿着伍德沃德大道游行。今年的新大头是杰夫·丹尼尔斯。”

paras.en: The installation also features several costumes worn by past members of the Distinguished Clown Corps, a group of community and business leaders who march in the parade in clown attire. With each consecutive year they march, members of the Distinguished Clown Corps earn ever-more-detailed colors, patterns and accoutrements.
paras.zh: 该装置还展示了杰出小丑军团前成员所穿的几套服装，这是一群穿着小丑服装参加游行的社区和商界领袖。随着每年的连续游行，杰出小丑军团的成员都会获得越来越详细的颜色、图案和装备。

paras.en: “The first five years, [the costume] has to be white,” Lena Antoon, a professor at Wayne State University, told CBS Detroit’s Sandra McNeill in 2023, her eighth year as a distinguished clown. “And then it’s the pattern of your choice.”
paras.zh: “头五年，[服装]必须是白色的，”韦恩州立大学教授莉娜·安东 (Lena Antoon) 在 2023 年告诉 CBS 底特律的桑德拉·麦克尼尔 (Sandra McNeill)，这是她作为杰出小丑的第八个年头。 “然后就是你选择的模式了。”

paras.en: The exhibit traces the story of the parade through factoids and trivia from its long history. In 1934, the Detroit Lions played their first annual Thanksgiving Day football game. The parade was televised for the first time in 1947, though it wasn’t until 1966 that the broadcast was in color. Lassie (the TV dog) was the parade’s grand marshal in 1964, and in 1976, the lit candles from a birthday cake float, made to commemorate the parade’s 50th anniversary, set several small fires along the route. In 1985, a Detroit Free Press article reported that “Santa buckled up in his sleigh because of Michigan’s new seat belt law,” per Midbrow’s Erica Hobbs.
paras.zh: 该展览通过其悠久历史中的轶事和琐事追溯了游行的故事。 1934 年，底特律雄狮队进行了他们的第一场年度感恩节橄榄球比赛。 1947 年，阅兵式首次进行电视转播，但直到 1966 年才以彩色形式播出。莱西（电视狗）是 1964 年游行的大元帅，1976 年，为纪念游行 50 周年而制作的生日蛋糕花车上点燃的蜡烛在沿途点燃了几处小火。 1985 年，《底特律自由报》的一篇文章报道称，“由于密歇根州新的安全带法，圣诞老人在雪橇上系好了安全带”，Midbrow 的艾丽卡·霍布斯 (Erica Hobbs) 如此报道。

paras.en: “Both Thanksgiving and football emerged in the 1860s as efforts to reunite a fractured nation in the aftermath of the Civil War,” Smithsonian magazine’s Gabby Shell writes. “In the nearly two centuries since, the rituals have evolved in tandem, expanding along with the growing nation and adopting its increasingly consumerist character.”
paras.zh: 史密森尼杂志的盖比·谢尔 (Gabby Shell) 写道：“感恩节和足球都是在 1860 年代出现的，目的是为了让内战后分裂的国家重新团结起来。” “在此后的近两个世纪里，这些仪式同步发展，随着国家的发展而扩展，并呈现出日益消费主义的特征。”

paras.en: “It really starts out [featuring] like Mother Goose and storybook characters … and then you slowly see pop culture introduced into the parade, where there’s a Donald Duck float or there’s flying saucers and space-inspired things in the 1960s,” Jeremy Dimick, the exhibit’s curator, tells Hobbs for the Detroit News. “It really just becomes a sign of the times into what’s going on in culture; when you look back at it in its totality, it tells the whole history of the city almost through this lens of the parade.”
paras.zh: 展览策展人杰里米·迪米克 (Jeremy Dimick) 在接受《底特律新闻》采访时表示：“游行一开始确实以鹅妈妈和故事书中的人物为特色……然后你会慢慢看到游行中引入了流行文化，其中有唐老鸭花车、飞碟和 20 世纪 60 年代的太空灵感物品。” “它确实成为了文化中正在发生的事情的时代标志；当你回顾它的整体时，它几乎通过游行的这个镜头讲述了这座城市的整个历史。”

paras.en: Detroit’s parade is tied with New York City’s Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade as the second-oldest in the country. Philadelphia’s Thanksgiving parade, which began in 1920, holds the title of the oldest.
paras.zh: 底特律的感恩节游行与纽约市的梅西百货感恩节游行并列，是美国历史第二悠久的感恩节游行。费城的感恩节游行始于 1920 年，被誉为历史最悠久的感恩节游行。

paras.en: “This is 100: America's Thanksgiving Parade” is on view at the Detroit Historical Society through January 3, 2027.
paras.zh: “这是 100 周年：美国感恩节大游行”将在底特律历史学会展出至 2027 年 1 月 3 日。

articles.title: While Exploring a 500-Year-Old Shipwreck Off the Coast of Sweden, Underwater Archaeologists Discovered Medieval Chain Mail That May Have Belonged to German Mercenaries

paras.en: More than five centuries after a royal Danish warship exploded and sank off the coast of Sweden, underwater archaeologists have uncovered finely crafted chain mail armor resting on the Baltic seafloor.
paras.zh: 一艘丹麦皇家军舰在瑞典海岸爆炸沉没五个多世纪后，水下考古学家在波罗的海海底发现了精工制作的锁子甲。

paras.en: The copper-alloy mail fragments were recovered in October from the wreck of Gribshunden, or Griffin, the 15th-century flagship of King Hans of Denmark and Norway. Researchers discovered the armor alongside a rare munitions chest while surveying the area beneath the vessel’s forecastle, an elevated combat platform at the ship’s bow.
paras.zh: 铜合金邮件碎片于 10 月在格里布顺登号（Gribshunden）（或称格里芬号）的残骸中被发现，这是丹麦和挪威国王汉斯的 15 世纪旗舰。研究人员在勘察船艏楼下方区域时发现了装甲，旁边有一个罕见的弹药箱，艏楼是船头的一个高架作战平台。

paras.en: “It was in the process of documenting the chest that I unexpectedly discovered exposed mail-armor fragments in the vicinity of the chest, along other items that could indicate more chests,” Rolf Warming, an archaeologist at Stockholm University who leads the project with Södertörn University’s Johan Rönnby, tells Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove in an email. “It was only by chance that we came across it, and it shows just how much is still on the wreck site.”
paras.zh: “在记录箱子的过程中，我意外地发现了箱子附近暴露的锁甲碎片，以及其他可能表明还有更多箱子的物品，”斯德哥尔摩大学考古学家罗尔夫·沃明（Rolf Warming）在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫（Johan Rönnby），他与南顿大学的约翰·伦比（Johan Rönnby）一起领导了该项目。 “我们只是偶然发现了它，它表明了沉船现场还有多少东西。”

paras.en: To map the newly explored section of the ship, the researchers paired diver-led excavation with high-resolution 3D photogrammetry and an uncrewed robotic survey boat operating on the surface, according to a statement. Together, the armor, the munitions chest and earlier finds of lead objects possibly linked to ammunition molds could point to a dedicated military storage zone.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，为了绘制该船新勘探部分的地图，研究人员将潜水员主导的挖掘工作与高分辨率 3D 摄影测量技术以及在水面上运行的无人机器人勘测船结合起来。装甲、弹药箱和早期发现的可能与弹药模具有关的铅制品可能指向一个专用的军事储存区。

paras.en: “Historical sources indicate that German mercenaries, or Landsknechts, were aboard Griffin when it sank in 1495,” Rodrigo Pacheco-Ruiz, a maritime archaeologist at the University of Southampton and co-investigator on the project, says in the statement. “This part of the ship may therefore have been used to stow equipment associated with these soldiers, including their armor, although we’ve yet to establish a precise function for the space.”
paras.zh: “历史资料表明，1495 年格里芬号沉没时，有德国雇佣兵，即 Landsknechts，”南安普顿大学海洋考古学家、该项目的联合调查员罗德里戈·帕切科-鲁伊斯 (Rodrigo Pacheco-Ruiz) 在声明中表示。 “因此，船的这一部分可能被用来存放与这些士兵相关的设备，包括他们的装甲，尽管我们尚未确定该空间的精确功能。”

paras.en: When Gribshunden set sail from Copenhagen in the summer of 1495, it led an 18-ship royal fleet bound for a political summit in Kalmar, Sweden, as Smithsonian magazine’s Jo Marchant reported in 2021. Hans, who ruled Denmark and Norway from 1481 to 1513, hoped to quell Swedish rebels and revive the Kalmar Union, which united the three kingdoms. Acting as both a diplomatic showcase and a “floating castle,” Marchant wrote, the flagship carried Danish noblemen, courtiers, a royal astronomer and roughly 150 German mercenary soldiers.
paras.zh: 正如《史密森尼》杂志的 Jo Marchant 在 2021 年报道的那样，当格里布顺登号于 1495 年夏天从哥本哈根起航时，它率领一支由 18 艘船组成的皇家舰队前往瑞典卡尔马举行政治峰会。1481 年至 1513 年统治丹麦和挪威的汉斯希望平息瑞典叛乱并复兴统一这三个王国的卡尔马联盟。马尚特写道，这艘旗舰既是一个外交展示柜，又是一座“浮动城堡”，船上载有丹麦贵族、朝臣、一名皇家天文学家和大约 150 名德国雇佣兵。

paras.en: “It was important to demonstrate military prowess, and the German and Swiss mercenaries were the finest you could get at that time,” Warming tells Live Science.
paras.zh: “展示军事实力非常重要，德国和瑞士雇佣兵是当时你能找到的最优秀的雇佣兵，”沃明告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The voyage ended in catastrophe while the ship lay anchored north of the small island of Stora Ekon, near Ronneby in southern Sweden. Gribshunden erupted in flames and sank rapidly. A 16th-century account of Hans’ life suggests its gunpowder stores accidentally ignited, while other hypotheses point to a possible lightning strike. Many aboard perished in the fire or drowned, though Hans survived because he was ashore at the time.
paras.zh: 当船停泊在瑞典南部龙讷比附近的斯道拉埃孔小岛北部时，航行以灾难告终。格里布顺登号起火并迅速沉没。 16 世纪对汉斯生活的描述表明，其火药库被意外点燃，而其他假设则表明可能是雷击。船上的许多人在火灾中丧生或溺水身亡，但汉斯由于当时在岸上而幸存下来。

paras.en: Rediscovered by local divers in 1971 and formally identified in 2013, the Gribshunden has survived in remarkable condition, thanks to the Baltic Sea’s low salinity, which keeps wood-eating shipworms at bay.
paras.zh: Gribshunden 于 1971 年被当地潜水员重新发现，并于 2013 年被正式确认。得益于波罗的海的低盐度，食木船蛆无法进入，Gribshunden 一直保存完好。

paras.en: Shipworms—which are actually a type of saltwater clam—have tormented seafarers for centuries. In fact, they may have weakened the hulls of the ships of the Spanish Armada when it failed in attacking England in 1588, leaving the ships vulnerable to cannonballs and storms.
paras.zh: 船蛆——实际上是一种咸水蛤——几个世纪以来一直折磨着海员。事实上，当 1588 年西班牙无敌舰队攻击英格兰失败时，它们可能削弱了其船体，使船只容易受到炮弹和风暴的攻击。

paras.en: Measuring nearly 100 feet long and resting in about 30 feet of water, the vessel is a rare surviving example of a late-medieval “caravel”-style ship, constructed with hull planks laid edge to edge over an internal frame so it could carry heavy cargoes and guns. That design placed Gribshunden in the same technological generation as the vessels sailed by Christopher Columbus and Vasco da Gama. Previous dives also yielded a fearsome carved figurehead depicting a monster swallowing a screaming man.
paras.zh: 该船长近 100 英尺，停泊在约 30 英尺的水中，是中世纪晚期“卡拉维尔”式船舶的罕见现存例子，其船体板边对边铺设在内部框架上，因此可以运载重型货物和枪支。这一设计使格里布顺登号与克里斯托弗·哥伦布和瓦斯科·达·伽马航行的船只属于同一代技术。之前的潜水还发现了一个可怕的雕刻人物雕像，描绘了一个怪物正在吞噬一个尖叫的男人。

paras.en: Despite the exceptional craftsmanship of the newly recovered chain mail, its quality does not automatically tie it to an elite knight or king. “This kind of armor could remain in use for extended periods, often undergoing repairs or being reused, so these fragments may represent older military equipment that was still active,” Warming explains in the statement.
paras.zh: 尽管新发现的锁子甲工艺精湛，但其质量并不能自动将其与精英骑士或国王联系在一起。沃明在声明中解释说：“这种装甲可以长时间使用，经常进行维修或重复使用，因此这些碎片可能代表仍在使用的旧军事装备。”

paras.en: Researchers are now conducting chemical analyses on the armor and on samples taken from the munitions chest to determine the chain mail’s origins and the chest’s contents.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在正在对装甲和从弹药箱中取出的样本进行化学分析，以确定链甲的来源和箱内的物品。

paras.en: It is actually a really fascinating research question of ours that could illuminate supply chains and the military logistics,” Warming tells Live Science. “Did the mercenary forces bring their own ammunition and tool kit aboard, or was this supplied by the royal fleet?”
paras.zh: 这实际上是我们的一个非常有趣的研究问题，可以阐明供应链和军事后勤，”沃明告诉《生活科学》。“雇佣军是否携带了自己的弹药和工具包，还是由皇家舰队提供的？”

articles.title: How Jump-Roping Toy Soldiers Accidentally Took Over Your FYP
articles.author: Ej Dickson

paras.en: Holidave, the stalwart leader of SeaWorld’s jump-roping toy soldiers troupe, is known for his ability to jump rope while sitting down, “a skill only shared by 0.1 percent of Earth’s population.”
paras.zh: 霍利达夫是海洋世界跳绳玩具士兵团的坚定领袖，他以坐着跳绳的能力而闻名，“这种技能只有地球上 0.1% 的人口拥有。”

paras.en: He’s the most “laid-back” of all the toy soldiers, allowing fellow toy soldier Jackary Jingleson to take center stage. And “experts” and “recent polling data,” “fans believe it is Holidave who holds the most whimsy” out of all the SeaWorld toy soldiers.
paras.zh: 他是所有玩具士兵中最“悠闲”的一个，这使得其他玩具士兵杰克里·金格尔森（Jackary Jingleson）占据了舞台的中心。而“专家”和“最近的民意调查数据”，“粉丝们认为，在所有海洋世界玩具士兵中，霍利达夫是最有奇思妙想的”。

paras.en: This is all according to AI slop videos posted by @wejumprope_memes, a fan page devoted to the group of masked professional jump ropers, who perform an annual holiday show at SeaWorld Orlando. Per toy soldier lore, in addition to Jackary Jingleson there’s also Sugarsnookie, Soulja Toy, Big Chestnut, and Frosty McSleigh. And all of the edits are the same: an AI-generated narrator recites stats about the toy soldiers, such as their net worth and their vertical leap, as if they were elite athletes and not niche theme park performers.
paras.zh: 这一切都是根据 @wejumprope_memes 发布的 AI slop 视频得出的，该粉丝页面专门介绍蒙面专业跳绳运动员团体，他们在奥兰多海洋世界进行年度假日表演。根据玩具士兵的传说，除了 Jackary Jingleson 之外，还有 Sugarsnookie、Soulja Toy、Big Chestnut 和 Frosty McSleigh。所有的编辑都是相同的：人工智能生成的叙述者背诵有关玩具士兵的统计数据，例如他们的净资产和垂直跳跃，就好像他们是精英运动员而不是小众主题公园表演者一样。

paras.en: For the past two weeks, fan page videos featuring the jump-roping toy soldiers have been going viral, with @wejumprope_memes’ most popular video garnering 1.2 million views. In the comments sections, fans debate the merits and deficits of each toy soldier, declaring their allegiance to their favorite as if they were a ’90s boy band: “Jackery Jingleson is having a banner year! His speed is incomparable, his style undeniable, and his technique is utterly flawless,” reads one comment. Another disputes this, writing “Soulja Toy the underrated gem.”
paras.zh: 在过去的两周里，以跳绳玩具士兵为主题的粉丝页面视频在网上疯传，@wejumprope_memes 最受欢迎的视频获得了 120 万次观看。在评论部分，粉丝们争论每个玩具士兵的优点和缺点，宣布他们效忠他们最喜欢的人，就好像他们是一个 90 年代的男孩乐队一样：“Jackery Jingleson 度过了辉煌的一年！他的速度是无与伦比的，他的风格是不可否认的，他的技术是完美无瑕的，”一条评论写道。另一位网友对此提出质疑，写道“Soulja Toy 是被低估的宝石”。

paras.en: Mostly, people seem confused as to why these videos keep showing up in their algorithm and why they keep watching them. “I have a PhD and lecture at a university. And yet here I am,” one commenter writes on a video about whether Major Bounce, a new toy soldier, will show up for the 2026 season. (In a November 20 Reel announcing “major news for the jump-roping toy soldier community,” he finally did.)
paras.zh: 大多数情况下，人们似乎对为什么这些视频不断出现在他们的算法中以及为什么他们继续观看它们感到困惑。 “我拥有博士学位并在一所大学担任讲师。但我却在这里，”一位评论者在一段关于新玩具士兵 Bounce 少校是否会出现在 2026 年赛季的视频中写道。 （在 11 月 20 日的 Reel 杂志上，他终于宣布了“跳绳玩具士兵界的重大消息”。）

paras.en: As it turns out, there’s a simple explanation for the virality. @wejumprope_memes is run by Devin Meek, an Orlando-based professional entertainer who works for WeFlip, a production company that produces acrobatics shows. But he’s now perhaps best known as his alter ego—Holidave.
paras.zh: 事实证明，病毒式传播有一个简单的解释。 @wejumprope_memes 由德文·米克 (Devin Meek) 运营，他是奥兰多的专业艺人，为制作杂技表演的制作公司 WeFlip 工作。但现在他最出名的或许是他的另一个自我——霍利达夫。

paras.en: What started just a few weeks ago as him making memes to make his coworkers laugh has metamorphosed into an internet sensation, with the toy soldiers amassing a genuine, and ardent, fandom. “I really just made these videos for my friends in the jump-roping community,” Meek tells WIRED. “But I guess they resonated with more people than I thought.”
paras.zh: 几周前，他制作表情包让同事们开怀大笑，这件事已经在网络上引起轰动，玩具士兵聚集了一批真诚而热情的粉丝。 “我真的只是为跳绳社区的朋友们制作了这些视频，”米克告诉《连线》杂志。 “但我想他们引起的共鸣比我想象的要多。”

paras.en: The videos are piggybacking on a larger—and increasingly absurd—trend of seasonal theme park employees going viral. In September, as WIRED previously reported, SeaWorld Orlando enjoyed a bump in ticket sales thanks to Just One More Chapter, a BookTok-themed Halloween scare zone at SeaWorld Orlando that featured swaggering bad boys from the romantasy genre flirting with guests. And last month, women on TikTok swooned over Archer and Fryboy, two performers at Hersheypark Halloween known for sliding around in kneepads wearing tactical streetwear and clown makeup, a practice known as “sliding.”
paras.zh: 这些视频顺应了季节性主题公园员工病毒式传播的更大且越来越荒谬的趋势。据《连线》此前报道，9 月份，奥兰多海洋世界的门票销量大幅增长，这得益于 Just One More Chapter，奥兰多海洋世界以 BookTok 为主题的万圣节惊吓区，其中有来自浪漫幻想类型的大摇大摆的坏男孩与游客调情。上个月，TikTok 上的女性对 Archer 和 Fryboy 着迷，这两位在好时公园万圣节表演的表演者因穿着街头战术服、化着小丑妆、戴着护膝滑行而闻名，这种做法被称为“滑行”。

paras.en: Meek, who has been jumping rope for the past 20 years, was inspired to create the videos featuring Sugarsnookie, Jackary, and the like after seeing the success of Archer and Fryboy, who have a combined more than 3.1 million followers on TikTok. “It was such an interesting phenomenon, because I’m somebody who is in a very similar position where I work a few months out of the year as a holiday-themed performer,” he says. “So I got a kick out of it.”
paras.zh: 米克在过去 20 年里一直在跳绳，在看到 Archer 和 Fryboy 的成功后，他受到启发，创作了以 Sugarsnookie、Jackary 等人为主角的视频，Archer 和 Fryboy 在 TikTok 上的粉丝总数超过 310 万。他说：“这是一个非常有趣的现象，因为我的处境非常相似，一年中有几个月我都是以节日为主题的表演者。” “所以我从中得到了乐趣。”

paras.en: Meek already had an account, @wejumprope_memes, where he posted jump-roping fails and compilations. He posted one video on November 13 featuring old footage from SeaWorld Orlando, where he’s been performing with the other toy soldiers for the past six years. (The group got started during the height of the Covid pandemic—hence, why they wear masks during their shows.) “Fryboy who? Move over, Archer,” it begins, before introducing the lore of Jackery Jingleson, the most “light-hearted, nonchalant” of the toy soldiers.
paras.zh: 米克已经有一个帐户@wejumprope_memes，他在其中发布了跳绳失败和汇编。他于 11 月 13 日发布了一段视频，其中包含奥兰多海洋世界的旧镜头，过去六年来他一直在那里与其他玩具士兵一起表演。 （这个团体是在新冠疫情最严重的时候成立的，因此，他们在表演时戴上了口罩。）“Fryboy 谁？让开，阿切尔”，它开始，然后介绍了杰克里·金格尔森（Jackery Jingleson）的故事，他是玩具士兵中最“轻松、漫不经心”的人。

paras.en: To Meek’s surprise, the video received almost a million views and 588 comments, most of which were not from fellow members of the jumping community but from total strangers. So Meek posted more toy soldier lore on his meme page, introducing Big Chestnut (“a powerful jumper”), Soulja Toy (the developer of the “Christmas Ice Storm 261”), Sugarsnookie (“the girl’s girl of the group,” who is dating Big Chestnut) and Frosty McSleigh (“he has the fastest salute time of all the toy soldiers.”)
paras.zh: 令米克惊讶的是，该视频获得了近 100 万次观看和 588 条评论，其中大部分不是来自跳跃社区的其他成员，而是来自完全陌生的人。 So Meek 在他的表情包页面上发布了更多玩具士兵的传说，介绍了 Big Chestnut（“强大的跳跃者”）、Soulja Toy（“圣诞冰风暴 261”的开发者）、Sugarsnookie（“团体中的女孩”，正在与 Big Chestnut 约会）和 Frosty McSleigh（“他的敬礼时间是所有玩具士兵中最快的。”）

paras.en: Though the lore is fictional, it’s also based on the jumpers’ actual skills and personalities: the jumpers who play Big Chestnut and Sugarsnookie are actually in a long-term relationship, and Jackery Jingleson, perhaps the most popular of the group, once held the world record for the fastest jump roper in the United States. “Honestly, that makes [the popularity of the memes] even funnier to us,” he says.
paras.zh: 虽然这个传说是虚构的，但它也是基于跳绳运动员的实际技能和个性：扮演“Big Chestnut”和“Sugarsnookie”的跳绳运动员实际上处于长期关系中，而杰克里·金格尔森（Jackery Jingleson）可能是该团体中最受欢迎的，曾经保持着美国最快跳绳运动员的世界纪录。 “老实说，这让[模因的流行]对我们来说更有趣，”他说。

paras.en: Though some fans have speculated in the comments that the toy soldier memes are a marketing campaign for SeaWorld Orlando, Meek denies that’s the case: He doesn’t tag SeaWorld in the comments, nor has he been in contact with the theme park about his page. (SeaWorld Orlando did not respond to WIRED’s request for comment.)
paras.zh: 尽管一些粉丝在评论中猜测玩具士兵模因是奥兰多海洋世界的营销活动，但米克否认了这一点：他没有在评论中标记海洋世界，也没有就他的页面与主题公园联系。 （奥兰多海洋世界没有回应《连线》杂志的置评请求。）

paras.en: “This is something that is so targeted to people who are internet-brained and have this ironic sense of humor,” he says. “And that’s exactly the type of person who’ll tune out immediately if they feel like they’re being sold something on the internet.”
paras.zh: “这是专门针对那些具有网络头脑并具有讽刺幽默感的人的东西，”他说。 “如果他们觉得自己在互联网上被兜售了一些东西，那么这种人就会立即退出。”

paras.en: Others have even speculated that there is an actual feud brewing between the SeaWorld Orlando “jumpers” and the Southern California–based “sliders,” though Meek says the rivalry is playful, and he has even reached out to collab with them. (The sliders may view it differently: So far, he says, they “don’t seem super interested” in joining forces.)
paras.zh: 其他人甚至猜测奥兰多海洋世界的“跳跃者”和南加州的“滑者”之间实际上正在酝酿不和，尽管米克表示这种竞争很有趣，他甚至已经主动与他们合作。 （滑块可能有不同的看法：到目前为止，他说，他们对联合起来“似乎不太感兴趣”。）

paras.en: What has surprised Meek the most, however, is that very few commenters suspect that the toy soldiers themselves are behind the memes. In fact, he’s been shocked by how many organic meme fan pages have popped up within the past week, with people drawing their own fan art of Holidave saluting or Jackery Jingleson jumping. WeFlip has also been deluged with business inquiries: “People are like, how can we get Jackery Jingleson out here?”
paras.zh: 然而，最让米克惊讶的是，很少有评论者怀疑玩具士兵本身就是这些模因的幕后黑手。事实上，他对过去一周内出现的如此多的有机表情包粉丝页面感到震惊，人们画出了自己的粉丝艺术，比如霍利达夫敬礼或杰克里·金格尔森跳跃。 WeFlip 也收到了大量的商业咨询：“人们会问，我们怎样才能把 Jackery Jingleson 带到这里？”

paras.en: Essentially, what started as an inside joke within an extremely niche community has evolved into an inside joke for the internet at large. “I think people like the feeling of being in on a joke and being a part of it and building it up,” he says.
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，最初是一个极其小众社区内的内部笑话，现在已经演变成整个互联网的内部笑话。 “我认为人们喜欢参与笑话、参与其中并不断发展的感觉，”他说。

paras.en: So what’s next for the SeaWorld Orlando jump-roping toy soldiers? The rotating cast typically performs at the park on the weekends, ramping up appearances as it gets closer to the holiday season. Meek also shares that the toy soldiers will “likely cross state lines” in the coming months, including a stint at the Christmas market in Cullman, Alabama. Frosty McSleigh, renowned for his 0.08-second salute, plus a slew of new, yet-to-be-introduced toy soldiers will also make an appearance.
paras.zh: 那么奥兰多海洋世界跳绳玩具士兵的下一步是什么？轮流演员通常会在周末在公园表演，随着假期临近，演出次数也会增加。米克还表示，这些玩具士兵将在未来几个月“可能跨越州界”，包括在阿拉巴马州卡尔曼的圣诞市场上展示。以其 0.08 秒敬礼而闻名的弗罗斯蒂·麦克斯利 (Frosty McSleigh) 以及大量尚未推出的新玩具士兵也将亮相。

paras.en: Though it may come as a disappointment to some that the roots of the toy soldier phenomenon were inorganic, Meek isn’t concerned. “The people are real. The athleticism is real. The lore is real,” he says. “For all of these people, jump rope is their life, and we’re super-dedicated to teaching it and sharing it. And I think people can feel that.”
paras.zh: 尽管玩具士兵现象的根源是无机的，这可能会让一些人感到失望，但米克并不担心。 “人们是真实的。运动能力是真实的。传说是真实的，”他说。 “对于所有这些人来说，跳绳就是他们的生活，我们非常致力于教授和分享它。我认为人们可以感受到这一点。”

articles.title: The 30 Best Early Black Friday Deals: Our Ultimate Picks (2026)
articles.author: Simon Hill

paras.en: While the Friday after Thanksgiving has traditionally been the busiest shopping day of the year, Black Friday deals have gradually spread well beyond the day. First came Cyber Monday, then Cyber Week. Now, early Black Friday deals kick off before November has even started. The tricky part for early birds is knowing what’s a genuine deal and what’s likely to go even lower when Black Friday arrives.
paras.zh: 虽然感恩节后的星期五传统上是一年中最繁忙的购物日，但黑色星期五的优惠活动已逐渐蔓延到这一天之外。首先是网络星期一，然后是网络周。现在，黑色星期五特卖早在 11 月开始之前就开始了。对于早起的鸟儿来说，棘手的部分是知道什么是真正的交易，以及当黑色星期五到来时什么可能会更低。

paras.en: The Reviews team at WIRED tracks prices on our favorite gadgets year-round, and we only highlight deals on devices we’ve tested and would recommend to our own friends and family. Some of these picks may be cheaper for Black Friday, but these are the discounts that have caught our eye so far.
paras.zh: 《连线》的评论团队全年跟踪我们最喜欢的小工具的价格，我们只突出我们已经测试过并会推荐给我们自己的朋友和家人的设备的优惠。其中一些精选产品在黑色星期五可能会更便宜，但这些是迄今为止引起我们注意的折扣。

paras.en: Updated November 25: We’ve added new deals on Apple’s iPad Mini, Bose QuietComfort headphones, Google’s Pixel 11 range, Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold8, the Anker MagGo UFO 3-in-1 charger, Sonos Arc Ultra soundbar, Eufy S4 security camera and E340 video doorbell, and Amazon Echo Spot speaker. We also removed some lackluster deals and checked for accuracy throughout.
paras.zh: 11 月 25 日更新：我们增加了 Apple iPad Mini、Bose QuietComfort 耳机、Google Pixel 11 系列、三星 Galaxy Z Fold8、Anker MagGo UFO 三合一充电器、Sonos Arc Ultra soundbar、Eufy S4 安防摄像头和 E340 视频门铃以及 Amazon Echo Spot 扬声器的新优惠。我们还删除了一些平淡的交易，并检查了整个过程的准确性。

paras.en: The best trackers for anyone with an iPhone; you can use them to keep tabs on your keys, luggage, bike, or whatever else you worry might go missing. Each AirTag location is marked clearly in the Find My app. The battery should last a year, and we have a guide on how to replace your AirTag battery. Just please don’t use them to track people. This is the lowest price we have seen on the single tag, but it drops this low pretty frequently.
paras.zh: 适合任何 iPhone 使用者的最佳追踪器；您可以用它们来监视您的钥匙、行李、自行车或您担心可能丢失的任何其他物品。每个 AirTag 位置都在“查找我的”应用程序中清晰标记。电池可持续使用一年，我们提供了如何更换 AirTag 电池的指南。只是请不要使用它们来跟踪人们。这是我们在单个标签上看到的最低价格，但它经常下降到这个低位。

paras.en: If you want to pair wireless earbuds with your iPhone and enjoy a seamless, feature-rich experience, you should snag the AirPods Pro 3. They are comfy, boast top-notch active noise cancellation, and can even translate some languages in real time. This is the lowest price we've ever seen, but act fast because there's no telling when this discount will disappear.
paras.zh: 如果您想将无线耳机与 iPhone 配对并享受无缝、功能丰富的体验，您应该购买 AirPods Pro 3。它们佩戴舒适，拥有一流的主动降噪功能，甚至可以实时翻译某些语言。这是我们见过的最低价格，但行动要快，因为不知道折扣何时会消失。

paras.en: The latest iPad Mini is thinner than its predecessor and has a slightly larger screen, and the front-facing camera has been moved to a landscape orientation for better video calls. You also get the A20 Pro chip and an OLED screen, making this perhaps the best small tablet in town. The price is a bit steep, but at $100 off, it's more tempting.
paras.zh: 最新的 iPad Mini 比其前身更薄，屏幕稍大，前置摄像头已移至横向，以实现更好的视频通话效果。您还可以获得 A20 Pro 芯片和 OLED 屏幕，使其成为城里最好的小型平板电脑。价格有点贵，但是100美元的折扣，还是比较诱人的。

paras.en: With excellent noise canceling, 30-hour battery life, and loads of customization options, the Sony WH-1000XM6 are a great pair of headphones. They’re also stylish and comfy with a mix of easy-to-use touch controls and physical buttons. This is the lowest price we’ve ever seen them go on sale for.
paras.zh: 索尼 WH-1000XM6 具有出色的降噪功能、30 小时的电池续航时间和大量定制选项，是一款出色的耳机。它们还时尚舒适，结合了易于使用的触摸控制和物理按钮。这是我们见过的最低价格。

paras.en: The QuietComfort Headphones (2nd Gen) are super comfy to wear, even for long periods, with absolutely top-notch ANC (active noise cancellation). We felt they were a bit pricey on release, but these Bose headphones are easy to recommend with this tasty discount.
paras.zh: QuietComfort 耳机（第二代）即使长时间佩戴也非常舒适，具有绝对一流的 ANC（主动降噪）功能。我们觉得它们发布时有点贵，但这些 Bose 耳机凭借如此优惠的折扣很容易推荐。

paras.en: The best Android phones for most folks are Google's Pixels. They have excellent cameras, genuinely useful AI-enhanced features, and the slickest software around. You can also expect decent performance, with all three sporting Google's Tensor G6 chipset. The base Google Pixel 11 will be enough for most people, but the 11 Pro or 11 Pro XL have the deepest discounts and represent the very best Google has to offer this year.
paras.zh: 对于大多数人来说，最好的 Android 手机是 Google 的 Pixel。它们拥有出色的相机、真正有用的人工智能增强功能以​​及最流畅的软件。您还可以期待不错的性能，这三款产品都配备了 Google 的 Tensor G6 芯片组。基本款 Google Pixel 11 对于大多数人来说已经足够了，但 11 Pro 或 11 Pro XL 的折扣力度最大，代表了 Google 今年提供的最好产品。

paras.en: No one knows foldables like Samsung, and the Z Fold8 draws on all of its experience to create our top pick for the best folding phones. The passport-sized form factor combines a 5.5-inch cover screen with a 7.7-inch inner screen that's perfect for side-by-side apps. It's a powerful phone with a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and has plenty of stamina thanks to the 4,800-mAh silicon-carbon battery. This $350 discount brings it to the lowest price we’ve seen so far.
paras.zh: 没有人像三星一样了解可折叠手机，Z Fold8 借鉴了三星的所有经验，打造了我们最佳折叠手机的首选。护照大小的外形结合了 5.5 英寸覆盖屏幕和 7.7 英寸内屏幕，非常适合并排应用程序。这是一款功能强大的手机，配备 Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 芯片组，并配备 4,800mAh 硅碳电池，具有充足的耐力。 350 美元的折扣使其达到我们迄今为止见过的最低价格。

paras.en: This excellent MagSafe wallet holds two cards securely. The reason we like it so much is due to the clever pop-out mechanism that lets you take out your cards quickly without needing to fight for them. Some MagSafe wallets make the process of paying or grabbing your ID more cumbersome than they’re worth. This one makes it easy, and it looks good doing it.
paras.zh: 这款出色的 MagSafe 钱包可以安全地容纳两张卡。我们之所以如此喜欢它，是因为它巧妙的弹出机制可以让你快速取出卡片，而无需为它们而战。一些 MagSafe 钱包使支付或获取您的 ID 的过程变得比它们的价值更加繁琐。这使事情变得很容易，而且看起来很不错。

paras.en: Moft does a lovely line of origami-style folding stands and wallets for iPhones and other magnetic Qi2 phones. The accessory maker has an early Black Friday sale on now with up to 30 percent off this and other accessories.
paras.zh: Moft 为 iPhone 和其他磁性 Qi2 手机设计了一系列可爱的折纸式折叠支架和钱包。该配件制造商现在开始提前进行黑色星期五促销活动，这款配件和其他配件最高可享受 30% 的折扣。

paras.en: Looking for a power bank that can keep your laptop, phone, and other gadgets powered up on the go? Look no further. The EcoFlow Rapid Pro is my top power bank for laptops because of the 27,650-mAh capacity (allowed on flights), three USB-C ports (rated at 140 watts, 65 watts, and 65 watts), and retractable 2-foot USB-C cable (rated at 140 watts).
paras.zh: 正在寻找一款可以让您的笔记本电脑、手机和其他小工具在旅途中保持供电的移动电源？别再看了。 EcoFlow Rapid Pro 是我最喜欢的笔记本电脑移动电源，因为其容量为 27,650 mAh（航班上允许）、三个 USB-C 端口（额定功率为 140 瓦、65 瓦和 65 瓦）以及可伸缩 2 英尺 USB-C 电缆（额定功率为 140 瓦）。

paras.en: If you have Apple's trio of gadgets (iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods), a 3-in-1 travel charger is a handy thing to own. This is the smallest option you'll find that's still usable, and it can squeeze into any overstuffed bag or case. Unfolded, there's a magnetic pad to charge your iPhone at up to 15 watts, a middle pad for your AirPods, and an Apple Watch charger on the right.
paras.zh: 如果您拥有 Apple 的三件套设备（iPhone、Apple Watch 和 AirPods），那么拥有一个三合一旅行充电器会很方便。这是您会发现仍然可用的最小选项，它可以挤进任何塞满的袋子或箱子中。展开后，有一个磁性垫可以为您的 iPhone 充电，最大功率为 15 瓦，中间有一个垫可以为您的 AirPods 充电，右侧有一个 Apple Watch 充电器。

At 40 percent off, this is the lowest price I’ve seen.
paras.zh: 小工具太无聊了。我希望生活中有更多拟人化的设备。 Ugreen 简单地在这款无线充电器上添加了一个小机器人脸，它会根据充电状态改变表情。我立刻就喜欢它胜过我所有的旧无脸充电器。充电板支持 Qi2/MagSafe，最多可倾斜 70 度，露出第二个充电板，为 AirPods 或其他无线耳机充电。它甚至还有一个用于第三个小工具的 USB-C 端口。 40％的折扣，这是我见过的最低价格。

articles.title: The Iowa Lead Detonation Happened. Now the Real Work Begins to Study It
articles.author: Molly Taft

paras.en: On Wednesday morning, the US Army detonated nearly five tons of degraded lead azide outside of Middletown, Iowa.
paras.zh: 周三上午，美国陆军在爱荷华州米德尔敦郊外引爆了近五吨降解的叠氮化铅。

paras.en: Environmental Protection Administration chief Lee Zeldin told CNN shortly after the explosion that preliminary monitoring from the site detected no lead in the air around the site.
paras.zh: 爆炸发生后不久，环境保护局局长李泽尔丁告诉美国有线电视新闻网，现场初步监测没有发现现场周围空气中含有铅。

paras.en: But the full extent of the fallout may not be certain for at least a few days. A barrage of government, university, and citizen monitoring and testing projects are underway. Air, soil, and water samples they’ve collected will determine the extent of lead exposure, if any, in Middletown and the surrounding area.
paras.zh: 但至少在几天内，影响的全部程度可能还不确定。政府、大学和公民的一系列监测和测试项目正在进行中。他们收集的空气、土壤和水样本将确定米德尔敦及周边地区的铅暴露程度（如果有）。

paras.en: The lead azide has been on the base near Middletown for decades, but recently the Army deemed it unstable and too dangerous to move and remediate. Poor communication between the Army and towns in the path of the fallout led to a public uproar. While the federal government stepped up its mitigation measures—the Army dug a dam around the detonation site, while NASA stepped in with research jets and satellites for monitoring—universities had already been swinging into action due to the chaotic rollout.
paras.zh: 叠氮化铅已在米德尔敦附近的基地存在了数十年，但最近陆军认为该基地不稳定且太危险，无法移动和修复。军队与辐射路径上的城镇之间的沟通不畅导致了公众的骚动。虽然联邦政府加强了缓解措施——陆军在爆炸地点周围挖了一座大坝，而美国宇航局则派出研究飞机和卫星介入进行监测——但由于混乱的部署，大学已经开始采取行动。

paras.en: Several departments at the University of Iowa kicked into gear to begin to set up air and soil monitoring stations late last week. “Initially we did not know that [the] EPA or Army or anybody else was going to be doing anything,” says Peter Thorne, a professor of environmental health at the university.
paras.zh: 爱荷华大学的几个系于上周晚些时候开始建立空气和土壤监测站。 “最初我们并不知道美国环保局、陆军或其他任何人会采取任何行动，”该大学环境健康教授彼得·索恩 (Peter Thorne) 说。

paras.en: Scientists at Purdue University, nearly 300 miles away, also put out a call for soil samples from Middletown.
paras.zh: 近 300 英里外的普渡大学的科学家们也呼吁从米德尔敦获取土壤样本。

paras.en: “We learned about the detonation late last week; once we learned of the initial delay in detonation date we decided to put forth the call,” says Ellen Wells, a professor of public health at Purdue who is helping lead the testing.
paras.zh: “我们上周晚些时候得知了爆炸的消息；当我们得知爆炸日期最初延迟后，我们决定发出呼吁，”帮助领导测试的普渡大学公共卫生教授埃伦·威尔斯说。

paras.en: Surrounding towns were notified in late October that the Army wanted to conduct pre- and post-detonation soil sampling for “an intentional, controlled detonation” of a “quantity of lead azide”—seemingly the only notification that many towns in the initial modeled path of the fallout say they received before a press release issued by the Army days before the planned explosion.
paras.zh: 10月底，周边城镇接到通知，陆军希望对爆炸前和爆炸后的土壤进行采样，以“有意、受控地爆炸”一定量的“叠氮化铅”——这似乎是最初模拟的放射性尘埃路径中的许多城镇表示，他们在计划爆炸前几天陆军发布新闻稿之前收到的唯一通知。

paras.en: The lack of communication has, understandably, instilled a lot of public distrust in the federal government, including agencies’ monitoring programs. Thorne says that efforts like the University of Iowa’s are not meant to displace federal monitoring, but rather to supplement and support it—and hopefully reassure the public.
paras.zh: 可以理解的是，缺乏沟通已经让公众对联邦政府产生了很大的不信任，包括各机构的监控计划。索恩表示，像爱荷华大学这样的努力并不是要取代联邦监控，而是要补充和支持它，并希望让公众放心。

paras.en: “We and the EPA are doing similar exposure assessment efforts. If they agree, they can give us some confidence,” he says. “For people who might be concerned about the veracity of what the government tells them, if their findings are in alignment with ours, then I think that helps quell some of those concerns.”
paras.zh: “我们和美国环保局正在做类似的暴露评估工作。如果他们同意，他们可以给我们一些信心，”他说。 “对于那些可能担心政府告诉他们的真实性的人来说，如果他们的发现与我们的一致，那么我认为这有助于平息其中一些担忧。”

paras.en: Thorne says that the soil samples the University of Iowa scientists had measured before the detonation had low levels of lead. “If I saw something like a 10 fold increase in the amount of lead in the soil 20 miles downwind, I’d be concerned with that,” he says.
paras.zh: 索恩说，爱荷华大学科学家在爆炸前测量的土壤样本中铅含量较低。 “如果我看到顺风 20 英里处土壤中的铅含量增加了 10 倍，我就会对此感到担忧，”他说。

paras.en: Some soil testing can be done instantaneously with devices that can image the soil’s surface, using a gun device that fires X-ray beams into a sample and measures the specific electromagnetic signature of lead atoms that bounce back. While Wells and her team don’t have those instruments in the field, they are planning on using them to analyze the samples they receive. More sensitive lab equipment can provide even more granular data, though Thorne estimates those results could take about a week.
paras.zh: 一些土壤测试可以通过可对土壤表面进行成像的设备即时完成，使用枪设备将 X 射线束发射到样品中并测量反射回来的铅原子的特定电磁特征。虽然威尔斯和她的团队在现场没有这些仪器，但他们计划使用它们来分析收到的样本。更敏感的实验室设备可以提供更精细的数据，但索恩估计这些结果可能需要大约一周的时间。

paras.en: In addition to monitoring being done by the Army and the EPA, which is maintaining a live website of air quality results, University of Iowa scientists are monitoring the plume to figure out where the highest concentration of lead may settle. They’re also collecting data on particulate matter in the air around the detonation site for analysis, sending air filters to the lab for more detailed results.
paras.zh: 除了陆军和环保局（负责维护空气质量结果的实时网站）进行的监测之外，爱荷华大学的科学家们还在监测羽流，以确定铅浓度最高的地方可能会沉降。他们还收集爆炸地点周围空气中颗粒物的数据进行分析，并将空气过滤器发送到实验室以获得更详细的结果。

paras.en: “As these data are compiled over the holiday week to the early next week, I think we'll start to have a bigger picture of roughly how much loading we have of the soil at various places downwind and what we can expect from that,” says Thorne.
paras.zh: 索恩说：“随着这些数据在假期周到下周初进行汇总，我认为我们将开始对顺风各个地方的土壤负载有一个更大的了解，以及我们可以从中得到什么。”

paras.en: A lot of concern online has centered around how additional lead in the soil may impact crops in Iowa, one of the central agricultural hubs for soybeans and corn. Jeffrey Catalano, a professor of earth and environmental sciences at Washington University in Saint Louis, says that there’s a large amount of research showing that plants like corn are actually pretty bad at absorbing lead.
paras.zh: 网上的很多担忧都集中在土壤中额外的铅可能如何影响爱荷华州的农作物上，爱荷华州是大豆和玉米的中央农业中心之一。圣路易斯华盛顿大学地球与环境科学教授杰弗里·卡塔拉诺 (Jeffrey Catalano) 表示，大量研究表明，玉米等植物实际上吸收铅的能力相当差。

paras.en: “The hazard is more like, if soil with lead in it gets stuck to leaves, and you eat leaves that have lead-rich soil on them,” he says. “If you take some corn crops next year versus this year and measure their lead content, I don’t think you would see anything other than random variations. I’m not worried about food produced in Iowa.”
paras.zh: “危险更像是，如果含铅的土壤粘在叶子上，而你吃的叶子上含有富含铅的土壤，”他说。 “如果你拿明年和今年的一些玉米作物来测量它们的铅含量，我认为你除了随机变化之外不会看到任何其他东西。我并不担心爱荷华州生产的食品。”

paras.en: Municipal drinking water is also unlikely to be affected because most treatment plants are designed to remove lead from water supplies, says Patrick McNamara, a professor of environmental engineering at Marquette University. It’s more worrisome for private wells or streams on people’s property where livestock may drink. McNamara suggests that owners use at-home lead water tests for safety.
paras.zh: 马凯特大学环境工程教授帕特里克·麦克纳马拉表示，市政饮用水也不太可能受到影响，因为大多数处理厂的设计目的都是去除供水中的铅。对于人们财产上可供牲畜饮用的私人水井或溪流来说，更令人担忧。麦克纳马拉建议业主使用家庭铅水测试来确保安全。

paras.en: While the detonation and haphazard announcements leading up to it raised alarm bells, both Thorne and Catalano say that there are communities dealing with legacy pollution around the country that are exposed to dangerous levels of lead every day that deserve attention—and remediation.
paras.zh: 虽然爆炸和导致爆炸的随意公告敲响了警钟，但索恩和卡塔拉诺都表示，全国各地有一些处理遗留污染的社区每天都暴露在危险水平的铅中，值得关注和补救。

paras.en: “I've done work in places like East Chicago, Indiana, where they built a housing project and a school on the grounds of a former lead smelting plant—we were seeing soil lead levels that are roughly 10,000-fold higher than what we've measured in Iowa this week,” Thorne says. “There are a lot of places around the country where there's a much greater lead hazard than I'm going to anticipate what we’ll end up with here. I don't want to over-sell this one when we recognize that there are places where people are really suffering, and need to be remediated for the health of their children.”
paras.zh: “我曾在印第安纳州东芝加哥等地工作过，他们在一座前铅冶炼厂的基础上建造了一个住房项目和一所学校，我们发现土壤中的铅含量比我们本周在爱荷华州测得的含量高出大约 10,000 倍，”索恩说。 “全国很多地方的铅危害比我预期的要严重得多。当我们认识到有些地方的人们确实在遭受苦难，并且需要为了孩子的健康而采取补救措施时，我不想过度推销这一点。”

articles.title: Billboard’s Music Industry Events Calendar
articles.author: Colin Stutz

paras.en: As part of our continuing efforts to serve the music industry and its creators, Billboard Pro now features a music industry events calendar for readers.
paras.zh: 作为我们为音乐行业及其创作者提供服务的持续努力的一部分，Billboard Pro 现在为读者提供了音乐行业活动日历。

paras.en: The calendar will act as music’s most complete summary major national and international industry events, from conferences to festivals to networking mixers and more. Just as Billboard is music’s must-read source for news, charts and analysis, now it also is the go-to for business happenings.
paras.zh: 该日历将作为音乐最完整的主要国内和国际行业活动的总结，从会议到节日到社交混音器等等。正如 Billboard 是音乐界必读的新闻、图表和分析来源一样，现在它也是商业活动的首选。

paras.zh: - 10 月 9 日至 10 日 – GoldenSky Festival（加利福尼亚州萨克拉门托）

articles.title: Hold Your Turkeys! Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade Has Been Postponed: Here’s the New Date
articles.author: Kyle-Brandon Denis

paras.en: After waiting 100 years for the parade’s centennial edition, what’s a few more days?
paras.zh: 百年庆典等了100年，还等几天又怎样？

paras.en: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade will be postponed to Saturday, Nov. 28, because of severe weather.
paras.zh: 由于恶劣天气，梅西百货第 100 届感恩节游行将推迟至 11 月 28 日星期六。

paras.en: “The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our City and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year’s celebration,” Macy’s representatives said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 梅西百货的代表周三表示：“参与者和观众的安全是我们的首要任务，在与市政府和机构合作伙伴密切协商后，我们决定推迟今年的庆祝活动。”

paras.en: Even though organizers had already begun inflating the parade’s iconic balloons, the department store, alongside city officials and the New York Police Department, confirmed the Thanksgiving celebration will commence n Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET instead.
paras.zh: 尽管组织者已经开始为游行的标志性气球充气，但百货商店与市政府官员和纽约警察局一起确认感恩节庆祝活动将于美国东部时间周六上午 8:30 开始。

paras.en: The parade’s delay comes amid a particularly grim forecast for the East Coast. The National Weather Service is predicting a strong storm will impact the area on Thanksgiving Day, inundating it with heavy rain, intense winds and coastal flooding.
paras.zh: 游行推迟之际，东海岸的预测尤其严峻。美国国家气象局预测，感恩节当天，一场强风暴将影响该地区，带来大雨、强风和沿海洪水。

paras.en: RAYE, who recently earned a record-tying 11 nominations at the 2027 Grammys, is set to open the broadcast, which will air on NBC, Peacock and Telemundo. The historic parade will march from the Upper West Side to Macy’s Herald Square flagship store, and include performances by Billboard chart-topping stars Megan Mooney and Teddy Swims. Tony and Grammy-nominated Broadway star Megan Hilty will lead a tribute to the late Dolly Parton, who passed in August at age 80.
paras.zh: 雷伊最近在 2027 年格莱美颁奖典礼上获得了创纪录的 11 项提名，他将担任该节目的开场嘉宾，该节目将在 NBC、Peacock 和 Telemundo 上播出。历史性的游行将从上西区游行到梅西百货先锋广场旗舰店，其中包括公告牌排行榜冠军梅根·穆尼和泰迪·斯威姆斯的表演。获得托尼奖和格莱美奖提名的百老汇明星梅根·希尔蒂 (Megan Hilty) 将主持一场悼念活动，悼念已故的多莉·帕顿 (Dolly Parton)，她于 8 月去世，享年 80 岁。

paras.en: Other celebrities to keep an eye out for in the parade’s eye-popping floats include EJAE of KPop Demon Hunters girl group HUNTR/X, Queen Latifah, Jimmy Fallon and The Roots, JoJo, Keke Palmer, Smash Mouth, Mckenna Grace, K-pop boy band RIIZE, Indigo Girls, Natasha Bedingfield, Feid, Icona Pop, Wyclef Jean, Jamie Miller, Leslie Odom Jr., Anthony Ramos, Melissa Joan Hart, Jamie Miller, Holly Robinson Peete and more.
paras.zh: 游行中令人眼花缭乱的花车中其他值得关注的名人包括韩国流行音乐恶魔猎人女子组合 HUNTR/X 的 EJAE、Queen Latifah、Jimmy Fallon 和 The Roots、JoJo、Keke Palmer、Smash Mouth、Mckenna Grace、韩国流行男孩乐队 RIIZE、Indigo Girls、Natasha Bedingfield、Feid、Icona Pop、Wyclef Jean、Jamie Miller、Leslie小奥多姆、安东尼·拉莫斯、梅丽莎·琼·哈特、杰米·米勒、霍莉·罗宾逊·皮特等。

paras.en: The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade first marched New York City’s streets in 1924, and it’s only been canceled twice: 1942, 1943 and 1944. During those years, materials for giant balloons were prioritized for World War II efforts over holiday parades. Notably, the balloons were last grounded in 1971 due to severe weather; city regulations dictate that balloons can only fly when wind speeds remain below 23 mph. In 2019, inclement weather forced the balloons to be flown at lower heights than usual.
paras.zh: 梅西百货感恩节游行于 1924 年首次在纽约街头游行，仅在 1942 年、1943 年和 1944 年两次被取消。在那些年里，巨型气球的材料优先用于二战，而不是节日游行。值得注意的是，由于恶劣天气，这些热气球最后一次停飞是在 1971 年。城市法规规定，气球只能在风速低于 23 英里/小时时飞行。 2019年，恶劣天气迫使热气球的飞行高度低于平常。

paras.en: Officials will address the city tonight at 6 p.m. ET.
paras.zh: 官员们将于今晚 6 点向市政府发表讲话。等。

articles.title: Andy Taylor, Former Duran Duran Guitarist, Dead at 65
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: Andy Taylor, guitarist and former member of Duran Duran, has died after a yearslong battle with prostate cancer. He was 65 years old.
paras.zh: 吉他手、杜兰·杜兰乐队前成员安迪·泰勒在与前列腺癌抗争多年后去世。他今年 65 岁。

paras.en: The musician’s former bandmates shared the news Wednesday (Nov. 25) on their website and on Instagram, announcing that Taylor had passed away two days prior. “Andy was there at the very beginning of our story,” the group wrote. “From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music.”
paras.zh: 这位音乐家的前乐队成员周三（11 月 25 日）在他们的网站和 Instagram 上分享了这一消息，宣布泰勒在两天前去世。 “安迪在我们故事的一开始就在那里，”该组织写道。 “从他带着一把吉他从东北来到伯明翰的那一刻起，他对我们能够成为什么样的人有着不可动摇的信念，他给我们的音乐带来了不可磨灭的热情和昂扬。”

paras.en: Duran Duran continued, “His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded and gave the band its edge through the extraordinary years that followed.”
paras.zh: 杜兰·杜兰继续说道：“他的演奏带动了我们环游世界的歌曲，他的冷幽默与他极其冷静、严肃的人生观相匹配，让我们脚踏实地，并在接下来的非凡岁月中为乐队带来了优势。”

paras.en: Still in its early years, the band added Taylor to the lineup in 1980. He would leave in 1986 before rejoining in 2001, playing guitar on Duran Duran’s 2004 album Astronaut — which reached No. 17 on the Billboard 200, one of nine albums to enter the chart during Taylor’s tenure — before leaving again in 2006. In 2023, he’d contribute guitar to Halloween-themed LP Danse Macabre.
paras.zh: 乐队仍处于早期阶段，1980 年泰勒就加入了乐队。他于 1986 年离开，然后于 2001 年重新加入，在 Duran Duran 2004 年的专辑《Astronaut》中演奏吉他，这张专辑在 Billboard 200 上排名第 17，是泰勒任职期间进入排行榜的九张专辑之一，然后在 2006 年再次离开。2023 年，他为乐队贡献了吉他。万圣节主题的 LP Danse Macabre。

paras.en: During his time in the group, Duran Duran scored 13 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, including two No. 1s: “The Reflex” in 1984 and “A View to a Kill” in 1985. As a soloist, he scored two entries on the chart: “Take It Easy” (No. 24 in 1986) and “When the Rain Comes Down” (No. 73 in 1986).
paras.zh: 在乐队期间，杜兰·杜兰在 Billboard Hot 100 上获得了 13 首单曲，其中包括两次排名第一：1984 年的《The Reflex》和 1985 年的《A View to a Kill》。作为独奏者，他在排行榜上获得了两首歌曲：《Take It Easy》（1986 年排名第 24）和《When the Rain Comes Down》（1986 年排名第 73）。

paras.en: Taylor’s wife, Tracey, also shared a statement Wednesday. “To the world, Andy was a brilliant guitarist, but to us, he was the most wonderful husband, a loving dad and the proudest grandfather,” she wrote. “He was the rock of our family. For all the incredible experiences music brought him, family always came first.”
paras.zh: 泰勒的妻子特雷西周三也发表了一份声明。 “对世界来说，安迪是一位出色的吉他手，但对我们来说，他是最好的丈夫、慈爱的父亲和最自豪的祖父，”她写道。 “他是我们家庭的支柱。尽管音乐给他带来了所有令人难以置信的经历，但家庭始终是第一位的。”

paras.en: His cancer diagnosis was first revealed in 2022, when frontman Simon LeBon told fans at Duran Duran’s induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame — from which Taylor was absent — that he’d already been battling the illness for four years at that point. In 2023, Taylor shared that he’d started taking cancer drug Lutetium-177, which he said extended his life by five years.
paras.zh: 他的癌症诊断首次被披露是在 2022 年，当时主唱西蒙·勒邦 (Simon LeBon) 在杜兰·杜兰 (Duran Duran) 入选摇滚名人堂 (泰勒缺席) 的入职仪式上告诉歌迷，当时他已经与癌症作斗争了四年。 2023 年，泰勒表示，他开始服用抗癌药物 Lutetium-177，他说这使他的生命延长了五年。

paras.en: “Andy faced the last few years with so much courage and determination,” Tracey added in her statement. “He never gave up, fighting until the very end, never losing his love of life. The kindness and support shown to him by fans from all over the world throughout his illness brought him immense comfort and strength, and for that we will always be grateful.”
paras.zh: “安迪以巨大的勇气和决心面对过去的几年，”特雷西在声明中补充道。 “他从未放弃，战斗到最后一刻，从未失去对生活的热爱。在他患病期间，世界各地球迷对他的善意和支持给他带来了巨大的安慰和力量，为此我们将永远感激不已。”

paras.en: Andy is also survived by his children — Georgina, Isabella, Bethany and Andrew — and grandson Albie.
paras.zh: 安迪身后还有他的孩子——乔治娜、伊莎贝拉、贝瑟尼和安德鲁——以及孙子阿尔比。

articles.title: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade Postponed as Storm Descends on Northeast
articles.author: Alex Weprin

paras.en: In an unprecedented move, the 100th edition of the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City will be postponed until Saturday Nov. 28, Macy’s and NBC announced Wednesday.
paras.zh: 梅西百货和 NBC 周三宣布，史无前例的举动是，纽约市第 100 届梅西百货感恩节游行将推迟至 11 月 28 日星期六。

paras.en: The decision comes as a powerful nor’easter storm is bearing down on the northeast, with potential wind gusts north of 60 miles per hour alongside heavy rain.
paras.zh: 这一决定是在一场强大的东北风暴袭击东北部之际作出的，该风暴可能会带来时速 60 英里以北的阵风，并伴有大雨。

paras.en: It’s also a major headache for the broadcast partner NBC, with last year’s parade drawing over 34 million viewers between NBC and Peacock.
paras.zh: 这也是广播合作伙伴 NBC 的一大头疼问题，去年的游行吸引了 NBC 和 Peacock 超过 3400 万观众。

paras.en: The parade is now expected to kick off on the Upper West Side at 8:30 a.m. on Saturday, with the floats, balloons and performers making their way down to Macy’s flagship store on 34th Street.
paras.zh: 游行预计将于周六上午 8:30 在上西区开始，花车、气球和表演者将前往位于 34 街的梅西百货旗舰店。

paras.en: “Due to the extreme weather conditions, the city of New York, Macy’s and NBC have decided, in the interest of safety for both the participants and spectators, to move the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday, Nov. 28,” an NBC spokesperson told The Hollywood Reporter. “More details to follow. In addition, NBC will telecast the 2025 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade tomorrow at 8:30 a.m. in all time zones.”
paras.zh: “由于极端的天气条件，纽约市、梅西百货和 NBC 决定，为了参与者和观众的安全，将梅西百货感恩节游行移至 11 月 28 日星期六，”NBC 发言人告诉《好莱坞报道》。 “更多细节敬请关注。此外，NBC 将于明天上午 8:30 在所有时区直播 2025 年梅西百货感恩节大游行。”

paras.en: It’s also a logistical nightmare, with many performance groups and musical artists coming into town for the parade, and which may need to find alternative travel plans.
paras.zh: 这也是一场后勤噩梦，许多表演团体和音乐艺术家进城参加游行，他们可能需要寻找替代的旅行计划。

paras.en: The parade has never been canceled in its 100 years, though some of the iconic giant balloons have been grounded when there have been high winds. Balloons are supposed to be grounded if wind gusts top 34 miles per hour.
paras.zh: 尽管一些标志性的巨型气球在大风时被搁浅，但游行一百年来从未被取消过。如果阵风达到每小时 34 英里，气球应该停飞。

paras.en: In 1993, a Sonic the Hedgehog balloon was pushed into a lamppost amid high winds, injuring multiple people, and a similar incident occurred in 1997 with a Cat in the Hat balloon.
paras.zh: 1993年，刺猬索尼克气球在大风中被推入灯柱，导致多人受伤，1997年戴帽子的猫气球也发生了类似事件。

paras.en: This year’s postponement is also a first. New York City officials and Macy’s executives are expected to address the postponement later on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 今年的推迟也是首次。纽约市官员和梅西百货高管预计将在周三晚些时候解决推迟问题。

articles.title: TV Ratings: ‘Dancing With the Stars’ Records Another Huge Finale
articles.author: Rick Porter

paras.en: The season 35 finale of Dancing With the Stars capped off a season of big ratings with the show’s best numbers of the fall.
paras.zh: 《与星共舞》第 35 季大结局以该剧秋季最佳收视率收视率结束。

paras.en: Early Nielsen ratings have the finale — which aired live coast to coast, a first for DWTS — averaging 9.2 million viewers, on par with preliminary numbers for last season’s final episode. The season 34 finale ended up at 9.43 million viewers after the addition of Nielsen’s big data component; final same-day numbers for Tuesday’s show will be available after Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 尼尔森早期收视率显示，大结局的平均收视人数为 920 万，与上一季最后一集的初步数字持平，该大结局在全国各地直播，这是 DWTS 的首次。加上尼尔森的大数据成分后，第 34 季大结局的收视人数达到了 943 万；周二演出的最终当日数据将于感恩节后公布。

paras.en: The DWTS finale also scored the show’s best rating among adults 18-49 in more than a decade: It’s currently at 2.38 (equivalent to about 3.24 million people in the demographic), subject to adjustments. That’s the highest rating for a Dancing With the Stars episode since the season 19 finale in 2014 — when current host Alfonso Ribeiro won the mirror ball trophy — and the highest mark for a regularly scheduled network entertainment show (i.e., not a special like the Oscars or Grammys) since an episode of The Masked Singer in April 2020.
paras.zh: DWTS 大结局还获得了该剧十多年来在 18-49 岁成年人中的最佳收视率：目前为 2.38（相当于人口中约 324 万人），可能会有所调整。这是自 2014 年第 19 季大结局（现任主持人阿方索·里贝罗赢得镜球奖杯）以来与星共舞剧集的最高收视率，也是自 2020 年 4 月《蒙面歌王》一集以来定期安排的网络娱乐节目（即不是像奥斯卡或格莱美那样的特别节目）的最高收视率。

paras.en: The finale also scored a 15-year high among adults under 35 with a 2.86 rating — an almost unheard-of number for anything outside of live sports in the current broadcast environment.
paras.zh: 大结局在 35 岁以下成年人中也获得了 15 年来的最高收视率，达到 2.86，这对于当前广播环境中体育直播之外的任何节目来说几乎是闻所未闻的数字。

paras.en: Pending updates for the finale, season 35 of DWTS averaged 7.19 million viewers, up about 11 percent from last year. The show’s 1.59 rating among adults 18-49 is up by almost 20 percent year to year. The latter number ranks first among all network shows this fall, excluding live sports, and leads second-place Survivor (0.86 rating) by a canyon-sized 86 percent margin. Should that hold, it would be the largest gap between a first- and second-place show in the 18-49 demo since the beginning of Nielsen’s electronic measurement in 1991.
paras.zh: 待大结局更新后，DWTS 第 35 季的平均观众人数为 719 万，比去年增长约 11%。该剧在 18-49 岁成年人中的收视率达到 1.59，同比增长近 20%。后者的数字在今年秋季所有网络节目（不包括现场体育赛事）中排名第一，并以 86% 的差距领先第二名的《幸存者》（收视率 0.86）。如果这种情况成立，这将是自 1991 年尼尔森电子测量开始以来 18-49 演示中第一名和第二名之间的最大差距。

paras.en: ABC says viewers cast a record-setting 86 million votes during the finale, up from 72 million for the season 34 closer. DWTS also generated the most social media engagements of any primetime program Tuesday.
paras.zh: ABC 表示，观众在大结局中投了创纪录的 8600 万票，高于第 34 季结束时的 7200 万票。周二，DWTS 的社交媒体参与度也是所有黄金时段节目中最多的。

articles.title: With ‘Guarding Stars,’ Jared Padalecki Finally Takes A Break From All That Action
articles.author: Nicole Fell

paras.en: Jared Padalecki has been steadily employed on television since his days on aughts classic Gilmore Girls, so it’d be easy to assume that playing an actor in the new Netflix holiday offering Guarding Stars would be second nature. But the 44-year-old, who also produces the movie, found the role to be more difficult than he’d expected.
paras.zh: 贾里德·帕达里克（Jared Padalecki）自从出演经典电视剧《吉尔莫女孩》（Gilmore Girls）以来，就一直在电视上稳定工作，因此很容易认为，在 Netflix 的新假日剧《守护星星》中扮演演员将是他的第二天性。但这位 44 岁的电影制片人发现这个角色比他预想的要困难。

paras.en: “Jack Stapleton in this world is super famous,” he tells The Hollywood Reporter about this character. “He’s Brad Pitt, he’s George Clooney, he’s Chris Hemsworth — people who can’t walk outside. After 26 years in the industry, I can walk outside.”
paras.zh: “杰克·斯泰普尔顿在这个世界上非常有名，”他向《好莱坞报道》谈到这个角色时说道。 “他是布拉德·皮特、乔治·克鲁尼、克里斯·海姆斯沃斯——这些人都不能走出去。在这个行业工作了 26 年之后，我可以走出去了。”

paras.en: It’s not as though Padalecki is claiming to fly completely under-the-radar. He admits that he’ll often encounter people in public who stop him to share their love for Supernatural or Gilmore Girls, but he’s still able to go to his son’s games or his daughter’s field hockey practices. It helps, certainly, that he and his wife, actress and fellow Guarding Stars producer Genevieve Padalecki, live in a ranch outside Austin, Texas, rather than in Los Angeles.
paras.zh: 帕达里基并不是声称自己完全不为人所知。 He admits that he’ll often encounter people in public who stop him to share their love for Supernatural or Gilmore Girls, but he’s still able to go to his son’s games or his daughter’s field hockey practices. It helps, certainly, that he and his wife, actress and fellow Guarding Stars producer Genevieve Padalecki, live in a ranch outside Austin, Texas, rather than in Los Angeles.

paras.en: Guarding Stars, released on the streamer on Nov. 18, is based on Katherine Center’s romance novel The Bodyguard and features a delightful role reversal. Rather than Padalecki, who’s spent much of his adult life starring in action-driven projects, as the dutiful protector, his character Jack finds himself under the care of bodyguard Hannah Brooks, played by Leighton Meester.
paras.zh: 《守护星星》于 11 月 18 日在主播上线，改编自凯瑟琳·中心的爱情小说《保镖》，角色反转令人愉悦。帕达里克成年后的大部分时间都在行动驱动的项目中担任主角，他扮演的角色杰克不是一个尽职的保护者，而是由莉顿·梅斯特饰演的保镖汉娜·布鲁克斯照顾。

paras.en: The book, while not set at Christmas, has the same spirit as its onscreen adaptation. The Padaleckis were responsible for getting the project off the ground after Gen Padalecki featured Center’s book in her online book club and interviewed the author four years ago.
paras.zh: 这本书虽然不是以圣诞节为背景，但与改编的电影有着同样的精神。四年前，帕达里克将军在她的在线读书俱乐部中推荐了中心的书，并采访了作者，帕达里克夫妇负责启动该项目。

paras.en: When the interview ended, Gen Padalecki told Center that she thought the book would make a great movie. The author agreed, and the couple soon had acquired the rights and began shopping the project around. Eventually, it landed at Netflix, underwent a name change and found its badass leading lady in Meester and formable leading man in Padalecki. Center, throughout it all, took any changes to her material in stride, Padalecki says, mimicking her response when changes would arise, “It’s not a documentary.”
paras.zh: 采访结束后，帕达里克将军告诉《中心》，她认为这本书会拍成一部很棒的电影。作者同意了，这对夫妇很快就获得了权利并开始购买该项目。最终，它登陆了 Netflix，并进行了更名，并找到了坏蛋女主角梅斯特和帅气的男主角帕达里克。帕达里茨基说，在整个过程中，中心对她的材料进行了任何改变，模仿她在发生变化时的反应，“这不是一部纪录片。”

paras.en: Starring in a romance film is a lane change for Padalecki, who spent 15 seasons fighting demons, vampires and all other creatures that go bump in the night on the long-running CW series Supernatural. “Truth be told, I enjoy all those genres, and it’s more that’s what was hiring,” he says when it’s suggested he’s spent almost his entire career in the action space.
paras.zh: 帕达里基在 CW 长剧《邪恶力量》中花了 15 季的时间与恶魔、吸血鬼和所有其他在夜间出现的生物作战。 “说实话，我喜欢所有这些类型，而且更重要的是招聘的内容，”当有人建议他几乎整个职业生涯都在动作领域度过时，他说道。

paras.en: “Frankly, I don’t like doing action. I don’t hate it, but I really love the character exploration part of storytelling,” Padalecki continues. “I’d be happy to do a series or movie where I just sat in a chair and talked with somebody.”
paras.zh: “坦白说，我不喜欢做动作戏。我并不讨厌它，但我真的很喜欢讲故事中的角色探索部分，”帕达里茨继续说道。 “我很乐意制作一部系列片或电影，让我坐在椅子上与某人交谈。”

paras.en: There’s plenty of action in Guarding Stars, it’s just most of it falls on Meester, rather than Padalecki. She was “game for all of it,” he says. The actor recalls one of the film’s central action sequences, that forces Meester onto the roof of a car. The scene was shot practically, with Meester in a harness atop the actually moving car.
paras.zh: 《守护星星》中有很多动作戏，只是大部分都落在梅斯特身上，而不是帕达里基身上。他说，她“对这一切都很感兴趣”。这位演员回忆起影片的一个中心动作序列，即迫使梅斯特登上车顶。这个场景是实际拍摄的，梅斯特在实际行驶的汽车顶上系着安全带。

paras.en: “It was -10 degrees Fahrenheit outside,” he says. “The camera equipment was freezing. It was that cold. Even the Calgarians had never seen it happen before. “But she was like, ‘Yeah, I can do it again.'”
paras.zh: “外面的温度是 -10 华氏度，”他说。 “摄像设备结冰了。太冷了。即使是卡尔加里人以前也从未见过这种情况。“但她说，‘是的，我可以再做一次。’”

paras.en: Meester was on the top of Padakecki’s radar from the beginning. He refers to the actress as the film’s “Moby Dick” cheekily. “She already had a huge body of work. She has incredible comic timing. She has a fantastic work ethic,” the actor says about his co-star. The team called around to people that knew her, and they all came back with the same answer. They loved her.
paras.zh: 梅斯特从一开始就受到帕达凯基的关注。他厚颜无耻地称这位女演员为电影中的“白鲸”。 “她已经有了大量的作品。她有令人难以置信的喜剧时机。她有出色的职业道德，”这位演员谈到他的搭档时说道。团队打电话给认识她的人，他们都得到了相同的答案。他们爱她。

paras.en: Meester and Padalecki had plenty of freedom to have fun in the takes. “[There’s a scene where] we’re having a snowball fight, and she just smashes snow into my face. Not scripted,” he says, laughing. “Maybe she was getting out some frustration or something, but it was in good fun.”
paras.zh: 梅斯特和帕达里克有足够的自由来享受拍摄的乐趣。 “[有一个场景]我们正在打雪仗，她只是把雪砸到我脸上。这不是剧本，”他笑着说。 “也许她是为了发泄一些沮丧之类的，但这很有趣。”

paras.en: Padalecki and his wife met on Supernatural. The pair starred alongside one another in the show’s fourth season, and according to the actor, they’ve always had spirited debates about film and television. Naturally, working together through their production company Living in the Asterisk came easy.
paras.zh: 帕达里克和他的妻子是在《邪恶力量》中相识的。两人在该剧第四季中并肩出演，据演员透露，他们一直就电影和电视展开激烈的辩论。当然，通过他们的制作公司 Living in the Asterisk 进行合作很容易。

paras.en: Padalecki enjoys the lack of hierarchy between the two. It’s just like how the pair work together at home. “If I’m free, I’m taking the kids to school. If she’s free and I’m not, then she’s taking the kids to school. It’s just really legitimately teamwork,” he says.
paras.zh: 帕达里克喜欢两人之间没有等级制度。就像两人在家里一起工作一样。 “如果我有空，我就会送孩子们去学校。如果她有空而我没空，那么她就会送孩子们去学校。这是真正合理的团队合作，”他说。

paras.en: “I love the way her brain works, and I love to see it in action. She has an incredible work ethic. It’s intimidating, but she inspires me and motivates me,” he adds. “I hope I can offer some bit of the same to her.”
paras.zh: “我喜欢她大脑的运作方式，也喜欢看到它的运作方式。她有着令人难以置信的职业道德。这令人生畏，但她激励着我，激励着我，”他补充道。 “我希望我能为她提供一些同样的东西。”

paras.en: Another draw to the film for Padalecki was the understanding that this might be something the entire family can watch, which can’t be said for all his past work. When the couple optioned the book, their oldest son was 10, their younger song was nine and their daughter was five. “I was probably, whether I realized or not, hoping to find something they could watch,” he admits.
paras.zh: 帕达里克对这部电影的另一个吸引力是，他知道这可能是全家人都可以观看的电影，而他过去的所有作品都无法做到这一点。当这对夫妇选择这本书时，他们的大儿子 10 岁，小宋 9 岁，女儿 5 岁。 “无论我是否意识到，我可能希望找到他们可以观看的东西，”他承认。

paras.en: Padalecki wasn’t, and frankly isn’t much still, interested in showing the children Supernatural. It’s not that he isn’t proud of his time on the show, but more about his desire to not traumatize his children given he’s “killing everybody” in the show, including their mom, and he himself dying at different points. “Dad and Uncle Jen[sen Ackles] killed Mom,” he says, mimicking his children.
paras.zh: 坦率地说，帕达里克对向孩子们展示超自然现象并不感兴趣。这并不是说他对自己在节目中的时光感到自豪，而是因为他不想让孩子们受到创伤，因为他在节目中“杀死了所有人”，包括他们的妈妈，以及他自己在不同时刻的死亡。 “爸爸和詹叔叔[sen Ackles]杀了妈妈，”他模仿他的孩子们说道。

paras.en: Even his last series, Walker, which ran for four seasons on the CW, featured Gen Padalecki as his late wife. Before the show premiered, the family had some friends over to watch the episode, which featured the death of her character Emily. When the show was over, no one could find their middle son Shep, who was about seven or eight at the time. He ended up being found in the backyard, crying under a tree.
paras.zh: 就连他的最后一部连续剧《沃克》（Walker）在 CW 播出了四个季，帕达里克将军也饰演他已故的妻子。在节目首播之前，家人请了一些朋友来看这一集，其中讲述了她所扮演的角色艾米丽的死亡。演出结束后，没有人能找到他们当时七八岁的二儿子谢普。最终人们发现他在后院的一棵树下哭泣。

paras.en: “Mom, if dad’s the boss, why does he make you die and everything?” Padalecki says, repeating what his son had asked his mother after seeing Walker. As they continued to watch the show in the years down the line, Padalecki and his wife would snuggle up with their son and remind him it was fictional. But as soon as he’d see his mom unwell onscreen, he’d burst into tears.
paras.zh: “妈妈，如果爸爸是老大，他为什么要让你死等等？”帕达里克重复了儿子见到沃克后问母亲的话。在接下来的几年里，当他们继续观看这部剧时，帕达里克和他的妻子会依偎在他们的儿子身边，提醒他这是虚构的。但当他在银幕上看到妈妈身体不适时，他就泪流满面。

paras.en: “It breaks my heart,” adds Padalecki. “He’s such a little empath.”
paras.zh: “这让我心碎，”帕达里克补充道。 “他真是个有同情心的人。”

articles.title: Bullish hopes spring as traders bet against a higher VIX: Options Action Live

paras.en: With stocks mounting a comeback Wednesday, options trading across a few key volatility products suggests big swings in stocks may dampen in the near term.
paras.zh: 随着周三股市反弹，几种主要波动性产品的期权交易表明，股市的大幅波动可能会在短期内减弱。

paras.en: More than 80,000 options traded on the Barclays S&P 500 VIX Short Term Futures ETN (VXX), almost three times the 30-day average, with more puts trading than calls, according to LiveVol data. The fund aims to track the moves in Cboe's VIX Index, which surged to 35 early Wednesday but slipped to below 28 as the S&P 500 rallied to within 25 basis points of unchanged.
paras.zh: LiveVol 数据显示，巴克莱标准普尔 500 VIX 短期期货 ETN (VXX) 交易了超过 80,000 份期权，几乎是 30 日平均水平的三倍，看跌期权交易量多于看涨期权交易量。该基金旨在追踪 Cboe VIX 指数的走势，该指数周三早些时候飙升至 35，但随着标准普尔 500 指数上涨至 25 个基点不变，该指数跌至 28 以下。

paras.en: At the same time, options volume on VIX itself was 50% above average, with an even more distinctive bias towards puts, suggesting traders see stocks firming, or at least, the size of the market's moves shrinking. Of the 850,000 options traded on VIX, more than 515,000 were puts, with twice as many puts likely initiated by buyers than calls, Cboe data show.
paras.zh: 与此同时，VIX 本身的期权交易量比平均水平高出 50%，看跌期权的倾向更为明显，这表明交易者认为股市走强，或者至少市场波动的规模正在缩小。 Cboe 数据显示，在 VIX 交易的 850,000 份期权中，超过 515,000 份是看跌期权，买家发起的看跌期权数量可能是看涨期权的两倍。

articles.title: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather

paras.en: Macy's on Wednesday announced it's postponing the annual Thanksgiving Day Parade due to severe weather.
paras.zh: 梅西百货周三宣布，由于恶劣天气，推迟一年一度的感恩节游行。

paras.en: The parade, held each year on Thursday morning, will now take place on Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET, according to the company. The New York City area is expected to have heavy rain and thunderstorms on Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 据该公司称，每年在周四早上举行的游行现在将于美国东部时间周六上午 8:30 举行。预计感恩节纽约地区将出现大雨和雷暴天气。

paras.en: "The safety of our participants and spectators is our top priority, and after close consultation with our city and agency partners, we have made the decision to move this year's celebration," Macy's said in a statement.
paras.zh: 梅西百货在一份声明中表示：“参与者和观众的安全是我们的首要任务，在与我们的城市和机构合作伙伴密切协商后，我们决定推迟今年的庆祝活动。”

paras.en: This year's event marks the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. The annual event has never been canceled due to weather, though it was suspended between 1942 and 1944 for World War II.
paras.zh: 今年的活动是梅西百货感恩节大游行的第 100 届。尽管 1942 年至 1944 年间因第二次世界大战而暂停，但这项一年一度的活动从未因天气原因而取消。

paras.en: The parade's viability this year had been in question after concerns arose over strong winds that could become dangerous for the massive balloons that the event is known for. Many of the balloons had already been inflated as of Wednesday afternoon.
paras.zh: 今年游行的可行性受到质疑，因为人们担心强风可能会对游行活动中的巨型气球造成危险。截至周三下午，许多气球已经充气。

paras.en: The postponement also means thousands of volunteers and artists slated to perform will have to adapt to Saturday's schedule.
paras.zh: 推迟还意味着数千名计划表演的志愿者和艺术家将不得不适应周六的时间表。

articles.title: Liesman: Why Greenspan could bet on productivity — and Warsh needs to hike

paras.en: In a discussion on CNBC's Halftime Report Wednesday, the question came up: Why can't Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh hold the line on interest rates the way his icon Alan Greenspan did at the beginning of the dot-com era?
paras.zh: 在周三 CNBC 半场报道的讨论中，出现了这样一个问题：为什么美联储主席凯文·沃什不能像他的偶像艾伦·格林斯潘在互联网时代初期那样坚守利率底线？

paras.en: Greenspan famously leaned against inflation hawks on his committee in 1995 and 1996, holding the line on interest rates amid strong growth, because he believed in the productivity promise of the internet revolution.
paras.zh: 1995年和1996年，格林斯潘在委员会中反对通胀鹰派，在强劲增长的情况下坚持利率不变，因为他相信互联网革命的生产力承诺。

paras.en: It would be nice if Warsh could follow the same playbook amid the artificial intelligence build-out and keep rates steady until the productivity arrives. Unfortunately, a quick look at the numbers shows just how different the situation is for Warsh when it comes to inflation, the magnitude of the capital-investment boom and the monetary and fiscal stimulus boosting the economy.
paras.zh: 如果沃什能够在人工智能的发展过程中遵循同样的策略，并在生产力达到之前保持稳定的利率，那就太好了。不幸的是，快速浏览一下这些数字就会发现，在通货膨胀、资本投资热潮的规模以及提振经济的货币和财政刺激方面，沃什的情况有多么不同。

paras.en: Bottom line: the Fed looks like it has to hike — and maybe substantially — to be anywhere close to the position where the Fed was in Greenspan's time at the dawn of a major technological revolution.
paras.zh: 底线：美联储看起来必须加息——而且可能是大幅加息——才能接近格林斯潘时代重大技术革命初期美联储的水平。

paras.en: - The nominal Fed funds rate was substantially higher in 1995 than it is today. The real, or inflation adjusted, funds rate was a positive 3.75% back then, and it's now at zero. So the Fed was leaning against the dotcom boom. Greenspan just decided not to lean more. Today, at a zero real rate, the Fed could be said to be fueling the boom.
paras.zh: - 1995 年名义联邦基金利率比现在高得多。当时的实际基金利率（或经通胀调整后）为 3.75%，而现在为零。因此，美联储倾向于反对互联网泡沫。格林斯潘只是决定不再倾斜。如今，在实际利率为零的情况下，美联储可以说正在推动经济繁荣。

paras.en: - Inflation, as measured by the personal consumption expenditures price index, was substantially lower, right about target at 1.99% (even though there wasn't a formal 2% target then). It's above target now, at 3.8% according to government data published today, and going the wrong way.
paras.zh: - 以个人消费支出价格指数衡量的通货膨胀率大幅降低，接近 1.99% 的目标（尽管当时没有正式的 2% 目标）。根据今天公布的政府数据，现在已经超出了 3.8% 的目标，而且走错了路。

paras.en: - The current investment boom now is absolutely off the charts compared with the dot-com era. No real comparison. In 1995, spending on information processing equipment rose 15% year over year. In 2025, it was 27%. Looking at the latest data reported today, it grew 60% in the third quarter at an annualized rate. In the second quarter of 1995, it was 18%.
paras.zh: - 与互联网时代相比，当前的投资热潮绝对是超乎想象的。没有真正的比较。 1995年，信息处理设备的支出同比增长15%。 2025年，这一比例为27%。从今天公布的最新数据来看，第三季度按年率计算增长了60%。 1995年第二季度为18%。

paras.en: - Government deficit spending is substantially more stimulative now than it was then. In 1995, the deficit was just 2.2% of GDP. Today, it's 6.2%.
paras.zh: - 政府赤字支出现在比以前更具刺激性。 1995年，赤字仅占GDP的2.2%。今天，这个数字是 6.2%。

paras.en: - Add higher oil prices, higher tariffs and the recent tax cuts and accelerated depreciation on investments, and there's a lot for the Fed to lean against.
paras.zh: - 再加上油价上涨、关税上涨以及最近的减税和投资加速折旧，美联储有很多可以依靠的因素。

paras.en: It may be that the massive capex spending on AI will mean more productivity and less inflation down the road. But the front-end build-out is proving to be more inflationary, and more challenging, to a Fed already dealing with high inflation. In many ways, that's the opposite of what Greenspan had to handle.
paras.zh: 人工智能上的巨额资本支出可能意味着未来生产力的提高和通货膨胀的减少。但事实证明，对于已经在应对高通胀的美联储来说，前端扩张会带来更大的通胀，也更具挑战性。在很多方面，这与格林斯潘必须处理的事情相反。

articles.title: The U.S. Army is blowing up five tons of toxic lead azide in Iowa

paras.en: The U.S. Army detonated five tons of lead azide, used in munition manufacturing, at a site in Iowa on Wednesday. Any toxic material released by the blast could extend for miles, affecting parts of Iowa and neighboring Missouri, and would pose a significant danger to people's health, experts say.
paras.zh: 周三，美国陆军在爱荷华州的一处地点引爆了五吨用于弹药制造的叠氮化铅。专家表示，爆炸释放的任何有毒物质都可能延伸数英里，影响爱荷华州部分地区和邻近的密苏里州，并对人们的健康构成重大威胁。

paras.en: Officials said prior to the blast that they anticipated “zero release” of toxins because of mitigation efforts. Two controlled explosions occurred at 10 A.M. EST. A New York Times reporter on the scene said he saw a plume of smoke rise into the sky and drift south. It is unclear whether any toxic material escaped at this time, but early reports suggest the material was largely contained at the site. Independent scientists are also trying to verify whether any lead exposure occurred.
paras.zh: 官员们在爆炸前表示，由于缓解措施，他们预计毒素将“零释放”。上午 10 点发生两起受控爆炸。美国东部时间。 《纽约时报》现场记者称，他看到一缕浓烟冲天而起，并向南飘去。目前尚不清楚此时是否有任何有毒物质逸出，但早期报告表明该物质大部分被控制在现场。独立科学家也在试图验证是否发生了铅暴露。

paras.en: An Environmental Protection Agency site tracking lead concentration in the air around the blast zone had so far failed to detect the element as of noon on Wednesday. Iowa’s governor-elect Rob Sand said in a social media post that, by all indications, “Iowans are safe” but that the “lead-up to the detonation should never have been so chaotic and unclear,” adding that “Iowans ... are understandably alarmed and scared.”
paras.zh: 截至周三中午，环境保护局监测爆炸区周围空气中铅浓度的站点迄今未​​能检测到该元素。爱荷华州当选州长罗布·桑德在社交媒体上发帖称，从各种迹象来看，“爱荷华州人是安全的”，但“爆炸的前因后果不应该如此混乱和不明朗”，并补充道，“爱荷华州人……感到震惊和害怕是可以理解的。”

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
