paras.zh: 尽管该研究没有调查导致潜在有害药物暴露减少的原因，但 Hsu 指出，在过去的二十年中，研究人员和临床医生的认识不断增强。这种逐步但持续的改善可能反映了老年医学的更广泛进步以及使处方药使用更安全的努力。

paras.en: "We were happy to see the percentages of harm decline over that 11-year period," he says. "However, one-third of our target population is still exposed to these harmful medications, which isn't good."
paras.zh: “我们很高兴看到这 11 年期间伤害百分比有所下降，”他说。 “然而，我们的目标人群中有三分之一仍然接触这些有害药物，这并不好。”

paras.en: Older adults, even those without cognitive disorders, are particularly susceptible to harmful drug interactions and inappropriate prescriptions. In some cases, these complications can increase the risk of death. These dangers are a central focus of Team Alice, an ongoing interdisciplinary research initiative at the University at Buffalo dedicated to medication safety.
paras.zh: 老年人，即使没有认知障碍，也特别容易受到有害药物相互作用和不适当处方的影响。在某些情况下，这些并发症会增加死亡风险。这些危险是爱丽丝团队的核心关注点，该团队是布法罗大学正在进行的一项跨学科研究计划，致力于药物安全。

paras.en: Team Alice takes its name from Alice Brennan, who died in 2009 following a prescription for a muscle relaxant identified as potentially inappropriate under the Beers Criteria. The prescribing error went unrecognized within the health care system, and Brennan died following six weeks of preventable complications.
paras.zh: Team Alice 的名字取自爱丽丝·布伦南 (Alice Brennan)，她于 2009 年因服用一种根据比尔斯标准被认为可能不合适的肌肉松弛剂处方而去世。医疗保健系统没有意识到处方错误，布伦南在出现可预防的并发症六周后去世。

paras.en: Her daughter, Mary Brennan-Taylor, shared her mother's experience with University at Buffalo researchers in the hope of bringing about systemic changes that would spare other patients and families from similar harm.
paras.zh: 她的女儿玛丽·布伦南-泰勒与布法罗大学的研究人员分享了她母亲的经历，希望带来系统性的改变，使其他患者和家庭免受类似的伤害。

paras.en: Hsu began the new study shortly after joining the university's pharmacy school and Team Alice, where he works in the UB Patient Safety Learning Laboratory.
paras.zh: Hsu 在加入大学药学院和 Alice 团队后不久就开始了这项新研究，他在 UB 患者安全学习实验室工作。

paras.en: "This work extends a series of national analyses our group has published on potentially inappropriate medications, quality of life, and health care use in older adults," says David Jacobs, PharmD, PhD, associate professor of pharmacy practice and a principal investigator on Team Alice.
paras.zh: “这项工作扩展了我们小组发表的关于老年人潜在不适当药物、生活质量和医疗保健使用的一系列全国性分析，”药学实践副教授、Alice 团队首席研究员 David Jacobs 博士说。

paras.en: "It is especially important as older adults with cognitive disorders are the least able to tolerate medications that worsen memory or thinking, yet nearly one in three are still receiving them. Most of these patients have a regular source of care so these medications can be identified and addressed with their care team."
paras.zh: “这一点尤其重要，因为患有认知障碍的老年人最不能耐受导致记忆或思维恶化的药物，但近三分之一仍在接受这些药物。这些患者中的大多数都有定期的护理来源，因此他们的护理团队可以识别和处理这些药物。”

paras.en: Improving Medication Safety for Older Adults
paras.zh: 提高老年人的用药安全

paras.en: Other contributors to the study included Team Alice's fellow principal investigators Ranjit Singh, MD, associate professor and interim chair of the Department of Family Medicine at UB's Jacobs School of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences, and Robert Wahler, PharmD, clinical associate professor of pharmacy practice.
paras.zh: 该研究的其他贡献者包括 Alice 团队的首席研究员、布法罗大学雅各布斯医学与生物医学学院家庭医学系副教授兼临时系主任兰吉特·辛格 (Ranjit Singh) 医学博士，以及药学实践临床副教授罗伯特·瓦勒 (Robert Wahler) 药学博士。

paras.en: Collin Clark, PharmD, clinical associate professor of pharmacy practice, and Steven Feuerstein, an information systems analyst at the Jacobs School, also contributed to the research.
paras.zh: 药学博士、药学实践临床副教授科林·克拉克 (Collin Clark) 和雅各布斯学院信息系统分析师史蒂文·福尔斯坦 (Steven Feuerstein) 也对这项研究做出了贡献。

paras.en: The findings underscore the value of thorough medication reviews during routine outpatient appointments. The researchers also suggest incorporating clinical assessment tools such as the Drug Burden Index into acute and outpatient care. Such tools can help health care professionals assess the combined effects of medications that act on the central nervous system and potentially prevent avoidable complications.
paras.zh: 研究结果强调了在常规门诊预约期间进行彻底药物审查的价值。研究人员还建议将药物负担指数等临床评估工具纳入急症和门诊护理中。这些工具可以帮助医疗保健专业人员评估作用于中枢神经系统的药物的综合作用，并有可能预防可避免的并发症。

paras.en: Further research is needed to establish whether improving medication use can enhance quality of life and reduce hospital admissions and emergency room visits among older adults experiencing cognitive difficulties.
paras.zh: 需要进一步研究来确定改善药物使用是否可以提高患有认知困难的老年人的生活质量并减少住院和急诊就诊。

paras.en: A Rapidly Aging Population Raises New Concerns
paras.zh: 人口迅速老龄化引发新的担忧

paras.en: The findings arrive at a significant moment in global demographic history. According to a recent report from the U.S. Census Bureau, adults age 65 and older now outnumber children from birth through age 5 worldwide for the first time in human history.
paras.zh: 这些发现正值全球人口历史上的一个重要时刻。根据美国人口普查局最近的一份报告，全球 65 岁及以上成年人的数量在人类历史上首次超过了出生至 5 岁儿童的数量。

paras.en: However, greater longevity does not necessarily translate into more years of good health. The same report indicates that nearly 75% of adults age 65 and older have at least two chronic health conditions. Managing multiple illnesses often requires taking more medications, some of which may have detrimental effects on the aging body and brain.
paras.zh: 然而，更长的寿命并不一定意味着更长的健康状况。同一份报告表明，近 75% 的 65 岁及以上成年人至少患有两种慢性疾病。治疗多种疾病通常需要服用更多药物，其中一些药物可能会对衰老的身体和大脑产生不利影响。

paras.en: "This is an issue that has been building for decades, but the growth of the older adult population has arrived sooner than we expected," Hsu says. "This means that health care professionals need to pay closer attention than ever to medication safety, especially for older adults experiencing cognitive decline or other complex health concerns."
paras.zh: “这是一个几十年来一直存在的问题，但老年人口的增长比我们预期的要早，”许说。 “这意味着医疗保健专业人员需要比以往任何时候都更加关注用药安全，特别是对于经历认知能力下降或其他复杂健康问题的老年人。”

paras.en: Materials provided by University at Buffalo. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由布法罗大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Haowen Hsu, Collin M. Clark, Steven Feuerstein, Robert G. Wahler, Ranjit Singh, David M. Jacobs. Cognitive Potentially Inappropriate Medications, Quality of Life, and Healthcare Use in Older Adults With Cognitive Disorders. Journal of the American Geriatrics Society, 2026; 74 (10): 2888 DOI: 10.1111/jgs.70607

articles.title: SpaceX Starship debris becomes art in Ashley Zelinskie's 'The Weight of Space' (video, photos)
articles.author: Steve Spaleta

paras.en: When a SpaceX Starship broke apart over Turks and Caicos in Jan. 2025, pieces of its heat shield washed ashore. Some of that material now hangs on a gallery wall in New York City, embedded in artist Ashley Zelinskie's print of the very explosion it survived.
paras.zh: 2025 年 1 月，当 SpaceX 的一艘星际飞船在特克斯和凯科斯群岛上空解体时，其隔热罩的碎片被冲上岸。其中一些材料现在挂在纽约市画廊的墙上，嵌入艺术家阿什利·泽林斯基(Ashley Zelinskie)在爆炸中幸存下来的版画中。

paras.en: Look closely at the print and you can see little flakes on the surface. Some of Zelinskie's friends vacationing on the islands had come across pieces of heat-shield tile. "I think you might want these," Zelinskie recalled one friend telling her. She did. The Brooklyn-based artist ground the fragments into dust and worked them into the print.
paras.zh: 仔细观察印刷品，您可以看到表面有小薄片。泽林斯基的一些朋友在岛上度假时发现了隔热瓦片。 “我想你可能想要这些，”泽林斯基回忆说，一位朋友告诉她。她做到了。这位布鲁克林的艺术家将这些碎片磨成灰尘，然后将它们加工成印刷品。

paras.en: The Starship print is part of "Ejecta," which captures rocket plumes and explosions on paper. It's one of four series in Zelinskie's solo exhibition, "The Weight of Space," which opened Nov. 20 at Heft Gallery in Manhattan. Her marble sculptures in "Monuments" depict the Hubble Space Telescope, retired NASA astronaut Mike Massimino's spaceflight gear and more. Five "Launch Sequence" sculptures follow a rocket through liftoff, and the interactive "Crowded Sky" lets visitors track what's currently orbiting overhead in real time.
paras.zh: 星舰照片是“Ejecta”的一部分，该作品在纸上捕捉了火箭羽流和爆炸。这是 Zelinskie 个展“空间的重量”的四个系列之一，该展览于 11 月 20 日在曼哈顿赫夫特画廊开幕。她在《纪念碑》中的大理石雕塑描绘了哈勃太空望远镜、美国宇航局退休宇航员迈克·马西米诺的航天装备等。五个“发射序列”雕塑跟随火箭升空，互动的“拥挤的天空”让游客可以实时跟踪当前在头顶上空运行的物体。

paras.en: Zelinskie gave Space.com Editor-in-Chief Tariq Malik and me a tour before the gallery doors opened. Massimino joined her that evening to celebrate the exhibition and their collaboration on "Monuments." You can watch the tour in the video above.
paras.zh: 在画廊开门前，泽林斯基带领 Space.com 主编塔里克·马利克和我参观了一番。那天晚上，马西米诺和她一起庆祝展览以及他们在“纪念碑”上的合作。您可以在上面的视频中观看游览。

paras.en: Massimino turned up in our first look at Zelinskie's work, too. In 2022, I photographed the two of them beside her "Exploration JWST" sculpture at "Unfolding the Universe: First Light," an exhibit inspired by the James Webb Space Telescope's first images. Four years later, Massimino stood in a New York gallery looking at another Zelinskie sculpture. "That's my arm there," he told Malik.
paras.zh: 马西米诺也出现在我们第一次看到泽林斯基的作品中。 2022 年，我在“展开宇宙：第一道曙光”展览中在她的“探索 JWST”雕塑旁边拍摄了两人的照片，该展览的灵感来自詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜的第一批图像。四年后，马西米诺站在纽约画廊里观看另一件泽林斯基雕塑。 “那是我的手臂，”他告诉马利克。

paras.en: In that hand is a piece of hardware Malik remembers watching Massimino wrestle with in real time. During NASA's final Hubble servicing mission in 2009, a stripped bolt left a handrail blocking access to the telescope's Space Telescope Imaging Spectrograph (STIS). Mission Control instructed Massimino to forcibly remove the handrail so he and fellow spacewalker Michael Good could get on with the repair.
paras.zh: 马利克记得那只手上拿着一块硬件，当时他正在观看马西米诺的实时摔跤。在 2009 年 NASA 的最后一次哈勃维修任务中，一根螺栓脱落，导致扶手挡住了望远镜的太空望远镜成像光谱仪 (STIS)。任务控制中心指示马西米诺强行拆除扶手，以便他和太空行走者迈克尔·古德能够继续进行维修。

paras.en: Massimino told Malik that pulling the handrail off Hubble brought back a childhood memory of his father and his Uncle Frank driving a long screwdriver through a stuck oil filter. "Then my uncle Frank pulled to get more leverage, and that's what was going through my mind when I pulled off that handrail," Massimino said. He remembered looking down at Earth and thinking, "This one's for you, Uncle Frank."
paras.zh: 马西米诺告诉马利克，从哈勃望远镜上拉下扶手让他想起了他父亲和他的叔叔弗兰克驾驶一把长螺丝刀穿过卡住的机油滤清器的童年记忆。 “然后我的叔叔弗兰克拉动以获得更多的杠杆作用，这就是当我拉下扶手时我的想法，”马西米诺说。他记得他低头看着地球，心想：“这个是给你的，弗兰克叔叔。”

paras.en: Massimino wore bulky, pressurized gloves to pull off the handrail, but Zelinskie chose to show his bare hand gripping the copper-plated replica. "I wanted to bring the humanity back into the piece," she told Malik.
paras.zh: 马西米诺戴着笨重的加压手套来拉下扶手，但泽林斯基选择展示他的赤手抓着镀铜的复制品。 “我想把人性带回到作品中，”她告诉马利克。

paras.en: The gloves have a story of their own. When Massimino brought a pair to her studio to be 3D-scanned, Zelinskie noticed how the fabric held its folds when the gloves were set down. "Oh my god, these want to be stone," she recalled thinking. So she went out and learned to work in marble.
paras.zh: 这款手套有自己的故事。当 Massimino 将一双手套带到她的工作室进行 3D 扫描时，Zelinskie 注意到当手套放下时，织物如何保持其褶皱。 “天哪，这些都想变成石头，”她回忆道。于是她出去学习大理石工作。

paras.en: The astronaut boots have a detail you could easily miss from above. Zelinskie polished the soles smooth because, as she put it, "they're built for floating in space." For her sculpture of Massimino's reentry helmet, the kind he wore for the trip home from space, Zelinskie paired carved marble with a 3D-printed visor, which she electroplated and polished to a mirror finish.
paras.zh: 宇航员靴子有一个从上面很容易被忽视的细节。泽林斯基将鞋底打磨光滑，因为正如她所说，“它们是为漂浮在太空中而设计的。”在马西米诺重返大气层头盔的雕塑中，泽林斯基将雕刻的大理石与 3D 打印的护目镜搭配在一起，并对其进行了电镀和抛光，使其达到镜面效果。

paras.en: The Hubble Space Telescope gets its own marble tribute in "Monuments." Zelinskie started with a NASA 3D model of the telescope and used the modeling software Blender to give it a veil.
paras.zh: 哈勃太空望远镜在“纪念碑”中得到了自己的大理石致敬。 Zelinskie 从 NASA 的望远镜 3D 模型开始，并使用建模软件 Blender 给它蒙上一层面纱。

paras.en: "So I kind of threw a digital piece of fabric on the Hubble telescope over and over and over again until I got it right," she told Malik. The veil is a nod to the blurry images Hubble first sent back to Earth. A Digital Stone Project robotic arm in Tuscany carved the rough shape in marble, and Zelinskie finished it by hand. When she invited Malik to touch what looked like cloth, he reached out. "It's like a very buttery, smooth surface," he said.
paras.zh: “所以我一遍又一遍地将一块数字织物扔到哈勃望远镜上，直到我得到正确的结果，”她告诉马利克。这面纱是对哈勃首次发回地球的模糊图像的致敬。托斯卡纳的数字石材项目机械臂在大理石上雕刻出了粗糙的形状，泽林斯基手工完成了它。当她邀请马利克触摸看起来像布的东西时，他伸出了手。 “它就像一个非常光滑的黄油表面，”他说。

paras.en: The last time we saw Zelinskie at Heft, she and DJ and producer illich Mujica had filled the gallery with Webb imagery, live electronic music and a little Pink Floyd for their audiovisual performance "Redshift." We've also seen her turn Webb's view of the Pillars of Creation into artwork. This time, one of the images on the wall began with a camera Zelinskie pointed at a rocket herself.
paras.zh: 上次我们在 Heft 见到 Zelinskie 时，她和 DJ 兼制作人 illich Mujica 在画廊里摆满了 Webb 图像、现场电子音乐和一点 Pink Floyd 的视听表演“Redshift”。我们还看到她将韦伯对创造之柱的看法转化为艺术品。这一次，墙上的其中一张照片以泽林斯基本人用相机对准火箭开始。

paras.en: Zelinskie photographed NASA's Artemis 2 launch from the Kennedy Space Center visitor center in Florida. The resulting print is part of "Ejecta," alongside the Starship breakup print and more. She uses data to distort the image until the swirls in a rocket plume start to resemble a nebula.
paras.zh: 泽林斯基在佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心游客中心拍摄了美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯 2 号的发射照片。由此产生的印刷品是“Ejecta”的一部分，与星舰解体印刷品等一起。她使用数据扭曲图像，直到火箭羽流中的漩涡开始像星云。

paras.en: Another print in the series depicts the loss of the space shuttle Challenger. That one has a personal connection for me. Jan. 28, 1986, was my birthday. Challenger broke apart 73 seconds after liftoff that day, killing all seven crew members. The memory of that day helped inspire my career covering space.
paras.zh: 该系列中的另一幅作品描绘了挑战者号航天飞机的失事。那个人与我有个人联系。 1986年1月28日，是我的生日。当天，挑战者号在升空 73 秒后解体，七名机组人员全部遇难。那天的记忆激发了我的太空职业生涯。

paras.en: Massimino spoke with Malik about what it was like to see a familiar image of the disaster through Zelinskie's eyes. "It's an artist's interpretation of it, which in some way, when I look at it, is more emotional," he said.
paras.zh: 马西米诺与马利克谈论了通过泽林斯基的眼睛看到熟悉的灾难画面的感受。 “这是艺术家对它的诠释，在某种程度上，当我看到它时，它更加情绪化，”他说。

paras.en: "I just became obsessed with launch clouds," Zelinskie told Malik. That fascination made its way into "Launch Sequence," a series of five sculptures that capture successive moments of liftoff.
paras.zh: “我只是沉迷于发射云，”泽林斯基告诉马利克。这种魅力体现在“发射序列”中，这是一系列五个雕塑，捕捉了连续的升空时刻。

paras.en: The cloud grows as the rocket climbs away. For the shape of the rocket itself, Zelinskie drew on sculptor Constantin Brâncuși's "Bird in Space" to give it the feeling of upward motion.
paras.zh: 随着火箭爬升，云层逐渐增大。对于火箭本身的形状，泽林斯基借鉴了雕塑家康斯坦丁·布朗库西的《太空中的鸟》，赋予它向上运动的感觉。

paras.en: The tour ends with "Crowded Sky," where visitors can follow individual objects in Earth orbit. White markers represent government-owned objects and black markers represent privately owned ones. When the display picks out a target, scan a QR code and your phone tells you what you're looking at, what it does and when it launched.
paras.zh: 游览以“拥挤的天空”结束，游客可以在其中跟踪地球轨道上的各个物体。白色标记代表政府拥有的物品，黑色标记代表私人拥有的物品。当显示屏选择目标时，扫描二维码，您的手机就会告诉您您正在看什么、它在做什么以及何时启动。

paras.en: Wind the clock back far enough and there's just one object to follow. Run it a decade into the future and you get Zelinskie's projection of how much busier the sky could become.
paras.zh: 将时钟拨回足够远的地方，就只剩下一个目标可以跟随。运行十年后，你就会得到泽林斯基对天空会变得多么繁忙的预测。

paras.en: With all those objects circling overhead, Malik asked Zelinskie what space means to her. "I think the more we learn about space, the more we appreciate our own planet," she said. "It's the overview effect. And I'm hoping that everybody gets that out of the artwork."
paras.zh: 当所有这些物体在头顶盘旋时，马利克问泽林斯基太空对她意味着什么。 “我认为我们对太空了解得越多，我们就越欣赏我们自己的星球，”她说。 “这是概览效果。我希望每个人都能从艺术作品中得到这一点。”

paras.en: "The Weight of Space" runs through Jan. 16, 2027, at Heft Gallery in New York City. Explore more of Zelinskie's work on the artist's website.
paras.zh: “空间的重量”将于 2027 年 1 月 16 日在纽约赫夫特画廊展出。在艺术家的网站上探索泽林斯基的更多作品。

paras.en: Steve Spaleta is Space.com's Senior Producer. Since 2007, Steve has produced and edited space, science and entertainment-related videos for Space.com. He is also the producer/writer/editor of Space.com's CosMix series on space-enthused artists. He studied psychology at the State University of New York at Stony Brook and is originally from Zadar, Croatia by way of Astoria, NY. To see Steve's latest project, follow him on Twitter and follow Space.com's VideoFromSpace YouTube Channel.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·斯帕莱塔 (Steve Spaleta) 是 Space.com 的高级制作人。自 2007 年以来，Steve 一直为 Space.com 制作和编辑与太空、科学和娱乐相关的视频。他还是 Space.com 的 CosMix 系列有关太空爱好者的艺术家的制作人/作家/编辑。他在纽约州立大学石溪分校学习心理学，来自克罗地亚扎达尔，途经纽约州阿斯托里亚。要查看 Steve 的最新项目，请在 Twitter 上关注他并关注 Space.com 的 VideoFromSpace YouTube 频道。

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 25, 1970: NASA's 'wingless' M2-F3 'lifting body' aircraft makes its 1st powered flight ahead of supersonic tests
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 25, 1970, an experimental aircraft called the Northrop M2-F3 made its first powered flight.
paras.zh: 1970 年 11 月 25 日，一架名为诺斯罗普 M2-F3 的实验飞机进行了首次动力飞行。

paras.en: The M2-F3 aircraft was a heavyweight "lifting body" designed to test its ability to produce most of its lift through its fuselage instead of wings. It's commonly referred to as a "wingless" aircraft.
paras.zh: M2-F3 飞机是一种重量级“升力体”，旨在测试其通过机身而不是机翼产生大部分升力的能力。它通常被称为“无翼”飞机。

paras.en: After Air Force test pilot Bill Dana took the M2-F3 on three unpowered glide test flights, he did the first powered flight, too. Dana soared to an altitude of 45,000 feet during this flight, which lasted just over 6 minutes. He didn't break the sound barrier this time, but he did on later flights.
paras.zh: 在空军试飞员 Bill Dana 驾驶 M2-F3 进行了三次无动力滑翔测试飞行后，他也进行了第一次动力飞行。达纳在这次飞行中飙升至 45,000 英尺的高度，飞行时间仅超过 6 分钟。这次他没有突破音障，但在后来的航班中他做到了。

paras.en: The M2-F3 flew a total of 27 missions in its three-year flight history. Its top speed was 1.6 times the speed of sound, and its top altitude was 71,500 feet.
paras.zh: M2-F3 在其三年的飞行历史中总共执行了 27 次任务。它的最高速度为音速的1.6倍，最高高度为71,500英尺。

paras.en: In the late 1960s and early 1970s, NASA was investigating lifting bodies as an approach to both new aircraft and what future spacecraft, and as its number suggests, the M2-F3 was not the first of its kind.
paras.zh: 在 20 世纪 60 年代末和 1970 年代初，NASA 正在研究升力体作为新型飞机和未来航天器的一种方法，正如其数字所示，M2-F3 并不是同类产品中的第一架。

paras.en: In fact, the M2-F3 was a rebuilt version of its predecessor, the M2-F2 lifting body, after that vehicle crashed in a dry lake bed in California's Mojave Desert during an unpowered test flight. That crash (which appears in the opening of the TV show "The Six-Million-Dollar Man") led to upgrades for a better handling lifting body, NASA said.
paras.zh: 事实上，M2-F3 是其前身 M2-F2 升力体的重建版本，该车在一次无动力试飞期间坠毁在加利福尼亚州莫哈韦沙漠的干涸湖床上。美国宇航局表示，那次事故（出现在电视节目《六百万美元的人》的开头）导致了对更好操控的升力机构的升级。

paras.en: "When the M2-F2 was rebuilt and redesignated the M2-F3, it was modified with an additional third vertical fin – centered between the tip fins – to improve control characteristics," NASA wrote in an overview.
paras.zh: NASA 在一份概述中写道：“当 M2-F2 被重建并重新命名为 M2-F3 时，它被修改为额外的第三个垂直尾翼（位于尾翼之间的中心），以提高控制特性。”

paras.en: Unpowered glide flights for the M2-F3 began in June 1970, but Dana's flight on Nov. 25 of that year was the first time the vehicle fired up its rocket engine to test its controls under powered flight. One vital upgrade on the vehicle was a set of reaction control thrusters to help maintain its orientation.
paras.zh: M2-F3 的无动力滑翔飞行于 1970 年 6 月开始，但当年 11 月 25 日达纳的飞行是该飞行器首次启动火箭发动机以测试其在动力飞行下的控制。飞行器的一个重要升级是一组反应控制推进器，以帮助保持其方向。

paras.en: "A reaction jet control system, similar to thrusters used on orbiting spacecraft, was also installed on the M2-F3 to obtain research data about their effectiveness for vehicle control," NASA wrote. "As the M2-F3’s portion of the lifting body program neared an end, it evaluated a rate command augmentation control system and a side-arm control stick similar to side-arm controllers now used on many modern aircraft."
paras.zh: NASA 写道：“M2-F3 上还安装了类似于轨道航天器上使用的推进器的反应喷射控制系统，以获得有关其飞行器控制有效性的研究数据。” “随着 M2-F3 升力体项目的部分接近尾声，它评估了速率指令增强控制系统和类似于现在许多现代飞机上使用的侧臂控制器的侧臂控制杆。”

paras.en: If you want, you can see the M2-F3 vehicle today. NASA donated it to the Smithsonian Institution. It is now hanging at the National Air and Space Museum in Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: 如果您愿意，您今天就可以看到 M2-F3 车辆。美国宇航局将其捐赠给史密森尼学会。它现在悬挂在华盛顿特区的国家航空航天博物馆。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: December full moon 2026: When, where and how to see the Cold Moon
articles.author: Anthony Wood

paras.en: The December full moon reaches peak illumination at 8:28 p.m. EST on Dec. 23 (0128 GMT on Dec. 24) as the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky. It is often called the "Cold Moon" in reference to the frigid temperatures that prevail in the Northern Hemisphere around the time of its rising, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac.
paras.zh: 12 月的满月在晚上 8:28 达到最高亮度。美国东部时间 12 月 23 日（格林尼治标准时间 12 月 24 日 0128），月盘在地球天空中与太阳相对照耀。根据《老农年鉴》，它通常被称为“冷月”，因为它升起时北半球普遍寒冷。

paras.en: December's full moon will also occur close to perigee — the moon's closest point to Earth in its elliptical orbit — giving rise to a spectacular supermoon. A supermoon can appear 30% brighter and 14% larger than a full moon at its farthest point from Earth (also known as a micromoon)..
paras.zh: 十二月的满月也将出现在近地点附近——月球在其椭圆轨道上距离地球最近的点——从而产生壮观的超级月亮。超级月亮在距离地球最远的地方可能比满月（也称为微月亮）亮 30%、大 14%。

paras.en: According to the late, great astronomer Fred Espenak, the Cold Moon will be just 221,667 miles (356,740 kilometers) from Earth when it turns full, making it the closest supermoon of 2026!
paras.zh: 根据已故伟大天文学家 Fred Espenak 的说法，冷月满月时距离地球仅 221,667 英里（356,740 公里），使其成为 2026 年最近的超级月亮！

paras.en: The full Cold Supermoon will make for a spectacular sight when it rises over the eastern horizon at sunset on Dec. 23, mere hours before reaching maximum illumination. Remember to use Time and Date's moonrise and moonset tracker for timings specific to your location.
paras.zh: 12 月 23 日日落时分，完整的冷超级月亮将在东部地平线升起，此时距离达到最大亮度仅几个小时。请记住使用时间和日期的月出和月落跟踪器来获取特定于您所在位置的时间。

paras.en: Earth's satellite may appear larger than normal while close to the horizon. This is partly because it is near perigee, when it appears subtly larger in the night sky, but also because of a phenomenon called the moon illusion, which tricks us into perceiving the moon to be bigger than it actually is while in the presence of foreground objects.
paras.zh: 当接近地平线时，地球的卫星可能看起来比正常卫星大。部分原因是它接近近地​​点，当它在夜空中显得略大时，但也因为一种称为月亮错觉的现象，它欺骗我们在有前景物体的情况下感知月亮比实际更大。

paras.en: The moon may also adopt a striking golden or orange hue around moonrise and moonset. When the moon is low on the horizon, its light travels through more of Earth's atmopshere, scattering shorter, bluer wavelengths of light and allowing longer, redder wavelengths to reach our eyes.
paras.zh: 在月出和月落时，月亮也可能呈现出引人注目的金色或橙色色调。当月球位于地平线下方时，它的光会穿过更多的地球大气层，散射更短、更蓝的波长的光，并允许更长、更红的波长到达我们的眼睛。

paras.en: The table below details moonrise timings for a selection of cities spread across the globe for Dec. 23-24:
paras.zh: 下表详细介绍了 12 月 23 日至 24 日全球部分城市的月出时间：

paras.en: Local moonrise timings for the December 2026 full Cold Moon
paras.zh: 2026 年 12 月冷月满月的当地月出时间

paras.en: The December full moon is often called the Cold Moon in reference to the often freezing temperatures that can descend this time of the year. It's also known as the "Long Night Moon" by the Mohican tribe of North America, because of its proximity to the winter solstice, which marks the shortest day of the year in the Northern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 十二月的满月通常被称为冷月，因为一年中的这个时候气温通常会下降。它也被北美莫西干部落称为“长夜月亮”，因为它临近冬至，标志着北半球一年中白天最短的日子。

paras.en: Old English peoples knew it as the "Moon Before Yule", according to Time and Date, while the Celts of Europe referred to it as the Oak Moon after traditions that centered around the hardy trees.
paras.zh: 根据《时间和日期》，古英国人将其称为“圣诞节前的月亮”，而欧洲的凯尔特人则根据以耐寒树木为中心的传统，将其称为“橡树之月”。

paras.en: The December full moon also coincides with the Hindu festival of Datta Jayanti, when followers gather to celebrate the birth of Lord Dattatreya, who embodies the Hindu holy trinity of Lord Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, according to the Government of Maharashtra. The December full moon also rises close to the Christian celebration of Christmas on Dec. 25, when followers celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.
paras.zh: 据马哈拉施特拉邦政府称，12月的满月也恰逢印度教的达塔贾扬蒂节，届时追随者聚集在一起庆祝达塔特雷亚勋爵的诞生，达塔特雷亚勋爵象征着印度教神圣的三位一体：梵天、毗湿奴和湿婆。 12 月的满月也在 12 月 25 日基督教庆祝圣诞节附近升起，届时追随者庆祝耶稣基督的诞生。

paras.en: What else to see in the sky around the full moon
paras.zh: 满月周围的天空中还能看到什么

paras.en: The Cold Moon will shine in the center of a majestic "Winter Hexagon" of stars bright enough to easily cut through the glare cast by the lunar disk after it rises on Nov. 24.
paras.zh: 11月24日升起后，冷月将在雄伟的“冬季六边形”恒星中心闪耀，这些恒星的亮度足以轻松穿透月盘投射的眩光。

paras.en: Begin by locating Sirius, the brightest star in our night sky, which rises into the southeastern sky shortly after 8 p.m. local time for viewers in New York. Next, trace an imaginary line to the blue supergiant star Rigel in the nearby constellation Orion, before hopping to the orange glow of Aldebaran, which represents an eye of the great bull depicted in the constellation Taurus.
paras.zh: 首先找到天狼星，这是我们夜空中最亮的星星，晚上 8 点后不久，它就会升入东南方的天空。纽约观众当地时间。接下来，沿着一条假想线到达附近猎户座的蓝色超巨星参宿七，然后跳到毕宿五的橙色光芒，它代表金牛座中描绘的巨大公牛的眼睛。

paras.en: Next we move to Capella, the jewel of the constellation Auriga, before jumping down to Pollux in the constellation Gemini and nearby Procyon, before closing the loop with Sirius once more.
paras.zh: 接下来，我们将前往御夫座的宝石五车二，然后跳到双子座的北河三和附近的南河三，然后再次与天狼星闭合环路。

paras.en: Jupiter and the red light of Mars will shine low in the eastern sky in the hour before midnight, while Saturn will lurk close to the western horizon. Look to the southeast just before dawn to spot Venus appearing as a brilliant "Morning Star", with the red giant Arcturus shining higher in the predawn sky close to the constellation Bootes.
paras.zh: 午夜前一小时，木星和火星的红光将在东方天空低空闪耀，而土星将潜伏在西方地平线附近。在黎明前向东南方向看，金星会像一颗明亮的“晨星”一样出现，红巨星大角星在靠近牧夫座的黎明前天空中闪耀得更高。

paras.en: The December full moon presents a stunning opportunity to photograph the lunar disk as it shines in Earth's sky entirely free from shadow. Be sure to make use of our expert guide to photographing the moon, along with our picks of the best cameras and lenses for astrophotography, if you want to upgrade your equipment.
paras.zh: 十二月的满月提供了拍摄月盘的绝佳机会，因为它在地球的天空中完全没有阴影地闪耀。如果您想升级您的设备，请务必使用我们的月球拍摄专家指南，以及我们精选的最佳天文摄影相机和镜头。

paras.en: - Use a tripod to keep your camera as steady as possible.
paras.zh: - 使用三脚架尽可能保持相机稳定。

paras.en: - Use a remote shutter release or self-timer to prevent camera wobble.
paras.zh: - 使用遥控快门释放或自拍来防止相机晃动。

paras.en: - A smartphone stargazing app can help you find the exact point of moonrise on your local horizon.
paras.zh: - 智能手机观星应用程序可以帮助您找到当地地平线上月出的准确点。

paras.en: - A 12–50 mm lens is useful for landscape photography, while at least 400 mm is advised for capturing more detailed views of the lunar surface.
paras.zh: - 12-50 毫米镜头适用于风景摄影，而建议至少使用 400 毫米镜头来捕捉月球表面的更详细视图。

paras.en: - The moon can be made to appear particularly large while close to the horizon next to foreground objects, where it may take on an orange-yellow appearance thanks to Rayleigh scattering. A cleaner, more "classic" view can be captured as it soars high overhead.
paras.zh: - 可以使月亮在靠近前景物体旁边的地平线时显得特别大，由于瑞利散射，月亮可能呈现橙黄色外观。当它在头顶高空翱翔时，可以捕捉到更干净、更“经典”的景色。

paras.en: These times mark the exact instant of full illumination. Your own moonrise or moonset may be hours earlier or later, depending on your location. For the best viewing plan, use an app such as Stellarium or SkySafari 7 Pro.
paras.zh: 这些时间标志着完全照明的确切时刻。您自己的月出或月落可能会提前或晚几个小时，具体取决于您所在的位置。为了获得最佳观看计划，请使用 Stellarium 或 SkySafari 7 Pro 等应用程序。

paras.en: Editor's Note: If you would like to share your full moon photos with Space.com's readers, then please send your photo(s) along with your name, the location and any comments on what it was like to capture the picture to spacephotos@space.com.
paras.zh: 编者注：如果您想与 Space.com 的读者分享您的满月照片，请将您的照片连同您的姓名、地点以及对拍摄照片的感受的任何评论发送至 spacephotos@space.com。

paras.en: Anthony Wood joined Space.com in April 2025 after contributing articles to outlets including IGN, New Atlas and Gizmodo. He has a passion for the night sky, science, Hideo Kojima, and human space exploration, and can’t wait for the day when astronauts once again set foot on the moon.
paras.zh: 安东尼·伍德 (Anthony Wood) 在向 IGN、New Atlas 和 Gizmodo 等媒体投稿后于 2025 年 4 月加入 Space.com。他热爱夜空、科学、小岛秀夫和人类太空探索，迫不及待地等待宇航员再次踏上月球的那一天。

articles.title: Childhood, Career Come Full Circle for Budget Analyst at NASA Goddard
articles.author: Rob Garner

paras.en: Conversations about NASA were the norm around the dinner table during Ashley Knight’s childhood. Her parents worked at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, and discussions about happenings at the agency continued even when they came home from the office.
paras.zh: 在阿什利·奈特 (Ashley Knight) 的童年时期，关于 NASA 的讨论是餐桌上的常态。她的父母在马里兰州格林贝尔特的美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心工作，即使他们从办公室回家，有关该机构发生的事情的讨论仍在继续。

paras.en: “I remember a poignant dialogue we had after the space shuttle Challenger disaster,” Knight recalled. “However, we talked just as much about the engaging work my parents were doing inside Goddard’s gates.”
paras.zh: “我记得挑战者号航天飞机灾难后我们进行了一次令人心酸的对话，”奈特回忆道。 “然而，我们同样谈论了我父母在戈达德的大门内所做的引人入胜的工作。”

paras.en: Her father Lyle Knight was a mechanical engineer, while her mother Julia Knight worked the bulk of her career in human resources. They brought their daughter on center for Take Your Child to Work Day and other events, and over time she became hooked.
paras.zh: 她的父亲莱尔·奈特 (Lyle Knight) 是一名机械工程师，而她的母亲朱莉娅·奈特 (Julia Knight) 的大部分职业生涯都在人力资源领域工作。他们带着女儿参加“带孩子去上班日”和其他活动，随着时间的推移，她就上瘾了。

paras.en: “I saw the chambers where spacecraft and instruments were being tested, as well as other facilities used to help further space exploration. Above all, I witnessed the passion and collaborative spirit everyone had at Goddard,” Knight said. “As a child, I found it incredibly fascinating.”
paras.zh: “我看到了正在测试航天器和仪器的房间，以及用于帮助进一步太空探索的其他设施。最重要的是，我目睹了戈达德每个人的热情和协作精神，”奈特说。 “当我还是个孩子的时候，我发现它非常迷人。”

paras.en: It all came full circle in late August when, after growing up around NASA and later working several contractor roles for the agency, Knight and a number of her colleagues in the Goddard Office of the Chief Financial Officer were sworn in as federal employees as part of a workforce directive to strengthen the agency’s technical core competencies by bringing mission-critical positions into the civil service.
paras.zh: 8 月下旬，这一切又回到了原点。在 NASA 周围长大，后来又在该机构担任过多个承包商职位后，奈特和她在戈达德首席财务官办公室的一些同事宣誓就任联邦雇员，这是一项劳动力指令的一部分，旨在通过将关键任务职位纳入公务员队伍来加强该机构的技术核心能力。

paras.en: She began her Goddard career more than two decades ago following graduation from the University of Maryland in nearby College Park. As the job search began after commencement, one organization inevitably stood out, along with one particular mission.
paras.zh: 二十多年前，她从附近大学公园市的马里兰大学毕业后，开始了戈达德的职业生涯。随着毕业典礼后求职的开始，一个组织和一个特定的使命不可避免地脱颖而出。

paras.en: When she came across a contractor job opening at Goddard in support of the Hubble Space Telescope team, Knight jumped at the opportunity.
paras.zh: 当她在戈达德发现一个支持哈勃太空望远镜团队的承包商职位空缺时，奈特抓住了这个机会。

paras.en: “Hubble was doing amazing things, and I always admired how they fixed the faulty mirror,” she said, referring to how astronauts and team members corrected an early spherical aberration during the observatory’s first servicing mission. “It was exciting to become involved with such a flagship mission, especially coming right out of college.”
paras.zh: “哈勃做了令人惊奇的事情，我一直很钦佩他们如何修复有缺陷的镜子，”她说，指的是宇航员和团队成员在天文台第一次维修任务期间如何纠正早期球面像差。 “参与这样一个旗舰任务真是令人兴奋，尤其是刚从大学毕业的时候。”

paras.en: As a project support analyst, Knight assisted engineers with test plans, data gathering, and hardware procurement for Hubble’s fifth and final shuttle servicing mission.
paras.zh: 作为项目支持分析师，奈特协助工程师为哈勃第五次也是最后一次航天飞机维修任务制定测试计划、数据收集和硬件采购。

paras.en: Following the mission’s completion in 2009 and subsequent end of the Hubble shuttle servicing era, she took on a similar role with the Robotic Refueling Mission in what was then the Satellite Servicing Capabilities Office at Goddard – now known as NASA’s In-Space Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacturing Capabilities Office.
paras.zh: 2009 年该任务完成，哈勃航天飞机服务时代结束后，她在当时的戈达德卫星服务能力办公室（现称为 NASA 太空服务、组装和制造能力办公室）的机器人加油任务中担任了类似的角色。

paras.en: Knight left Goddard momentarily afterward to perform contracting work in support of the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory in Washington. After a phone call, she found her way back as a contractor program analyst in the Goddard Office of the Chief Financial Officer, helping manage labor budgets within programs by avoiding funding lapses and ensuring employees received their paychecks on time.
paras.zh: 奈特随后离开戈达德，从事支持华盛顿美国海军研究实验室的承包工作。打完电话后，她回到戈达德首席财务官办公室担任承包商项目分析师，通过避免资金失误和确保员工按时收到工资来帮助管理项目内的劳动力预算。

paras.en: Following the August ceremony, Knight now carries the title of budget analyst in the Program Analysis Office within the Goddard Office of the Chief Financial Officer, performing many of the same critical duties as a civil servant.
paras.zh: 八月份的仪式结束后，奈特现在在戈达德首席财务官办公室项目分析办公室担任预算分析师，履行许多与公务员相同的关键职责。

paras.en: “While many functions are similar, transitioning into the civil service makes it easier for my colleagues and I to help keep NASA’s missions going from the financial aspect,” said Knight. “We have more autonomy to perform certain government-related tasks by being on the government side.”
paras.zh: 奈特说：“虽然许多职能相似，但转入公务员队伍使我和我的同事更容易从财务方面帮助维持 NASA 的任务。” “通过站在政府一边，我们有更多的自主权来执行某些与政府相关的任务。”

paras.en: The civil service also provides additional training and growth opportunities for such positions.
paras.zh: 公务员制度还为此类职位提供额外的培训和成长机会。

paras.en: “Ashley is a great team player. This conversion is a fantastic milestone because it unlocks new avenues for her learning and development, and allows us to integrate her into new roles,” said Linnette Morales, Knight’s supervisor in the Program Analysis Office. “I am thrilled she can now fully access the opportunities on the civil servant side, immensely benefiting both her continued career growth and our organization.”
paras.zh: “阿什利是一位出色的团队合作者。这次转变是一个了不起的里程碑，因为它为她的学习和发展开辟了新的途径，并使我们能够将她融入新的角色，”奈特在项目分析办公室的主管林内特·莫拉莱斯（Linnette Morales）说。 “我很高兴她现在可以充分获得公务员方面的机会，这对她的持续职业发展和我们的组织都非常有利。”

paras.en: The workforce directive, entitled “Restoring NASA’s Core Competencies” and announced by NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman in February, is part of a broader effort to expand the agency’s critical institutional knowledge, increase resources essential for mission success, and maintain U.S. leadership in space exploration.
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 在 2 月份宣布了题为“恢复 NASA 核心能力”的劳动力指令，该指令是扩大该机构关键机构知识、增加任务成功所需资源以及保持美国在太空探索领域领导地位的更广泛努力的一部分。

paras.en: “The directive has given our office an opportunity to rebalance positions across the organization and remove limitations that were applied to those who were previously not government employees,” said Lisa Kelleher, Goddard’s chief financial officer. “We are now better able to insource many of our experienced contractor staff, allowing us to build up our in-house core competencies in areas such as budget analysis and accounting, and in turn increase our support for mission success.”
paras.zh: 戈达德首席财务官丽莎·凯莱赫表示：“该指令使我们办公室有机会重新平衡整个组织的职位，并取消对以前非政府雇员的限制。” “我们现在能够更好地外包许多经验丰富的承包商员工，使我们能够在预算分析和会计等领域建立我们的内部核心能力，从而增加对任务成功的支持。”

paras.en: For Knight, she sees an increasing importance for her organization and hopes to make impactful contributions, especially as work taking place at Goddard helps NASA return a crewed mission to the lunar surface, build a Moon Base, and eventually send humans to Mars.
paras.zh: 对于奈特来说，她认为她的组织越来越重要，并希望做出有影响力的贡献，特别是戈达德的工作帮助美国宇航局将载人任务送回月球表面，建立月球基地，并最终将人类送上火星。

paras.en: “We’re the go-between between NASA Headquarters and Goddard programs, and it’s our job to make it a seamless transition for projects to use money they’ve been given to help get these projects off the ground,” she said. “It’s both vital and exciting with the lunar and Mars endeavors, and I’m proud to play whatever role I can.”
paras.zh: 她说：“我们是美国宇航局总部和戈达德项目之间的中间人，我们的工作是让项目实现无缝过渡，利用他们获得的资金来帮助这些项目启动。” “对于月球和火星的探索来说，这既重要又令人兴奋，我很自豪能够发挥我所能发挥的作用。”

paras.en: Decades after first following her parents around center, and now following in their footsteps as a NASA civil servant, Knight is as captivated by Goddard and its people as she was during her early visits.
paras.zh: 几十年前，奈特第一次跟随父母来到中心，现在又追随他们的脚步，成为美国国家航空航天局(NASA)的一名公务员。奈特和她早期访问时一样，对戈达德及其人民着迷。

paras.en: “Through the years, I’ve noticed everyone remains driven by teamwork and achieving the mission,” she said. “Everybody wants to succeed together by working toward the same goal, and I’m grateful I can continue to be part of it all.”
paras.zh: “多年来，我注意到每个人仍然受到团队合作和实现使命的驱动，”她说。 “每个人都希望通过努力实现同一个目标来共同取得成功，我很高兴能够继续成为这一切的一部分。”

articles.title: NASA Eyes Crop Candidates for Future Menus

paras.en: As NASA prepares for future missions to the Moon and Mars, researchers are studying crops that could provide astronauts with fresh food, nutrition, and variety far from Earth. Such crop variety can help with menus in deep space, something top of mind this week as the nation celebrates Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 在美国宇航局为未来的月球和火星任务做准备之际，研究人员正在研究可为宇航员提供远离地球的新鲜食物、营养和品种的农作物。这种作物品种可以帮助制定深空菜单，这是本周全国庆祝感恩节的首要考虑因素。

paras.en: Recent testing points to strawberries, cucumbers, and lemon basil as potential options for future explorers. Space crops can absorb carbon dioxide, produce oxygen, and recycle water. These capabilities will become increasingly important as crewed missions extend farther from our home planet.
paras.zh: 最近的测试表明草莓、黄瓜和柠檬罗勒是未来探险家的潜在选择。太空作物可以吸收二氧化碳、产生氧气并回收水。随着载人任务距离我们的星球越来越远，这些能力将变得越来越重要。

paras.en: While space crop research advances on Earth, capabilities are also expanding in space. A new investigation from NASA’s Biological and Physical Sciences Division is set to launch to the International Space Station, where the first-of-its-kind prototype growth chamber will provide critical insights for developing crop production systems that could grow crops like these for future Moon Base habitats and Mars missions.
paras.zh: 虽然太空作物研究在地球上取得了进展，但太空作物的研究能力也在不断扩大。美国宇航局生物和物理科学部门的一项新调查将在国际空间站展开，其中首个原型生长室将为开发农作物生产系统提供重要的见解，这些系统可以为未来的月球基地栖息地和火星任务种植此类农作物。

paras.en: Strawberries are among the few sweet fruits under consideration for spaceflight and are nutritious, aromatic, and self-pollinating.
paras.zh: 草莓是少数考虑用于太空飞行的甜水果之一，营养丰富、芳香且自花授粉。

paras.en: Researchers at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida are growing strawberries in flight-like growth chambers to evaluate the potential space crop, and NASA partners at The Australian Research Council Centre for Excellence in Plants for Space also are helping expand knowledge of space strawberries.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心的研究人员正在飞行式生长室中种植草莓，以评估潜在的太空作物，美国宇航局澳大利亚研究委员会太空植物卓越中心的合作伙伴也在帮助扩大对太空草莓的了解。

paras.en: Researchers at NASA Kennedy, the University of Melbourne, and the University of Western Australia recently tested a wild strawberry against NASA’s leading strawberry candidate, ‘Delizz,’ to see which thrived better under simulated space conditions.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪、墨尔本大学和西澳大利亚大学的研究人员最近将野草莓与美国宇航局领先的候选草莓“Delizz”进行了测试，看看哪种在模拟太空条件下生长得更好。

paras.en: Delizz and the wild strawberry produced very different fruits, according to a study published in September in the journal Life Sciences in Space Research. Delizz grew large, red fruit, while the wild strawberry produced small, yellow fruit due to a recessive genetic mutation.
paras.zh: 根据《太空研究生命科学》杂志九月份发表的一项研究，德利兹和野草莓结出的果实截然不同。德利兹（Delizz）结出大的红色果实，而野草莓由于隐性基因突变而结出小而黄色的果实。

paras.en: But looks are not everything. When grown from a seed, the wild strawberry produced twice as many buds, flowers, and fruit as Delizz. Ultimately, however, NASA’s pick kept its top spot, as the wild strawberry grew too many runners that would take up valuable room aboard a spacecraft.
paras.zh: 但外表并不代表一切。当野草莓从种子中培育出来时，其芽、花和果实的数量是 Delizz 的两倍。然而，最终，美国宇航局的选择保持了榜首，因为野草莓长出了太多的茎，会占用航天器上宝贵的空间。

paras.en: Many crops have been grown in space, but none so far have come from the gourd family. Cucumbers could be the first.
paras.zh: 许多农作物已经在太空中种植，但迄今为止还没有一种来自葫芦科。黄瓜可能是第一个。

paras.en: Before crops like cucumbers can be grown and eaten in space, they must undergo extensive testing. NASA-funded researchers recently evaluated cucumbers for their growth, yield, and nutrition under spaceflight conditions.
paras.zh: 黄瓜等农作物在太空中种植和食用之前，必须经过广泛的测试。美国宇航局资助的研究人员最近评估了黄瓜在太空飞行条件下的生长、产量和营养。

paras.en: The researchers found that while the plants showed some signs of enlarged leaves, they produced a steady stream of edible fruit, according to a study published in August in the journal HortScience.
paras.zh: 根据《园艺科学》杂志八月份发表的一项研究，研究人员发现，虽然这些植物表现出一些叶子增大的迹象，但它们却能源源不断地产出可食用的果实。

paras.en: Offering a variety of crops, such as cucumbers, not only benefits astronauts’ diets and mental well-being, but it also increases plant biodiversity, which can improve the likelihood of crop success on long-duration missions.
paras.zh: 提供黄瓜等多种农作物不仅有利于宇航员的饮食和心理健康，而且还可以增加植物多样性，从而提高农作物在长期任务中成功的可能性。

paras.en: Herbs can spice up life in space, turning a bland meal into a bold one.
paras.zh: 香草可以为太空生活增添情趣，将平淡的饭菜变成大胆的饭菜。

paras.en: Lemon basil, an edible herb with a citrus scent and taste, is making strides in testing at NASA Kennedy.
paras.zh: 柠檬罗勒是一种具有柑橘香味和味道的食用草本植物，在美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心的测试中取得了重大进展。

paras.en: Researchers report that lemon basil passed its preliminary round of space crop testing and successfully underwent seed sanitization, which is required before spaceflight to remove microorganisms from the seeds. Lemon basil’s next steps include assessing its growth in plant pillows, which can house plants aboard the space station.
paras.zh: 研究人员报告说，柠檬罗勒通过了初步一轮太空作物测试，并成功进行了种子消毒，这是在航天之前去除种子中微生物所必需的。柠檬罗勒的下一步包括评估其在植物枕头中的生长情况，植物枕头可以容纳空间站上的植物。

paras.en: Menu fatigue can quickly become a problem for astronauts, but fresh herbs like lemon basil help transform packaged meals into something new and satisfying, supporting human health and performance in space.
paras.zh: 菜单疲劳很快就会成为宇航员的一个问题，但柠檬罗勒等新鲜香草有助于将包装食品变成新的、令人满意的食物，支持人类在太空中的健康和表现。

articles.title: NASA Enhances Supplier Program, Announces Mentor-Protégé Agreement
articles.author: Jennifer M. Dooren

paras.en: How NASA works with small businesses is evolving, and as a result, the agency is strengthening the domestic aerospace industrial base to support future exploration missions through its recently renamed Small Business Supplier Development Program. As part of the program, NASA announced its latest Mentor-Protégé Agreement, this one signed between The Boeing Company and GRACE Aerospace.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局与小企业的合作方式正在不断发展，因此，该机构正在通过最近更名为“小企业供应商发展计划”来加强国内航空航天工业基础，以支持未来的探索任务。作为该计划的一部分，美国宇航局宣布了最新的导师-门生协议，该协议是由波音公司和 GRACE Aerospace 签署的。

paras.en: NASA is streamlining the application process for the Small Business Supplier Development Program, as well as reducing administrative requirements, accelerating review and approval timelines, and enhancing incentives for prime contractor participation. These improvements are aimed at making supplier development more accessible, efficient, and closely aligned with NASA’s mission needs.
paras.zh: NASA 正在简化小型企业供应商发展计划的申请流程，减少管理要求，加快审查和批准时间表，并增强对主承包商参与的激励。这些改进旨在使供应商开发更容易、更高效，并与 NASA 的任务需求紧密结合。

paras.en: “We have intentionally redesigned the program as a mission-focused tool for strengthening industrial base readiness and mission success,” said Dwight Deneal, assistant administrator, Office of Small Business Programs, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “By simplifying participation and focusing developmental assistance on the capabilities NASA needs most, we are helping build a stronger, more resilient supplier base that can support the agency’s highest-priority missions.”
paras.zh: 美国宇航局华盛顿总部小企业项目办公室助理管理员德怀特·德内尔表示：“我们有意重新设计该项目，作为以任务为中心的工具，以加强工业基础准备和任务成功。” “通过简化参与并将发展援助重点放在 NASA 最需要的能力上，我们正在帮助建立一个更强大、更有弹性的供应商基础，以支持该机构的最高优先级任务。”

paras.en: Under the new Mentor-Protégé Agreement, Boeing will provide structured assistance to help GRACE expand its capabilities as a supplier of mission-critical aerospace hardware. Boeing will fund the agreement, valued at nearly $500,000.
paras.zh: 根据新的导师-门生协议，波音公司将提供结构化援助，帮助 GRACE 扩大其作为关键任务航空航天硬件供应商的能力。波音将为该协议提供资金，价值近 50 万美元。

paras.en: “Boeing is proud to continue its longstanding relationship with NASA in support of its mission and the opportunities this agreement creates for Boeing, GRACE, and the broader aerospace industrial base,” said Christian Diamond, Mentor-Protégé Program manager and small business liaison officer for Boeing. “Through this partnership, Boeing looks forward to sharing our expertise to support the continued growth and long-term success of a small business while strengthening our supplier base.”
paras.zh: “波音很自豪能够继续与 NASA 保持长期合作关系，以支持其使命以及该协议为波音、GRACE 和更广泛的航空航天工业基础创造的机会，”波音导师门徒项目经理兼小企业联络官克里斯蒂安·戴蒙德 (Christian Diamond) 表示。 “通过这种合作伙伴关系，波音期待分享我们的专业知识，以支持小型企业的持续增长和长期成功，同时加强我们的供应商基础。”

paras.en: Building on two decades of experience supporting defense and aerospace customers, GRACE will use the partnership to prepare for increasingly complex aerospace and spaceflight programs.
paras.zh: 凭借二十年为国防和航空航天客户提供支持的经验，GRACE 将利用这一合作伙伴关系为日益复杂的航空航天和航天项目做好准备。

paras.en: “GRACE Aerospace is thankful and honored to participate in the program,” said Pauline Sevigny, president and owner of GRACE Aerospace. “We look forward to growing and learning from industry experts and supporting the mission of resilience and space superiority.”
paras.zh: GRACE Aerospace 总裁兼所有者 Pauline Sevigny 表示：“GRACE Aerospace 非常感谢也很荣幸参与该计划。 “我们期待与行业专家一起成长和学习，并支持弹性和空间优势的使命。”

paras.en: NASA’s enhanced supplier program is part of the agency’s broader Office of Small Business Programs.
paras.zh: NASA 的增强型供应商计划是该机构更广泛的小企业计划办公室的一部分。

articles.title: Dubois vs Parker announced for WBO heavyweight title clash

paras.en: Daniel Dubois to fight Joseph Parker in WBO heavyweight world championship clash in Manchester on January 30
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜波依斯将于 1 月 30 日在曼彻斯特举行的 WBO 重量级世界拳王争霸赛中对阵约瑟夫·帕克

paras.en: Daniel Dubois will box former world champion Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena; Dubois will be defending the WBO heavyweight world title he secured defeating Fabio Wardley; Parker has had his suspension lifted
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜布瓦 (Daniel Dubois) 将于 1 月 30 日在曼彻斯特的 Co-op Live 竞技场与前世界冠军约瑟夫·帕克 (Joseph Parker) 进行拳击比赛；杜波依斯将卫冕 WBO 重量级世界拳王头衔，他击败了法比奥·沃德利 (Fabio Wardley)； Parker has had his suspension lifted

paras.en: Daniel Dubois will defend the WBO heavyweight world championship against Joseph Parker on January 30 at Manchester's Co-op Live arena.
paras.zh: 丹尼尔·杜波依斯将于 1 月 30 日在曼彻斯特的 Co-op Live 竞技场对阵约瑟夫·帕克，卫冕 WBO 重量级世界拳王头衔。

paras.en: Dubois and Parker were due to box in 2025 for the IBF title, only for Dubois to fall ill and withdraw just three days before the fight.
paras.zh: 杜波依斯和帕克原定于 2025 年争夺 IBF 冠军头衔，但就在比赛前三天，杜波依斯生病并退出了比赛。

paras.en: Parker knocked out short-notice replacement Martin Bakole and then lost a WBO Interim title bout to Fabio Wardley.
paras.zh: 帕克击倒了临时替补的马丁·巴科勒，然后在 WBO 临时冠军争夺战中输给了法比奥·沃德利。

paras.en: In August he announced that he could continue his career after a suspension was lifted following a failed drug test in October 2025.
paras.zh: 8 月，他宣布在 2025 年 10 月药检失败后禁赛解除后，他可以继续自己的职业生涯。

paras.en: Dubois lost the IBF strap to Oleksandr Usyk last year but stormed back to form when he twice halted Wardley, winning and retaining the full WBO world championship.
paras.zh: 杜波依斯去年输给了乌西克，失去了 IBF 腰带，但在两次击败沃德利后，他又恢复了状态，赢得并卫冕了 WBO 世界冠军。

paras.en: He will now be back in action early in the new year against Parker, who's also recorded standout wins over Deontay Wilder and Zhilei Zhang in recent years.
paras.zh: 他现在将在新年伊始重返赛场，对阵帕克，帕克近年来也取得了对德昂泰·维尔德和张志磊的出色胜利。

paras.en: A former holder of the belt, the New Zealander lost the WBO championship to Anthony Joshua back in 2018 at the Principality Stadium when he became the first professional opponent to go the distance with Joshua.
paras.zh: 作为前金腰带持有者，新西兰人于 2018 年在公国体育场将 WBO 冠军头衔输给了安东尼·约书亚，当时他成为第一个与约书亚赛跑的职业对手。

paras.en: Frank Warren said: "This heavyweight showdown will deliver a blockbuster beginning to 2027.
paras.zh: 弗兰克·沃伦 (Frank Warren) 表示：“这场重量级对决将在 2027 年开始带来轰动效应。

paras.en: "It's a fight everyone wanted to see, and I'm thrilled we can now make it happen. Daniel is entering his prime and when he is on his game it is hard to picture anybody beating him.
paras.zh: “这是一场每个人都想看到的比赛，我很高兴我们现在可以实现这一目标。丹尼尔正在进入他的巅峰期，当他处于比赛状态时，很难想象有人会击败他。

paras.en: "But Joseph has long promised to become world champion again, and now he gets his chance."
paras.zh: “但约瑟夫长期以来一直承诺再次成为世界冠军，现在他得到了机会。”

articles.title: Rodgers released after claiming Steelers coach was 'sleeping in meetings'

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers released by Pittsburgh Steelers after accusing head coach Mike McCarthy of 'sleeping in meetings'
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯因指责主教练迈克·麦卡锡“在会议中睡觉”而被匹兹堡钢人队解雇

paras.en: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers claims that head coach Mike McCarthy was 'snoring' in a quarterback meeting in an explosive interview; Steelers have released the four-time NFL MVP; Rodgers had been benched after back-to-back losses with Mason Rudolph taking his place
paras.zh: 匹兹堡钢人队四分卫亚伦·罗杰斯在一次爆炸性采访中声称主教练迈克·麦卡锡在四分卫会议上“打鼾”；钢人队公布了四届 NFL MVP；罗杰斯在连续两场失利后被坐在替补席上，梅森·鲁道夫取代了他的位置

paras.en: Aaron Rodgers has been released by Pittsburgh Steelers after making explosive claims about head coach Mike McCarthy.
paras.zh: 亚伦·罗杰斯在对主教练迈克·麦卡锡发表爆炸性言论后被匹兹堡钢人队解雇。

paras.en: Speaking on the Pat McAfee Show, Rodgers claimed that McCarthy had been "falling asleep in meetings" and insisted that the entire team felt a change was necessary following the veteran quarterback's decision to bench him for Friday's game against the Denver Broncos. Mason Rudolph is set to start in place of the four-time NFL MVP.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯在帕特·麦卡菲秀上发表讲话时声称麦卡锡“在会议中睡着了”，并坚称在这位经验丰富的四分卫决定让他在周五对阵丹佛野马队的比赛中坐在替补席上后，整个团队都认为有必要做出改变。梅森·鲁道夫将接替四届 NFL MVP 首发。

paras.en: Pittsburgh confirmed in a statement that Rodgers would be "inactive", despite McCarthy having said on Monday that the 43-year-old remained the team's starting quarterback. Rodgers subsequently voiced his frustrations in a scathing interview, which has led to his release by the Steelers.
paras.zh: 匹兹堡在一份声明中证实罗杰斯将“不活跃”，尽管麦卡锡周一表示这位 43 岁的罗杰斯仍然是球队的首发四分卫。罗杰斯随后在一次严厉的采访中表达了他的沮丧，这导致他被钢人队解雇。

paras.en: A six word statement on X read: "The Steelers have released Aaron Rodgers."
paras.zh: X 上的六字声明如下：“钢人队已经释放了亚伦·罗杰斯。”

paras.en: Rodgers had earlier told the ESPN sports talk show: "Mike and I talked for a long time the last few days, and that word [benched] never even came up.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯早些时候在 ESPN 体育脱口秀节目中表示：“过去几天，迈克和我聊了很长时间，而‘替补’这个词甚至从未出现过。

paras.en: "I want to take you back through my last week, and this is not an abnormal week what I'm about to tell you, but these are some of the issues that I've been dealing with, which ultimately led to where we're at now.
paras.zh: “我想带你回顾一下我的上周，我要告诉你的这并不是一个不正常的一周，但这些是我一直在处理的一些问题，这些问题最终导致了我们现在的处境。

paras.en: "Last Wednesday, we were in a quarterback meeting. Mike came in late, sat down, and within 10 minutes began snoring.
paras.zh: “上周三，我们参加了一次四分卫会议。迈克来晚了，坐下来，不到 10 分钟就开始打鼾。

paras.en: "He woke himself up, was rattling his papers, we all looked around. Five minutes later, you hear the snoring again. And less than five minutes after that, he walks out of the room like nothing happened.
paras.zh: “他自己醒了，把文件弄得嘎嘎作响，我们都环顾四周。五分钟后，你再次听到鼾声。不到五分钟后，他走出房间，就像什么都没发生一样。

paras.en: "Thursday, he misses an offensive meeting. Friday, he doesn't come to the walkthrough. We only have a walkthrough, really, on Friday.
paras.zh: “周四，他错过了一场进攻会议。周五，他没有参加演练。我们真的只有周五演练。

paras.en: "He doesn't come to the protection walkthrough on Thursday. Saturday, he misses the morning meeting, and we don't have a team meeting Saturday night, for whatever reason, in Philly.
paras.zh: “他没有参加周四的保护演练。周六，他错过了早上的会议，而且无论出于何种原因，周六晚上我们都没有在费城举行团队会议。

paras.en: "Then comes to Sunday, when obviously we struggled and the product wasn't great. And there was some guys early on that didn't like the way things were going, especially defensive guys. And Mike didn't want to get in the middle of defense.
paras.zh: “然后到了周日，很明显我们遇到了困难，表现也不尽如人意。一开始，有些人对事情的发展方向不满意，尤其是防守球员。Mike也不想介入防守。

paras.en: "At one point, I told him that he really needed to make more of an effort to connect with the defensive players and engage with them. His response was, 'Well, I don't think I need to.' I disagreed, and I think that attitude had already caused him to lose the support of a lot of those players.
paras.zh: “有一次，我告诉他，他确实需要付出更多努力来与防守球员建立联系并与他们互动。他的回答是，‘好吧，我认为我不需要这样做。’”我不同意，我认为这种态度已经让他失去了很多球员的支持。

paras.en: "I think the final straw for many of us came at half-time. Towards the end of the team talk, with the offence on one side and the defence on the other, he was rambling. Then, without any warning or context, he suddenly shouted, 'One, two, three, Packers!'
paras.zh: “我认为压倒我们很多人的最后一根稻草是在中场休息时。在球队谈话快结束时，一边进攻，一边防守，他语无伦次。然后，在没有任何警告或背景的情况下，他突然喊道：‘一、二、三，包装工！’

paras.en: "It was such a strange, out-of-the-blue moment. Nobody had even mentioned the Steelers; it was just an awkward, disjointed speech. But he said it loudly enough for everyone across the entire locker room to hear. It was one of those moments that really stuck with people.
paras.zh: “那真是一个奇怪、出乎意料的时刻。甚至没有人提到钢人队；这只是一场尴尬、脱节的演讲。但他说得声音足够大，整个更衣室的每个人都能听到。这是那些真正让人难以忘怀的时刻之一。

paras.en: "We all looked around going: 'What is going on? Where's his head at?'"
paras.zh: “我们都环顾四周：‘发生了什么事？他的头在哪里？’”

paras.en: Rodgers is currently in his 22nd and final NFL season, having reunited with McCarthy after the pair previously won the Super Bowl together with the Green Bay Packers in 2010.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯目前已进入 NFL 的第 22 个赛季，也是最后一个赛季，他与麦卡锡在 2010 年与绿湾包装工队一起赢得超级碗后重聚。

paras.en: He also played a key role in McCarthy's appointment as Mike Tomlin's successor.
paras.zh: 他还在麦卡锡被任命为迈克·汤姆林的继任者过程中发挥了关键作用。

paras.en: "We've had these conversations for months now, and it began as a concerned friend about somebody who's unhealthy," Rodgers continued.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯继续说道：“我们已经进行了这些对话几个月了，一切都是从一位关心某人健康状况的朋友开始的。”

paras.en: "If you're sleeping in meetings, you're unhealthy. You're not coming to everything you should be. How many quarterbacks around the league are dealing with the same type of stuff?
paras.zh: “如果你在会议中打瞌睡，那么你的健康就不健康。你没有达到应有的水平。联盟中有多少四分卫正在处理同样类型的事情？

paras.en: "This guy's calling the plays. And so Monday we're having this conversation and I just said: We've got to make a change for the betterment of the team.'
paras.zh: “这个人在指挥比赛。所以周一我们进行了这次谈话，我只是说：我们必须做出改变以改善球队。”

paras.en: "The entire team, and offensively think that a change is needed because they see it."
paras.zh: “整个团队，包括进攻端，都认为需要做出改变，因为他们看到了这一点。”

paras.en: Rudolph has started only 19 games in seven seasons with the Steelers and the Tennessee Titans.
paras.zh: 鲁道夫在钢人队和田纳西泰坦队的七个赛季中只首发了 19 场比赛。

articles.title: Trump proposes a new wave of tariffs on China, E.U. and other trade partners
articles.author: Steve Kopack

paras.en: The Trump administration on Wednesday proposed a new wave of tariffs on the European Union, China and other trade partners, the result of a probe into what it says are unfair manufacturing practices.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府周三提议对欧盟、中国和其他贸易伙伴征收新一波关税，这是对其所谓的不公平制造行为进行调查的结果。

paras.en: Some of the proposals include tariffs of at least 20% on China, which would match an agreement reached with the White House. But the duties could reach up to 40% if talks between the two countries fail.
paras.zh: 其中一些提案包括对中国征收至少 20% 的关税，这将符合与白宫达成的协议。但如果两国谈判失败，关税可能高达 40%。

paras.en: The United States’ current trade truce with China was recently extended and is set to expire in January.
paras.zh: 美国与中国目前的贸易休战协议最近被延长，并将于一月份到期。

paras.en: The tariffs will be implemented under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974, a statute that the White House has relied upon more frequently for trade authority ever since the Supreme Court blocked many of Trump’s 2025 country-specific tariffs, imposed under a different authority.
paras.zh: 这些关税将根据 1974 年《贸易法》第 301 条实施，自从最高法院阻止特朗普 2025 年根据不同机构征收的许多针对特定国家的关税以来，白宫更频繁地依赖该法规来获得贸易授权。

paras.en: Wednesday’s announcement came less than a month after Trump’s tariff policies — and the inflation they fueled — contributed to Republicans’ sweeping losses in the midterm elections. Inflation hit 3.7% in September, driven primarily by energy prices, but also by higher prices of goods.
paras.zh: 周三的宣布是在特朗普的关税政策及其引发的通货膨胀导致共和党在中期选举中惨败之后不到一个月发布的。 9 月份通货膨胀率达到 3.7%，主要是由能源价格推动的，但也受到商品价格上涨的推动。

paras.en: In announcing the details of the new duties, U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said that the overall rates applied to each trading partner would not surpass levels that were previously agreed to as part of bilateral framework trade deals.
paras.zh: 美国贸易代表杰米森·格里尔在宣布新关税细节时表示，适用于每个贸易伙伴的总体税率不会超过此前作为双边框架贸易协议一部分商定的水平。

paras.en: “When it all nets out, it really will just top up a few percentage points,” Greer said on CNBC.
paras.zh: 格里尔在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“当一切都结束后，它真的只会增加几个百分点。”

paras.en: “So what we’re proposing today are actually a set of targeted tariffs to respond to this problem of excess capacity,” he added.
paras.zh: “所以我们今天提出的实际上是一系列有针对性的关税，以应对产能过剩问题，”他补充道。

paras.en: For example, Trump agreed to cap tariffs on E.U. imports at 15% as part of a deal reached in 2025. On Wednesday, the trade representative reiterated that cap.
paras.zh: 例如，特朗普同意限制对欧盟的关税。作为 2025 年达成的协议的一部分，进口税率为 15%。周三，贸易代表重申了这一上限。

paras.en: The new tariffs will not stack on top of existing duties, except for the case of China.
paras.zh: 除中国外，新关税不会叠加在现有关税之上。

paras.en: “We’ve talked to our trading partners about this,” Greer said. “They know what we’re proposing. I think a lot of this is baked in, and I don’t think any of these would actually take effect earlier than a couple of months from now.”
paras.zh: “我们已经与我们的贸易伙伴讨论了此事，”格里尔说。 “他们知道我们的提议。我认为其中很多内容已经被考虑在内，而且我认为其中任何一项都不会在几个月后真正生效。”

paras.en: He said he expects that “a broad” negotiation with trading partners would follow Wednesday’s proposals.
paras.zh: 他表示，预计周三的提议后将与贸易伙伴进行“广泛”谈判。

paras.en: But tensions continue to flare with trading partners, especially between Canada, the E.U. and China.
paras.zh: 但与贸易伙伴的紧张关系继续加剧，尤其是加拿大、欧盟之间。和中国。

paras.en: Overnight, a spokesperson for the Chinese Commerce Ministry rejected the basis for the new tariffs. “Tariff wars and trade wars are in the interests of neither side,” the spokesperson said in a briefing for reporters.
paras.zh: 一夜之间，中国商务部发言人否认了新关税的依据。 “关税战和贸易战不符合任何一方的利益，”发言人在向记者通报的情况中表示。

paras.en: “So-called ‘overcapacity’ is a false proposition,” the spokesperson added. “China opposes using it as a pretext for political manipulation.”
paras.zh: “所谓‘产能过剩’是一个伪命题。”该发言人补充道。 “中方反对以此作为政治操纵的借口。”

paras.en: Separately, the European Union said its members “strongly reject the premise that Europe is a source of structural overcapacity. To the contrary, Europe is among those most exposed to overcapacity.”
paras.zh: 另外，欧盟表示，其成员国“强烈反对欧洲是结构性产能过剩根源的前提。相反，欧洲是产能过剩最严重的国家之一。”

paras.en: The bloc shares the Trump administration’s concerns about overcapacity, said Olof Gill, deputy chief spokesman for the the European Commission. Given the mutual concerns, the E.U. regrets “the lack of joint action” with the United States to address the problem.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会副首席发言人奥洛夫·吉尔表示，欧盟与特朗普政府一样对产能过剩感到担忧。考虑到双方的关切，欧盟对与美国“缺乏联合行动”来解决这一问题感到遗憾。

paras.en: Just weeks ago, Greer accused the E.U. of “aggressively” supporting Airbus and said that a loan from the European Investment Bank to the French aerospace giant threatened to inject “substantial uncertainty into transatlantic trade in the aerospace sector.”
paras.zh: 就在几周前，格里尔指责欧盟“积极”支持空客，并表示欧洲投资银行向这家法国航空航天巨头提供的贷款可能会给“航空航天领域的跨大西洋贸易带来巨大的不确定性”。

paras.en: The E.U. rejected Greer’s assertion, saying the loan was normal and he had “really no grounds” to question it. The bloc, made up of 27 countries, is America’s largest trading partner.
paras.zh: 欧盟拒绝了格里尔的说法，称这笔贷款是正常的，他“确实没有理由”质疑。该集团由 27 个国家组成，是美国最大的贸易伙伴。

paras.en: Meanwhile, in August, trade talks with Canada collapsed after Prime Minister Mark Carney said the Trump administration requested “uneconomic” and unfair terms at the last minute.
paras.zh: 与此同时，8月，加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示特朗普政府在最后一刻要求“不经济”且不公平的条款，导致与加拿大的贸易谈判破裂。

paras.en: Carney recalled his negotiators to Ottawa and for more than three months the two sides have traded verbal barbs. Canada is the country’s third-largest trading partner, according to data through September.
paras.zh: 卡尼将他的谈判代表召回渥太华，三个多月以来，双方一直在言语上互相攻击。截至 9 月份的数据显示，加拿大是该国第三大贸易伙伴。

paras.en: Recently, informal talks resumed between the U.S. and Canada but a formal deal does not yet appear to be within reach.
paras.zh: 最近，美国和加拿大之间恢复了非正式谈判，但似乎尚未达成正式协议。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Greer said those talks with Canada were continuing, due to some outstanding “sticking points.”
paras.zh: 周三，格里尔表示，由于存在一些突出的“症结”，与加拿大的谈判仍在继续。

paras.en: Another key U.S. trading partner, Mexico, was not included in Wednesday’s tariff proposals.
paras.zh: 美国另一个主要贸易伙伴墨西哥并未包含在周三的关税提案中。

paras.en: “I think the most important one where we’re still going through the investigation process, is Mexico,” Greer told CNBC. “I think it’ll be a little bit more time before we release that report,” he said.
paras.zh: 格里尔告诉 CNBC：“我认为我们仍在进行调查过程的最重要的国家是墨西哥。” “我认为我们还需要一段时间才能发布该报告，”他说。

articles.title: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine war, new estimate suggests
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed in Ukraine, according to a new projection based on leaked official data, an estimate that sheds new light on the staggering cost of President Vladimir Putin’s war.
paras.zh: 根据泄露的官方数据的最新预测，超过 70 万俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰丧生，这一估计让人们对弗拉基米尔·普京总统的战争造成的惊人成本有了新的认识。

paras.en: The grim assessment comes more than 4½ years after the Kremlin’s invasion of its neighbor, an all-out war that has consumed Russian society. The death toll has been mounting with each painstaking ground assault, with no end to the conflict in sight despite pressure from President Donald Trump for Kyiv to make a deal.
paras.zh: 这一严峻的评估是在克里姆林宫入侵邻国4年半多之后提出的，这场全面战争已经耗尽了俄罗斯社会的精力。随着每一次艰苦的地面进攻，死亡人数一直在增加，尽管唐纳德·特朗普总统向基辅施压要求达成协议，但冲突仍看不到尽头。

paras.en: The leak from Russia’s state statistics agency, Rosstat — released by Belarusian and Ukrainian hackers earlier this month — reveals that at least 490,000 Russian soldiers had been killed in Ukraine based on registered deaths as of the end of September. That’s according to breakdowns by a range of independent media, including the BBC and others, that were published this week. But one exiled Russian media outlet, Meduza, also used the leaked mortality data to project the total number of military deaths, including those that have not yet been recorded.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，白俄罗斯和乌克兰黑客发布了俄罗斯国家统计机构 Rosstat 的泄密信息，显示截至 9 月底，至少有 49 万名俄罗斯士兵在乌克兰被杀。这是根据包括 BBC 等在内的一系列独立媒体本周发布的细分数据得出的。但一家流亡的俄罗斯媒体 Meduza 也利用泄露的死亡率数据来预测军人死亡总数，包括尚未记录的死亡人数。

paras.en: Meduza estimates that number to be 720,000.
paras.zh: Meduza 估计这个数字为 720,000。

paras.en: NBC News did not have access to the leaked data and could not authenticate it or independently confirm these numbers.
paras.zh: NBC News无法访问泄露的数据，也无法对其进行验证或独立确认这些数字。

paras.en: Neither Moscow nor Kyiv provide regular updates on their battlefield losses.
paras.zh: 莫斯科和基辅都没有定期更新其战场损失情况。

paras.en: Mediazona, along with the BBC Russian Service and a team of volunteers, has been compiling a separate named list of Russian war dead using open-source data for years, given the difficulty of gauging the true impact of the war on Russian society.
paras.zh: 鉴于难以衡量战争对俄罗斯社会的真正影响，Mediazona 与 BBC 俄罗斯台和一组志愿者多年来一直在使用开源数据编制一份单独的俄罗斯战争死难者名单。

paras.en: In its analysis, Mediazona said it arrived at the 490,000 war dead number from the 29.7 million records it obtained from the hackers that covered nearly all death registrations in Russia from early 2021 through September this year, based mainly on records with an “explicit military cause of death” and court rulings declaring people dead.
paras.zh: Mediazona 在分析中表示，它从黑客处获得的 2970 万条记录中得出了 49 万人的战争死亡人数，这些记录几乎涵盖了俄罗斯从 2021 年初到今年 9 月的所有死亡登记，主要依据的是“明确的军事死因”记录和宣布死亡的法院裁决。

paras.en: The leaked data was cross-checked against Mediazona’s own named list and matched 95% of the records, as well as the publicly accessible national Probate Registry, a database of inheritance cases, and Rosstat’s own official mortality statistics, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体称，泄露的数据与 Mediazona 自己的名单、可公开访问的国家遗嘱认证登记处、继承案件数据库以及 Rosstat 自己的官方死亡率统计数据进行了交叉核对，并与 95% 的记录相匹配。

paras.en: Mediazona said it also checked against possible data tempering and fake military death injections by cross-referencing a unique vital record number that every death registration carries, and court rulings, which often cite death record numbers.
paras.zh: Mediazona 表示，它还通过交叉引用每个死亡登记所携带的独特生命记录编号以及法院裁决（通常引用死亡记录编号）来检查可能的数据篡改和虚假的军事死亡注射。

paras.en: “We are confident that this data is genuine,” the outlet said, adding that fabricating a dataset of this scale from scratch would be “impossible” especially as it checks out against official registries.
paras.zh: 该媒体表示：“我们相信这些数据是真实的。”他补充说，从头开始制作如此规模的数据集是“不可能的”，尤其是在与官方登记处进行核对时。

paras.en: The hackers shared leaked data with a number of other exiled Russian media outlets and the BBC, who all arrived at a figure close to the 490,000 reported by Mediazona. A similar estimate of half a million Russian troops killed was also shared by a senior British defense official in September.
paras.zh: 黑客与其他一些流亡的俄罗斯媒体和 BBC 分享了泄露的数据，这些媒体得出的数据接近 Mediazona 报道的 49 万。 9月份，一位英国高级国防官员也做出了类似的估计，有50万俄罗斯士兵被杀。

paras.en: Before the new analysis of the data in the Rosstat leak, the verified named list of Russia’s war dead compiled by Mediazona and the BBC stood at just over 289,000. It was based on obituaries, local news and official registries, and was the only publicly available database containing the fallen soldiers’ names.
paras.zh: 在对 Rosstat 泄露的数据进行新分析之前，Mediazona 和 BBC 编制的经核实的俄罗斯战死者名单刚刚超过 289,000 人。它基于讣告、当地新闻和官方登记，是唯一包含阵亡士兵姓名的公开数据库。

paras.en: The Russian Defense Ministry has not officially updated its death toll in Ukraine since the early months of the war, when then-Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu said it stood at nearly 6,000.
paras.zh: 自战争爆发的最初几个月以来，俄罗斯国防部一直没有正式更新乌克兰境内的死亡人数，当时时任国防部长谢尔盖·绍伊古称乌克兰死亡人数接近 6,000 人。

paras.en: Mediazona warned that due to a considerable lag in military death registrations, Rosstat may not yet have finished capturing deaths from 2025. “That means the leaked records through late September — however authentic and reliable they are — still fall short of the true death toll,” it said.
paras.zh: Mediazona 警告说，由于军事死亡登记存在相当大的滞后性，Rosstat 可能尚未完成 2025 年以来的死亡人数统计。“这意味着截至 9 月底的泄露记录——无论它们多么真实可靠——仍然低于真实的死亡人数，”它说。

paras.en: It was this that prompted Meduza to try and calculate an estimate of total Russian losses to date — 720,000 people, a figure that includes deaths it predicts will be registered later.
paras.zh: 正是这一点促使 Meduza 尝试计算迄今为止俄罗斯总损失的估计数——72 万人，其中包括预计稍后登记的死亡人数。

paras.en: “Since 2024, the share of late registrations has grown dramatically, and it continues to rise,” the outlet said in its own analysis, adding that the 2026 data is extremely incomplete for both missing service members and other military deaths. It said it used epidemiology and tools like the “chain-ladder method” from actuarial science, which uses mathematics to help measure the probability and risk of future events, to arrive at the projected estimate. These methods allowed Meduza to calculate the number of military deaths that it estimates have happened but haven’t yet shown up in the data, the outlet said.
paras.zh: 该媒体在自己的分析中表示：“自 2024 年以来，延迟登记的比例急剧增加，而且还在继续上升。”并补充说，2026 年的数据对于失踪军人和其他军人死亡来说都极其不完整。该公司表示，它使用了流行病学和精算科学中的“链梯法”等工具，利用数学来帮助衡量未来事件的概率和风险，以得出预计的估计。该媒体称，这些方法使 Meduza 能够计算出其估计已发生但尚未显示在数据中的军人死亡人数。

paras.en: “Today, it’s simply impossible to leave this category out of an overall estimate of the dead,” it added.
paras.zh: 报告补充说：“今天，根本不可能将这一类别排除在对死亡人数的总体估计之外。”

paras.en: The Kremlin dismissed the analysis Wednesday.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫周三驳回了这一分析。

paras.en: “The only department authorized to officially release data on casualties is the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation,” spokesman Dmitry Peskov told NBC News during a call with reporters, when asked if the Kremlin was aware of the 700,000 projected estimate by Meduza.
paras.zh: 当被问及克里姆林宫是否知道 Meduza 预计的 70 万人伤亡时，发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫 (Dmitry Peskov) 在与记者通话时告诉 NBC 新闻：“唯一有权正式发布伤亡数据的部门是俄罗斯联邦国防部。”

paras.en: “I suggest disregarding any other data,” he added.
paras.zh: “我建议忽略任何其他数据，”他补充道。

paras.en: It is similarly difficult to ascertain the true number of Ukrainian soldiers killed fighting against Russia. Kyiv has been slightly more forthcoming, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy volunteering some estimates of battlefield losses in recent years, the latest in July putting the total at around 50,000 killed.
paras.zh: 同样难以确定在与俄罗斯的战斗中阵亡的乌克兰士兵的真实人数。基辅的态度稍显坦诚，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基(Volodymyr Zelenskyy)自愿提供了对近年来战场损失的一些估计，最近一次是在7月，死亡总数约为5万人。

paras.en: But analysts say this is likely an undercount.
paras.zh: 但分析人士表示，这可能是低估的。

paras.en: An assessment by the Washington-based Center for Strategic and International Studies earlier this year said up to 150,000 Ukrainian soldiers have been killed, based on estimates from Britain’s military, Mediazona’s named war dead list, its own estimates and interviews with U.S., European, Ukrainian and other government officials.
paras.zh: 总部位于华盛顿的战略与国际研究中心今年早些时候的一项评估称，根据英国军方的估计、Mediazona 公布的战争死亡名单、该中心自己的估计以及对美国、欧洲、乌克兰和其他政府官员的采访，多达 15 万名乌克兰士兵被杀。

articles.title: A rising political star in China is the latest victim of Xi’s purge
articles.author: Max Burman

paras.en: He was on the rise among China’s political elite, hosting tech leaders and senior American officials. But now Shanghai party chief Chen Jining, a member of the country’s influential politburo, appears to be the latest senior official brought down by President Xi Jinping’s sweeping purge.
paras.zh: 他在中国政治精英中崭露头角，接待过科技领袖和美国高级官员。但现在，具有影响力的中国政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁似乎是习近平主席全面清洗下台的最新一位高级官员。

paras.en: The hammer unexpectedly came down on Chen in the form of a two-line bulletin on the Xinhua news agency Tuesday: He is “suspected of serious violations of Party discipline and law and is currently under disciplinary review and supervisory investigation” — a common euphemism for corruption crackdowns on ruling Communist Party officials under Xi.
paras.zh: 新华社周二发布的两行公报出人意料地对陈进行了打击：他“涉嫌严重违纪违法，目前正接受纪律审查和监察调查”——这是习近平领导下的反腐败行动的常见委婉说法。

paras.en: Public announcements such as these usually mark the end of a political career in China. Chen has made no public statement.
paras.zh: 诸如此类的公开声明通常标志着中国政治生涯的结束。陈没有发表公开声明。

paras.en: He is the fourth politburo member to be purged in less than two years, part of a broader crackdown that has swept aside top military leaders as Xi consolidates power. He is set to extend his rule next year, at a party congress that is held once every five years and looms over the preceding months.
paras.zh: He is the fourth politburo member to be purged in less than two years, part of a broader crackdown that has swept aside top military leaders as Xi consolidates power.他计划在明年召开的党代表大会上延长他的统治，党代表大会每五年举行一次，并在前几个月举行。

paras.en: But Chen’s abrupt downfall took many close observers of China by surprise, given his profile and career path would usually point to a bright future.
paras.zh: 但陈的突然垮台让许多密切关注中国的观察人士感到惊讶，因为他的个人资料和职业道路通常预示着光明的未来。

paras.en: “He was potentially going to the highest level, which would be the standing committee. And I think from a lot of Western observers, people thought he had even better prospects,” Damien Ma, the Singapore-based director of the Carnegie China think tank, told NBC News.
paras.zh: “他有可能晋升到最高级别，即常务委员会。我认为，从很多西方观察家的角度来看，人们认为他有更好的前景，”卡内基中国智囊团驻新加坡主任马达明告诉美国全国广播公司新闻。

paras.en: Some analysts have speculated that Xi, increasingly viewed as likely to rule for life, may have been purging a viable replacement. Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute in London, said however that Chen was “someone who could rise further but not as a successor.”
paras.zh: 一些分析人士推测，越来越被认为有可能实现终身统治的习近平可能正在清除一个可行的替代者。然而，伦敦亚非学院中国研究所所长曾锐生表示，陈是“可以进一步晋升的人，但不是接班人”。

paras.en: Chen, a 62-year-old technocrat known as a friend of foreign business and an advocate for AI, was an environmental scientist who studied in London and swiftly rose through the party’s ranks. He served as China’s environmental minister, Beijing’s mayor and the party secretary in Shanghai — a post once held by Xi and widely considered a stepping stone to bigger things.
paras.zh: 陈是一位 62 岁的技术官僚，被誉为外国企业的朋友和人工智能的倡导者，他是一位环境科学家，曾在伦敦学习并迅速在党内晋升。他曾担任中国环境部部长、北京市市长和上海市委书记——习近平曾担任过这一职位，并被广泛认为是实现更大目标的垫脚石。

paras.en: Just last month, Chen hosted Apple Chairman Tim Cook, welcoming the U.S. tech giant to “make full use of Shanghai’s strengths” and bring more products to the city, a financial and cultural hub that has long served as a connection between China and the international community.
paras.zh: 就在上个月，陈云接待了苹果公司董事长蒂姆·库克，欢迎这家美国科技巨头“充分利用上海的优势”，为这座长期作为中国与国际社会联系的金融和文化中心的城市带来更多产品。

paras.en: In his last public appearance last week, during a tour of a shipping facility, Chen called for advancing the industry’s digital transformation.
paras.zh: 在上周视察一家航运设施时，陈吉宁在最后一次公开露面中呼吁推进该行业的数字化转型。

paras.en: By Wednesday, Chen’s name has been removed from some official websites. A webpage on the Shanghai government site showing that meeting with Cook is now showing a 404 message, or not found.
paras.zh: 截至周三，陈的名字已从一些官方网站上删除。上海市政府网站上显示与库克会面的网页现在显示404消息，或者没有找到。

paras.en: Chen is just the latest senior official in the crosshairs of Xi’s long-running anti-corruption campaign and emphasis on party discipline, which analysts say is as much about loyalty as it is about reform.
paras.zh: 陈只是习近平长期反腐运动和强调党纪的最新一位高级官员，分析人士表示，这既关乎改革，也关乎忠诚。

paras.en: “It is a warning to all technocrats, as Chen was a rising star among technocrats and had no apparent failures in a technocratic way. So, message is: adhere to strict party discipline and demonstrate unquestionable loyalty to Xi or else,” Tsang said.
paras.zh: “这是对所有技术官僚的警告，因为陈是技术官僚中的后起之秀，在技术官僚方面没有明显的失败。因此，传达的信息是：遵守严格的党纪，并对习近平或其他人表现出毫无疑问的忠诚，”曾荫权说。

paras.en: The party’s Central Committee, which has about 200 mostly male leaders, vowed to “ensure more rigorous discipline enforcement, and make full use of discipline as a guide, restraint, guarantee, and incentive” at its closed-door gathering, the fifth plenum, last month.
paras.zh: 由约200名主要领导人组成的党中央在上个月举行的五中全会闭门会议上誓言要“更加严格执行纪律，充分发挥纪律的引领作用、约束作用、保障作用和激励作用”。

paras.en: “What they’ve been building as part of this discipline machine over the last 15 years is to kind of implement their sort of internal operating system of how they deal with, let’s say, bad eggs within the party,” Ma, of Carnegie China, said.
paras.zh: 卡内基中国的马云表示：“过去 15 年里，他们一直在建立一套纪律机制，以实施他们如何处理党内坏蛋的内部操作系统。”

paras.en: “The top leadership is normalizing this anti-corruption, this self-cleansing,” Ma said. “It is now a normal part of what the party expects, and they’re trying to embed that over time and down to every single level,” he added.
paras.zh: 马云表示：“最高领导层正在将这种反腐败、这种自我净化常态化。” “现在，这是党期望的正常部分，他们正试图随着时间的推移将其融入到各个层面，”他补充道。

paras.en: The Chinese government has not announced any charges against Chen, who was the youngest member of the country’s elite decision-making body. The 24-member Politburo was unveiled in 2022 but is now down to 21 members after the purges. Last month, top general Zhang Shengmin was elevated to the body in a rare addition.
paras.zh: 中国政府尚未宣布对陈提出任何指控，他是中国精英决策机构中最年轻的成员。由 24 名成员组成的政治局于 2022 年揭晓，但在清洗后目前已减少至 21 名。上个月，最高将领张胜民罕见地晋升为正职。

paras.en: Chen’s undoing comes a year before the party’s top leadership is reshuffled at the 21st Communist Party Congress, when Xi is expected to solidify control even further and cement another five-year term at the helm of the country.
paras.zh: 陈的下台发生在中共第二十一次全国代表大会上对党的最高领导层进行改组的一年前，届时习近平预计将进一步巩固控制权，并巩固国家的另一个五年任期。

paras.en: Born in 1964, Chen studied at the prestigious Tsinghua university, long a major pipeline for senior party officials and where he served as president from 2012 to 2015. His name has now been removed from Tsinghua’s online list of former presidents.
paras.zh: 陈出生于 1964 年，曾就读于著名的清华大学，清华大学长期以来一直是党的高级官员的主要培养人才，并于 2012 年至 2015 年担任校长。他的名字现已从清华大学的在线前校长名单中删除。

paras.en: After studying at Tsinghua in the 1980s, he moved for a decade to Britain, where he obtained a doctorate from Imperial College London in 1993.
paras.zh: 20世纪80年代在清华大学学习后，他移居英国十年，并于1993年在伦敦帝国理工学院获得博士学位。

paras.en: Chen returned to Tsinghua’s environmental science and engineering department in 1998 before being named the university’s president in 2012, according to an official biography.
paras.zh: 据官方传记称，陈于 1998 年回到清华大学环境科学与工程系，并于 2012 年被任命为清华大学校长。

paras.en: He’s authored dozens of papers, including on carbon emission reduction and water quality monitoring.
paras.zh: 他撰写了数十篇论文，包括有关碳减排和水质监测的论文。

paras.en: The relatively young Chen would ride around campus on his bike and built a reputation for pushing institutional reforms in his three years at the helm of the university, according to an article in People’s Digest, a magazine affiliated with the People’s Daily, the community party’s official newspaper.
paras.zh: 据共产党官方报纸《人民日报》旗下杂志《人民文摘》上的一篇文章称，相对年轻的陈经常骑着自行车在校园里骑车，并在执掌大学的三年里因推动体制改革而建立了声誉。

paras.en: The article, titled “From University President to Cabinet Minister,” was published in 2015, the same year he was picked to lead the Environmental Protection Ministry. In 2017, Chen became mayor of the capital, Beijing, where he oversaw the 2022 Winter Olympics during the Covid pandemic.
paras.zh: 这篇题为《从大学校长到内阁部长》的文章发表于 2015 年，同年他被选为环境保护部部长。 2017年，陈就任首都北京市市长，并在新冠病毒大流行期间监督了2022年冬季奥运会的举办。

paras.en: Later that year he was transferred to Shanghai and became the party chief, a coveted role that Xi took on himself in 2007 before becoming the country’s leader in 2013.
paras.zh: 同年晚些时候，他被调到上海，成为市委书记，这是习近平在 2013 年成为国家领导人之前于 2007 年亲自担任的令人垂涎的职位。

paras.en: There, he became heavily involved with the tech industry, regularly hosting CEOs and advocating for more investment into Shanghai, where the World AI Conference was hosted earlier this year.
paras.zh: 在那里，他积极参与科技行业，定期接待首席执行官，并倡导对今年早些时候举办世界人工智能大会的上海进行更多投资。

paras.en: Chen hosted Elon Musk in 2023 to discuss Tesla’s operations in the city. Last year, he accompanied Xi to an AI hub there. And last month, Chen met with several European tech leaders, in addition to hosting Cook.
